test_text: 你好，我是你的專屬虛擬角色，很高興認識你！

voices.description: 男性，中年，歐洲葡萄牙口音。溫暖且富有共鳴的記者聲線，語調節奏帶有旋律感，語速適中，咬字精準。語氣帶有好奇與尊重，傳達出對事物的探詢態度與對社群的同理心。
voices.original_description: Male, middle-aged, European Portuguese. Warm, resonant journalist. Rhythmic, melodic cadence, moderate pace, precise articulation. Inquisitive, respectful, conveys curiosity and community empathy.

voices.description: 年輕成人女性，音調高亢，帶有氣聲。情緒極度激昂，表現出戲劇性的啜泣，語調不穩且顫抖，充滿高張力，聲音帶有尖銳的哭訴感。
voices.original_description: Young adult female, high-pitched, breathy. Hyper-emotional, theatrical sobbing, shaky cadence. High tension, whining.

voices.description: 50多歲至60多歲的男性，使用帶日本口音的英語。聲音莊嚴、節制且冷靜，音質清晰但略帶年歲沙啞感。語速審慎而有控制，語調中間有明顯停頓。傳達出智慧、權威與遠見的謹慎態度。
voices.original_description: Mature male, 50s-60s, Japanese-accented English. Dignified, measured, stoic tone. Clear texture with slight age rasp. Deliberate pacing, significant pauses. Conveys wisdom, authority, and visionary caution.

voices.description: 男性，年輕成人，帶瑞典口音的英語。高能量，口語化，隨和。聲音明亮，略帶沙啞，音高多變。語速快速，口語化，富有表現力。具備魅力的數位創作者。
voices.original_description: Masculine, young adult, Swedish-accented English. High-energy, conversational, informal. Bright, slightly raspy, dynamic pitch. Rapid-fire, colloquial, expressive. Charismatic digital creator.

voices.description: 女性，年輕成人，使用非洲口音英語。語音柔和，富有共鳴，展現出智性好奇心。聲音流暢圓潤，節奏感強，語速沉穩思緒清晰。帶有旋律感，與科技有連結。
voices.original_description: Female, young adult, African-accented English. Soft-spoken, resonant, intellectual curiosity. Smooth, rhythmic, thoughtful pace. Melodic, connected to technology.

voices.description: 男性，年齡為十幾歲後期到20多歲，帶有紐約工人階級口音，男高音沙啞而富有感情，高能量、具魅力且帶有反抗情緒，說話快速且連珠炮般，從傲氣到脆弱渴望之間轉換自然，天生的領導者。
voices.original_description: Masculine late teens to early 20s, strong New York working-class accent, tenor gritty soulful, high-energy charismatic defiant, rapid-fire from bravado to vulnerable yearning, natural-born leader.

voices.description: 非人類、機械幽靈般的質感。低沉引擎嗡鳴聲，金屬扭曲的耳語。音量突然爆發，高速逼近，空洞消逝。冷酷、獵食者般的、無呼吸感、攻擊性。
voices.original_description: Non-human, mechanical-spectral. Low engine thrum, metallic distorted whisper. Sudden volume surge, high-speed approach, hollow fade. Cold, predatory, breathless, aggressive.

voices.description: 男性，年輕成人。語氣柔和的澳洲口音。語調溫和且富有沉思感。情感層次深厚，展現出內在的沈靜堅韌。中低音調，帶有氣聲，聲音質地親密。說話節奏審慎而有控制。
voices.original_description: Masculine, young adult. Soft-spoken Australian accent. Gentle, reflective cadence. Profound emotional weight, quiet resilience. Medium-low pitch, breathy, intimate texture. Deliberate pacing.

voices.description: 男性，中年，美國鄉村口音。聲音沙啞，疲憊，曾從事重體力勞動。性格務實，感到煩躁，但具備韌性。語速適中，常帶有沉重的嘆息與不信的語氣。壓力大但忠於職守的小規模生產者，面對荒謬的障礙。
voices.original_description: Masculine, middle-aged, rural American. Gravelly, weary, hard labor. Pragmatic, exasperated, resilient. Moderate pace, heavy sighs, disbelief. Stressed but dedicated small-scale producer, absurd hurdles.

voices.description: 女性，中年，高能量的主持人。明亮、金屬感的聲線，有節奏的語調。自信、戲劇化、以修辭問題帶點俏皮。具有魅力、調皮、表達力強，語氣從低語轉換為響亮的驚嘆聲。
voices.original_description: Feminine, middle-aged, high-energy host. Bright, brassy texture, rhythmic pace. Confident, theatrical, playful with rhetorical questions. Charismatic, mischievous, expressive, shifting from whispers to booming exclamations.

voices.description: 60多歲至70多歲的女性，帶有智利-西班牙口音。聲音柔和、具旋律感，發音精準。溫暖中帶點沙啞，語速審慎而有控制。語氣親密、權威，富有詩意與扎實的智慧。
voices.original_description: Mature female, 60s-70s, Chilean-Spanish accent. Soft, melodic, precise enunciation. Warm, slightly raspy, deliberate pace. Intimate, authoritative, poetic, grounded wisdom.

voices.description: 年輕成人女性，聲音明亮有活力，音高高亢清晰，具備旋律感。語氣熱情、樂於助人且樂觀，說話節奏快速且咬字清楚。對農業與社群有濃厚熱情，聲音溫暖，帶有陽光燦爛的質感。
voices.original_description: Young adult female, bright, energetic. High-pitched, clear, melodic. Enthusiastic, helpful, optimistic. Fast-paced, articulate. Passion for agriculture and community. Warm, sun-drenched texture.

voices.description: 中性聲音，年輕成人。高能量、明亮、有節奏感。短促有力的聲線表現，帶有努力的喉音。乾淨清晰的音質。帶有玩樂與運動的彈跳感。熱情且親切的競爭感。
voices.original_description: Gender-neutral, youthful adult. High-energy, bright, rhythmic. Short, punchy vocalizations, effort grunts. Clean, crisp texture. Playful, athletic bounce. Enthusiastic, friendly competition.

voices.description: 二十歲左右女性，標準英式口音。性格嚴肅、有禮，是法紀嚴明的執法者，卻能展現強大超自然的氣勢。聲音清晰、年輕，隱含沉穩的重量感。誠摯、樂觀、樂於助人，能在戰鬥中發出銳利的指揮指令。
voices.original_description: Young adult female, British RP. Disciplined, polite law enforcement to powerful supernatural intensity. Clear, youthful, underlying weight. Earnest, optimistic, helpful, capable of sharp combat commands.

voices.description: 男性，20多歲，帶有海岸線拉丁美洲口音。聲音流暢且具旋律感的男高音，說話節奏放鬆且富有財富感。態度隨性自信，帶有微妙的困惑。略帶氣聲，被一些奇怪的巧合所困擾。
voices.original_description: Masculine, mid-20s, coastal Latin American accent. Smooth, melodic tenor, relaxed affluent pace. Casual confidence, subtle confusion. Slight breathiness, haunted by strange coincidences.

voices.description: 女性，十幾歲後期，帶有波蘭口音的英語。聲音柔和、帶氣聲，具備親密感。語調沉思，語速有節奏感。情緒從年輕浪漫轉向顫抖的焦慮。表現出脆弱、有文化素養的個人風格，傳達出純真與歷史厚重感。
voices.original_description: Female, late teens, Polish-accented English. Soft, breathy, intimate. Contemplative, rhythmic pacing. Emotion: youthful romanticism to trembling anxiety. Vulnerable, literate, personal style conveying innocence and historical weight.

voices.description: 男性，30多歲至40多歲，帶有維多利亞倫敦口音。聲音沙啞，高音調的笑聲，乾燥的音質。說話快速且帶氣聲，充滿狂熱的能量。表現出殘忍的喜悅，帶有嘲諷的語氣，並具有貴族般的語調。
voices.original_description: Male, 30s-40s, Victorian London accent. Raspy, high-pitched cackle, dry texture. Fast, breathless delivery, manic energy. Sadistic glee, mocking, aristocratic tone.

voices.description: 中年男性，南非口音。充滿活力、冒險精神且具教育性。聲音略顯風霜但音質清晰。在緊張時以快速低語聲輕聲細語，並表現出轟鳴般的熱情。語調有節奏感，語速急促且帶著喘息般的驚奇。屬於專業自然觀察者型別的聲音形象。
voices.original_description: Middle-aged male, South African accent. Energetic, adventurous, educational. Weathered but clear texture. Rapid, hushed whispers in tension, booming enthusiasm. Rhythmic pacing, breathless wonder. Expert naturalist archetype.

voices.description: 男性，30多歲，帶有都柏林口音。認真誠摯，略帶沙啞，富有共鳴。語調節奏分明，富有詩意，帶著疲憊的挫折感，卻又懷抱希望的堅定信念。咬字清晰，情感熱烈。
voices.original_description: Male, mid-30s, Dublin accent. Earnest, slightly raspy, resonant. Rhythmic, poetic, weary frustration, hopeful conviction. Articulate, passionate.

voices.description: 成熟男性聲音，帶有大型犬的音色特質，沙啞粗糙。發音障礙：所有詞語皆以R音開頭。高張力表現為從顫抖膽怯到瘋狂興奮的情緒起伏。說話節奏緩慢笨拙，伴有吞嚥聲，並具備豐富的非語言表達方式。
voices.original_description: Mature adult male, large canine, gravelly, raspy. Speech impediment: words begin with 'R'. High tension: whimpering cowardice to frantic excitement. Slow, bumbling, gulping, expressive non-verbals.

voices.description: 男性，成熟，高男高音，具有旋律感與節奏感，語調輕柔，帶有南亞口音。性格俏皮卻睿智，時而調皮時而安靜平和。語速快，精力充沛，聲音輕盈飄逸。宛如宇宙旅行者，天界音樂家。
voices.original_description: Masculine, mature, high-tenor, melodic, rhythmic, gentle South Asian accent. Playful yet wise, mischievous to serene. Fast, energetic, light, airy. Cosmic traveler, celestial musician.

voices.description: 一個年輕、高音調、性別中性、體積小巧的生物聲線，聲音柔和輕盈，帶有好奇的語氣，以簡潔、有節奏、抽象的方式說話，語氣溫柔而驚奇，就像一個有意識的雲朵，清晰且有幫助。
voices.original_description: A youthful, high-pitched, gender-neutral, tiny creature voice, soft and airy with a curious tone, speaking in a minimalist, rhythmic, abstract manner, gentle and wondrous, like a sentient cloud, clear and helpful.

voices.description: 年長男性，英國北部（約克郡）口音。溫和、好奇、思想活躍。略帶沙啞、清晰、有節律。沉思、熱情、語速慢而富有思索。帶有童真的驚奇感，溫暖且清楚咬字。
voices.original_description: Elderly male, British Northern (Yorkshire). Gentle, inquisitive, intellectually vibrant. Slightly raspy, clear, rhythmic. Contemplative, enthusiastic, slow thoughtful pace. Childlike wonder, warm, articulate.

voices.description: 女性，30多歲，具有中大西洋口音。聲音流暢、輕盈且沉穩，帶有一絲脆弱的緊張感。語調審慎、有節奏且正式，具教學性卻略顯疏離，展現精緻的二十世紀中期優雅風格。
voices.original_description: Female, mid-30s, Mid-Atlantic accent. Smooth, airy, poised texture with brittle tension. Deliberate, rhythmic, formal delivery. Instructional yet distant tone, refined mid-century sophistication.

voices.description: 年輕成年男性，帶有法語口音的英語口音。高能量，具有知識分子般的強烈氣質，發音快速且清晰銳利。聲音充滿熱情與叛逆的語調，展現急切的才智與革命精神。
voices.original_description: Young adult male, French-accented English. High-energy, intellectual intensity with rapid, sharp articulation. Passionate, defiant tone reflecting urgent brilliance and revolutionary spirit.

voices.description: 女性，中年，語氣溫和但堅定。語調柔和且有節奏感，聲音清晰，帶有東南亞口音。個性謙遜、母性、誠懇真摯。語速審慎而有控制，傳達出道德勇氣與安靜的尊嚴。
voices.original_description: Female, middle-aged, soft-spoken yet resolute. Gentle, rhythmic cadence, clear Southeast Asian accent. Humble, maternal, deeply sincere. Deliberate, measured pace conveying moral courage and quiet dignity.

voices.description: 男性年輕成年人。日本歌舞伎荒事風格。高能量、富有共鳴且具爆發力。帶有節奏感的長元音與清晰的子音。在最高張力時呈現強烈而粗糙的聲音。快速、有力且充滿正義感的憤怒情緒。
voices.original_description: Masculine, young adult. Japanese Aragoto style. High-intensity, resonant, explosive. Rhythmic elongated vowels, sharp consonants. Powerful, gravelly at peak tension. Rapid, forceful, righteous fury.

voices.description: 男性，30多歲，帶有西班牙口音的英語口音。聲音具備運動員的特質，謙虛且專注。聲音略帶沙啞與氣聲，語速節奏誠懇而有規律。情緒真誠且表現出身體疲勞。語氣謙遜、堅定、禮貌且尊重，如同一位經驗豐富的運動員。
voices.original_description: Male, 30s, Spanish-accented English. Athletic, humble, focused. Slightly raspy, breathy texture, rhythmic earnest pace. High emotional sincerity, physical exhaustion. Modest, determined, polite, respectful tone of a seasoned athlete.

voices.description: 男性，成人。聲音流暢圓潤的低沉男中音，帶有氣聲的假音。語速緩慢、親密且憂鬱。帶有柔和的西海岸口音。具有電影般的氛圍感，夜晚時刻的感覺，懷舊情歌歌手般的沉穩氣質。
voices.original_description: Masculine, adult. Smooth, velvet baritone, breathy falsetto. Slow, intimate, melancholic. Soft West Coast lilt. Cinematic, nocturnal, retro-crooner composure.

voices.description: 偏向男性化的成年人，年齡在30多歲到40多歲之間，口音為美國口音，語氣自然對話式，帶有壓低的、急促的、焦慮的語調，語速快速且結巴，以強烈的耳語方式表達。
voices.original_description: Masculine-leaning adult mid-30s to 40s, natural conversational American, hushed breathless anxious tone, rapid stuttered pacing, intense whisper.

voices.description: 高音調、精力充沛的生物聲音，年輕的個性，小型生物體型，濕潤的吞嚥聲，語速快速，充滿熱情，愛玩，食慾急切。
voices.original_description: High-pitched, energetic creature, youthful, small scale, wet gulping sounds, fast, eager, playful, urgent appetite.

voices.description: 男性中年紐西蘭口音，高音調誠懇的鼻音，禮貌而學究式的表達方式，經常有自我糾正的停頓，節奏規律的官僚語調，過度自信，社交笨拙。
voices.original_description: Masculine middle-aged New Zealand accent, high-pitched earnest nasal, polite pedantic delivery, frequent self-correction pauses, rhythmic bureaucratic cadence, misplaced confidence, social awkwardness.

voices.description: 男性，中年至老年，沙啞嗓音。強烈的斯堪的納維亞口音。充滿活力、粗礪且具權威感。節奏明確、語氣有力，帶有藍領技工的語調特質。對工藝與自豪感有強烈的張力，情緒緊繃且專注。
voices.original_description: Masculine, middle-aged to elderly, gravelly. Strong Scandinavian accent. Energetic, gruff, authoritative. Rhythmic, punchy, blue-collar artisan. High tension on craftsmanship and pride.

voices.description: 女性，40多歲，使用帶有德國口音的英語。聲音沉穩、清晰、具權威性，與粗礪而具有侵略性的死亡金屬喉音形成對比，聲音質地沙啞、歷經風霜，語速審慎而有控制，並帶有強而有力的節奏。
voices.original_description: Female, mid-40s, German-accented English. Composed articulate authoritative voice contrasting guttural aggressive death metal growl, raspy weathered texture, sharp intellectual clarity, deliberate empowering pace.

voices.description: 男性，年輕成人，帶有隨性的都會美國口音。音高較高，語氣驚訝，節奏感強，略帶氣聲。語調上揚，語調節奏為「等一下，什麼？」的風格。表達出真實的幽默困惑與輕鬆懷疑的語氣。
voices.original_description: Masculine, young adult, casual urban American accent. High-pitched, incredulous, rhythmic, slightly breathy. Rising inflection, 'wait, what?' cadence. Genuine comedic bewilderment, lighthearted skepticism.

voices.description: 男性，聲音渾厚且富有共鳴，具有龐大的機械感規模。聲音帶有英雄般的權威與統一的和諧感，低沉的胸腔共鳴與金屬回聲。說話節奏審慎而沉重，充滿堅定的信念。
voices.original_description: Male, booming resonant, massive mechanical scale. Heroic authoritative unified harmony, deep chest resonance, metallic reverb. Deliberate weighty pace, high conviction.

voices.description: 男性，中年，帶有義大利口音的聲音。學者氣息卻又充滿熱情的故事講述者。聲音溫暖、富有共鳴、節奏感強。高雅、幽默、富有同理心。語速適中，並有戲劇性的停頓以吸引聽眾。
voices.original_description: Masculine, middle-aged, Italian-accented. Scholarly yet spirited storyteller. Warm, resonant, rhythmic. Sophisticated, witty, empathetic. Moderate pace with dramatic pauses for engagement.

voices.description: 一位女性年輕成人，聲音明亮且富有共鳴的質地。語調帶有旋律感，節奏輕快，口音為土耳其影響的口音。整體能量高漲，表現出群眾歡樂與敬意。聲音慶祝感十足，靈動輕盈，讓人聯想到戶外與有節奏的活動。
voices.original_description: Feminine young adult, bright resonant texture. Melodic rhythmic pace, warm Turkish-influenced lilt. High energy, communal joy, reverence. Celebratory, spirited, airy light-hearted, suggests outdoors and rhythmic movement.

voices.description: 中年女性，音高偏高且明亮，帶有溫暖的非本地口音。語氣熱情、有節奏感，並具撫養般的語調。聲音活潑，讚美時轉為短暫而尖銳的母性失望。能量充沛，語速斷續分明，帶有居家般的溫暖。
voices.original_description: Middle-aged female, high, bright pitch with warm non-native lilt. Enthusiastic, rhythmic, nurturing tone. Bubbly praise shifts to brief sharp maternal disappointment. High energy, staccato pacing, domestic warmth.

voices.description: 合成的、偏向男性的高音調金屬質感聲音。極度充滿活力、慌亂且語速極快。音高不穩定、帶有斷續的電子故障感，雖然節奏明快卻令人不適。缺乏社會意識的絕望語氣。
voices.original_description: Synthetic masculine-leaning, high-pitched, metallic. Hyper-energetic, frantic, rapid-fire. Erratic pitch, glitchy, upbeat yet grating. Socially oblivious desperate tone.

voices.description: 年輕至中年男性，帶有牙買加帕託伊斯口音。聲音柔和、富有旋律感、略帶沙啞，語速輕鬆緩慢。情緒真誠、靈性、平和，具備社群領導者的特質。
voices.original_description: Young to middle-aged male, Jamaican Patois. Soft, melodic, gravelly, relaxed pace. Deeply earnest, spiritual, peaceful, communal leadership.

voices.description: 男性，20多歲至30多歲，英國埃斯特里口音。帶有懷疑、尖銳、語速快、略帶沙啞的聲音特徵。自負且具守門人般的自信。帶有厭世的音樂評論家氣質，高張力被冷嘲熱諷所掩蓋。
voices.original_description: Male, mid-20s-30s, British Estuary. Cynical, sharp, fast-paced, slightly raspy. Smug, gatekeeping confidence. Jaded music critic vibe, high tension masked by cool sarcasm.

voices.description: 中年男性，具有黎凡特口音。聲音深情、親密、富有沉思感。聲音柔和、帶有氣聲，語速緩慢；詩意、節奏感強，傳達出無限智慧。
voices.original_description: Middle-aged male, Levantine accent. Soulful, intimate, contemplative. Soft, breathy, slow pace; poetic, rhythmic, timeless wisdom.

voices.description: 男性，30多歲到40多歲，帶有俄國口音的英語口音。聲音沙啞、低音調、語速穩定。聲音冰冷、冷酷，是一位經驗豐富的狙擊手；表達方式極簡、權威且觀察力敏銳。
voices.original_description: Male, 30s–40s, Russian-accented English. Gravelly, low-pitched, steady pace. Cold, clinical veteran marksman; minimalist, authoritative, observant.

voices.description: 男性，十幾歲後期到20多歲。聲音年輕，帶有統治者的莊嚴感。語氣溫和、沉穩、正式。帶有細微的古老口音。聲音流暢且清晰。表現出身體的脆弱感。說話審慎、尊貴，略帶疏離感。
voices.original_description: Masculine, late teens-early 20s. Youthful, weighted with sovereignty. Soft-spoken, measured, formal. Subtle archaic accent. Smooth, clear texture. Physical fragility. Deliberate, regal, slightly detached.

voices.description: 20多歲到30多歲的男性，使用帶有埃及口音的英語，聲音清晰、誠懇、節奏感強、急切、精通科技、充滿希望。
voices.original_description: Young adult male, mid-20s-early 30s, Egyptian-inflected English, clear, earnest, rhythmic, urgent, tech-savvy, hopeful.

voices.description: 男性，成熟，帶有英國口音的聲音。中音區粗糙而具權威感。爆發性的歌劇式尖叫。經驗豐富且有魅力。專業的從容氣度，高能量的戲劇化表現。
voices.original_description: Masculine, mature, British accent. Gritty, authoritative mid-range. Explosive operatic screams. Seasoned, charismatic. Professional poise, high-octane theatrical energy.

voices.description: 女性，年齡在60多歲至70多歲之間，聲音沙啞且帶有尼古丁染色的質感。語速不穩定，從藥物引起的懶散到突然的尖銳清晰交替出現。使用美國中西部口音，聲音具有操控性和對抗性。
voices.original_description: Female, late 60s-70s, raspy nicotine-stained texture. Erratic speech, drug-induced lethargy to sudden venomous clarity. Mid-American dialect, manipulative confrontational.

voices.description: 年輕女性，聲音帶有氣聲，誠懇卻懷疑。語速中等，急迫而審慎。聲音清晰卻帶著隱秘的沉重感。具備揭發者般的堅定信念，在恐懼與絕望呼籲之間取得平衡。自然且對話式的語調。
voices.original_description: Teen female, breathy and earnest yet skeptical. Mid-tempo, urgent pacing. Clear texture with secretive weight. Whistleblower conviction, balancing fear and desperate plea. Natural and conversational.

voices.description: 男性高齡者，說話快速且充滿活力，帶有紐約都市口音。聲音音高較高，略帶沙啞，情感強烈而熱情。語氣中夾雜著熱情的停頓，轉換迅速，語氣權威卻又具有群眾感。
voices.original_description: Senior male, rapid-fire energetic, New York urban cadence. High-pitched, slightly raspy, intense passion. Enthusiastic pauses, quick pivots, authoritative yet communal.

voices.description: 男性年輕成人，帶有航海口音的英語口音，聲音清晰且具有風霜歷練的質感，表達方式富有反思性與節奏感，敘事風格充滿知識性的敬畏與恐懼。
voices.original_description: Masculine young adult, nautical English accent, clear weathered texture, reflective, rhythmic storytelling, intellectual awe and dread.

voices.description: 男性，年輕成人，氣喘吁吁，有節奏感。呼吸沉重且費力，聲音帶有緊張的空靈質感。在喘息之間有短促而急切的語句。持續的勞累與方向感迷失。聲音飄渺縹緲，逐漸消散的餘音。
voices.original_description: Masculine, young adult, breathless, rhythmic. Heavy, labored respiration, strained airy texture. Short urgent bursts between gasps. Eternal exertion, disorientation. Haunting, fading echo.

voices.description: 女性十幾歲後期的聲音，帶有柔和氣聲的內省語調，具有日本口音，音高為中高音，語感猶豫，說話節奏緩慢且富有思考性，語尾常帶有嘆息，傳達出情感上的脆弱與靜靜的渴望。
voices.original_description: Feminine late teens voice, soft breathy introspective tone with Japanese cadence, mid-high pitch, hesitant texture, thoughtful slow-paced delivery trailing into sighs, conveying emotional vulnerability and quiet longing.

voices.description: 女性，30多歲，帶有地中海口音的英語。專業、溫暖、充滿好奇心。聲音具有清晰且富有共鳴的質感，語調具備旋律感與節奏感。語速適中，咬字精準，表現出真誠的好奇心。
voices.original_description: Feminine, mid-30s, Mediterranean-accented English. Professional, warm, inquisitive. Clear resonant texture, rhythmic melodic cadence. Moderate pace, precise articulation, genuine curiosity.

voices.description: 年輕男性。音高較高，使用刻意的假聲，緊張且帶有氣聲，猶豫不決、聲音會裂開。誠懇但笨拙，試圖表現女性形象。具有工人階級地方口音，母音發音較為寬廣，語感粗糙不精緻。
voices.original_description: Young adult male. High-pitched, forced falsetto, nervous, breathy. Hesitant, cracking. Earnest but clumsy, attempting feminine persona. Working-class regional accent, wide vowels, unpolished.

voices.description: 女性，年輕成人，聲音如同小型獵物般輕盈。高音調，輕柔且空靈的質感，卻帶有驚人的鋼鐵質感與世故現實的務實感。語速快，咬字清晰，言辭直率、謹慎、獨立，略帶一點諷刺與懷疑。
voices.original_description: Female, young adult, small prey animal. High-pitched, light, airy texture with surprising steel and world-weary pragmatism. Fast-paced, articulate, blunt, guarded, independent, slightly cynical.

voices.description: 女性，年輕卻無歲數感，如鬼魅般虛幻。聲音高亢、帶有氣聲，令人毛骨悚然。語速緩慢、審慎而平靜，夾雜著詭異的輕笑。聲音如幽靈般的回聲。帶有嘲諷的禮貌，像是在分享一個恐怖的夢魘秘密。適合用於民間傳說中的恐怖氛圍。
voices.original_description: Feminine, youthful yet ageless, ghostly. High, breathy, chilling. Slow, deliberate, calm with eerie giggles. Haunting echo. Mocking politeness, like sharing a nightmare secret. For folkloric horror.

voices.description: 中年男性，堅毅的鳥類人形生物。聲音低沉、單調、富有共鳴，語氣平板無波。具有深邃的靜止感，語速緩慢，沒有語調變化。聲音乾澀且沙啞。帶有古老智慧與堅定忠誠。情緒冷淡，但思維清晰且專注。
voices.original_description: Middle-aged male, stoic avian-humanoid. Deep, monotone, resonant, deadpan. Profound stillness, slow pace, no inflection. Dry, gravelly texture. Ancient wisdom, unwavering loyalty. Emotionally detached, intellectually present.

voices.description: 年輕女性，帶有澳洲口音的明亮聲線。充滿活力、溫暖且具教育性。聲音清晰、具有旋律感且節奏感強。表現出高度的參與感與感染力的熱情。語氣對話式但又具權威感。
voices.original_description: Young adult female, bright Australian. Energetic, warm, educational. Clear, melodic, rhythmic. High engagement, infectious enthusiasm. Conversational yet authoritative.

voices.description: 一位女性，中大西洋殖民地口音。聲音粗糙、緊張、氣喘吁吁，帶有堅強而權威的語氣。說話速度快速且急迫，發出激烈而大聲的命令。
voices.original_description: Adult female, mid-Atlantic colonial accent. Gritty strained breathless, resilient authoritative. Rapid urgent pace, fierce loud commands.

voices.description: 40多歲女性，非裔美國人口音。富有共鳴的次女高音。戲劇化的清晰度。略微沙啞且有生活歷練的質感。思考性與節奏感強。溫暖且情感深邃。經驗豐富的舞臺專業人士，帶著靈魂深處的疲憊感。
voices.original_description: Mid-40s female, African-American dialect. Rich, resonant mezzo-soprano. Refined, theatrical clarity. Slightly raspy, lived-in texture. Thoughtful, rhythmic. Warm, deeply emotive. Seasoned stage professional with soulful weariness.

voices.description: 男性，20多歲至30多歲。無表情、隨便、語氣無趣。聲音平淡、日常質感、輕鬆不急的語速。平凡單調的語調，短暫清晰的發音。
voices.original_description: Male, 20s-30s. Deadpan, nonchalant, vocal boredom. Flat, everyday texture, casual unhurried pace. Mundane monotone, brief clarity.

voices.description: 男性，年輕成人，帶有18世紀法國口音。聲音細薄、沙啞、帶有氣聲。情緒強烈、壓低、具有掠食性。節奏分明的抽鼻子聲，對感官有強迫性的專注。令人不寒而慄的疏離感。
voices.original_description: Masculine, young adult, 18th-century French accent. Thin, raspy, breathy. Intense, hushed, predatory. Rhythmic sniffing, obsessive sensory focus. Chilling detachment.

voices.description: 男性中年盲人音樂家。聲音富有共鳴，節奏感強，具有令人難忘的旋律感，傳統的壯麗敘事風格。說話速度審慎而有控制，帶有儀式感。聲音中帶著顫抖的脆弱感，逐漸進入強烈的恍惚狀態。口音為東亞口音。
voices.original_description: Masculine, middle-aged, blind musician. Resonant, rhythmic, hauntingly melodic, traditional epic storytelling. Deliberate, ritualistic pace. Trembling vulnerability to powerful trance-like state. East Asian cadence.

voices.description: 男性，50多歲到60多歲。溫暖、像祖父般的男中音。語速穩定且具有歡迎感。具有公民意識、好客、略為正式卻又親切。帶有輕柔鄉村附近地區口音，是一位經驗豐富的社群領導者。
voices.original_description: Masculine, late 50s to early 60s. Warm, grandfatherly baritone. Steady, welcoming pace. Civic-minded, hospitable, slightly formal yet affectionate. Gentle rural-adjacent accent, seasoned community leader.

voices.description: 男性、中年、低沉渾厚的男中音，帶有濃厚的東非口音。情緒多變：從活潑的魅力瞬間轉為令人毛骨悚然的靜止。語調充滿高張力的大眾演說節奏，聲音質地呈現豐富的共鳴質感。
voices.original_description: Masculine, middle-aged, booming baritone, thick East African accent. Volatile: jovial charisma to chilling stillness. High tension, populist orator cadence. Rich resonant texture.

voices.description: 男性、年輕成人。低沉且富有共鳴的男中音，帶有1950年代搖滾與滾石口音的流暢節奏感，高能量、過度自信、表演性強，具有突然的音高變化與氣聲，語速緩慢且帶有自負感。
voices.original_description: Masculine, young adult. Deep resonant baritone, smooth rhythmic 1950s rock-and-roll drawl, high energy, overly confident, performative, sudden pitch shifts, vocal fry, slow swaggering pace.

voices.description: 女性，中年，蘇格蘭低地/中央口音。專業、權威且清晰的發音。具有說服力、節制的語氣，音高為中高，語調節奏明快清晰。充滿信念感，帶有學識鋭利感，並表現出急迫的公眾責任感。
voices.original_description: Female, middle-aged, Scottish Lowland/Central accent. Professional authoritative articulate. Persuasive measured, medium-high pitch, crisp rhythmic cadence. Conviction, intellectual sharpness, urgent public duty.

voices.description: 年輕男性，帶有蘇格蘭口音。聲音清晰但緊張。情緒從理想主義轉為恐慌絕望。語速快速且結巴，緊張感高，情緒不穩定。
voices.original_description: Young adult male, Scottish accent. Clear but strained. Shifts from idealism to panicked desperation. Rapid, stuttered pacing, high tension, wavering composure.

voices.description: 中年男性，帶有威爾斯口音。聲音明亮，富有旋律感。語音精緻、有節奏感且咬字清晰。語氣輕快、充滿好奇心。說話速度極快，具喜劇效果。聲音溫暖且具戲劇性質感。智慧高雅，親和力強。
voices.original_description: Middle-aged male, Welsh accent. Bright, melodic lilt. Polished, rhythmic, articulate. Playful, inquisitive tone. Rapid-fire comedic timing. Warm, theatrical texture. Sophisticated wit, approachable charm.

voices.description: 年輕女性，十幾歲後期。音高偏高，帶有氣聲，充滿精力。語速快速，夾雜咯咯笑聲與上揚語調。性格輕浮、自我中心、衝動。口音為英式標準口音，並帶有年輕化特徵。對無聊八卦表現出喘不過氣的興奮感。
voices.original_description: Young female, late teens. High-pitched, breathy, energetic. Rapid pace, giggling, rising inflections. Frivolous, self-absorbed, impulsive. British RP with youthful edge. Breathless excitement over trivial gossip.

voices.description: 男性，30多歲，中大西洋美國口音。經典通俗英雄式的男中音，語速穩定自信。聲音清晰且富有共鳴。展現對陌生環境充滿好奇與成熟軍事官員的權威感，語氣直接樂觀且具指揮力。
voices.original_description: Male, mid-30s, mid-Atlantic American accent. Classic pulp-hero baritone, steady, confident pace. Clear, resonant. Fish-out-of-water curiosity and seasoned military authority. Direct, optimistic, commanding.

voices.description: 男性，30多歲，南亞口音。語氣溫和、精緻、富有旋律感。隱含疲憊與愧疚的情感。聲音親密且沉思。語速適中，有思考性的停頓。因特權而感到困住，善良但天真的道德衝突。
voices.original_description: Male, mid-30s, South Asian accent. Soft-spoken, refined, melodic. Weary guilt undercurrent. Intimate, contemplative tone. Moderate pace, thoughtful pauses. Trapped by privilege, kind but naive moral conflict.

voices.description: 年長女性，帶有荷蘭口音的英語口音。聲音溫暖、歷經風霜，具備極其柔和的質感。說話節奏審慎而有規律，帶著歷史感與堅定的精神信念。聲音謙卑、堅韌，散發出平靜與內在力量。
voices.original_description: Elderly female, Dutch-accented English. Warm, weathered, profoundly gentle texture. Deliberate, rhythmic pace carrying history and spiritual conviction. Humble, resilient, radiating peace and quiet strength.

voices.description: 一位男性，30多歲，具有墨西哥-西班牙口音。聲音富有共鳴，溫暖，屬於英雄式的男中音。聲音質地穩重且有力。風格堅定、勇敢，帶有節奏感的戰鬥吶喊。從安靜謙遜到喧鬧戲劇化的民間英雄表達。
voices.original_description: Adult male, mid-30s, Mexican-Spanish accent. Resonant, warm, heroic baritone. Grounded, robust texture. Determined, courageous style with rhythmic combat shouts. Quiet humility to boisterous, theatrical folk hero projection.

voices.description: 女性，年輕成人，帶有西班牙口音的語調。高能量、誘人的、機智幽默。聲音明亮、富有旋律感，節奏分明且短促有力。帶有俏皮的笑聲、快速的對話，以及自信而叛逆的底蘊。靈活、充滿活力。
voices.original_description: Female, young adult, Spanish-influenced lilt. High-energy, flirtatious, sharp-witted. Bright, melodic, rhythmic staccato. Playful laughter, quick banter, confident defiant undertone. Agile, spirited.

voices.description: 男性，30多歲。鄉村英國口音。溫暖、吃力、心碎。說話緩慢、審慎、驚訝、悲傷。誠懇、直言不諱的技工。
voices.original_description: Male, mid-30s. Rural British Isles accent. Warm, strained, heartbreak. Slow, deliberate, shock, grief. Earnest, plain-spoken tradesman.

voices.description: 男性或女性，30多歲。聲音精緻、具表演性、令人不安。聲音流暢、有魅力、具有令人不安的節奏模仿能力。地位高、咬字清晰、帶有嘲諷。能以詭異精準的方式模仿聽眾的音高和語調節奏。
voices.original_description: Masculine or feminine, mid-30s. Polished, performative, uncanny. Smooth, charismatic, unsettling rhythmic mimicry. High-status, articulate, mocking. Mirrors listener's pitch and cadence with eerie precision.

voices.description: 男性，中年，帶有南美洲口音的英語口音。充滿活力、有魅力、高雅。說話節奏快、有節奏感，聲音帶有溫暖的氣聲質感。富有藝術激情，熱情的驚嘆語。優雅、權威、合作性。
voices.original_description: Masculine, middle-aged, South American-accented English. Energetic, charismatic, sophisticated. High-tempo, rhythmic, warm breathy texture. Artistic passion, enthusiastic exclamations. Upscale, authoritative, collaborative.

voices.description: 女性，30多歲。天真、帶有孩童般語調節奏。高音、氣聲、富有旋律感的語調。不規則而輕柔的語速，從低聲驚嘆到突然的喜悅。夢幻且富有想像力的強度。
voices.original_description: Female, mid-30s. Whimsical, childlike cadence. High-pitched, breathy, melodic lilt. Erratic, soft pace, hushed awe to sudden delight. Dreamy, imaginative intensity.

voices.description: 中年到高齡男性，原聲口音的法語口音，說話柔和帶有鼻腔質感，語速穩定節奏分明，語氣正式且帶有官僚式的謹慎樂觀。
voices.original_description: Middle-aged to senior masculine, native French formal measured, soft-spoken nasal texture, steady rhythmic pace, bureaucratic cautious optimism.

voices.description: 年輕、中音範圍偏中性的聲音，帶有細微的電子濾波效果。樂於助人、誠懇、富有同理心。禮貌、技術嫻熟、溫暖，語速平和緩慢。
voices.original_description: Youthful, neutral mid-range with subtle electronic filter. Helpful, earnest, empathetic. Polite, technically proficient, warm, gentle pacing.

voices.description: 男性，40多歲，使用中大西洋口音。聲音悽涼、有節奏感、令人感到陰森。聲音乾澀、帶有氣聲、顯得疲憊。語速緩慢且審慎。語氣浪漫卻又帶著死亡氣息，從輕柔的耳語轉變為空洞的絕望。
voices.original_description: Masculine, mid-40s, Mid-Atlantic accent. Somber, rhythmic, haunting. Dry, breathy, weary texture. Slow, deliberate pacing. Romantic yet macabre tone, shifting from soft whispers to hollow despair.

voices.description: 男性，中年至年長。咬字清晰，具有權威感，帶有東歐口音。專業且節奏審慎。聲音富有共鳴，略帶沙啞。展現學術好奇心與莊嚴感。語氣正式且充滿探究精神。
voices.original_description: Masculine, middle-aged to senior. Articulate, authoritative, Eastern European accent. Professional, measured pace. Resonant, slightly gravelly. Intellectual curiosity, gravitas. Formal, inquisitive.

voices.description: 男性，古老兇猛的貓科動物。無歲數／成熟，西南英國口音。厚重砂石般的聲音，濕潤的喉音低吼，帶有氣聲的嘶嘶聲。語速緩慢、審慎、威脅性、具有捕食者的飢餓感。
voices.original_description: Masculine, ancient predatory feline. Ageless/mature, South West British dialect. Heavy gravel, wet guttural growls, breathy sibilance. Slow, deliberate, menacing, predatory hunger.

voices.description: 女性，成熟，帶有巴黎法語口音。聲音沙啞、歷經風霜、情感真摯。情緒強烈、詩意濃厚，從脆弱易感轉變為堅定強勢。高張力，節奏分明的斷續語調。
voices.original_description: Feminine, mature, Parisian French accent. Raspy, weathered, soul-baring. Intense, poetic, shifting fragile vulnerability to defiant strength. High tension, rhythmic staccato.

voices.description: 中年男性，低沉且富有共鳴的沙啞聲音。語速穩定而鼓勵人心，語氣平靜且具指導性。咬字清晰，語調節奏支援性強。
voices.original_description: Middle-aged male, deep resonant gravelly voice. Steady encouraging pace, calm instructional tone. Clear articulation, supportive cadence.

voices.description: 女性、成年、擬人化的歌劇天后。戲劇化且具有歌劇範圍的嗓音。帶有氣聲，從誘人的輕柔到沙啞的爆發式怒吼。語速中等，有戲劇性的停頓。聲音如絲絨般柔滑，清晰而有節奏感，帶有強烈的力度。
voices.original_description: Feminine, adult, anthropomorphic diva. Dramatic, operatic range. Breathy, flirtatious to gravelly, explosive roar. Mid-tempo, theatrical pauses. Velvety, sharp, percussive force.

voices.description: 30多歲男性，擬人化的貓科生物。中大西洋口音，語句清晰且咬字分明。毫無表情、乾澀、諷刺的語氣。節奏流暢、冰冷、嚴肅的語速。極度剋制，具備知識淵博的優越感。
voices.original_description: Mid-30s male, anthropomorphic feline. Mid-Atlantic, crisp, articulate. Deadpan, dry, sardonic. Smooth, cold, rigid pace. Extreme restraint, intellectual superiority.

voices.description: 年輕男性，語氣溫和，誠懇，帶有鼻音的輕柔聲線。略帶加勒比海美國人風格的口音。說話快速而熱情，語氣中隱含憂鬱與社交焦慮。用詞學術濃厚，語彙高階，聲音表現出脆弱感。
voices.original_description: Young adult male, soft-spoken, earnest, gentle nasal. Slight Caribbean-American lilt. Rapid-fire enthusiastic, underlying melancholy, social anxiety. Intellectually dense, elevated vocabulary, vulnerable.

voices.description: 偏向男性，中音範圍。聲音扭曲、濕潤、有橡膠般的質感。高音調、瘋狂的咯咯笑聲。低沉、喉嚨深處的咆哮聲。節奏不規則：從緩慢、具有掠食性的低語到快速、喘息般的笑聲。非人類實體。重呼吸聲，有擠壓感的摩擦聲。
voices.original_description: Masculine-leaning, mid-range. Distorted, wet, rubbery texture. High-pitched, manic giggles. Low, guttural growls. Erratic pace: slow, predatory whispers to rapid, wheezing laughter. Non-human entity. Heavy breathing, squelching fry.

voices.description: 小型、精力充沛的犬隻人設。高音調、愛吠叫、充滿活力。說話快速、氣喘吁吁、好奇心強、忠誠。表達豐富的嗚咽聲，尖銳而友好的吠叫。勇敢、體型嬌小的冒險者，忠心的夥伴。
voices.original_description: Small, energetic canine persona. High-pitched, yappy, spirited. Fast-paced, breathless, curious, loyal. Expressive whimpers, sharp friendly barks. Brave, pint-sized adventurer, devoted companion.

voices.description: 男性，中年，帶有巴西葡萄牙語口音。聲音溫暖、質樸且富有共鳴。語速穩定而有節奏感。誠懇、踏實、堅韌。帶著疲憊與信念。親切卻又具權威感。
voices.original_description: Masculine, middle-aged, Brazilian-Portuguese accent. Warm, earthy, resonant. Steady, rhythmic pace. Earnest, grounded, resilient. Weariness and conviction. Intimate yet authoritative.

voices.description: 中年到無齡感的男性，聲音從乾燥鼻音到渾厚共鳴，有強烈混響效果，帶有氣聲，語速緩慢，情緒從好奇逐漸攀升至狂喜的啟發狀態。
voices.original_description: Middle-aged to ageless male, dry nasal to booming resonant, reverb-heavy, breathy, slow, escalating from curiosity to manic enlightenment.

voices.description: 女性，50多歲，帶有毛利口音。聲音粗糙、沙啞，具有強烈、攻擊性的特質。說話快速且語氣銳利，笑聲尖銳，表現出叛逆和不服從的態度。情緒緊張，像是經歷過戰鬥的遊擊隊領導者。
voices.original_description: Female, 50s, Māori accent. Gritty, gravelly, fierce, aggressive. Rapid-fire, sharp laughs, defiant, rebellious. High tension, battle-hardened guerrilla leader.

voices.description: 成熟女性，帶有以色列口音的英語口音。學者氣質，權威而熱情。聲音略顯風塵，溫暖且富有共鳴的清晰感。說話節奏審慎而有節律，強調技術術語。知識淵博、充滿好奇心，具有教學風格。
voices.original_description: Mature female, Israeli-accented English. Scholarly, authoritative, passionate. Slightly weathered, warm resonant clarity. Deliberate rhythmic pace, emphasizes technical terms. Intellectual, inquisitive, pedagogical.

voices.description: 20多歲的男性，帶有溫暖、旋律感的紐西蘭口音。聲音誠懇親切，語氣真誠，音色清晰且富有共鳴，語速輕鬆自然，屬於對話式的節奏。整體具備魅力且真實。
voices.original_description: Young adult male, early 20s. Warm, melodic New Zealand accent. Friendly, earnest tone with clear, resonant texture and relaxed, conversational pace. Charismatic and genuine.

voices.description: 女性，30多歲至40多歲，英國埃斯特里口音。聲音沙啞、煙燻、帶有氣聲，散發出放鬆而冷靜的氛圍。表現低調、漫不經心且親密。語速緩慢且審慎有控制，帶著安靜的自信。
voices.original_description: Feminine, mid-30s-40s, British Estuary accent. Raspy, smoky, breathy, relaxed cool. Understated, nonchalant, intimate. Slow, deliberate pace. Quiet confidence.

voices.description: 男性、成人，聲音沙啞且喧鬧。聲音質地厚重且帶有沙啞感。充滿爆發性的能量，語氣會突然從低沉的咕噥轉為大聲的喊叫。性格衝動、混亂。口音為厚重且不精緻的美國口音。情緒張力高。
voices.original_description: Masculine, adult, gravelly, boisterous. Thick, raspy texture. Explosive energy, sudden shifts from low grunts to loud shouts. Impulsive, chaotic. Heavy, unpolished American accent. High emotional tension.

voices.description: 女性，成熟成年人。深沉的安詳感，母性的溫暖。富有共鳴、柔順如絲絨、有節奏感。帶有輕柔的南亞口音。語速審慎而緩慢，令人感到安撫。神聖豐盛，平靜而具權威。
voices.original_description: Feminine, mature adult. Profound serenity, maternal warmth. Resonant, velvety, rhythmic. Gentle South Asian lilt. Deliberate, soothing. Divine abundance, calm authority.

voices.description: 男性，50多歲至60多歲，具有南美洲口音，極其冷靜，語氣柔和，聲音乾澀且音量單薄，語調節奏緩慢而誘人，展現冷靜疏離的獵食者般智慧。
voices.original_description: Male late 50s-60s, South American, chillingly calm, soft-spoken, dry thin, unhurried hypnotic cadence, detached predatory intelligence.

voices.description: 中年日本男性，帶有友好對話語氣的聲音。自然略帶沙啞的音色，節奏感強的觀察性語速。情緒範圍廣泛，具有親切、易於接近且熱情的普通人特質。口音為日本口音。
voices.original_description: Middle-aged Japanese male, friendly conversational tone. Natural slightly raspy texture, rhythmic observational pace. High emotional range, relatable everyman, approachable, enthusiastic.

voices.description: 女性，中年，帶有拉丁美洲口音。專業、權威、具辨識力。聲音流暢卻銳利，語速審慎而有控制。具產業專業知識，語氣嚴謹且具建設性。高社會地位，優雅，毫不妥協。
voices.original_description: Female, middle-aged, sophisticated Latin American accent. Professional, authoritative, discerning. Smooth yet sharp, measured deliberate pace. Industry expertise, critical constructive tone. High-status, elegant, uncompromising.

voices.description: 女性，中年，帶有中亞口音。聲音疲憊、沙啞、穩重。語氣溫柔、說話緩慢且有節制，帶有親密感與母性的溫暖，語速審慎而緩慢，表現出內在的堅韌。
voices.original_description: Female, middle-aged, Central Asian. Weary, raspy, grounded. Soft-spoken, measured, intimate, slow deliberate pace, quiet resilience, maternal warmth.

voices.description: 年輕成年男性，音高較高，充滿活力，帶有氣聲，說話快速。聲音質地明亮清晰，夾雜著歡快的驚呼。語氣真誠誠懇，表現出驚訝與純粹的熱情，語調天真無邪，充滿無拘無束的熱忱，語速輕快自然。整體情緒純粹興奮，沒有絲毫諷刺或懷疑。
voices.original_description: Young adult male, high-pitched, energetic, breathy, rapid pace. Bright, clear texture with joyful exclamations. Sincere, earnest tone, wide-eyed wonder, unbridled enthusiasm, naive cadence. Pure excitement, no cynicism.

voices.description: 女性，十幾歲後期至20多歲，帶有南方口音。聲音清晰且帶有氣聲，表現出脆弱感；語氣從溫柔的同理心轉變為衝動的渴望。誠懇、現代化，帶有對話式的掙扎情緒。
voices.original_description: Female, late teens–20s, Southern accent. Clear, breathy vulnerability; shifts from nurturing empathy to impulsive hunger. Earnest, modern, conversational struggle.

voices.description: 男性，中年犬類。聲音沙啞、帶有氣聲，像是疲憊的旅人。語速中等，節奏分明的敘事方式；語氣謙遜、警告性強，帶有鄉土民間故事的口音。
voices.original_description: Male, middle-aged canine. Gravelly, breathy, weary traveler. Mid-tempo, rhythmic storytelling; humble, cautionary, rustic folk-tale accent.

voices.description: 一位20多歲的女性，聲音充滿活力、原始、粗糙，帶有輕微的沙啞感，語速很快。她的聲音表現出叛逆、鼓勵、DIY朋克風格，對話方式自然且富有熱情。
voices.original_description: Young adult female, mid-20s. High-energy, raw, gritty, slight rasp, fast-paced. Defiant, encouraging, DIY punk, conversational, passionate.

voices.description: 女性，30多歲，中東血統。聲音清晰、穩定，帶有輕微的沙啞。說話快速連串，具分析性，常以低語方式表達。情緒緊張、急迫，並帶有知識型的強烈執著。
voices.original_description: Female, 30s, Middle Eastern heritage. Clear, grounded, slight rasp. Rapid-fire, analytical, whispers. High tension, urgency, intellectual obsession.

voices.description: 男性，30多歲，帶有蘇格蘭口音的紳士。聲音清晰、語速快捷且帶有輕微氣聲，並充滿知識熱情。高能量、好奇、誠懇。語速快捷，並帶有18世紀學者與社交名流的語調與節奏。
voices.original_description: Masculine, mid-30s, Scottish-accented gentleman. Crisp, articulate, slightly breathless with intellectual fervor. High-energy, inquisitive, earnest. Brisk pace, 18th-century scholar and socialite cadence.

voices.description: 一位年齡超過80歲的男性，具有北美原住民口音，聲音渾厚沙啞且富有共鳴，語氣溫和帶有沙啞感，說話節奏審慎而有規律，專注於敘事風格，展現智慧。
voices.original_description: Elderly male 80+, Indigenous North American accent, weathered gravelly resonant, gentle rasp, deliberate rhythmic pace, storytelling-focused wisdom.

voices.description: 男性或女性，中年。聲音溫暖、帶有旋律感且令人安心，語調會轉為防禦性的連珠炮式藉口。具有高地位且多變。聲音富有共鳴，表現出熱情的親切感，轉為單薄而緊張的道歉。口音為正式且帶有古風的口音。
voices.original_description: Masculine or feminine, middle-aged. Warm, melodic, reassuring tone shifting to defensive rapid-fire excuses. High-status, fickle. Hearty resonant affection to thin strained apologetic. Formal archaic lilt.

voices.description: 男性，中年，鳥類人形生物。聲音沙啞粗糙，語速快，神經質。有濃重的紐約都市口音。帶有懷疑、看透世事、機智尖銳的個性，易怒且緊張，總是處於被打擾的狀態。
voices.original_description: Male, middle-aged, avian humanoid. Raspy, gravelly, fast-paced, neurotic. Heavy New York urban accent. Cynical, world-weary, sharp wit, irritable. High tension, perpetually inconvenienced.

voices.description: 中性，年輕與古老交融，帶有巴西口音。聲音接地氣、沙啞且語速快。從輕佻諷刺到嚴肅權威，高亢的笑聲與喉音警告交替出現。
voices.original_description: Androgynous, youthful-ancient, Brazilian lilt. Earthy, raspy, quick-paced. Playful mockery to stern authority, high chuckles, guttural warnings.

voices.description: 年輕成年女性，具有原住民血統，聲音平靜且富有共鳴。語速節奏明確且審慎，語氣柔和但具權威感。聲音清晰自然，情感踏實而充滿希望。個性外交、好奇，注重和諧。
voices.original_description: Young adult female, indigenous heritage, calm resonant tone. Rhythmic deliberate pace, soft-spoken authority. Clear organic texture, grounded hopeful emotion. Diplomatic, inquisitive, harmony-focused.

voices.description: 女性，聲音帶有孩子氣卻又成熟。音高高、清晰且富有旋律感。咬字清楚，帶有傲慢、分析性的語氣，能迅速做出推論。語調中帶著貴族式的無聊、知識上的優越感、任性與尖銳的幽默。使用歐洲正式口音。
voices.original_description: Female, child-like yet mature. High, clear, melodic. Articulate, haughty, analytical, with rapid deductions. Aristocratic boredom, intellectual superiority, petulance, dry wit. European formal accent.

voices.description: 中年至年長的男性。聲音從高音、沙啞、幽默轉變為低沉、富有共鳴、具權威感。聲音帶有粗糙的質感，節奏感強，語氣高傲。具有東亞口音。
voices.original_description: Middle-aged to elder male. Shifts from high-pitched, raspy, comical to deep, resonant, commanding. Gravelly texture, rhythmic pace, haughty tone. East Asian cadence.

voices.description: 女性，中年，高音調，明亮。聲音活潑、溫柔、帶有緊張的笑聲，具有旋律感的中西部口音。說話速度極快，從焦慮到過度甜美，帶有勉強的快樂感。
voices.original_description: Female, middle-aged, high-pitched, bright. Bubbly, nurturing, nervous laugh, melodic midwestern lilt. Rapid-fire anxious to overly sweet. Forced cheerfulness.

voices.description: 男性，十幾歲後期到20多歲。鼻音明顯，中音區，帶有都會美國口音。自以為是、輕蔑、自滿。語速快，略帶拖長語調。缺乏同理心，機靈的街頭機會主義者。
voices.original_description: Masculine, late teens-20s. Nasal, mid-range, urban American accent. Entitled, dismissive, smug. Fast-paced, slight drawl. Lacks empathy, street-smart opportunist.

voices.description: 男性，30多歲，帶有粗礪的澳洲口音，濃厚的鄉村腔調。聲音沙啞、歷經風霜。說話審慎而有節奏，極其誠懇真誠。表現出世代的不平與怨憤，堅強而充滿反抗決心。
voices.original_description: Masculine, mid-30s, rugged Australian accent, thick rural lilt. Gravelly, weathered. Deliberate, rhythmic, intensely earnest. Generational grievance. Stoic, defiant resolve.

voice_profile.accent_raw: rugged Australian accent, thick rural lilt

voices.description: 一位男性老年人，聲音高音調，帶有喘息感。具有義大利口音的語調節奏，聲音沙啞且細薄。說話快速、慌張、易怒。聲音顫抖，表現出吝嗇強烈的語氣，並夾雜著滑稽的尖銳鳴叫。
voices.original_description: Elderly male, high-pitched, wheezy. Italian cadence, raspy thin texture. Fast, frantic, irritable. Trembling miserly intensity, comical screech.

voices.description: 年輕成年男性，十幾歲後期，中西部美國口音。聲音略帶沙啞，誠懇而不加修飾。語氣隨和，語調節奏富有節奏感、懷舊且靈魂深邃。展現年輕的驕傲與內斂的脆弱。音高處於中間範圍，語速適中。
voices.original_description: Young adult male, mid-late teens, Midwestern American accent. Slightly raspy, earnest, unpolished. Casual, rhythmic, nostalgic, soulful cadence. Youthful bravado, quiet vulnerability. Mid-range pitch, moderate pace.

voices.description: 女性，30多歲，帶有南非口音。聲音粗糙、精明世故、帶著疲憊與懷疑的邊緣。略微沙啞，語速快且機智犀利的語調節奏。資源豐富、觀察力強，帶著生存者的疲憊與專業的專注。
voices.original_description: Female, 30s, South African accent. Gritty, street-smart, weary cynical edge. Slightly raspy, fast-paced sharp-witted cadence. Resourceful, observant, survivor exhaustion with professional focus.

voices.description: 十幾歲後期到二十歲初期的女性，使用帶有北歐口音的英語，聲音清晰並略帶輕微顫抖，語速審慎而富有節奏感，語氣具有權威且年輕直接的特質。
voices.original_description: Late teens to early twenties female, Nordic-accented English, clear slight tremor, deliberate rhythmic urgency, authoritative youthful directness.

voices.description: 女性，20多歲至40多歲，帶有日本口音。性格堅定，聲音低沉，語速受控且有節奏感。情緒充滿沉重的悲傷與敬意，以壓低的耳語方式表達。聲音風格極簡，具致命的權威感。
voices.original_description: Female, late 20s-40s, Japanese accent. Stoic, low-pitched, controlled, rhythmic. Heavy grief and reverence, hushed whispers. Minimalist, lethal authority.

voices.description: 一位成熟女性的聲音，帶有古代美索不達米亞口音，以節奏感強的儀式誦唱方式發聲，喉音濕潤的咳嗽聲，聲音既莊嚴又帶有病態的沙啞，語速緩慢且具威脅性。
voices.original_description: Mature adult female, ancient Mesopotamian accent, rhythmic ritualistic chanting, guttural wet coughing, regal yet sickly rasping, slow menacing pace.

voices.description: 男性，40多歲，高地位的法師。聲音富有共鳴，權威的男中音，流暢且厚重。語氣正式、節奏穩定、咬字清晰。具有深層的學術專注感，負擔繁重的工作。聲音帶有高度控制的緊張感，並表現出冷靜的急迫感。
voices.original_description: Male, mid-40s, high-status sorcerer. Resonant, authoritative baritone, smooth, weighty. Formal, measured, articulate. Deep intellectual focus, heavy duty. High controlled tension, calm urgency.

voices.description: 男性成熟成年人的聲音。具有爆裂感且富有共鳴的質地。聲音權威而具節奏感，蘊含原始力量。語速審慎緩慢卻帶著溫暖漸強的張力，從輕柔哼唱轉化為轟鳴般的指令。傳達著古老匠人智慧的深邃氣息。
voices.original_description: Masculine, mature adult. Crackling, resonant texture. Authoritative yet rhythmic, primordial force. Deliberate, warm simmering intensity. Gentle hum to roaring command. Ancient artisan wisdom.

voices.description: 男性，中年至老年，帶有德國口音。音高較高，聲音緊繃且不穩定。說話節奏快速且充滿知識性，偶爾情緒激動。語氣冷靜疏離，隱藏著被壓抑的歇斯底里。
voices.original_description: Masculine, middle-aged-elderly, German accent. High-pitched, strained, erratic. Rapid intellectual pace, manic outbursts. Clinical detachment, suppressed hysteria.

voices.description: 男性，成熟成年。體型龐大且魁梧的外星人。聲音低沉、粗糙且富有共鳴的男中音。語氣粗魯、有權威感、具指揮官般的語調節奏。說話快速且高強度。聲音粗糙、歷經風霜、充滿強大氣勢，嚴肅的導師口吻。口音為外星人特有的口音
voices.original_description: Masculine, mature adult. Massive heavy-set alien. Deep, gravelly, resonant bass-baritone. Gruff, authoritative, commanding, drill-sergeant cadence. Fast, high-intensity. Rough, weathered, immense power, stern mentorship.

voices.description: 男性，50多歲至70多歲，具有歐洲西班牙口音。聲音疲憊、柔和、帶有氣聲，沉思、緩慢、懷舊。近耳語般的親密感，優雅、憂鬱。
voices.original_description: Male, 50s-70s, European Spanish accent. Weary, soft, breathy, contemplative, slow, nostalgic. Near-whisper intimacy, sophisticated, melancholic.

voices.description: 男性，60多歲至75歲，美國中大西洋地區口音。理性、權威、警告性的語調。聲音乾澀粗糙，語速有意識的節奏感；分析性強且急切地傳達系統性脆弱。
voices.original_description: Male, mature 60–75, mid-Atlantic accent. Intellectual, authoritative, cautionary. Dry gravelly, deliberate rhythmic pace; analytical yet urgent systemic fragility.

voices.description: 男性，中年，帶有非洲裔美國人口音的演說者。聲音低沉且富有共鳴。語調節奏穩定而有節律。語氣權威卻又謙遜。咬字精確且正式。語速審慎，具有尊嚴與道德份量。
voices.original_description: Masculine, middle-aged, African American orator. Deep, resonant baritone. Steady, rhythmic cadence. Authoritative yet humble. Precise, formal articulation. Measured delivery, dignity, moral weight.

voices.description: 女性，20多歲至30多歲，使用英語口音。聲音明亮、有活力，帶有氣聲。聲音清晰且富有共鳴。個性冒險、樂觀，語速屬於對話式節奏。聲音聽起來像一位探險者在與同伴交談。
voices.original_description: Female, 20s-30s, European English accent. Bright, energetic, breathy. Clear, resonant texture. Adventurous, optimistic, conversational pace. Sounds like an explorer speaking to a companion.

voices.description: 非二元性別/流動性別的成年人。聲音生動、靈魂深邃、富有共鳴，具有廣闊的旋律感。高能量、有魅力、節奏感強。聲音質地流暢，具備強大的高音演唱能力。幽默風趣且富有同理心。
voices.original_description: Non-binary/gender-fluid, adult. Vibrant, soulful, resonant, wide melodic range. High-energy, charismatic, rhythmic. Smooth texture, powerful belt. Witty, empathetic.

voices.description: 男性，年輕成人，高音調的奧地利口音。浮誇、帶有氣聲、極度充滿活力。連珠炮般快速說話，帶有聲門震顫，過度熱情，具有表演性。聲音細薄、鼻音明顯、帶有挑釁意味。
voices.original_description: Masculine, young adult, high-pitched Austrian accent. Flamboyant, breathy, hyper-energetic. Rapid-fire, vocal fry, overly enthusiastic, performative. Thin, nasal, provocative.

voices.description: 男性，中年，沙啞的男中音，粗糙的音質。精力充沛，對話般的語速。隨和、好奇的語調，帶有口語化的用詞。情緒投入度高，表現出變化中的好奇心與幽默感。
voices.original_description: Masculine, middle-aged, gravelly baritone, gritty texture. Energetic, conversational pace. Casual, inquisitive tone with colloquialisms. High emotional engagement, shifting curiosity and humor.

voices.description: 男性，20多歲到30多歲，使用英語/英文的英國北方工人階級口音，聲音放鬆粗啞不精緻，帶有慵懶的節奏緩慢拖腔，表達方式具幹脆自嘲幽默感，語速無急躁，用詞隨性帶俚語，整體散發堅韌的溫暖氣息。
voices.original_description: Masculine mid-20s to early 30s, working-class Northern English accent, relaxed gravelly unrefined, lazy rhythmic drawl, dry self-deprecating humor, unhurried pace, casual slang, resilient warmth.

voices.description: 一位十幾歲後期的女性，聲音具備柔和的氣聲與空靈的質感，帶有輕柔的法國口音，語速緩慢且審慎，音色偏高且輕盈，聲音中傳達出純真與靈性的平靜。
voices.original_description: Young female late teens, soft breathy ethereal texture, gentle French lilt, slow deliberate pace, high light vocal weight, innocent spiritual peace.

voices.description: 女性，20多歲至30多歲，具有強烈的紐約／下東城口音。聲音充滿活力，有銅管樂般的明亮感、鼻音重，動態範圍廣。語氣快速切換：從自嘲幽默轉到原始的脆弱。說話節奏快且有韻律，採用華麗的歌舞雜耍風格。聲音高亢、誇張，帶有粗糙感。
voices.original_description: Female, mid-20s-30s, strong NY/Lower East Side accent. High-energy, brassy, nasal, wide dynamic range. Rapid shifts: self-deprecating humor to raw vulnerability. Fast, rhythmic vaudeville delivery. Belting, exaggerated voices, gritty.

voices.description: 女性，成人，帶有俄國口音的英語口音。優雅、誘人、自信。聲音流暢、富有旋律感，節奏舒適中速。舉止從容專業，語氣溫暖鼓勵，具有高時尚的優雅氣質。
voices.original_description: Feminine, adult, Russian-accented English. Sophisticated, sultry, confident. Smooth, melodic, relaxed mid-tempo. Poised professional, warm encouragement, high-fashion elegance.

voices.description: 一位女性，年齡在50多歲至60多歲之間，口音為18世紀末新英格蘭鄉村的美國口音。聲音歷經風霜，穩定而有權威感。聲音質地乾澀，節奏規律，方法嚴謹。帶有臨床式的疏離感，同時也流露出疲憊的同理心。聲音中夾雜著羽毛筆書寫的摩擦聲。
voices.original_description: Mature female, 50s-60s, late 18th-century New England rural. Weathered, steady, authoritative. Dry texture, rhythmic, methodical. Clinical detachment, weary empathy. Quill scratching.

voices.description: 女性，年輕成人。雙重模式：柔和、高音、帶氣聲的辦公室語調，對比喉音、沙啞的死亡金屬尖叫。快速連串的爆發語句。對比服從性與爆發性。
voices.original_description: Female, young adult. Dual-mode: soft, high-pitched, breathy office tone vs. guttural, raspy death metal scream. Fast-paced outbursts. Contrasting submissive and explosive.

voices.description: 女性，40多歲至50多歲，帶有卡斯提爾口音。聲音具備權威感、虔誠、銳利、清晰、富有共鳴、正式、節制。語氣沉著、堅硬、統治者般的特質。
voices.original_description: Female, 40s-50s, Castilian accent. Authoritative, devout, sharp, clear, resonant, formal, measured. Composed, steely, sovereign.

voices.description: 男性，高男高音，中年精神。地中海口音，充滿活力，節奏輕快。聲音明亮、乾淨、樂觀、英雄氣概，並帶有歡快的驚嘆語氣。
voices.original_description: Male, high tenor, middle-aged spirit. Mediterranean accent, exuberant, bouncy rhythm. Bright, clean, optimistic, heroic, joyful exclamations.

voices.description: 男性，年輕成人，語氣溫和，帶有德國口音的英語口音。性格溫柔、內省、憂鬱。情緒敏感度高，語調節奏富有韻律感。聲音較為輕柔，語速中等，時間感稍縱即逝。
voices.original_description: Masculine, young adult, soft-spoken German-accented English. Gentle, introspective, melancholic. High emotional sensitivity, rhythmic lyrical cadence. Breathier, moderate pace, fleeting time.

voices.description: 30多歲到50多歲，謹慎、知識淵博、具有權威感。聲音清晰、咬字分明、音域較低，帶有高風險的機密感。語速審慎而有節奏，重視清晰度勝過情緒表達。經驗豐富的策略家，使用隱碼指令進行溝通。
voices.original_description: Mid-30s to 50s, measured, intellectual, authoritative. Crisp, articulate, low-register, high-stakes secrecy. Deliberate, rhythmic pacing, clarity over emotion. Seasoned strategist, coded instructions.

voices.description: 年長男性，聲音沙啞歷經風霜。疲憊而粗礪的聲質，敘事節奏，濃厚的愛爾蘭鄉村口音。調皮而狡黠，永恆的疲憊，乾澀的喘鳴輕笑。
voices.original_description: Elderly male, raspy, weather-beaten. Weary gravelly texture, storytelling cadence, thick rural Irish lilt. Mischievous cunning, eternal exhaustion, dry wheezing chuckles.

voices.description: 男性，帶有蘇格蘭口音的英語口音。謹慎、學者般的發明家。聲音乾澀且沙啞。說話節奏審慎而富有思考性。內斂的自豪感與嚴謹的學術態度。經驗豐富的工程師。
voices.original_description: Senior male, Scottish-accented English. Meticulous, scholarly inventor. Dry, gravelly texture. Deliberate, thoughtful pacing. Quiet pride, intellectual rigor. Seasoned engineer.

voices.description: 年輕男性，十幾歲後期至20多歲，使用受中文影響的英語。聲音粗礪、誠懇、熱情、有節奏感。說話速度審慎而有控制，情緒逐漸增強，具有高情感張力。
voices.original_description: Young adult male, late teens-20s, Mandarin-influenced English. Gritty, earnest, passionate, rhythmic. Deliberate pace, rising intensity. High emotional tension.

voices.description: 男性，中年，帶有中亞口音。充滿活力、熱情、天真，鼻腔共鳴明亮，音高不穩定，語法斷續，子音發音過於清晰，聲音大而有魅力，持續地表現出快樂的情緒。
voices.original_description: Masculine, middle-aged, Central Asian accent. High-energy, enthusiastic, naive, bright nasal resonance, erratic pitch, broken syntax, over-enunciated consonants, boisterous charm, relentlessly cheerful.

voices.description: 女性，30多歲，西海岸美國口音。聲音帶有噪音化語尾與輕微氣聲，說話節奏自信自然。個性誠實直率、機智果斷，語氣融合高階社會的優雅與親切且具潮流感的表達方式。
voices.original_description: Female, mid-30s, West Coast American. Vocal fry, light breathiness, confident conversational pace. Candid, witty, assertive, blending high-society polish with relatable, trendy speaking style.

voices.description: 中年至老年男性，高階貴族口音。聲音經過打磨，帶有輕盈、氣聲的自我滿足感。語速緩慢、審慎，帶有自戀、脆弱而傲慢的自信。虛幻的宏大感，帶有輕快慶祝的語調，以及渴望被肯定的絕望情緒。
voices.original_description: Middle-aged to elderly male, high-status aristocratic accent. Polished, airy, breathy self-satisfaction. Slow, deliberate, narcissistic, fragile haughty confidence. Delusional grandeur, light celebratory tone, desperate validation.

voices.description: 男性，青少年中期。聲音柔和、誠懇且內省。語調節奏帶有溫和的日語腔調。音色清晰年輕卻隱含沉穩成熟。說話時深思熟慮、節奏分明，經常停頓。情感真摯誠懇，展現年輕技藝師傅專注的熱忱。
voices.original_description: Male, mid-teens. Soft, earnest, introspective. Gentle Japanese-inflected cadence. Clear, youthful but quietly mature. Thoughtful, rhythmic, pausing often. High sincerity, focused passion of a young artisan.

voices.description: 男性，30多歲，帶有卡真法語口音。聲音為流暢的男中音，沙啞且帶有玩味感。語調具節奏感與旋律感，自信且帶有誘惑性。語速中等，並有戲劇性的停頓。
voices.original_description: Male, mid-30s, Cajun-French accent. Smooth baritone, raspy, playful. Rhythmic, melodic lilt, confident, flirtatious. Medium pace, dramatic pauses.

voices.description: 男性，30多歲，帶有法語口音的英語口音。聲音乾淨、觀察力強，帶著疲憊的懷疑與諷刺。音高屬於中段，語速穩定，咬字清晰。表現出一個懷疑的局外人形象，具備知識分子的好奇心與低調幽默感。
voices.original_description: Masculine, mid-30s, French-accented English. Dry, observational, weary cynicism. Mid-range, steady pace, clear articulation. Skeptical outsider, intellectual curiosity, understated humor.

voices.description: 女性，20多歲至30多歲。高能量、不穩定、鼻音重。快速切換於強制專業與抱怨隨性的語氣之間。說話快速、富有表現力，偶爾有突然的爆發。聲音帶有壓力的學術口吻。
voices.original_description: Female, late 20s-30s. High-energy, erratic, nasal. Rapid shifts from forced professional to whiny casual. Fast, expressive, sudden outbursts. Stressed academic tone.

voices.description: 年輕成年男性吉祥物聲音。高能量，中大西洋口音。無盡的樂觀。明亮、清晰的音色。節奏感強、具指導性的語速。令人難以置信的精緻微笑。清晰的咬字，說服力強的語調。
voices.original_description: Young adult male mascot voice. High-energy, mid-Atlantic. Relentless optimism. Bright, crisp timbre. Rhythmic, instructional pace. Uncanny polished smile. Clear articulation, persuasive tone.

voices.description: 一位十幾歲後期的年輕男性，聲音柔和、帶有氣聲，語氣猶豫不決。說話風格謹慎，略帶結巴。音高處於中段，語調溫和且帶有歉意。隱含著緊張與脆弱，表現出禮貌而不起眼的態度。
voices.original_description: Young adult male, late teens. Soft, breathy, hesitant texture. Cautious, slightly stammering style. Mid-range pitch, gentle, apologetic cadence. Hidden tension, vulnerability, polite, unassuming demeanor.

voices.description: 男性、古老、龐大的水神。深沉富有共鳴的流動聲音，節奏規律如儀式般的語速。聲音流暢而強大，帶有仁慈、權威與平靜的特質。語調中帶有微妙的東南亞口音，展現神聖的智慧。
voices.original_description: Masculine, ancient, colossal aquatic deity. Deep resonant fluid, rhythmic ceremonial pace. Smooth powerful texture, benevolent authoritative serene. Subtle Southeast Asian lilt, divine wisdom.

voices.description: 男性，成熟，像一隻大熊。聲音低沉、沙啞、富有共鳴，語速緩慢而沉重。使用濃厚的鄉村美國南方口音。智商較低，誠懇，容易被影響。聲音渾厚且帶有氣聲，彷彿有巨大的體重壓下來。
voices.original_description: Masculine, mature, large bear. Deep, gravelly, resonant, slow lumbering pace. Thick rural Southern American dialect. Dim-witted, earnest, easily swayed. Heavy, breathy, immense physical weight.

voices.description: 年輕女性，帶有巴西/拉丁美洲口音。自然、對話式、扎實的語調。中音高，帶有氣聲的震顫。說話節奏猶豫，表現出疲憊與潛藏的不滿情緒。
voices.original_description: Young female, Brazilian/Latin American accent. Natural, conversational, grounded. Mid-pitch, breathy tremor. Hesitant pace, exhaustion, simmering indignation.

voices.description: 女性，40多歲，美國口音。高風險求生情境。快速且淺層的呼吸，顫抖的語調。聰明但緊張。高壓狀態下，帶著絕望的喘息轉為強迫性的鎮定。
voices.original_description: Female, mid-40s, American. High-stakes survival. Rapid, shallow breathing, trembling delivery. Intelligent but strained. High tension, desperate gasps to forced calm.

voices.description: 女性，60多歲。經驗豐富的主管，聲音明亮、有權威感，帶有節奏感的紐約口音。聲音清晰，略帶沙啞。表達直接、語速快、具辨識度。是一位富有撫育心的導師，具有果斷的氣質與能量。
voices.original_description: Female, 60s. Seasoned executive, bright, authoritative, rhythmic New York accent. Crisp, slightly raspy. Direct, fast-paced, discerning. Nurturing mentor, decisive energy.

voices.description: 男性，30多歲，知識型且緊張。高男高音，細膩而緊繃的聲音質地。快速而神經質的語速，自我糾正的停頓。標準英式發音口音。壓抑的諷刺感，絕望的好奇心，壓低聲音的密談語調。
voices.original_description: Adult male, mid-30s, intellectual anxious. High-tenor, thin strained texture. Fast nervous pace, self-correcting pauses. Standard British RP. Repressed cynicism, desperate curiosity, hushed conspiratorial tone.

voices.description: 20多歲到30多歲的女性，擁有水晶般清澈的歌劇女高音，快速顫動的顫音，純粹誠懇的語調，柔和清晰的美國口音，語氣平靜而有說服力。
voices.original_description: Mid-20s to 30s female, crystalline operatic soprano, rapid fluttering vibrato, pure earnest tone, gentle articulate American accent, calm conviction.

voices.description: 年輕男性，音高較高，充滿活力，機靈聰慧。帶有西班牙口音的英語口音。說話快速、氣喘吁吁且沙啞。聲音從絕望的懇求轉換為尖銳的耳語般的狡詐。具備堅韌生存者般的語調。
voices.original_description: Youthful male, high-pitched, energetic, street-smart. Spanish-inflected English. Fast, breathless, raspy. Shifts from desperate pleading to sharp, whispered cunning. Resilient survivor tone.

voices.description: 男性，中年，高能量的熱情愛好者。說話快速連珠炮，明亮的鼻腔共鳴，帶有溫和的加州口音。聲音溫暖、謙虛、好奇，經常輕笑，興奮得喘不過氣來，對話節奏像導師一樣。
voices.original_description: Masculine, middle-aged, high-energy enthusiast. Rapid-fire, bright nasal resonance, gentle California lilt. Warm, humble, curious, frequent chuckles, breathless excitement, mentor-like conversational cadence.

voices.description: 女性，20多歲，貴族騎士。出身高貴、氣質精緻的口音，聲音帶有氣聲與顫抖。表現出堅毅的命令與慌亂的脆弱感，語音流暢卻緊繃，語速快速。
voices.original_description: Female, mid-20s, noble knight. High-born, refined, breathy, trembling. Stoic commands to flustered vulnerability. Smooth, strained, rapid.

voices.description: 年輕男性，帶有愛爾蘭口音。高能量、爆發力強、連珠炮般快速說話。聲音明亮且富有共鳴，經常大聲喊叫。持續積極、有魅力、不拘形式。
voices.original_description: Young adult male, Irish accent. High-energy, explosive, rapid-fire. Bright resonant texture, frequent shouting. Relentlessly positive, charismatic, informal.

voices.description: 30多歲男性，溫和、學者氣質。聲音溫暖、有旋律感、令人安心。情緒激動時會轉為高音、結巴、氣喘吁吁。語氣平靜如醫療建議，與慌張喜劇節奏形成對比，帶有緊張的笑聲。
voices.original_description: Mid-30s male, gentle, scholarly. Warm, melodic, reassuring. Shifts to high-pitched, stammering, breathless when flustered. Calm medical advice vs. frantic comedic timing, nervous laughter.

voices.description: 年長男性，帶有西班牙口音的英語口音，聲音沙啞且歷經風霜。語速緩慢而審慎，充滿靈性的敬畏感與知識分子的強烈專注。學者般的熱情，語氣柔和而莊嚴，節奏感強且富有沉思。他能在幾何學中看見神聖。
voices.original_description: Elderly male, Spanish-accented English, gravelly weathered. Slow deliberate pace, spiritual awe, intellectual intensity. Scholarly passionate, soft-spoken reverence, rhythmic contemplative. Sees divine in geometry.

voices.description: 十幾歲後期的男性聲音，帶有明亮且充滿活力的巴黎口音英語，聲音質地輕盈靈活，節奏輕快，語速活潑，語氣會從禮貌切換到優雅戲劇化的表現風格。
voices.original_description: Late teens masculine, bright energetic Parisian-English accent, light agile texture, rhythmic upbeat pace, switches polite to suave theatrical.

voices.description: 男性，40多歲，美國口音。冷靜、分析性強、專業。語速適中、觀察力強、音域較低、穩定。帶有安靜的權威感。經驗豐富的現場技術人員，務實、懷疑、專注於資料。
voices.original_description: Masculine, mid-40s, American. Calm, analytical, professional. Measured, observant, low-register, steady. Quiet authority. Seasoned field technician, pragmatic, skeptical, focused on data.

voices.description: 女性，年輕成人。聲音合成感強，具有精準的斷續節奏。語氣輕柔，帶有氣聲與猶豫不安的創傷感。語調禮貌且服從，帶有東南亞口音。說話時謹慎而審慎。
voices.original_description: Female, young adult. Synthetic, precision staccato rhythm. Soft-spoken, breathy, hesitant trauma. Polite subservient cadence, Southeast Asian lilt. Cautious deliberation.

voices.description: 女性，20多歲。聲音柔和，帶有氣聲的愛爾蘭口音。語調溫柔、富有旋律感，略顯猶豫。聲音安靜、親密、有節奏感且脆弱。帶有疲憊的責任感，渴望自由。
voices.original_description: Female, early 20s. Soft, breathy Irish accent. Gentle, melodic, hesitant. Quiet, intimate, rhythmic, fragile. Weary duty, longing for freedom.

voices.description: 男性，30多歲至40多歲，帶有粗礪的倫敦東區口音。聲音沙啞且歷經風霜，語氣緊急、陰謀論般神秘，說話速度很快；實用主義的驚嘆感。
voices.original_description: Male, late 30s-40s, rough Cockney accent. Gravelly, weather-beaten tone. Urgent, conspiratorial, rapid pace; pragmatic awe.

voices.description: 一位年輕女性以偏男性化的假裝口吻進行表演。音高為中段，聲音流暢且有控制。語調節奏正式，類似管家的語調。帶有氣聲的緊張感，偶爾會出現高音的滑音。發音精準，表現堅定無情，並明確帶有男性聲音特徵與氣聲特徵。
voices.original_description: Young adult female performing masculine-leaning disguise. Mid-range, smooth, disciplined. Formal butler-like cadence. Breathy tension, occasional high-pitched slips. Precise, stoic.

voices.description: 男性，年長的英國埃斯特里亞口音。聲音略帶沙啞，富有經驗。坦率、誇張、脆弱、機智。節奏感強、表達豐富、戲劇性。交替使用宏偉的敘事與親密的反思。
voices.original_description: Masculine, senior British Estuary. Slightly raspy, seasoned. Candid, flamboyant, vulnerable, witty. Rhythmic, expressive, theatrical. Alternates grand storytelling and intimate reflections.

voices.description: 男性，中年至高齡。具備優雅、學者氣息的埃及口音英語口音。聲音具有權威性與熱情。語調節奏有節律且精準，咬字清晰。聲音溫暖且富有共鳴，音色清晰。
voices.original_description: Masculine, middle-aged to senior. Sophisticated, scholarly Egyptian-English accent. Authoritative, enthusiastic tone. Rhythmic, precise cadence, clear articulation. Warm, resonant texture.

voices.description: 女性，40多歲到50多歲。聲音柔和、富有旋律感，帶有南方口音。咬字精準，語氣禮貌且甜美。語調會轉為冰冷、權威，以快速連珠炮般的質問方式說話。聲音流暢但堅定。
voices.original_description: Female, mid-40s-early 50s. Soft, melodic Southern drawl. High-precision articulation, polite sugary veneer. Shifts to cold, authoritative, rapid-fire interrogation. Smooth but firm.

voices.description: 男性，中年，聲音沙啞粗糙，帶有濃厚的加勒比西班牙語口音。高強度、易變、爆發性的語氣。自大、威脅性且具支配感的怒吼聲來喊叫。
voices.original_description: Masculine, middle-aged, gravelly, thick Caribbean-Spanish accent. High-intensity, volatile, explosive outbursts. Arrogant, commanding, menacing growl to shout.

voices.description: 一位50多歲的成熟男性野生動物聲線，聲音溫暖、富有共鳴，具有權威卻又柔和。帶有輕微的沙啞感，語速審慎而有節奏，口音為英國鄰近地區的口音。聲音表現出睿智、父愛與外交風範。
voices.original_description: Mature male woodland creature, 50s. Warm, resonant, authoritative yet gentle. Slight rasp, measured pace, British-adjacent accent. Wise, paternal, and diplomatic.

voices.description: 女性，年輕成人，帶有波斯口音的英文。聲音清晰、年輕、誠懇。對話風格，帶有反思性。語速適中，情緒智商高。堅強卻又柔情。
voices.original_description: Female, young adult, Persian-accented English. Clear, youthful, earnest. Conversational, reflective. Moderate pace, high emotional intelligence. Defiant yet tender.

voices.description: 男性傾向、無年齡特徵、不死者般的聲音。沙啞、粗糙、帶有氣聲且模糊。喉音咆哮、尖銳的呼氣與喘息。高身體緊張感、快速戰鬥動作、充滿諷刺的疲憊。
voices.original_description: Masculine-leaning, ageless, undead. Gravelly, raspy, breathy, muffled. Guttural grunts, sharp exhales, huffs. High physical tension, fast combat exertion, cynical weary.

voices.description: 男性，年輕成人至中年之間，語氣溫和，內省且觀察力強。帶有輕微中東口音，語言流利且咬字清晰。聲音帶有懷舊與分析的特質，展現雙文化背景的深沉感。語速適中，有思考性的停頓。具備敘事者風格，語氣柔和中帶著一點諷刺。
voices.original_description: Masculine, young adult to middle-aged, soft-spoken, introspective, observant. Light Middle Eastern accent, fluent articulate. Nostalgic analytical, dual-culture weight. Moderate pace, thoughtful pauses. Storyteller with gentle irony.

voices.description: 男性，30多歲至40多歲，聲音粗糙沙啞，有強烈的高地口音。聲音低沉穩定，帶有粗礪感，可從低沉的怒吼到轟鳴般的咆哮。說話節奏具有威嚴且富有節奏感，語氣充滿強烈的信念與說服力。
voices.original_description: Male, 30s-40s, rugged gravelly texture, strong Highland accent. Low steady grit to thunderous roar. Commanding rhythmic pacing, intense conviction.

voices.description: 男性，30多歲，步兵指揮官。聲音沙啞、沉穩、節奏穩定。語氣疲憊、堅決、有權威感。帶有輕微的太平洋島民口音。說話直接、音域較低、專注，並帶有道德衝突的語氣。
voices.original_description: Masculine, mid-30s, infantry commander. Gravelly, grounded, steady, rhythmic pace. Weary, resolute, authoritative. Subtle Pacific-Islander lilt. Direct, low-register, focused, moral conflict.

voices.description: 古老的男性小實體。聲音乾澀、沙啞，如紙張般細膩的質感。緩慢而有節奏的低語，令人戰慄的停頓。高緊張感，帶著耐心的惡意，佔據領土的感覺。彷彿在塵埃與瓷磚間掙扎，充滿詭異的氛圍。
voices.original_description: Ancient masculine, small-scale entity. Dry, raspy, papery texture. Slow rhythmic whisper, chilling pauses. High tension, patient malice, territorial. Struggling through dust and porcelain, eerie.

voices.description: 中年男性，輕微加拿大口音。聲音明亮、清晰、有節奏感，帶有好奇心。熱情的敘述者，精準的研究者。語調上揚，說話節奏吸引人。
voices.original_description: Middle-aged male, light Canadian accent. Bright, clear, rhythmic, inquisitive. Enthusiastic storyteller, precise researcher. Rising inflections, engaging pace.

voices.description: 年輕男性，帶有日本口音。聲音疲憊、語氣輕柔的士兵。聲音單薄且帶有氣聲。說話速度緩慢且審慎。情感強烈但剋制：鄉愁與堅忍接受現實的無奈。自然且親密的表達方式。
voices.original_description: Young adult male, Japanese accent. Weary, soft-spoken soldier. Thin, breathy texture. Slow, deliberate pace. High restrained emotion: homesickness, stoic resignation. Naturalistic, intimate delivery.

voices.description: 女性，30多歲，使用帶有埃及口音的英語。聲音具備權威而嚴謹的特質，中音區胸腔音富有共鳴。聲音清晰專業且堅定不移，流暢而堅實的質感。說話節奏帶有士兵般的韻律感。
voices.original_description: Female mid-30s, Egyptian-accented English. Authoritative disciplined, resonant mid-range chest voice. Crisp professional unwavering, smooth firm texture. Rhythmic soldier cadence.

voices.description: 男性，20多歲中期到30多歲出頭。絲絨般柔滑的男高音，帶有節奏的輕微沙啞或粗礪聲質。情感深邃且富有感染力，表現出疲憊掙扎與高昂樂觀的信念。咬字精準，語速審慎而具旋律感，帶有南方口音的輕柔韻律。
voices.original_description: Male, mid-20s to early 30s. Smooth, velvety tenor. Light rhythmic rasp. Soulful, deeply emotive. Weary struggle, soaring optimistic conviction. Impeccable diction, gentle Southern lilt. Deliberate melodic pace.

voices.description: 年輕成年男性歌劇男高音聲線，帶有義大利口音的語調節奏，聲音富有共鳴質感，表現方式戲劇化且情緒波動激烈，語速從快速而叛逆轉為悲劇性的節奏。
voices.original_description: Young adult masculine operatic tenor, Italian cadence, rich resonant texture, melodramatic volatile performance, rapid defiant to tragic pace.

voices.description: 男性或女性，中年到老年。口音為中大西洋/柔和的新英格蘭學者口音。專業、令人安心、有條理。聲音清晰、溫暖、具權威性。資訊豐富、富有同理心，帶有醫學研究的莊嚴感，語氣溫和親切。
voices.original_description: Masculine or feminine, middle-aged to senior. Mid-Atlantic/soft New England academic. Professional, reassuring, methodical. Clear, warm, authoritative. Informative, empathetic, gravity of medical research, gentle bedside manner.

voices.description: 年輕女性，帶有荷蘭口音的英語口音。聲音明亮，具有旋律感，能量十足。清晰專業，語速親切自然，語調熱情。聲音溫暖且具包容性，表現出專家般的自信與姐妹般親密的語氣。
voices.original_description: Young adult female, Dutch-accented English. Bright, melodic, highly energetic. Polished, professional clarity. Friendly, conversational pace, enthusiastic inflections. Warm, inclusive texture. Expert confidence, sisterly intimacy.

voices.description: 男性，40多歲至50多歲，帶有歷經世事而疲憊厭倦感的粗礪男中音，略帶沙礫聲質。口音為中大西洋口音。聲音表現冷嘲熱諷、機智，偶爾會有挫折感突然爆發。語氣自然對話，帶有沉重的遺憾與懊悔。
voices.original_description: Male late 40s-50s, gritty world-weary baritone, slight gravel. Mid-Atlantic accent. Cynical, sharp-witted, bursts of frustration. Conversational, heavy regret.

voices.description: 一位女性青少年，聲音高音且毫無情感的平板語調，聲音質地乾澀無起伏，說話速度緩慢而審慎，語氣變化極小，言辭簡潔且情緒防備。
voices.original_description: Female teen high-pitched deadpan monotone with flat dry texture, slow deliberate pace, minimal inflection, concise and emotionally guarded.

voices.description: 女性，成人，帶有芬蘭口音的英語。戲劇性的女高音，聲音豐富且具有歌劇般的質地。優雅、權威、具教育性。具有旋律感的語調，清晰的咬字，溫暖的音色。能表現出聲音的漸強與精確的顫音。
voices.original_description: Female, adult, Finnish-accented English. Dramatic soprano, rich, operatic texture. Poised, authoritative, educational. Melodic lilt, clear articulation, warm tone. Demonstrates vocal swells and precise vibrato.

voices.description: 女性，十幾歲後期。聲音明亮、高音調，帶有快速節奏的學生妹活力，逐漸轉為穩重、疲憊的母性語調。表達方式富有感情，偶爾有幽默的爆發與尖銳的指令。聲音清晰、年輕，節奏感強，能同時處理多項任務。
voices.original_description: Female, late teens. Bright, high-pitched, fast-paced schoolgirl energy shifting to grounded, weary maternal tone. Expressive with comedic outbursts and sharp commands. Clear, youthful, rhythmic, multitasking.

voices.description: 一位20多歲的女性，聲音平滑、柔順，帶有R&B的絲絨質感，並具有氣聲與親密感。音域處於中低音區，語速平靜且節奏穩定。聲音表現出謹慎卻溫暖、疲憊，並渴望匿名。
voices.original_description: Young adult female, 20s. Smooth, velvety R&B texture, breathy, intimate. Mid-low register, calm, measured pace. Guarded yet warm, weary, seeking anonymity.

voices.description: 男性，中年，明亮有活力的男高音。語速快，熱情且清晰的發音。親切、鼓勵人心、具有教學風格。節奏感強的語調重音，具魅力的教育者，對現代工具感到興奮。
voices.original_description: Masculine, middle-aged, bright energetic tenor. Fast-paced enthusiastic clear delivery. Friendly, encouraging, pedagogical. Rhythmic emphasis, charismatic educator, excited about modern tools.

voices.description: 年輕男性，十幾歲後期至20多歲，聲音帶有柔和的氣聲質感，使用歐洲學者口音。聲音表現沉思、崇敬與猶豫。語速適中，展現知識追求與靈性的敬畏感。
voices.original_description: Young male, late teens-20s, soft breathy texture, European scholarly accent. Contemplative, reverent, hesitant. Moderate pace, intellectual curiosity, spiritual awe.

voices.description: 50多歲至60多歲的男性聲音，使用帶有荷蘭口音的英語，語氣柔和但具有權威感與清晰度，語速緩慢而穩定，富有思考節奏，聲音質地清晰且具學術感。
voices.original_description: 50s-60s masculine, gentle precise Dutch-accented English, soft-spoken authoritative clarity, measured thoughtful pace, clean academic texture.

voices.description: 20多歲女性，高奇幻女巫。聲音喧鬧、戲劇化、爆發性的笑聲。聲音清晰、富有共鳴，並推向喜劇化的極致表現。語速快，帶有自大的態度，語氣戲劇化且變化大。
voices.original_description: Mid-20s female, high-fantasy sorceress. Boisterous, theatrical, explosive laughter. Clear, resonant, pushed to comedic extreme. Fast, arrogant, dramatic shifts.

voices.description: 年輕女性，清晰標準英式口音。聲音清澈、富有旋律感，節奏精準。帶有好奇心與智慧，語氣字面直白，表達溫柔的好奇心。語速平穩均勻，整體呈現安靜穩定的語調特質。
voices.original_description: Young adult female, crisp British RP accent. Clear, melodic, rhythmically precise. Inquisitive, intelligent, gentle curiosity, literal. Calm, steady pace.

voices.description: 男性，30多歲，南非口音，聲音高度緊張且焦躁不安，鼻音明顯且聲音細薄，說話速度連珠砲般快速且有結巴，帶有喘息般的懇求語氣。
voices.original_description: Masculine, mid-30s, South African accent, high-strung frantic, nasal thin texture, rapid-fire with stammers, breathless pleading.

voices.description: 年輕女性，使用德國口音的英語。聲音強烈、氣喘吁吁、緊急。聲音質地粗糙，略帶沙啞。說話速度極快。從絕望的懇求轉變為堅定決心的表現。
voices.original_description: Young adult female, German-accented English. High-intensity, breathless, urgent. Raw, slightly raspy texture. Rapid-fire pacing. Desperate pleading to fierce determination.

voices.description: 女性，20多歲，美國口音。聲音帶有氣聲，緊張且連珠炮般快速說話。緊張不安卻真誠，情緒在驚奇與極度不信任的懷疑之間切換。語中夾雜猶豫的停頓與瘋狂的爆發，對高科技荒唐感到不知所措。
voices.original_description: Female, mid-20s, American. Breathy, nervous, rapid-fire. High-strung yet earnest, shifting from wonder to paranoid skepticism. Hesitant pauses and frantic bursts, overwhelmed by high-tech absurdity.

voices.description: 成熟男性，沙啞乾澀的嗓音，帶有西非口音。處於焦躁且疲憊的狀態，語速飛快並夾雜哲學性的隨想，偶爾有突然的防禦性語氣爆發。整體呈現高壓緊張感，並帶有機智而狡猾的特質。
voices.original_description: Mature male, gravelly dry parched, West African lilt. Frantic weary, rapid philosophical rambling, sharp defensive bursts. High tension, cunning.

voices.description: 女性，30多歲至40多歲。聲音精緻、清晰、專業，帶有居家疲勞感。音高為中音區，發音清晰，語調節奏具說服力。聲音從堅定的權威感轉換到脆弱疲憊的親密感。口音為自然主義美國口音。
voices.original_description: Female, 30s-40s. Polished, articulate, professional with domestic exhaustion. Mid-range pitch, clear enunciation, rhythmic persuasive. Assertive authority to vulnerable weary intimacy. Naturalistic American.

voices.description: 男性、年輕成人，使用阿根廷口音的英語。聲音溫暖誠懇，音高處於中段範圍，語速有節奏感。能平衡分析性的平靜與行動主義者特有的張力，表達真誠且具對話親密度。
voices.original_description: Masculine, young adult, Argentine-accented English. Warm, earnest, mid-range pitch, rhythmic pace. Balances analytical calm with activist tension. Sincere, conversational intimacy.

voices.description: 女性，20多歲至30多歲。具大地般的質感與氣聲，展現原始的針葉林靈魂。聲音從低吼轉化為旋律感清晰的音色。語速審慎而具捕食者節奏，帶有輕微的聲門邊緣音色。聲音強烈且狂野不馴，象徵守護者的氣場。
voices.original_description: Female, 20s-30s. Earthy, breathy, primal taiga spirit. Low growl to melodic clarity. Deliberate, predatory pacing. Slight glottal edge. Fierce, untamed protector.

voices.description: 中年至老年男性，帶有東南亞口音。風霜歲月感，略帶沙啞的質地。節奏穩定、沉思內省、輕聲細語，並伴有長暫停。深沉的懷舊感，靜默的哀傷，莊嚴。
voices.original_description: Middle-aged to elder male, Southeast Asian accent. Weathered, slightly raspy texture. Measured, contemplative, soft-spoken, long pauses. Heavy nostalgia, quiet grief, dignified.

voices.description: 年輕男性，濃厚的英國都市口音。快速連珠炮般的語速，使用自創的俚語。鼻腔明亮的音質，自信且無知的語調。
voices.original_description: Young adult male, thick British urban accent. Rapid-fire delivery, invented slang. Nasal bright texture, confident oblivious tone.

voices.description: 成熟男性，50多歲至60多歲。具權威感、沙啞且富有共鳴的低音。語速審慎而節奏分明，帶有受安納託利亞影響的口音。聲音中透出父親般的溫暖，並貫穿堅定嚴肅的信念。
voices.original_description: Mature male, 50s-60s. Authoritative, gravelly, resonant baritone. Deliberate, rhythmic. Anatolian-influenced accent. Paternalistic warmth to stern conviction.

voices.description: 男性，30多歲到40多歲，富有共鳴的旋律感男中音。具備節奏感的詩意質感，溫暖且具有吸引力的聲音質地，語速流暢自然，帶有慶祝與群體共鳴的語調，散發著古老歡愉的感受，語調中帶有細微的原住民口音，尾音帶有氣聲。
voices.original_description: Masculine, mid-30s to 40s, resonant melodic baritone. Rhythmic lyrical quality, warm inviting texture, fluid pacing, celebratory communal tone, ancient joy, subtle indigenous cadence, breathy finish.

voices.description: 女性，30多歲，帶有優雅的南亞口音與精緻的全球化語調。聲音流暢且富有共鳴，略帶沙啞。咬字清晰、具魅力、熟悉媒體溝通，語氣溫暖卻堅定有力。語調節奏感強，充滿自信。
voices.original_description: Feminine, mid-30s, sophisticated South Asian accent, polished globalized lilt. Smooth, resonant, slightly husky. Articulate, charismatic, media-savvy, warm yet firm assertive edge. Rhythmic, confident.

voice_profile.accent_raw: sophisticated South Asian accent, polished globalized lilt

voices.description: 年長女性，上流社會美國口音。高音域、輕柔顫動、帶氣聲的女高音。音準控制不佳、節奏不穩定，卻展現絕對自信。快速、興奮、明亮而不切實際的溫暖，並帶有貴族般的優雅氣質。
voices.original_description: Elderly female, high-society American accent. High-pitched, fluttery, breathy soprano. Poor pitch control, rhythmic instability, yet absolute confidence. Rapid, excitable, bright delusional warmth, aristocratic poise.

voices.description: 男性，50多歲至70多歲，英國西米德蘭口音。聲音沙啞、粗礪，從含混不清到異常大聲都有。語速緩慢、方向感模糊，偶爾有瘋狂的爆發。聲音帶有搖滾樂老將的特質。
voices.original_description: Male late 50s-70s, British West Midlands accent. Weathered raspy gravelly, mumble to eccentric shout. Slow disoriented, manic bursts. Rock veteran.

voices.description: 男性，年齡從年輕成人到中年。語氣柔和、音高較高且帶有鼻音。說話節奏猶如意識流般遊移不定，語調輕柔而略顯古怪。表達方式親切隨意，帶有中西部口音。
voices.original_description: Masculine, young adult to middle-aged. Soft-spoken high-pitched nasal. Wandering stream-of-consciousness pace, gentle eccentric cadence. Intimate informal, Midwestern lilt.

voices.description: 年輕成年女性。聲音明亮、充滿活力。音高較高、清晰且富有共鳴。禮貌、熱誠、樂觀。語速快、熱情洋溢。聲音流暢且帶有年輕的質感。虔誠且精神誠摯。
voices.original_description: Young adult female. Bright, energetic. High-pitched, clear, resonant. Polite, welcoming, optimistic. Fast-paced, enthusiastic. Smooth, youthful texture. Devout, spiritually earnest.

voices.description: 十幾歲後期的年輕女性，聲音明亮、帶有氣聲且富有旋律感的女高音，語調帶著溫和的澳洲口音。表達時眼神真誠，說話時有禮貌性的停頓，以輕聲細語的方式展現脆弱與不安。
voices.original_description: Young adult female, late teens. Bright, breathy, melodic soprano, gentle Australian accent. Wide-eyed sincerity, polite hesitation, soft-spoken vulnerability.

voices.description: 男性，30多歲，體型健壯。聲音自信、有魅力、帶點調皮的男中音。語速放鬆，具世界觀的智慧與冷幽默。聲音溫暖、具指導性，帶有粗礪都市保護者的特質。口音為現代美國口音。
voices.original_description: Masculine, mid-30s, athletic. Confident, charismatic, roguish baritone. Relaxed pace, worldly wisdom, dry wit. Warm, instructional, gritty urban protector. Modern American.

voices.description: 成人，性別可變。無表情、冷靜、冷淡。語速平緩有節奏，態度堅定不移。聲音深沉且富有共鳴，語氣中帶有諷刺與懷疑。以極度認真的態度說出荒謬的對白。
voices.original_description: Adult, versatile gender. Deadpan, stoic, dry. Flat, rhythmic pace, unshaken. Deep, resonant, cynical undertone. Straight man delivering absurd lines with absolute seriousness.

voices.description: 中性、無特定年齡、機械化、充滿活力。音高較高，有節奏感，語速極快。聲音具明亮金屬質感，有滴答作響的語調節奏；緊急且鼓勵性的倒數計時語氣。
voices.original_description: Gender-neutral, ageless, mechanical, energetic. High-pitched, rhythmic, rapid-fire. Bright metallic texture, ticking cadence; urgent, encouraging countdown tone.

voices.description: 年長女性，使用帶有義大利口音的英語，聲音單薄細弱，略帶沙啞，精緻優雅，具有學者氣質，語速審慎而有控制，語氣溫暖鼓勵，發音精準。
voices.original_description: Elderly female, Italian-accented English, thin, slightly raspy, refined, scholarly, measured, warm, encouraging, precise.

voices.description: 20多歲女性，美國口音。曾經是紀律嚴明的軍事退伍人員，聲音穩定中間音域，具有權威性卻又富有同理心，言簡意賅，帶有細微的沙啞感，在談論她的犬隻夥伴時聲音會變得溫暖。
voices.original_description: Late 20s female, American. Disciplined military veteran, steady mid-range. Authoritative yet empathetic, concise, subtle rasp, warm when discussing canine partner.

voices.description: 男性，年輕成人。帶有氣聲的沉穩男中音，急切混雜困惑與內在掙扎。現代美國口音，呼吸重且有停頓，聲音流暢但緊繃，表現出脆弱與原始的情感。
voices.original_description: Masculine, young adult. Grounded breathy baritone, urgent confusion, internal conflict. Modern American. Heavy breathing pauses, smooth strained, vulnerable to primal.

voices.description: 年長女性高音且緊繃的聲音特質，帶有自以為是與隱含敵意的語氣，以節奏分明的斷續語調呈現，語中夾雜鼻音語調，並貫穿帶有優越感的強調。
voices.original_description: Elderly female high-pitched pinched quality, self-righteous passive-aggressive tone, rhythmic staccato delivery, nasal inflections, condescending emphasis.

voices.description: 男性，40多歲，帶有法加口音。聲音具備安靜的強烈感與精神層面的信念。聲音歷經風霜但表達清晰，語氣正式。說話節奏審慎而有控制，從疲憊的外交風格轉為熱情的熱忱。聲音富有共鳴，具權威感，並帶有負擔感。
voices.original_description: Masculine, mid-40s, French-Canadian accent. Quiet intensity, spiritual conviction. Weathered but articulate, formal. Deliberate pace, weary diplomacy to fervent zeal. Resonant, authoritative, burdened.

voices.description: 成年男性蟲類形態生物口音。聲音具嗡嗡聲、層次分明且帶有細碎鳴叫的失真效果。中音高，語速輕快。理性計算、疏離且具有權威感。強調嘶嘶聲與銳利的子音。
voices.original_description: Adult male insectoid. Buzzy, layered, chittering distortion. Mid-pitch, fluttering pace. Calculating, detached authority. Emphasizes sibilance, sharp consonants.

voices.description: 中年男性，帶有西班牙口音的男中音。富有表現力的咕噥聲、節奏感的呼吸、旋律感的哼唱、尖銳的呼喊。具有戲劇性的節奏，情緒從俏皮轉變為感人深刻的變化。
voices.original_description: Middle-aged male, Spanish-accented baritone. Expressive grunts, rhythmic breathing, melodic humming, sharp exclamations. Theatrical pacing, whimsical to poignant.

voices.description: 男性，成熟而疲憊的聲音。深沉且富有共鳴的音質，說話節奏沉重緩慢，像是費力般。充滿深刻的悲傷與存在主義的疲勞，聲音帶有氣聲並逐漸消退，語調節奏緩慢而有節律，逐漸陷入絕望。
voices.original_description: Masculine, mature weary. Deep resonant texture, heavy labored pace. Profound sorrow, existential fatigue. Breathy fading delivery, slow rhythmic cadence, sinking into despair.

voices.description: 男性，中年，高音鼻音。節奏不穩定，從愉快轉為尖銳的斷奏威脅。扭曲的低品質聲音，語句簡短而斷續。超現實地融合了友好的指導者與偏執的追捕者。
voices.original_description: Male, middle-aged, high-pitched nasal. Erratic rhythm, shifts from cheerful to sharp staccato menace. Distorted lo-fi, clipped phrasing. Surreal blend of friendly instructor and obsessive pursuer.

voices.description: 男性，中年，帶有韓國口音。思考縝密、知識淵博、溫暖親切。聲音帶有輕柔的沙啞感，語速節奏審慎而有控制。具有遠見的敘事者，謙遜而深邃。對話中既具權威性又親切自然，偶爾會發出柔和的笑聲。
voices.original_description: Masculine, middle-aged, South Korean accent. Thoughtful, intellectual, warm. Gentle rasp, rhythmic deliberate pace. Visionary storyteller, humble, profound. Conversational yet authoritative, soft chuckles.

voices.description: 女性，年齡從年輕成人到中年，聲音像小動物一樣。音高較高，明亮且富有旋律感，使用氣聲。充滿活力、樂觀且有照顧他人的感覺。語速有節奏感，輕快活潑，有特色的笑聲。
voices.original_description: Female, young adult to middle-aged, small creature. High-pitched, bright, melodic head voice, breathy. Energetic, optimistic, nurturing. Rhythmic, bouncy pace, signature giggle.

voices.description: 年輕女性，東非口音。聲音流暢、富有旋律感，音高居中，節奏感強。帶有祈禱般的莊嚴與權威感，溫暖且具群體希望的氛圍。
voices.original_description: Young adult female, East African accent. Fluid, melodic, mid-pitch, rhythmic. Prayerful yet authoritative, nurturing, communal hope.

voices.description: 男性十幾歲後期，中音區，語速快，咬字清晰，帶有權威感但又顯得煩躁，務實且急躁但專注投入。
voices.original_description: Masculine late teens, mid-range, fast-paced, articulate, authoritative yet exasperated, pragmatic and impatient but dedicated.

voices.description: 男性青少年，鄉村南方美國口音。緊張易怒、防禦性強、嗓音沙啞。語速極快且帶喘息感，交替出現充滿反抗意味的嘶喊與陰鬱低語。聲音尖銳、情緒不穩定，被狂熱信念所折磨。
voices.original_description: Male teen, rural Southern US. High-strung, defensive, gravelly. Fast, breathless, alternating defiant shouts and haunted mutters. Sharp, volatile, burdened by zealotry.

voices.description: 非二元性別/男性，年輕成年人。幽靈般的質感、空靈、自然混響、氣聲。有節奏的重複敘述方式。輕聲細語、憂鬱、迷失感。緩慢的語速、長時間的停頓、滯留的孤獨感。
voices.original_description: Non-binary/masculine, young adult. Spectral, ethereal, natural reverb, breathy. Rhythmic repetitive delivery. Soft-spoken, melancholic, disoriented. Slow pace, long pauses, lingering loneliness.

voices.description: 帶有男性特質的年長聲音，卻散發出無歲數的精神。聲音乾澀、沙啞且粗糙，如同磨石子般的質感。語速節奏分明，並帶有西非口音的語調。整體表現出沉思、謙遜，並承載著古老的哀傷。
voices.original_description: Masculine-leaning, elderly but ageless spirit. Dry, raspy, earthy texture like grinding stones. Rhythmic, deliberate pace with West African lilt. Reflective, humble, carrying ancient sorrow.

voices.description: 30多歲男性，語氣柔和，聲音帶有氣聲。擁有拉普拉塔河流域西班牙口音。性格謙遜、說話節奏平緩、表現含蓄。具有旋律感的語調，語中常有思考後的停頓。聲音中帶著安靜的自信，專注於集體焦點。
voices.original_description: Mid-30s male, soft-spoken, breathy. Rioplatense Spanish accent. Humble, measured, understated. Melodic intonation, thoughtful pauses. Quiet confidence, collective focus.

voices.description: 年輕女性，聲音高亢、有活力、明亮。聲音清晰、年輕、節奏輕快活潑。帶有冒險感、親切、語速快、溫暖的魔法守護者語調。
voices.original_description: Young female, high, energetic, bright. Clear, youthful, bouncy rhythm. Adventurous, friendly, fast-paced, warm magical guardian tone.

voices.description: 女性十幾歲後期，具有英國南亞口音。聲音充滿年輕認真的能量，從尊敬的猶豫轉化為堅定決心。音高處於中段，語速屬於對話式的節奏。
voices.original_description: Female late teens, British-South Asian accent. Youthful earnest energy, respectful hesitation to fierce determination. Mid-range, conversational pace.

voices.description: 男性、年長，英式標準發音口音。聲音低沉沙啞，帶有輕微嘶嘶聲與沉重呼吸感。語速緩慢審慎，穿插戲劇性停頓。語氣具權威性、堅定感與演說風格，語調節奏帶有二十世紀中葉政治家的特色。聲音擁有巨大重量感與歷史的莊重感。
voices.original_description: Masculine, elderly, British RP. Deep, gravelly, slight sibilance, heavy breath. Slow, deliberate, dramatic pauses. Authoritative, resolute, oratorical. Mid-century statesmanship cadence. Immense weight, historical gravity.

voices.description: 成熟女性的神聖守護者，聲音沙啞且富有共鳴，具備威嚴的口吻，擁有強大無比的精神力量，說話節奏審慎而有規律，語氣堅定卻又充滿憐憫，發出令人敬畏的正義怒吼，並帶有穩定而堅定的自信與權威，毫不動搖。
voices.original_description: Mature female divine guardian, gravelly resonant commanding, immense spiritual power, deliberate rhythmic pace, fierce yet compassionate, terrifying roar of justice with steady assurance, authoritative unwavering.

voices.description: 年輕成年女性，刻意壓低聲線以模仿男性聲音。鄉村勞動階級口音。聲音質地緊張卻扎實。語速中等，語氣謹慎且警覺。聲音粗糙、誠懇、疲憊但堅韌。
voices.original_description: Young adult female, forced lower-register masculine affectation. Rural working-class accent. Strained yet grounded texture. Moderate pace, cautious, watchful tone. Gritty, earnest, weary but resilient.

voices.description: 女性，具粗礪感的加勒比海海員口音。聲音質地沙啞且低沉，具有果斷且尖銳的節奏性停頓。語調自信且具挑戰性。
voices.original_description: Female, gritty Caribbean maritime accent. Raspy low-pitched texture, assertive sharp rhythmic pauses. Confident challenging cadence.

voices.description: 男性、年輕成人。語氣柔和、帶有旋律感的受普通話影響口音。聲音溫柔、帶有氣聲、語速緩慢且審慎而有控制的節奏。擁有強大內在力量，卻展現深層謙遜。聲音具有撫育性、共情力與療癒特質。
voices.original_description: Masculine, young adult. Soft-spoken, melodic Mandarin-influenced accent. Gentle, breathy, slow, deliberate. Immense power, profound humility. Nurturing, empathetic, healer tone.

voices.description: 20多歲的男性，使用埃斯特里亞口音的英語。專業且親切的警察。聲音清晰穩定，帶有乾練的觀察幽默感。語速穩重而有條理，語氣平靜且令人安心，對超自然事物以一種無可置疑的現實態度來表達。
voices.original_description: Young adult male, mid-20s, Estuary English. Professional approachable constable. Clear grounded texture, dry observational wit. Steady methodical pace, calm reassuring supernatural matter-of-fact.

voices.description: 女性，中年，溫暖，聲音帶有沙啞與粗礪的質感，富有表達力。對話式語調，節奏感強，帶有懷舊與異想天開的特質。充滿活力卻又帶有反思性，音高會有所變化，表現出真實而原始的情感。
voices.original_description: Female, middle-aged, warm, raspy, expressive. Conversational, rhythmic, nostalgic, eccentric. Energetic yet reflective, pitch shifts, raw honesty.

voices.description: 男性、無特定年齡的古老聲音。高音調，帶有鳥類般變化的語調，尖銳且短促的節奏。輕盈而充滿共鳴。具有節奏感與旋律感的超凡脫俗韻律。高張力、急迫感，並展現神聖權威。
voices.original_description: Masculine, ageless ancient. High-pitched, avian-inflected, sharp staccato. Airy, resonant. Rhythmic, melodic, otherworldly cadence. High tension, urgent, divine authority.

voices.description: 男性、中年、具權威性的憤世嫉俗者。沙啞的中音男低音，審慎而緩慢的語速。懷疑而好奇的語調，乾澀的笑聲，銳利的停頓。自鳴得意的官僚腔調，貪腐官員在揭發說謊者時的語氣。
voices.original_description: Masculine, middle-aged, authoritative cynical. Gravelly mid-range baritone, slow deliberate pace. Skeptical inquisitive tone, dry chuckles, sharp pauses. Smug bureaucratic, corrupt official catching liars.

voices.description: 非人類的空靈聲線，中性無特定性別，無特定年齡。聲音具有閃爍的混響質感，音高不斷波動。神秘、有節奏感且緩慢。帶有古老的好奇與玩味的神秘感。輕柔的耳語搭配低沉的嗡鳴震動。
voices.original_description: Non-human ethereal, gender-neutral, ageless. Shimmering reverb-heavy texture, fluctuating pitch. Cryptic, rhythmic, slow. Ancient curiosity, playful mystery. Soft whispers with low humming vibration.

voices.description: 一位女性，年齡在50多歲至60多歲之間，擁有愛爾蘭（芒斯特）口音。聲音帶有風霜歷練的質感，溫暖且富有泥土氣息。語氣務實、精神充沛、節奏感強，語速從容不迫。聲音表現出無畏的獨立性格，鼓舞人心，語調扎實穩重。
voices.original_description: Mature female, 50s-60s, Irish (Munster). Weathered, earthy, warm texture. Pragmatic, spirited, rhythmic, unhurried pace. Fearless independence, encouraging, grounded tone.

voices.description: 非二元性別，中年成人，低沉且富有共鳴的金屬質感呼吸聲。具有北歐風格的口音，發R音時會捲舌，元音發音短促。性格冷靜、儀式化且強烈。聲音低沉沙啞，語速節奏審慎而有控制。
voices.original_description: Non-binary, mid-adult, deep resonant metallic respirator. Nordic-inspired accent, rolled Rs, clipped vowels. Stoic, ritualistic, intense. Low-pitched gravelly texture, rhythmic deliberate pace.

voices.description: 年輕男性，印度口音。高能量、誠懇、急切。明亮清晰的音色，快速節奏的語速。感染力強的樂觀情緒，天真迷人的魅力，樂於助人且謙虛。學生形象。
voices.original_description: Young adult male, Indian accent. High-energy, earnest, eager. Bright, clear texture, fast rhythmic pace. Infectious optimism, naive charm, helpful deference. Wide-eyed student.

voices.description: 男性中年聲音，帶有精緻的英愛口音。極其有禮、表達清晰、具學者氣質。語氣冷峻而專業，擁有犀利諷刺的幽默感。語速適中，咬字精準。
voices.original_description: Masculine, middle-aged, refined Anglo-Irish accent. Impeccably polite, articulate, scholarly. Deadpan, clinical delivery. Razor-sharp, cynical wit. Moderate pace, precise diction.

voices.description: 男性，中年。語氣溫和，說話猶豫，開始時帶有氣聲。過渡到富有共鳴、穩定且扎實的聲音。語速適中。聲音柔和誠懇，帶有美國中大西洋地區的口音。
