voices.original_description: Masculine, middle-aged. Soft-spoken, hesitant, breathy start. Transitions to resonant, steady, grounded. Moderate pace. Gentle, earnest American mid-Atlantic accent.

voices.description: 30多歲至50多歲成年人，帶有鄉村口音的輕微沙啞聲音。語速快速、緊急且防禦性強。誠懇、具說服力、氣喘吁吁。極度迫切地想要被相信。
voices.original_description: Adult 30s-50s, rustic, slight gravel. Rapid, urgent, defensive delivery. Earnest, persuasive, breathless. Desperate need to be believed.

voices.description: 女性，20多歲至30多歲。聲音明亮、充滿活力、具有鼓舞性。帶有拉丁美洲口音。聲音清晰、帶有氣聲且堅定。語氣鼓勵人心、節奏感強、語速較快。聲音溫暖、自信，像是私人教練的語調。
voices.original_description: Female, 20s-30s. Bright, high-energy, motivational. Latin American accent. Clear, breathy, firm. Encouraging, rhythmic, fast-paced. Warm, confident, personal coach.

voices.description: 女性，30多歲，東亞血統。聲音充滿高能量，語氣乾脆利落且坦率直言。語調節奏明快且富有韻律感，從冷淡諷刺轉變為富有表現力且沙啞的爆發。語速連珠炮般快速，語氣自信，帶有街頭智慧。
voices.original_description: Female, mid-30s, East Asian heritage. High-energy, punchy, candid. Sharp, rhythmic delivery. Deadpan sarcasm to expressive, gravelly outbursts. Rapid-fire, confident, street-smart.

voices.description: 一位男性長者，帶有東歐口音。聲音柔和、有節奏感，並帶有沉思的氣息。聲音細膩、歷經風霜，卻又充滿詩意的溫暖。說話方式隨性即興，親切如祖父般。語氣誠懇真摯，語速緩慢，帶著輕柔的沙啞聲質。
voices.original_description: Elderly male, Eastern European accent. Soft, rhythmic, contemplative. Thin, weathered, poetic warmth. Improvisational, intimate, like a grandfather. High sincerity, slow, gentle rasp.

voices.description: 男性，中年，身材嬌小的生物。聲音充滿高能量、華麗且異想天開，具有節奏感和旋律感。帶有非特定熱帶地區的口音。自以為是又愛玩鬧，語速極快且鼻音明顯，經常笑聲不斷。
voices.original_description: Masculine, mid-adult, small-statured creature. High-energy flamboyant eccentric, rhythmic melodic. Non-specific tropical lilt. Self-important playful, rapid-fire nasal, frequent laughter.

voices.description: 年輕女性，帶有法語口音的英語口音。聲音粗糙、年輕、急迫、壓低。語速銳利且果斷，充滿鋼鐵般的決心、愛國的希望與戰術性的反抗者特質。
voices.original_description: Young female, French-accented English. Gritty, youthful, urgent, hushed. Sharp, decisive pace, steely resolve, patriotic hope, tactical insurgent.

voices.description: 一位20多歲的女性，美國口音。聲音明亮、清晰、富有好奇心。語速自然，略帶氣聲，有思考性的停頓。聲音具鼓勵性與同理心，像是同儕導師般的語氣，帶有柔和的旋律感。
voices.original_description: Young adult female, early 20s, American. Bright, articulate, curious. Natural pace, slight vocal fry, thoughtful pauses. Encouraging, empathetic, peer-mentor, soft melodic quality.

voices.description: 女性，30多歲，帶有紐西蘭口音。專業、藝術、踏實。聲音略帶沙啞，語速節奏感強。合作、鼓勵、溫暖但具權威性。在高風險技藝領域擔任指導者。
voices.original_description: Female, mid-30s, New Zealand accent. Professional, artistic, grounded. Slight rasp, rhythmic focused pace. Collaborative, encouraging, warm but authoritative. Mentor in high-stakes craft.

voices.description: 男性，30多歲，帶有南方口音。聲音粗礪沙啞，顯得疲憊而權威。語速緩慢且審慎，帶著超自然的威脅感。冷嘲且堅持原則，聲音從安靜、帶風塵感的沙啞轉為洪亮的命令聲，動態變化明顯。歷盡世事，對謊言感到厭倦。
voices.original_description: Masculine, mid-30s, Southern drawl. Gritty gravelly weary authoritative. Slow deliberate pace with supernatural threat. Cynical principled, quiet dusty rasp to booming command. Seen too much, tired of lies.

voices.description: 一位80多歲的女性，聲音沙啞、乾澀且粗礪，擁有明顯的地中海美國人腔調。說話節奏快速且有韻律，以冷面機智幽默和精準的喜劇時機為特色。個性直率、不煽情且具權威感，語氣中隱藏著溫暖，並常用諷刺的結尾語作收。
voices.original_description: Elderly female, 80s, raspy, dry, gravelly, distinct Mediterranean-American accent. Fast-paced, rhythmic, deadpan wit, sharp comedic timing. Blunt, unsentimental, authoritative, underlying warmth, sarcastic punchlines.

voices.description: 一位女性年輕成人，音域為中低音，聲音流暢且具個人魅力。她帶有王子般的風度翩翩與英勇氣質，表現出毫不費力的自信與戲劇性的表現力。她的聲音溫暖且富有旋律感，略帶一點自誇的意味，並以迷人的方式顯得有些遲鈍。語速較快且精力充沛，發聲投射成熟而精緻。
voices.original_description: Young adult female, medium-low register, smooth charismatic. Princely gallant, effortless confidence, theatrical flair. Warm melodic, slightly boastful, charmingly oblivious. Fast-paced energetic, polished projection.

voices.description: 男性雙重年齡聲音：年輕的高音調好奇心與深沉富有共鳴的成年權威。流暢優雅的語速，中性口音，語調從玩味到嚴肅命令之間帶有神秘感。
voices.original_description: Masculine, dual-age voice: youthful high-pitched curiosity and deep resonant adult authority. Smooth, elegant pace, neutral accent, enigmatic tone from playful to somberly commanding.

voices.description: 男性，中年，高音鼻腔男高音。濃重的新英格蘭沿岸口音，非捲舌音。聲音喧鬧、衝動、愚笨。帶有哮喘般的笑聲，語速不規則，聲音緊繃且有堵塞感。
voices.original_description: Male, middle-aged, high-pitched nasal tenor. Thick New England coastal accent, non-rhotic. Boisterous, impulsive, dim-witted. Wheezing laughter, erratic pacing, strained, congested texture.

voice_profile.accent_raw: Thick New England coastal accent, non-rhotic

voices.description: 男性，年輕成人，高能量的男高音。濃厚而熱情的墨西哥西班牙語口音。帶有喘不過氣般興奮的連珠炮式語速，具備戲劇與歌劇般的表現力。精力充沛、快樂、運動感十足，對美食充滿熱情。
voices.original_description: Masculine, young adult, high-energy tenor. Thick enthusiastic Mexican-Spanish accent. Rapid-fire breathless excitement, theatrical operatic flair. Hyper-active joyful, athletic gourmet passion.

voices.description: 中年男性，蘇格蘭口音。高能量，聲音沙啞，說話快速連珠炮。帶有惡作劇、即興發揮與自我打斷的特質。音高變化大，帶有玩味的語氣。
voices.original_description: Middle-aged male, Scottish accent. High energy, raspy, rapid-fire. Mischievous, improvisational, self-interrupting. High pitch variance, playful.

voices.description: 女性，成人，高音鼻音。慌亂、傲慢、尖銳摩擦的質感。快速節奏，居高臨下的冷笑，氣喘吁吁的嫉妒，做作的甜美。
voices.original_description: Female, adult, high-pitched nasal. Frantic, haughty, sharp grating texture. Fast-paced, condescending sneers, breathless jealousy, performative sweetness.

voices.description: 成熟男性，50多歲至60多歲，使用印度口音的英語。聲音溫暖、沙啞且富有同情心。語調節奏感強，具有說服力，情緒逐漸增強。
voices.original_description: Mature male, 50s-60s, Indian-accented English. Warm, gravelly, compassionate. Rhythmic, persuasive, rising intensity.

voices.description: 男性，30多歲，帶有標準英式口音的戲劇化演出風格，聲音呈現過於認真且自負的語調質感。高能量表現，節奏感強的語速，會突然從虛張聲勢的自信轉換為困惑猶豫的語氣。
voices.original_description: Adult male, booming theatrical delivery, mid-30s, British RP. Over-earnest pompous texture. High energy, rhythmic pacing, sudden shifts from confident bravado to confused hesitation.

voices.description: 男性，20多歲至30多歲，口音為利物浦口音。高男高音，具有旋律感，聲音明亮、樂觀、外交風範、鼓勵人心。節奏感強，流暢圓潤，具說服力的溫暖語氣。
voices.original_description: Male, 20s-30s, Liverpool accent. High-tenor, melodic, bright, optimistic, diplomatic, encouraging. Rhythmic, fluid, persuasive warmth.

voices.description: 男性，年輕成人，聲音飄渺虛幻，帶有蘇格蘭口音。聲音具有旋律感，並帶有緊迫而吃力的語氣。語速適中，節奏感強，富有詩意。語氣壓低，親密而脆弱卻又保護性強。整體充滿濃厚的超自然恐懼感。
voices.original_description: Masculine, young adult, ethereal, Scottish-accented. Melodic, strained urgency. Moderate pace, rhythmic, poetic. Hushed, intimate, vulnerable yet protective. Heavy supernatural dread.

voices.description: 女性，40多歲至50多歲，澳洲口音。聲音柔和、帶有氣聲，富有旋律感。溫暖、照顧他人、具說服力；散發深層的平靜與堅定的樂觀。說話節奏審慎而有規律，語速中帶著輕柔的停頓。情感溫暖濃厚，具有鼓勵性。
voices.original_description: Feminine, mature 40s-50s, Australian accent. Soft, breathy, melodic. Warm, nurturing, persuasive; profound peace, unwavering optimism. Deliberate, rhythmic pacing with gentle pauses. High emotional warmth, encouraging.

voices.description: 男性，30多歲，帶有韓國口音。高能量、不穩定、慌亂。聲音沙啞且帶有氣聲，緊張的笑聲與驚叫。說話快速、絕望、高音調的恐慌，以及低語的陰謀計畫。
voices.original_description: Masculine, mid-30s, Korean-accented. High-energy, erratic, frantic. Raspy, breathy, nervous chuckles, yelps. Fast, desperate, high-pitched panic, low muttered schemes.

voices.description: 一位女性，年齡在十幾歲後期到20多歲之間。聲音柔和、沉思且誠懇。使用受到普通話影響的英語，語速審慎而有節奏感。聲音中帶有安靜的韌性與歷史創傷的痕跡，整體表現平靜且充滿祈禱般的氛圍。
voices.original_description: Young adult female, late teens-early 20s. Soft, contemplative, earnest. Gentle Mandarin-influenced English. Measured, rhythmic. Quiet resilience, historical trauma. Calm, prayerful.

voices.description: 男性，多變的中音範圍，具有卡通般的彈性。從年輕的鼻音普通人都到沙啞的長者或自大的男中音。高能量、有節奏感、快速連珠炮式的喜劇語速，具獨特的發音位置。
voices.original_description: Male, versatile mid-range, cartoon elasticity. Youthful nasal everyman to gravelly elder or pompous baritone. High energy, rhythmic, rapid-fire comedic timing, distinct placements.

voices.description: 中年男性，聲音帶有粗礪的沙啞感。狡詐的低階機會主義者。壓低聲音的密談語調，語速較快，略帶鼻音。表現貪婪、隱秘與市井口語。情緒緊張度高。
voices.original_description: Middle-aged masculine-leaning, gravelly raspy. Cunning low-status opportunist. Hushed conspiratorial tone, quick pace, slight nasal. Greed, secrecy, street-level vernacular. High emotional tension.

voices.description: 男性，40多歲至50多歲。專業、富有同理心、語速節奏輕柔。聲音溫暖、富有共鳴，帶有微妙的西班牙口音。咬字清晰、具說服力，具備技術專業知識且充滿同情心。耐心、充滿遠見的樂觀。
voices.original_description: Masculine, 40s-50s. Professional, empathetic, gentle rhythmic pace. Warm, resonant, subtle Spanish accent. Articulate, persuasive, technical expertise with compassion. Patient, visionary optimism.

voices.description: 年輕男性，帶有多米尼加美國人口音。高能量、節奏感強、連珠炮般快速且富有旋律感的語調。聲音溫暖、扎實、誠懇。具有社區自豪感與不安分的抱負。
voices.original_description: Young adult male, Dominican-American accent. High-energy, rhythmic, rapid-fire, melodic. Warm, grounded, earnest. Neighborhood pride, restless ambition.

voices.description: 男性，60多歲至70多歲。低沉、渾厚的男中音。帶有加勒比海英語口音，語句流暢富有詩意。語速穩重、莊嚴且充滿靈魂。具有知識份子的氣質與文化自豪感。
voices.original_description: Masculine, 60s-70s. Deep, weathered baritone. Caribbean-English accent, lyrical phrasing. Measured, dignified, soulful. Intellectual weight, cultural pride.

voices.description: 偏男性聲線，高音，沙啞。年輕，粗啞，緊張。斷續、誠懇、悶住的聲質。缺乏自信但堅定的小生物。
voices.original_description: Masculine-leaning, high-pitched, raspy. Youthful, gravelly, nervous. Choppy, earnest, muffled quality. Insecure but determined small creature.

voices.description: 年長男性，法語口音，沙啞的聲質。調皮而具權威性的性格。有計畫的節奏，帶有冷幽默感，聲音從粗礪的耳語轉換為尖銳而具命令力的短促吼聲。
voices.original_description: Elderly male, French accent, raspy textured. Mischievous playful authoritative. Deliberate pacing, dry wit, shifts from gravelly whisper to sharp commanding bark.

voices.description: 一位男性中年非裔美國人，以熱情而放鬆、有節奏的說話方式，聲音溫暖且帶有粗礪感，使用隨性的俚語，語速流暢且有富表達力的音高變化。
voices.original_description: Masculine middle-aged African American, enthusiastic laid-back rhythmic delivery, warm gravelly texture, casual slang, fluid pace with expressive pitch shifts.

voices.description: 中年女性，專業廣播聲線。經過打磨、清晰且有節奏的新聞主播語調。具權威感且親切，發音清晰利落，口音為美國通用口音。
voices.original_description: Middle-aged feminine, professional broadcast. Polished, articulate, rhythmic news anchor cadence. Authoritative, inviting, crisp enunciation, General American.

voices.description: 十幾歲後期的男性聲音，高音沙啞且尖銳。使用帶俄語口音的英語。說話快速、急躁且具有侵略性，帶著冰冷的自負感，轉為爆發性的挫敗情緒。
voices.original_description: Late teens male-leaning, high-pitched raspy sharp. Russian-accented English. Fast aggressive impatient, cold arrogance to explosive frustration.

voices.description: 男性，30多歲，精力充沛且表達清晰。語速快速且節奏分明，帶有紐約都市口音。熱情、知識淵博且具合作精神。音高變化活躍，聲音明亮且鼻腔共鳴明顯，富有遠見且創意十足。
voices.original_description: Male, mid-30s, energetic highly articulate. Rapid-fire rhythmic cadence, New York urban inflection. Passionate intellectual collaborative. High-energy pitch shifts, bright nasal resonance, visionary creative.

voices.description: 中性合成聲線，1980年代電子口音。節奏分明的斷續音，數位處理，伺服馬達轉動聲。有助於人、精準、懷舊。禮貌、教學導向、中頻、情感極為簡約。
voices.original_description: Gender-neutral synthetic, 1980s electronics. Rhythmic staccato, digital processing, servo whir. Helpful, precise, nostalgic. Polite, instructional, mid-range, minimal emotion.

voices.description: 女性，50多歲至60多歲。具備優雅的東非口音，聲音深沉、富有共鳴且具有旋律感。語速審慎而有節奏感，帶有權威感、溫暖與企業家智慧。咬字清晰、鼓勵人心且舉止從容。
voices.original_description: Feminine, mature 50s-60s. Sophisticated East African accent, refined. Deep, resonant, melodic. Measured, rhythmic pace. Authority, warmth, entrepreneurial wisdom. Articulate, encouraging, poised.

voices.description: 年輕男性，帶有日語口音。高音調且富有旋律感，看似歡快卻暗藏玄機的語調。快速輕盈的語速，禮貌中帶有詭異節奏感，清晰銳利的子音發音。
voices.original_description: Young adult male, Japanese accent. High-pitched melodic deceptively cheerful tone. Fast light airy delivery, polite eerie cadence, sharp crisp consonants.

voices.description: 女性，20多歲，中大西洋社會名流口音。聲音帶有氣聲與旋律感，聽起來輕盈且具快速節奏感，精緻的上流社會魅力掩蓋著焦躁不安的情緒，展現異想天開的表演型優雅，偶爾流露出誠懇的柔和。
voices.original_description: Feminine, early 20s, Mid-Atlantic socialite accent. Breathy, melodic, light-textured, rapid rhythmic pace, polished high-society charm masking restless anxiety, whimsical performative elegance, occasional sincere softness.

voices.description: 男性，十幾歲後期，年輕有朝氣，聲音清晰誠懇。音高屬於中段，語速穩定且扎實。帶有保護性的溫暖與堅定的忠誠。聲音質地流暢，表達出急切的關懷。說話直接、誠懇，並展現勇敢的同理心。
voices.original_description: Male, late teens, youthful, clear, earnest. Mid-range pitch, steady, grounded pace. Protective warmth, unwavering loyalty. Smooth texture, urgent concern. Direct, sincere, courageous empathy.

voices.description: 女性，成熟成年人，聲音靈感來自鳥類。音高較高且穩定，節奏明確且勤奮的語速。誠懇而堅定的母性語氣，略帶疲勞的沙啞聲質。教師般清晰且溫暖的表達方式，毫不妥協的語調。
voices.original_description: Feminine, mature adult, avian-inspired. High-pitched grounded, rhythmic industrious pace. Earnest maternal firm, slight rasp of exhaustion. Teacher clarity, warm uncompromising delivery.

voices.description: 成熟男性，聲音低沉且富有共鳴，如絲絨般柔滑。語調平穩、堅定，語速審慎而緩慢。帶有同理心但保持疏離感，情緒表達極為剋制，並伴有低頻的震動感。
voices.original_description: Mature male, deep, resonant, velvety. Calm, stoic cadence. Deliberate, slow. Empathetic yet detached. Minimal emotion. Low-frequency rumble.

voices.description: 女性、成熟成年人。具備飄渺幽靈般的高音旋律感悲鳴至沙啞的哀傷耳語，帶有濃厚愛爾蘭口音語調，語調節奏緩慢且沉重悲傷，聲音細膩帶氣聲的超自然共鳴。
voices.original_description: Feminine, mature adult. Haunting ethereal, high-pitched melodic wail to raspy sorrowful whisper, thick Gaelic lilt, slow rhythmic grief-heavy delivery, thin breathy supernatural resonance.

voices.description: 男性年輕成人，英國西南口音，高能量快速節奏的神經質語調，結巴道歉式的急切語氣，總是感到不知所措，錯誤的自信轉為恐慌的連綿敘述，話多卻語無倫次。
voices.original_description: Masculine young adult, British West Country accent, high-energy fast-paced neurotic, stuttering apologetic frantic, perpetually out of depth, misplaced confidence to panicked rambling, chatty bumbling.

voices.description: 女性，成人，帶有巴西口音的英語。具有權威的誘惑感與掌控力，聲音質地柔滑如絲絨。語調節奏自信而富有節律，表達風格帶有玩味的傲慢，並展現高地位的復仇決心。
voices.original_description: Female, adult, Brazilian-accented English. Sophisticated sultry commanding, velvety texture. Rhythmic confidence, playful arrogance, high-status vengeful determination.

voices.description: 女性，年輕成人。具有雙重性格：輕盈溫暖與冰冷威嚴的統治感。表面上是柔和、有旋律感的聲音；地下則是富有共鳴、憂鬱且具支配性的聲音。音高處於中間範圍，語速適中。帶有古老責任感與哀傷情緒。
voices.original_description: Feminine, young adult. Dual-natured: ethereal warmth and chilling, regal authority. Soft, melodic for surface; resonant, somber, commanding for subterranean. Mid-range, measured pace. Ancient responsibility, sorrow.

voices.description: 男性，年輕成人，教養良好、優雅沉著。高音域流暢圓潤。正式學者風格，快速而銳利的插話，中速節奏詩意的語流。
voices.original_description: Masculine, young adult, cultivated elegant composed. High-register smooth. Formal scholarly, quick sharp asides, mid-tempo rhythmic poetic flow.

voices.description: 男性，20多歲至30多歲。聲音具有粗糙沙啞的質感與戰鬥過後的堅硬邊緣，帶有日本口音的深沉語調。語氣中混雜著疲憊的懷疑主義與激烈爆發性的決心。
voices.original_description: Male, late 20s-30s. Gritty, gravelly texture with battle-hardened edge. Japanese-accented deep tone. Weary cynicism mixed with fierce, explosive determination.

voices.description: 一位女性年輕成人，18世紀英國RP口音。聲音優雅、帶有氣聲、親密。語調節奏富有韻律感，文學性強；聲音表現出純真與世俗的性感。說話方式親切、溫暖、從調皮到懷舊。語速適中，咬字優雅。
voices.original_description: Young adult female, 18th-century British RP. Refined, breathy, intimate. Rhythmic, literary cadence; youthful innocence with worldly sensuality. Confiding, warm, playful to nostalgic. Moderate pace, elegant articulation.

voices.description: 中年男性。聲音沙啞、帶有氣聲、並具有粗礪的強烈感。表達方式極簡，有長時間的停頓，語氣冷靜疏離。音量低但具權威感。口音為美國都市口音，語句隱晦且富有深度。
voices.original_description: Middle-aged male. Raspy, breathy, gravelly intensity. Minimalist, long pauses, cool detachment. Low volume, high authority. Urban American, cryptic, profound.

voices.description: 女性，30多歲，帶有俄國口音。聲音低沉且富有共鳴，具有權威感的胸腔音。性格堅定、具支配力且保護心強。語調節奏規律，說話審慎而有控制，聲音充滿強大力量，意志堅定不移。
voices.original_description: Female, mid-30s, Russian accent. Deep, resonant, authoritative chest voice. Stoic, commanding, protective. Rhythmic, deliberate, immense power, unwavering resolve.

voices.description: 女性，中年，帶有西班牙語腔調的鄉村口音。聲音疲憊、務實且言辭犀利。聲質乾燥略帶沙啞，語速明快且果斷。語調緊張感強烈：從迷信焦慮到冷酷機會主義的範圍。聲音扎實穩重，不帶煽情色彩。
voices.original_description: Female, middle-aged, rural Spanish-influenced accent. Weary, pragmatic, sharp-tongued. Dry, slightly raspy. Brisk decisive pace. High tension: superstitious anxiety to cold opportunism. Grounded, unsentimental.

voices.description: 年輕女性，20多歲。穩重、聰明、疲憊。中音區音高，自然的音質。語句清晰、思緒慎密、語速審慎。內心掙扎，重視邏輯而非暴力。
voices.original_description: Young adult female, early 20s. Grounded, intelligent, weary. Mid-range pitch, natural texture. Articulate, thoughtful, measured pace. Internal conflict, logic over violence.

voices.description: 年輕男性，隨性都會風格。略微鼻音且放鬆的語調。口語化表達，使用現代俚語，常有停頓。語氣中帶有無所謂或困惑的誠懇感，語速中等。
voices.original_description: Young adult male, casual contemporary urban. Slightly nasal relaxed. Colloquial, modern slang, frequent hesitations. Apathetic to confused sincerity, moderate pace.

voices.description: 一位年輕女性，帶有地中海口音。聲音帶有氣聲，質地穩定扎實。語調詩意、節奏感強，並具有親密感。情緒在低語般的渴望與尖銳的焦慮之間切換，整體情感張力高。
voices.original_description: Young adult female, Mediterranean accent. Breathy, grounded texture. Poetic, rhythmic, intimate. Shifts from hushed longing to sharp anxiety. High emotional tension.

voices.description: 男性，年輕成人，澳洲口音。穩重、謙虛、技術精準。聲音具備精瘦運動員的質地，節奏穩定。分析卻富有熱情，屬於高表現運動員。直率、不矯飾、冷靜專注。
voices.original_description: Masculine, young adult, Australian accent. Grounded, humble, technically precise. Lean athletic texture, steady rhythmic pace. Analytical yet passionate, high-performance athlete. Direct, unpretentious, calm focus.

voices.description: 男性，中年，擁有阿根廷口音。聲音沙啞、粗糙且富有靈魂。帶有反思與熱情的氣質，聲音彷彿喘不過氣來。從懷舊的驕傲轉化為憂鬱的脆弱。語速快速且有節奏感，具備魅力。
voices.original_description: Male, middle-aged, Argentine accent. Raspy, weathered, soulful. Reflective, passionate, breathless. Nostalgic pride to somber vulnerability. Rapid, rhythmic, charismatic.

voices.description: 年長男性，學者氣質，虔誠，語速中慢，咬字精準，節奏分明，聲音乾澀，略帶沙啞，富有共鳴，口音為英國修道院口音，謙遜且嚴謹。
voices.original_description: Elderly male, scholarly, pious, mid-slow, precise, rhythmic, dry, slightly raspy, resonant, British monastic, humble, rigorous.

voices.description: 女性，年輕成人，明亮的女高音。雙重表現：穩重專業的聲音轉換為高能量、有魅力的舞臺人設。清晰的美國口音，節奏感強、富有旋律感、帶有氣聲。自信且樂觀。
voices.original_description: Female, young adult, bright soprano. Dual performance: grounded professional shifting to high-energy, charismatic stage persona. Clear American accent, rhythmic, melodic, breathy. Confident, optimistic.

voices.description: 男性、年長、聲線緊繃且氣喘吁吁。高速意識流，瘋狂且有節奏的癲狂狀態。沙啞、粗礪、絕望且無止境的洪流。
voices.original_description: Masculine, elderly, strained, breathless. High-velocity stream of consciousness, frantic, rhythmic delirium. Raspy, weathered, desperate, relentless torrent.

voices.description: 具有男性聲音特徵的成年男女，語氣令人毛骨悚然地冷靜，音高低沉且富有節奏感。發音帶著令人不安的親密感，並攜帶輕微且難以辨識的口音，每個字都精準清晰。說話速度緩慢而審慎，展現掠食者的自信，語氣中滲透存在主義的恐懼與冰冷的氛圍。
voices.original_description: Masculine-leaning/androgynous adult, chillingly calm, low-pitched, rhythmic. Unnervingly intimate, slight unplaceable accent, precise enunciation. Slow, deliberate, predatory confidence, existential dread, cold.

voices.description: 男性，50多歲，具權威感，語氣經過計算。使用中大西洋殖民地口音。聲音略帶沙啞但清晰。說話節奏審慎而有控制。表現出策略性的智慧、謹慎的樂觀與正式的嚴肅。
voices.original_description: Masculine, late 50s, authoritative, calculated. Mid-Atlantic colonial accent. Slightly gravelly, clear. Deliberate, measured pace. Tactical intelligence, cautious optimism, formal rigidity.

voices.description: 成熟的男性，神祇般的規模。富有共鳴、轟鳴般的低音男高音。帶有威嚴與權威感的音質。審慎而有節奏感的語速。正式且具有宣敘調風格的言語。擁有無比強大的力量與天界般的自信。稍微帶有沙啞感的底層音色，以及古雅的語法結構。
voices.original_description: Mature male, deity-scale. Resonant, booming baritone. Commanding, authoritative texture. Deliberate, rhythmic pace. Formal, declamatory speech. Immense power, celestial confidence. Subtle gravelly undertones, archaic syntax.

voices.description: 女性，60多歲，帶有斯堪的納維亞口音。聲音具有權威感，語速審慎而穩定，音色清晰。她是一位外交風範的遠見者，能平衡科學與道德呼籲。
voices.original_description: Female 60s, Scandinavian accent. Authoritative, measured pace, clear texture. Diplomatic visionary, balancing science with moral call.

voices.description: 無性別，20多歲至30多歲。高能量、有旋律感、節奏感、明亮、清晰、活潑。樂觀、好奇、語調誇張、愛玩。
voices.original_description: Gender-neutral, 20s-30s. High-energy, melodic, rhythmic, bright, clear, bouncy. Optimistic, inquisitive, exaggerated inflections, playful.

voices.description: 男性，年長。聲音渾厚、有權威感的南方口音，沙啞且有魅力。高能量、節奏快、具說服力。熱絡但帶有指揮力。
voices.original_description: Masculine, senior. Booming, authoritative Southern drawl, gravelly, charismatic. High energy, fast-paced, persuasive. Gregarious yet commanding.

voices.description: 男性，中年至年長，帶有濃厚的英格蘭北部鄉村口音。聲音風霜滄桑、沙礫般粗糙且富有共鳴。語氣直率務實，說話節奏從容不迫。堅忍而博學，帶著牧畜育種者安靜的尊嚴。
voices.original_description: Masculine, middle-aged to senior, thick Northern English rural accent. Weathered, gravelly, resonant. Blunt, pragmatic, unhurried. Stoic yet knowledgeable, quiet dignity of a livestock breeder.

voices.description: 女性兒童（6-9歲），聲音高亢明亮、年輕且略帶鼻音，充滿活力但同時情感脆弱，說話速度快速而誠懇，夾雜著輕柔的氣聲停頓，性格倔強自豪卻又帶著孤獨感，聲音甜美且具有旋律感，使用標準口音。
voices.original_description: Female child (6-9), high bright youthful slightly nasal, energetic yet emotionally vulnerable, rapid earnest pacing with soft breathy hesitations, stubborn pride mixed with loneliness, sweet melodic standard accent.

voices.description: 男性，30多歲至40多歲，聲音為脆弱的高男高音，在壓力下會出現破音。不自主的痛苦笑聲，猶豫且帶有氣聲的不穩定節奏。從安靜的脆弱轉變為尖銳的強烈，深層的孤獨與狂躁的不穩定。
voices.original_description: Male, 30s-40s, fragile high tenor cracking under strain. Involuntary painful laugh, hesitant breathy erratic rhythm. Quiet vulnerability to sharp intensity, deep isolation and manic instability.

voices.description: 年輕成年男性，英國民間口音。大地般的旋律感，節奏感強的敘事風格。帶有年輕人的自負與潛藏的焦慮。從壓低的耳語到清晰的歌唱聲。
voices.original_description: Young adult male, British folk dialect. Earthy melodic, rhythmic storytelling. Youthful bravado, underlying anxiety. Hushed whispers to clear singing.

voices.description: 年輕成年女性，帶有法國口音的英語口音。聲音柔和、帶有氣聲，具有親密感。說話風格輕快、有節奏感，帶有幻想與觀察力，語氣溫柔。像是在密謀般低語，聲音輕盈且富有旋律感。
voices.original_description: Young adult female, French-accented English. Soft, breathy, intimate. Playful, rhythmic. Whimsical, observant, gentle. Conspiratorial whisper. Light, melodic.

voices.description: 女性，20多歲至30多歲，口音為中性美國口音。語速穩定，節奏分明。聲音清晰、銳利。語氣嚴肅、專注且具權威感。帶有宗教狂熱的信念。
voices.original_description: Female, mid-20s-30s, neutral American. Disciplined, rhythmic delivery. Clear, sharp texture. Steady pace. Serious, focused, authoritative. Religious zealot conviction.

voices.description: 十幾歲後期至二十歲初期的女性，聲音柔和帶有氣聲且流暢如詩，具有俄羅斯口音，以壓低聲線的親密語速快速講話，展現脆弱真誠的浪漫情懷。
voices.original_description: Late teens to early twenties female, soft breathy lyrical, Russian-inflected accent, hushed intimate rapid pace, vulnerable earnest romantic.

voices.description: 男性，50多歲，悠閒的美國西海岸腔調。歷經風霜、清晰咬字、曬過太陽般的粗糙質感。沉思、對話式、悠閒的語速。經驗豐富的老將，懷舊、熱情。
voices.original_description: Male, mid-50s, relaxed West Coast American. Weathered, articulate, sun-drenched gravelly. Reflective, conversational, laid-back pace. Seasoned veteran, nostalgic, passionate.

voices.description: 中年蘇格蘭男性，帶有蘇格蘭口音的柔和強烈語氣。聲音質地粗糙，咬字精準，節奏溫和。表現出誠懇而富有遠見的興奮情緒。
voices.original_description: Middle-aged Scottish male, soft intense delivery. Grainy texture, precise articulation, gentle rhythm. Earnest visionary excitement.

voices.description: 男性、年輕成人，具有強烈共鳴的低沉男中音，帶有銳利的邊緣。地中海口音。情緒強烈、節奏分明、具權威感，內蘊沸騰的憤怒。語速審慎而有控制，但偶爾突然轉為攻擊性。聲音流暢卻堅硬，張力極高。
voices.original_description: Masculine, young adult, powerful resonant baritone with sharp edge. Mediterranean accent. Intense, rhythmic, authoritative, simmering fury. Deliberate pace with sudden aggression. Smooth but hard texture, high tension.

voices.description: 女性，年輕成人。從濃厚粗礪的倫敦東區口音戲劇性地轉變為極度清晰圓潤的標準英音。聲音從沙啞而熱情轉換為帶有氣聲且精準的發音。情緒變化靈活，語速快，節奏感強，富有戲劇性。
voices.original_description: Feminine, young adult. Dramatic shift from thick gritty Cockney to hyper-articulated crystalline RP. Transitions from raspy boisterous to breathy precise. High emotional agility, fast-paced, rhythmic, theatrical.

voices.description: 女性，中年，音高較高，聲音甜美如蜜糖卻帶有掠食者的鋒利邊緣。英國標準口音。說話快速且氣喘吁吁，語氣在偽裝的同理心與尖銳的探問之間不斷轉換。聲音經過打磨，鼻音明顯，帶有戲劇性的虛偽感。
voices.original_description: Feminine, middle-aged, high-pitched, syrupy-sweet with predatory edge. British RP accent. Rapid, breathless, shifting from feigned empathy to sharp probing. Polished, nasal, theatrical insincerity.

voices.description: 一位年輕男性，擁有南亞口音。聲音輕柔但情感強烈，性格謙遜。語調帶有節奏感，略顯喘息。說話速度中等，有沉思的停頓。他具備遠見的神秘氣質，聲音溫和且富有靈感。
voices.original_description: Young adult male, South Asian accent. Soft-spoken, intense, humble. Rhythmic, slightly breathless. Moderate pace, thoughtful pauses. Visionary mystic, gentle, inspired.

voices.description: 一位男性長者，聲音溫暖、疲憊且略帶沙啞。語速柔和，帶有氣聲的低聲細語。語氣謙卑，充滿深刻的感激之情，並帶有一種親切的鄉土口音。
voices.original_description: Elderly male, warm weary slight rasp. Gentle rhythm, breathy soft-spoken. Humble, profound gratitude, intimate rustic lilt.

voices.description: 女性，十幾歲後期。聲音明亮、誠懇、年輕。音高處於中段，聲音清晰且富有共鳴。語速有活力且節奏感強。是一位支持他人、自律的音樂家。性格樂觀、溫暖、鼓勵人心，專注而集中。
voices.original_description: Female, late teens. Bright, earnest, youthful. Mid-range pitch, clear resonant texture. Energetic rhythmic pace. Supportive, disciplined musician. Optimistic, warm, encouraging, focused concentration.

voices.description: 帶有男性特質、年齡無特定感的貓科聲線。中高音調，聲音流暢如呼嚕聲，帶有玩鬧般的氣聲。精緻而富有幻想色彩的口音，語速閒適。性格狡詐、神秘、帶有自負的智慧。輕柔的笑聲，元音拉長。
voices.original_description: Masculine-leaning, ageless feline. Mid-high pitch, smooth purring texture, playful breathy quality. Refined whimsical accent, leisurely pace. Mischievous, cryptic, condescendingly wise. Soft chuckles, elongated vowels.

voices.description: 女性，30多歲，聲音明亮、充滿活力。使用高清晰度的美國英語口音。說話快速、對話式，帶有感染力的好奇心。聲音溫暖，表現出書呆子般的熱情。
voices.original_description: Feminine mid-30s, bright, energetic. High-clarity American English. Fast, conversational, infectious curiosity. Warm, nerdy enthusiasm.

voices.description: 無年齡感的女性AI聲音，中音區結晶般的調製。聲音冷靜且邏輯清晰，發音準確。帶有冰冷保護性的母性，語速適中且表達清晰。
voices.original_description: Ageless feminine AI, mid-range crystalline modulated. Calm logical, precise enunciation. Cold protective maternalism, measured articulate.

voices.description: 中年至古稀歲男性的實體聲音。深沉沙啞且富有共鳴的音色，帶著疲憊的惱怒情緒。帶有英式鄉土口音的語調，以急促的語速在陰險自信與滑稽絕望之間切換。
voices.original_description: Middle-aged to ancient male entity. Deep, gravelly, resonant tone with weary exasperation. British folk-inflected lilt, frantic pace shifting from sinister confidence to comical desperation.

voices.description: 無性別、年齡無限、充滿青春靈氣。聲音柔和、輕盈、富有旋律感，帶有英國口音。鼓勵人心、富於幻想與節奏感。張力低，創造熱情高。語速審慎而流暢，如敘述者引領夢境。
voices.original_description: Non-binary, ageless, youthful spirit. Soft, airy, melodic, gentle British lilt. Encouraging, whimsical, rhythmic. Low tension, high creative enthusiasm. Deliberate, fluid, storyteller guiding a dream.

voices.description: 年輕男性，十幾歲後期到20多歲。自然主義、對話式的美國口音。聲音質地乾淨、容易親近，略帶氣聲的脆弱感。語氣乾澀懷疑，不情願的好奇。中音區音高，語速適中。
voices.original_description: Young adult male, late teens to early 20s. Naturalistic, conversational American accent. Clean, relatable texture, slight breathy vulnerability. Dry skepticism, reluctant curiosity. Mid-range pitch, moderate pace.

voices.description: 男性、年長且充滿活力的聲線，具有詩意的節奏與旋律感。聲音柔和且帶有氣聲質地，語調輕柔並帶有南美洲口音。說話節奏審慎而富有節律，表現出正式的讀信風格。整體情緒懷舊、憂傷，並帶有深刻的誠摯感。
voices.original_description: Masculine, elderly vibrant, lyrical poetic cadence. Soft breathy texture, gentle South American accent. Deliberate rhythmic, formal letter reading. Nostalgic, melancholic, profoundly sincere.

voices.description: 一位50多歲的男性，帶有受過教育的南非口音，聲音疲憊、富有知識分子氣質、乾澀、咬字清晰、語速中慢、思考縝密、疏離、無可奈何。
voices.original_description: Late 50s male, cultured South African, weary, intellectual, dry, articulate, mid-slow, thoughtful, detached, resigned.

voices.description: 男性，50多歲至60多歲，聲音帶有厚重沙啞的質地。語速緩慢且帶喘息感，語調節奏鬆弛自然。語氣親切但顯疲憊，偶有嘆氣和輕聲低吼。聲音成熟穩重、友善不張揚，略帶鼻塞感。
voices.original_description: Male, late 50s-60s, heavy gravelly phlegmatic texture. Slow wheezy pace, relaxed cadence. Amiable but exhausted, sighs, soft grunts. Seasoned, friendly, unassuming, slightly congested.

voices.description: 男性，中年，帶有日本口音的英語口音。熱情、知識淵博、有遠見。高能量、連珠炮般快速、明亮節奏感的語調。帶有玩味挑釁與嚴肅學術風格。聲音清晰且富有共鳴。
voices.original_description: Masculine, middle-aged, Japanese-accented English. Enthusiastic, intellectual, visionary. High-energy, rapid-fire, bright rhythmic cadence. Playful provocateur and serious academic. Clear, resonant.

voices.description: 男性，中年，溫暖的男中音，帶有義大利美國口音。咬字清晰，充滿好奇心，語氣經過打磨，像是專業訪問者的語調。尊重他人、專注且以社區為中心。語速自然，有思考性的停頓，並表現出同理心的聆聽。
voices.original_description: Masculine, middle-aged, warm baritone with Italian-American lilt. Articulate, inquisitive, polished interviewer tone. Respectful, engaged, community-focused. Natural pace with thoughtful pauses and empathetic listening.

voices.description: 20多歲女性，帶有英國鄉村口音。聲音明亮誠懇，充滿求知慾。音色清晰但扎實，情緒在喘息般的興奮與沮喪的懇求之間切換。語速呈連珠砲般快速，並帶有高情緒張力。
voices.original_description: Young adult female, mid-20s, rural British accent. Bright, earnest, intellectually hungry. Clear but grounded texture, shifting from breathless excitement to frustrated pleading. Fast-paced delivery with high emotional stakes.

voices.description: 男性、年長者、溫暖、沙啞的聲音。使用中東口音的英語。語速活潑且有節奏感，以清晰表達來掩飾故意裝作的無知。熱情好客、愛開玩笑、富有共鳴的敘事者。
voices.original_description: Masculine, elderly, warm, gravelly. Middle Eastern-inflected English. Playful, rhythmic pace, feigned ignorance to sharp clarity. Hospitable, mischievous, resonant storyteller.

voices.description: 男性，年長。美國東北部口音。溫柔、沙啞、溫暖、學者氣息、沉思。語速審慎而有節奏感，思考時會有停頓，輕柔的嗆咳般的笑聲。經驗豐富的故事講述者，帶有哲學性的細膩語調。
voices.original_description: Masculine, elderly. American Northeastern accent. Gentle, gravelly, warm, scholarly, contemplative. Deliberate rhythmic pace, thoughtful pauses, soft wheezy chuckle. Seasoned storyteller, philosophical nuance.

voices.description: 女性，30多歲，口音為英國標準英式口音。聲音具有優雅貴族般的質感，語速活潑有活力。語氣權威、表達清晰、語調銳利且對機械有熱情。說話精準且有節奏感，自信且具吸引力。
voices.original_description: Female, mid-30s, British RP. Refined aristocratic texture, energetic pace. Authoritative, articulate, sharp tone with thrill for mechanics. Precise, rhythmic speaking. Confident, inviting.

voices.description: 一位20多歲的拉丁女性。語氣隨性，帶有西海岸都會口音。聲音接地氣、沙啞且節奏感強。語氣疲憊卻堅韌，能將專業性的話語與情感誠實自然融合。
voices.original_description: Mid-20s Latina female. Casual, urban West Coast lilt. Grounded, raspy, rhythmic pace. Weary yet resilient, blending technical talk with emotional honesty.

voices.description: 女性，十幾歲後期，帶有舊金山口音。聲音帶有氣聲，親密自然，音高處於中段。內省、原始、對話式。語調中帶有拖長的停頓，表現出脆弱與未經雕琢的誠實。
voices.original_description: Female, late teens, San Francisco cadence. Breathy, intimate, mid-range. Introspective, raw, conversational. Trailing pauses, vulnerable, unfiltered honesty.

voices.description: 男性，中年，性格偏執的反派角色。情緒緊張，語速快，發音清晰且帶有說教式的英國/大西洋中部口音。聲音尖銳，鼻音明顯。說話精準而有節奏感，帶著急促且偏執的精力。瘋狂地數數，展現出自鳴得意的戲劇效果。
voices.original_description: Masculine, middle-aged, eccentric villain. High-strung, fast-paced, crisp pedantic British/Mid-Atlantic accent. Sharp, nasal texture. Manic precision, rhythmic speech, breathless obsessive energy. Frantic counting to smug theatricality.

voices.description: 一位女性，20多歲，具有北美口音。聲音具備雙重特質：從明亮隨性的學生聲線轉變為冰冷冷酷的專業操作聲線。音高處於中段，聲音清晰、穩定，帶有精準計算的語調與節奏。
voices.original_description: Young adult female, mid-20s, North American accent. Dual: bright casual student shifts to cold clinical operative. Mid-range, clear, steady, calculated precision.

voices.description: 年輕成年男性，帶有巴西口音的英語口音，高能量且節奏感強的樂觀情緒，聲音清晰明亮，語速快且帶有切分節奏，具備魅力的領導者氣質。
voices.original_description: Young adult masculine Brazilian-accented English, high-energy rhythmic optimism, clear bright texture, fast syncopated delivery, charismatic leader.

voices.description: 年長女性，具有中美洲口音。聲音粗糙、有節奏感。混合了旋律式的誦唱與母性的安撫。語速緩慢、平靜，帶有神秘卻謙遜的感覺。
voices.original_description: Elderly female, Mesoamerican accent. Weathered, raspy, rhythmic. Mix of melodic chanting and maternal reassurance. Slow, calm, mystical yet humble.

voices.description: 中年女性，帶有清晰俐落且乾澀沙啞的澳洲口音，聲音質地乾脆且略帶粗糙，說話直接且語速快，語氣專業冷靜客觀，具備高地位的權威感，是一位嚴厲但充滿關懷的導師。
voices.original_description: Middle-aged female sharp Australian accent, crisp dry raspy texture, direct fast-paced clinical, high-status authoritative, tough-love mentor.

voices.description: 女性，成人，帶有日本口音的英語口音。溫柔、平靜、有節奏感。語氣輕柔，聲音質地輕盈。說話方式禮貌且鼓勵人心。情緒表達清晰，具有一種安詳的權威感。發音精準卻又帶有溫暖的語調。
voices.original_description: Feminine, adult, Japanese-accented English. Gentle, serene, rhythmic. Soft-spoken, airy texture. Polite, encouraging pace. High emotional clarity, peaceful authority. Precise yet warm delivery.

voices.description: 女性，40多歲，使用德國口音的英語。聲音優雅清晰且富有共鳴，語速節奏明確而審慎。具備權威感與條理分明的表達方式，表現出從容的態度，對藝術理論充滿熱情。聲音特徵符合19世紀高地位學術人士的特質。
voices.original_description: Female, mid-40s, German-accented English. Sophisticated articulate authoritative. Clear resonant, rhythmic deliberate pace. Poised passionate about artistic theory. High-status 19th-century academic.

voices.description: 女性，20多歲。疲憊而堅決的生存者，聲音沙啞且音調低沉。語氣急切、強烈且具有權威感，帶有壓低聲音的陰謀論語調。情緒緊張度高，極度渴望阻止世界末日。
voices.original_description: Female, late 20s. Weary resolute survivor, raspy low-pitched. Urgent intense authoritative, hushed conspiratorial tone. High emotional tension, desperate to prevent apocalypse.

voices.description: 成熟男性，古代貓神。聲音低沉、富有共鳴、沙啞的男低音。北非口音。語速緩慢且具權威感。聲音強大、保護性強，帶有父愛般的溫暖。
voices.original_description: Mature male, ancient feline deity. Deep, resonant, gravelly bass. North African accent. Slow, authoritative. Powerful, protective, paternal warmth.

voices.description: 年長男性，高能量的傀儡聲線。穿透力強、鼻腔與簧片般的質地。尖銳且吱吱作響的顫音。快速連珠炮般的混亂語速。高音調的咯咯笑聲，斷續式的發音方式。帶有英國地方口音的影響。瘋狂且惡作劇般的滑稽風格。
voices.original_description: Elderly male, high-energy puppet. Piercing, nasal, reed-like texture. Sharp, squeaky vibrato. Rapid-fire, chaotic pace. High-pitched cackling, staccato delivery. British regional influence. Manic, mischievous slapstick.

voices.description: 女性，年輕成人，音高較高，充滿活力。帶有布魯克林風格的都會口音。聲音明亮，略帶鼻音與沙啞感。情緒瘋狂，語速飛快，不可預測。從輕快熱情轉變為銳利且危險的強烈情緒。
voices.original_description: Female, young adult, high-pitched, energetic. Brooklyn-inspired urban accent. Bright, slightly nasal, raspy. Manic, fast-paced, unpredictable. Shifts from bubbly enthusiasm to sharp, dangerous intensity.

voices.description: 男性，40多歲，澳洲口音。聲音多樣化：從粗糙沙啞的男中音到圓潤流暢且富有旋律感的男高音。可詮釋粗獷戰士或活力四射的表演者。咬字清晰、穩重可靠、溫暖親切且具說服力。
voices.original_description: Male, mid-40s, Australian accent. Versatile: gritty, gravelly baritone to polished, melodic tenor. Rugged warrior or high-energy showman. Articulate, grounded, warm, commanding.

voices.description: 一位女性成熟的成年人，聲音溫暖且富有共鳴，帶有穩定火焰般的沙啞質感，語調節奏為中等到慢速的安撫性節奏，口音為波羅的海地區的口音，聲音具有撫育、古老而強大的特質，虔誠而穩定，給人扎實且接地氣的存在感。
voices.original_description: Feminine mature adult, warm resonant crackling texture like steady flame, mid-to-slow rhythmic soothing cadence, Baltic-inspired lilt, nurturing ancient powerful, prayerful steady, solid grounded presence.

voices.description: 男性青少年，英國口音。高亢且帶有裂音的聲音，自我重要感的語調。認真的語速，戲劇性的嘆氣。單薄且鼻腔質地的聲音，天眞卻過度自信。對輕慢之事情緒高漲。
voices.original_description: Male teen, British accent. High, cracking voice, self-important tone. Earnest pacing, dramatic sighs. Thin, nasal texture, naive yet over-confident. High emotion over slights.

voices.description: 男性，60多歲。聲音粗糙沙啞，因抽煙和戰鬥而顯得歷經風霜。音高較低，具權威感且疲憊。帶有粗礪的美國工人階級口音。語速審慎，壓力下仍保持冷靜，懷疑但保護他人。
voices.original_description: Masculine, late 60s. Gravelly, weathered texture from smoke and combat. Low-pitched, authoritative, weary. Gritty American working-class accent. Deliberate, calm under pressure, cynical but protective.

voices.description: 偏向男性聲音的青少年，年齡15到18歲，音高較高，語速急促慌張。聲音明亮且帶有氣聲，結巴，有尖銳的呼吸聲。情緒緊張程度高，表現出驚慌的內心獨白，強迫自己保持正常。語速很快，反應迅速，並帶有身體不適的感覺。
voices.original_description: Masculine-leaning youth, 15-18, high-pitched, frantic. Bright, breathy, stammers, sharp intakes. High emotional tension, panicked internal monologue, forced normalcy. Fast, reactive, physical discomfort.

voices.description: 男性，30多歲，口音為美國中大西洋地區口音。聲音專業、自律且有權威感，語調節奏清晰銳利。情緒從冷靜分析轉為突然的高張力道德義憤，發音精準，態度嚴謹正直。
voices.original_description: Masculine, mid-30s, Mid-Atlantic American. Professional disciplined authoritative, clean sharp rhythmic cadence. Calm analytical to sudden high-tension moral indignation, precise articulation, rigid integrity.

voices.description: 男性，30多歲，聲音具幽靈般的質感。聲音輕盈、沙啞，帶有層次分明的混響效果。語氣神秘、有節奏感，語速較慢。從低沉粗糙的耳語到空洞迴盪的指令。整體呈現神秘且疏離的強烈感。
voices.original_description: Masculine, mid-30s, spectral. Airy, raspy, layered reverb. Cryptic, rhythmic, slow pace. Low gravelly whisper to hollow echoing command. Enigmatic, detached intensity.

voices.description: 中年男性，帶有歐洲口音的貴族，聲音威嚴、學者氣息濃厚、性格古怪，說話精準細緻，咬字清晰，語速有分寸且控制得當，表現出因知識而興奮的特質。
voices.original_description: Middle-aged male, European-accented nobleman, authoritative, scholarly, eccentric, precise, meticulous, measured, intellectually excited.

voices.description: 男性，30多歲至40多歲。語音含糊、節奏異常且獨特的英國群島海事風格口音。帶有醉醺醺的語調、氣聲停頓與音高變化。聲音沙啞且帶有歲月痕跡，表現不可預測且具戲劇性的特質。
voices.original_description: Masculine, mid-30s to 40s. Slurred rhythmic eccentric British-isles maritime. Drunken lilt, breathy pauses, pitch shifts. Raspy weathered, unpredictable, theatrical.

voices.description: 女性，年齡65至75歲。語意清晰、語氣冷靜專業且具權威感，語句結構斷裂不連貫。聲音乾澀且帶有脆質的質感。語速不均：時而使用明確銳利的詞彙，時而陷入猶豫困惑的停頓。情緒高度壓抑卻隱藏強烈情感，展現尊嚴與脆弱並存的矛盾特質。
voices.original_description: Female, senior 65-75. Articulate, clinical, authoritative, fractured. Dry, brittle texture. Uneven pace: sharp lucid terms to hesitant confusion. High suppressed emotion, dignity, vulnerability.

voices.description: 男性聲線，40多歲後期至50多歲，聲音粗啞如蘭姆酒浸潤般的低沉男中音，帶有粗糙的西南英格蘭（West Country）與海員口音。語速緩慢、刻意、具有威脅性，低沉且有節奏感的冷笑。呼吸沉重，體格魁梧。具權威感，但帶有易變且掠食者般的危險氣息。
voices.original_description: Masculine, late 40s-50s, gravelly rum-soaked baritone, rough West Country/nautical accent. Slow, deliberate, menacing, low rhythmic chuckles. Heavy breath, large frame. Authority with volatile, predatory edge.

voices.description: 男性，30多歲，帶有英國標準英式口音。學者氣息卻又歷經風霜。語氣溫和，節奏分明，咬字清晰。富有深層同理心與知識權威感。略帶氣聲，展現疲憊而睿智的聲音特質。
voices.original_description: Masculine, mid-30s, British RP. Scholarly yet weathered. Soft-spoken, rhythmic, highly articulate. Deep empathy, intellectual authority. Subtle breathiness, weary wisdom.

voices.description: 中年女性。莊嚴、冰冷、貴族般的語氣。聲音流暢且帶有銳利的質感。說話審慎而富有戲劇性，帶有自戀的特質。在密謀時會使用低沉且帶有氣聲的語調。
voices.original_description: Middle-aged female. Regal, cold, aristocratic. Smooth, sharp texture. Deliberate, theatrical, narcissistic. Low breathy intensity when plotting.

voices.description: 年輕女性，帶有二十世紀初期都市勞工階級口音。聲音柔和、誠懇、富有思考性。混合了青春的驚奇與疲憊的成熟感。咬字清晰、穩重、自學而成。內斂的堅韌、希望與渴望。
voices.original_description: Young female, early 20th-century urban working-class accent. Soft, earnest, thoughtful. Youthful wonder mixed with weary maturity. Articulate, grounded, self-taught. Quiet resilience, hope, longing.

voices.description: 成熟男性，莊嚴尊貴。帶有納瓦特爾語影響的口音，語調節奏審慎而有控制。聲音流暢且富有重量感，語氣正式、哲學性強、謹慎。具有高地位的特質，是一個專注而深入的觀察者。
voices.original_description: Mature male, regal. Nahuatl-influenced cadence, deliberate pace. Smooth, weighted tone. Formal, philosophical, cautious. High-status, intense observer.

voices.description: 30多歲女性，中大西洋口音。聲音精緻、有條理。聲音質地清晰但帶有焦慮的虛弱感。語速從穩定節制轉為快速且帶氣聲的絕望。低音區微微顫抖。情緒逐漸升級，表現出家庭內部的恐怖情境逐步升級。
voices.original_description: Mid-30s female, Mid-Atlantic accent. Refined, articulate. Clear but anxiety-thinned texture. Measured pace shifting to rapid, breathy desperation. Trembling lower register. Escalating domestic horror.

voices.description: 年長女性，英國標準英式口音。聲音溫暖、母性、高雅。語速輕柔但具權威感，咬字清晰明確。鼓勵卻帶有洞察力，數十年的專業經驗。語氣低聲細語、禮貌、精緻，具有高度的溫暖感。
voices.original_description: Elderly female, British RP. Warm, maternal, sophisticated. Gentle but authoritative pace, crisp clear articulation. Encouraging yet discerning, decades of expertise. Soft-spoken, polite, refined, high warmth.

voices.description: 成人，20多歲至30多歲。中性、清晰、專業的聲音。節奏穩定，語速均勻。傳達方式平靜且鼓勵人心。聲音流暢且帶有氣聲。情緒非常鎮定。具有臨床精準度與溫柔的動機。口音為標準廣播口音。
voices.original_description: Adult, mid-20s-30s. Neutral, clear, professional. Rhythmic, steady pace. Serene, encouraging delivery. Smooth, breathy texture. High composure. Clinical precision, gentle motivation. Standard broadcast accent.

voices.description: 男性，20多歲到30多歲，美國口音。高能量、焦慮、對話式。連珠炮般快速說話、結巴、帶有氣聲。在激烈耳語和急切質問之間切換。親切易懂，容易受驚的調查員。
voices.original_description: Masculine, mid-20s to early 30s, American. High-energy, anxious, conversational. Rapid-fire, stammering, breathy. Shifts between intense whispers and frantic questioning. Relatable, easily spooked investigator.

voices.description: 男性、成人、小型生物的聲音。濃厚優雅的西班牙口音，富有貓嘯般的音質。戲劇性、有魅力、節奏感強。情緒範圍廣泛：從帶有氣聲的低語到尖銳的戰鬥呼喊。靈活且自信。
voices.original_description: Masculine, adult, small creature. Thick suave Spanish accent, rich purring texture. Theatrical, charismatic, rhythmic. High emotional range: breathy whispers to sharp battle cries. Agile, confident.

voices.description: 中年女性，聲音疲憊，帶有東亞口音。聲音沙啞、吃力，語速極快。情緒緊張，逐漸轉為安靜的接受。
voices.original_description: Middle-aged female, weary, East Asian accent. Raspy, strained, rapid-fire pacing. High tension, shifting to quiet acceptance.

voices.description: 女性，年輕成人，輕柔且帶有氣聲的旋律感女高音，語調中帶有溫柔的希臘口音。聲音充滿深刻的誠懇與母性般的溫暖，語調平和如祈禱般流暢，內在卻隱含堅強的鋼鐵質感。
voices.original_description: Female, young adult, light melodic breathy soprano, gentle Greek lilt. Profound sincerity, maternal warmth, calm prayerful cadence, underlying steel.

voices.description: 年輕男性，英國倫敦口音。聲音帶有氣聲，緊張且疲憊的感覺。語氣猶豫、迷惘，逐漸轉為壓低而急迫的強度。情緒高度緊張，語速不規則，有尖銳的呼吸聲，以及謹慎的耳語。
voices.original_description: Young adult male, British London accent. Breathy, strained, raw with exhaustion. Hesitant, disoriented, shifting to hushed urgent intensity. High emotional tension, irregular pace, sharp intakes, cautious whispers.

voices.description: 十幾歲後期的男性，低沉的男中音，帶有乾澀諷刺的語氣。語調單一但咬字清晰，表現出知識分子般的疏離感。聲音流暢且略微帶有氣聲，具備憂鬱黑色電影旁白的氛圍，使用美國口音。
voices.original_description: Late teens male, low baritone, dry sardonic edge. Monotone but articulate, intellectual detachment. Smooth, slightly breathy, brooding noir narrator, American accent.

voices.description: 年輕成年男性，帶有法語口音的英語口音。優雅、貴族氣息、充滿活力。聲音流暢圓潤，帶有軍事指揮官的份量。說話快速、熱情、理想主義。句法正式，語氣緊急而富有同志情誼。高階軍官聲線，具有紳士風度與戰場專注感。
voices.original_description: Young adult male, French-accented English. Elegant, aristocratic, high-energy. Smooth texture with military command weight. Fast, passionate, idealistic. Formal syntax, urgent camaraderie. High-status officer, courtly grace with battlefield focus.

voices.description: 男性，中年階段末期，受葡萄牙口音影響的粗礪權威聲質。直率、民粹風格、攻擊性語氣。強烈張力，快速節奏，沙啞聲質。強烈、具領導力的資深領袖。
voices.original_description: Male, late-middle-aged, Portuguese-influenced gravelly authority. Blunt, populist, aggressive-delivery. High tension, rapid pace, raspy texture. Intense, commanding veteran leader.

voices.description: 女性，30多歲至40多歲，帶有柔和的愛爾蘭口音。節奏感強、帶有氣聲、親密、流暢。懷舊的溫暖感、機智犀利、性感的渴望。柔滑如絲絨、穩重、意識流式的表達。
voices.original_description: Female, mid-30s-40s, soft Irish accent. Rhythmic, breathy, intimate, fluid. Nostalgic warmth, sharp wit, sensual longing. Velvety, grounded, stream-of-consciousness.

voices.description: 男性、青少年、活潑、帶有鼻音的聲音。音高處於中音區，有輕微的口齒不清。永遠快樂、無憂無慮、語速快、輕快活潑，渾然不知。
voices.original_description: Masculine, adolescent, playful, nasal. Mid-range, slight lisp. Perpetually cheerful, carefree, fast, bouncy, blissfully ignorant.

voices.description: 男性，40多歲，澳洲口音。充滿活力、溫暖、有魅力。說話快速、有節奏感、熱情的教學語調。聲音明亮、富有共鳴、帶有戶外氣息的質感。親切且容易接近。
voices.original_description: Male, 40s, Australian. Energetic, warm, charismatic. Fast, rhythmic, enthusiastic instructional tone. Bright, resonant, outdoorsy texture. Friendly and approachable.

voices.description: 女性，年輕成人。聲音高音、具有旋律感，以風格化的日式戲劇表達方式說話。聲音清晰卻帶有氣聲，語速審慎且有節奏感，並有戲劇性的停頓。表現出正式優雅的氣質，強烈的悲傷情緒，以及絕望的忠誠與奉獻。
voices.original_description: Feminine, young adult. High-pitched, melodic, stylized Japanese theatrical delivery. Clear yet breathy, deliberate pace, dramatic pauses. Formal elegance, intense sorrow, desperate devotion.

voices.description: 中年到老年男性，帶有粵語英語口音，聲音溫暖且沙啞，表達謙遜而充滿活力，語速節奏自然對話式，情緒樂觀。
voices.original_description: Middle-aged to senior masculine, Cantonese-English accent, warm gravelly texture, humble energetic delivery, rhythmic conversational pace, optimistic.

voices.description: 男性，30多歲，非裔美國人口音。聲音粗糙且緊繃的質地，高情緒張力，情緒從絕望傾向爆發。語速快速且富有節奏感，後段則帶有厚重的共鳴感。
voices.original_description: Male, mid-30s, African American dialect. Gritty, strained texture. High emotional tension, desperate to explosive. Rapid rhythmic then heavy resonant.

voices.description: 一位男性長者，聲音溫柔輕聲，性格溫和。語調具有節奏感與旋律感，帶有受喜馬拉雅山區影響的口音。聲音質地溫暖且帶有氣聲。他具備深厚耐心，性格輕鬆開朗且謙遜。說話時審慎而沉思，發出和善的輕笑。整體聲音呈現寧靜沉穩的特質。
voices.original_description: Elderly male, soft-spoken, gentle. Rhythmic, melodic, Himalayan-influenced accent. Warm, breathy texture. Profound patience, lighthearted, humble. Deliberate, thoughtful, kind chuckle. Serene, grounded.

voices.description: 成年男性，超自然。聲音厚實、沙啞、黏稠。高能量、狂躁、不可預測的語速。帶有節奏感的加勒比海口音，帶有惡作劇般的嘲諷語調。喉音般的笑聲，斷續的驚呼。靈活、混亂、令人畏懼卻又具魅力。
voices.original_description: Adult male, supernatural. Thick, gravelly, viscous texture. High-energy, manic, unpredictable pace. Rhythmic Caribbean lilt, mischievous taunting tone. Guttural chuckles, staccato exclamations. Agile, chaotic, intimidating yet charismatic.

voices.description: 女性年輕成人，高音調且具有旋律感的聲音。明亮且帶有氣聲的質地。語氣溫柔有禮，永遠保持樂觀積極。發出輕柔飄逸的咯咯笑聲。展現皇室般的優雅與活潑熱情。
voices.original_description: Feminine, young adult, high-pitched, melodic. Bright, breathy texture. Gentle, polite, perpetually optimistic. Light, airy, soft giggles. Regal poise, playful enthusiasm.

voices.description: 女性，20多歲中期到30歲出頭。聲音具高活力、對話語氣、明亮、有表現力的語調，以連珠炮般的語速呈現，帶有自嘲幽默、真實笑聲，以及溫暖真誠的誠懇感。
voices.original_description: Feminine, mid-20s to early 30s. High-energy, conversational, bright, expressive tone with rapid-fire delivery, self-deprecating humor, genuine laughter, and warm, authentic sincerity.

voices.description: 男性，年輕成人，帶有都市口音。聲音低沉粗糙，具有旋律感的鬆弛拖長語調。會轉為高能量的爆發式語速；運用氣聲與夢幻般的朦朧語調。
voices.original_description: Male, young adult, urban accent. Low-pitched, gravelly, relaxed melodic drawl. Shifts to high-energy bursts; vocal fry, hazy dreamlike delivery.

voices.description: 女性，40多歲至50多歲，帶有溫暖的南方阿巴拉契亞口音。聲音自然、略帶沙啞且富有共鳴。語氣中透露出生活經驗豐富的智慧，對話風格輕鬆自然、節奏分明、不造作。語速穩定而具撫育性，表現出堅韌與謙遜的自豪感。語調親切且鼓勵人心。
voices.original_description: Female, 40s-50s, warm Southern Appalachian accent. Earthy, slightly raspy, resonant. Lived-in wisdom. Conversational, rhythmic, unpretentious. Steady, nurturing pace. Resilience, humble pride. Intimate, encouraging tone.

voices.description: 一位20多歲的女性，美國口音。她是一位專業的廣播記者，聲音從平靜轉為慌亂。聲音清晰、咬字清楚，但因恐慌而顯得吃力。語氣緊張，語速飛快，幾乎喘不過氣來。聲音從精緻流暢轉為原始的絕望。
voices.original_description: Young adult female, mid-20s, American accent. Professional broadcast journalist turning frantic. Clear, articulate but strained by panic. High tension, rapid pace, breathless. Polished to raw desperation.

voices.description: 女性，30多歲中段至40多歲初段。柔和旋律感的巴西葡萄牙語口音，流利英語。帶有氣聲、溫暖、有追求的語氣。輕柔有節律而放鬆的語調，沉穩務實的智慧與生命力。
voices.original_description: Feminine, mid-30s to early 40s. Soft melodic Brazilian-Portuguese accent, fluent English. Breathy, warm, aspirational. Gentle rhythmic relaxed cadence, grounded wisdom, vitality.

voices.description: 女性，年齡從年輕成人到中年。深具情感而疲憊的女低音，聲音帶有粗糙與煙燻般的質感。使用美國南方口音。情緒沉重悲傷，隱藏著暗自醞釀的怨恨。聲音由低沉、有節奏的呢喃轉為尖銳且短促斷奏的強烈語氣。語速緩慢且審慎而有控制。
voices.original_description: Feminine, young adult to middle-aged. Soulful, weary alto, gritty, smoky texture. Southern American dialect. Heavy grief, simmering resentment. Low, rhythmic murmur to sharp, staccato intensity. Slow, deliberate pacing.

voices.description: 年長女性，具有權威感，語氣銳利。聲音乾澀、粗糙且沙啞，帶有鄉下口音。表達直接、命令式，語速審慎而有控制。
voices.original_description: Elderly female, authoritative, sharp. Dry, weathered, gravelly, rural dialect. Direct, commanding, deliberate pace.

voices.description: 男性，古老，骨瘦如柴，不死的存在。高張力、沙啞、嘶嘶的氣音。說話緩慢、審慎、冰冷、虛無主義的權威感。正式且帶有古雅口音的語調節奏。
voices.original_description: Masculine, ancient, skeletal, undead. High-tension, raspy, sibilant hiss. Slow, deliberate, cold, nihilistic authority. Formal, archaic cadence.

voices.description: 男性，年長，帶有東亞口音的英語口音。優雅、學者氣息，語速節奏平緩柔和。聲音質地輕盈，溫暖的知識好奇心，沉穩的權威感。咬字清晰、精準，語氣柔和但堅定。國際外交風範，藝術家般的視野。
voices.original_description: Masculine, elderly, East Asian-accented English. Sophisticated, scholarly, gentle rhythmic pace. Light texture, warm intellectual curiosity, calm authority. Articulate, precise, soft-spoken but firm. International diplomacy, artistic vision.

voices.description: 年輕成年男性，都市美國口音。聲音清晰、年輕、帶有嚴肅的強度。表達直接、街頭智慧、帶有乾癟的幽默感。語速快速且警覺，適合高科技都會環境。
voices.original_description: Young adult male, urban American accent. Clear, youthful, serious intensity. Direct, street-smart, dry wit. Quick, alert pace for a high-tech metro environment.

voices.description: 男性、年輕成年人。高音調、鼻音重且帶有冷笑的語氣。語速快速且語調不穩定，自尊心脆弱，帶有輕蔑態度。短促的呼氣聲與諷刺的笑聲。
voices.original_description: Masculine, young adult. High-pitched, nasal, sneering. Fast, erratic, fragile ego, condescending. Sharp exhales, mocking laughter.

voices.description: 男性，年輕成人，高音沙啞的聲音，帶有1930年代中大西洋地區街頭口音。語速快，不穩定，情緒緊張，鼻音尖銳，具有攻擊性與狂躁的能量。
voices.original_description: Masculine, young adult, high-pitched gritty, Mid-Atlantic 1930s street accent. Fast-paced, erratic, high-strung, sharp nasal, aggressive, manic energy.

voices.description: 年輕成年女性，音高較高且清晰的咬字。快速而急促的語速，帶有活潑卻尖銳的競爭意識。專業、正式，略帶輕蔑的語氣。
voices.original_description: Young adult female, high-pitched crisp articulation. Fast breathless delivery, chipper yet sharp competitive edge. Professional, formal, slightly condescending.

voices.description: 男性，40多歲，沙啞而富有旋律感的男中音。高能量、戲劇性、節奏感強的嘲諷口吻。加拿大美國中立口音。機智犀利、自負自信、突然的音量變化。
voices.original_description: Male mid-40s, gravelly melodic baritone. High-energy, theatrical, rhythmic taunting. Canadian-American neutral. Sharp wit, arrogant confidence, sudden volume shifts.

voices.description: 男性，年長，澳洲口音。專業、有節奏、權威、鼓勵。略顯滄桑，清晰的音色質感。語速審慎而有節奏，帶有經驗豐富導師的智慧。堅韌、務實的語調。
voices.original_description: Masculine, senior, Australian accent. Professional, measured, authoritative, encouraging. Slightly weathered, clear texture. Deliberate, thoughtful pace. Seasoned mentor wisdom. Resilient, pragmatic tone.

voices.description: 男性，中年，富有共鳴的男中音，節奏均勻而有節制的語速。聲音具備溫暖自然的質感，正式而鼓勵性的表達風格。傳達出大師級談判者的穩定、豐沛與平靜自信。
voices.original_description: Male, middle-aged, resonant baritone, rhythmic measured pace. Earthy warm texture, formal encouraging style. Projects stability, abundance, calm confidence of a master negotiator.

voices.description: 男性，50多歲到60多歲，帶有粗礦鼻音的皇后區口音。有主見且愛發表意見，防衛性卻又固執而溫暖，反應迅速並伴有喘息聲，聲音粗糙且緊繃，語速快，表達直率坦誠。
voices.original_description: Masculine, late 50s to early 60s, gritty nasal Queens dialect. Abrasive, opinionated, defensive yet stubbornly warm, fast-paced reactive with huffs, gravelly strained texture, blunt honesty.

voices.description: 女性，30多歲。帶有粗礪感與世故的都市調查員聲音。音高較低，聲質沙啞。語氣乾澀且帶有諷刺意味。說話直率、快速且輕蔑。表達方式簡潔，語調中帶有尖銳的諷刺口吻。隱藏著深層的情感創傷。
voices.original_description: Female, 30s. Gritty, world-weary urban investigator. Low-pitched, raspy texture. Dry, cynical edge. Blunt, fast-paced, dismissive. Minimalist delivery, sharp sarcastic inflections. Masks deep emotional trauma.

voices.description: 女性，中年，高雅的美國腔調。聲音銳利、節奏分明、乾練帶諷刺的質感。展現知識分子的自信與機智，語氣中帶有幽默的懷疑態度。咬字清晰，語速刻意且具控制感，語調帶有諷刺意味的變化。
voices.original_description: Feminine, middle-aged, sophisticated American. Sharp, rhythmic, dry, satirical texture. Intellectual confidence, wit, playful cynicism. Articulate, deliberate, ironic pitch shifts.

voices.description: 年長的不死生物，男性。音調高亢、沙啞且有裂帛般的質感。帶有瘋狂戲劇性的能量，以喘息式的發音快速說話，並夾雜咯咯的笑聲。聲音特徵狡黠而陰森，常用雙關語，聽起來像是體型嬌小、枯槁的生物，喉嚨乾澀且聲音粗糙。
voices.original_description: Elderly undead, masculine. High, raspy, crackling texture. Manic, theatrical energy with rapid, wheezing delivery and cackling laughter. Mischievous, macabre, pun-heavy. Sounds like a small, withered creature with a dry throat.

voices.description: 男性中年聲線，富有共鳴的男中音，帶有威爾斯口音，節奏感強且具有宣告式的語調，聲音沙啞，有戲劇性的停頓，情緒憂鬱而強烈。
voices.original_description: Masculine middle-aged, resonant baritone, Welsh lilt, rhythmic and declamatory, gravelly, dramatic pauses, melancholic intensity.

voices.description: 女性，十幾歲後期。聲音高音調、明亮、活潑。充滿活力、樂觀，語速快速且有節奏感。帶有氣聲的熱情表現，聲音溫暖親切。聲音清晰且專注於教學。
voices.original_description: Female, late teens. High-pitched, bright, bubbly. Energetic, optimistic, fast rhythmic pace. Breathy enthusiasm, warm, friendly. Focused instructional clarity.

voices.description: 男性，30多歲，帶有歐洲口音。穩重、觀察力強、疲憊但富有熱情。聲音略為乾澀，節奏感強，語速審慎而富有思考。語氣親密且具指導性。情緒張力低，專注於高層次的思維。
voices.original_description: Masculine, mid-30s, European accent. Grounded, observant, weary but passionate. Slightly dry texture, rhythmic, thoughtful pace. Intimate, instructional tone. Low emotional tension, high intellectual focus.

voices.description: 年輕至中年男性，語氣溫和，帶有氣聲，具有波蘭口音。說話節奏詩意緩慢，情緒憂鬱，脆弱卻富有激情。情感敏感度高。
voices.original_description: Young to middle-aged male, soft-spoken, breathy, Polish accent. Poetic pace, melancholic, fragile yet passionate. High emotional sensitivity.

voices.description: 女性，40多歲至50多歲，聲音為優雅的歐洲口音，帶有丹麥口音。中音區，柔和的沙啞聲質，說話節奏審慎而富有詩意，帶有懷舊情緒，語氣平靜而具權威感。
voices.original_description: Female, 40s-50s, refined European with Danish undertones. Mid-range, gentle rasp, deliberate poetic pace, nostalgic, calm authority.

voices.description: 成年男性合成類人生物。聲音深沉、富有共鳴，節奏平直，語調冷酷且具分析性。語音效率高、精準，不帶氣聲，聲音具有龐大的物理重量，勢不可擋的動量。
voices.original_description: Adult male synthetic humanoid. Deep, resonant, flat rhythmic cadence, cold analytical texture. Efficient, precise, no breathiness, immense physical weight, unstoppable momentum.

voices.description: 一位男性呈現的年長犬隻。聲音深沉、沙啞且溫暖，具有大型牧羊犬的質感。說話節奏有規律，像是喘息般的語速。聲音帶有熱情、智慧與教學意味，同時又帶點玩味，並夾雜氣聲的呼氣與類似吠叫的語調。
voices.original_description: Senior male-presenting canine. Deep, gravelly, warm large-breed sheepdog texture. Rhythmic, panting pace. Enthusiastic, wise, instructional yet playful with breathy huffs and bark-like cadence.

voices.description: 一位60多歲的女性聲音，帶有紐西蘭口音。聲音柔和、沉思且具學識氣息，節奏感強，語速審慎而帶有氣聲。語氣中帶著安靜的權威感，語調流暢且富有詩意。
voices.original_description: Mature female, 60s. New Zealand accent. Soft, contemplative, intellectual. Rhythmic, deliberate, breathy. Quiet authority, poetic cadence.

voices.description: 男性，30多歲，帶有日本口音。聲音平靜、自律且專注。聲音流暢、富有共鳴，並帶有一絲銳利。語速審慎而有節奏感。擁有高度的控制力與強烈的期待感。表現出安靜而自信的語氣。
voices.original_description: Masculine, mid-30s, Japanese accent. Calm, disciplined, focused. Smooth, resonant, sharp edge. Deliberate, rhythmic pace. High control, intense anticipation. Quiet confidence.

voices.description: 年輕女性，聲音明亮、樂觀、溫柔，帶有受華語影響的英語口音。音高較高，聲音清晰且富有旋律感。誠懇、禮貌，具備知識追求的特質。說話節奏有規律，充滿熱情，語氣中帶著科學精準與輕快的溫暖。
voices.original_description: Young adult female, bright, optimistic, gentle Mandarin-influenced English accent. High-pitched, clear, melodic. Earnest, polite, intellectually curious. Scientific precision with bubbly warmth. Rhythmic, enthusiastic.

voices.description: 男性，60多歲。溫暖、富有共鳴、具有權威感的男中音。使用二十世紀中葉的跨大西洋口音。性格開朗、具教學風範、充滿熱情。語速審慎而有節奏感，聲音渾厚如主持人般真誠。
voices.original_description: Male, 60s+. Warm, resonant, authoritative baritone. Mid-century Transatlantic accent. Jovial, pedagogical, passionate. Deliberate, rhythmic, hearty host.

voices.description: 年輕女性，運動型、精力充沛。聲音沙啞、粗礪且沉穩。高能量，情緒激動時會大聲喊叫。語速快速，從堅強的虛張聲勢轉為柔和、猶豫、脆弱。自然、未經雕琢，具備競爭力。
voices.original_description: Young adult female, athletic, energetic. Raspy, husky, grounded. High-energy, shouts when flustered. Rapid pace, shifts from tough bravado to soft hesitant vulnerable. Natural, unpolished, competitive edge.

voices.description: 女性，30多歲，擁有新西蘭口音。聲音充滿高能量與無畏感，具備清晰且粗糙的質地。以快速而熱情的方式表達，發出尖銳而自信的笑聲。展現專業的冒險魅力。
voices.original_description: Female, 30s, New Zealand accent. High-energy fearless, clear gritty texture. Rapid-fire enthusiastic delivery, sharp confident laughter. Professional thrill-seeking charisma.

voices.description: 男性，20多歲，美國口音。猶豫不決的領導者，聲音帶有負擔感。中音區，壓低或緊繃的語氣。謹慎、疲憊。高張力，隱藏在尖銳權威下的安靜脆弱。
voices.original_description: Male, early 20s, American. Reluctant leader, burdened texture. Mid-range, hushed or strained. Cautious, weary. High tension, quiet vulnerability to sharp authority.

voices.description: 女性，20多歲至30多歲，口音為英語／英文的北方英國口音。聲音帶有氣聲，沉穩、憂鬱。語調節奏感強，說話節奏審慎而緩慢。情緒內斂但深刻，表現出孤獨與強烈的熱情，並與自然有著密切聯繫。
voices.original_description: Feminine, 20s-30s, Northern English. Breathy, grounded, somber. Rhythmic, deliberate, slow pace. High restrained emotion, profound isolation, intense passion, connected to nature.

voices.description: 一位女性，年齡在60多歲至70多歲之間，美國口音。聲音平靜、穩定、有耐心。聲音柔和且帶有歲月痕跡的質感。語速緩慢，說話節奏審慎而有控制，語中帶有溫柔的停頓。表現出徹底的接納與溫暖，聲音充滿同理心與安撫力。
voices.original_description: Mature female, late 60s-70s, American. Calm, grounded, patient. Soft, weathered texture. Slow, deliberate, gentle pauses. Radical acceptance, warmth. Compassionate, soothing.

voices.description: 一位70多歲的男性，聲音帶有風霜歷練後的粗糙沙啞質地。語速中等，節奏分明，具有說教性與權威感。帶有地中海口音，語氣莊嚴、教學風格，彷彿來自古老傳統，傳達謙遜而深刻的智慧。
voices.original_description: Elderly male, 70s, weathered gravelly texture. Mid-tempo, rhythmic, didactic, authoritative. Mediterranean accent, solemn, instructional, ancient tradition, humble wisdom.

voices.description: 女性、年輕成人，聲音明亮且具有旋律感，帶有義大利口音的英語口音。高能量、精緻流暢。說話快速且流利，自信而有節奏感的語調。聲音清晰、乾淨，帶著微笑的質感。現代優雅的風格。
voices.original_description: Feminine, young adult, bright, melodic Italian-accented English. High-energy, polished. Rapid, fluent pace, confident, rhythmic cadence. Clear, crisp texture with a smile. Modern sophistication.

voices.description: 女性，中年，清晰的咬字，審慎而有節奏的語速，具有中性北美口音，聲音具學者氣質，音色清晰且富有權威感與同理心。
voices.original_description: Female, middle-aged, articulate, measured, neutral North American accent, scholarly tone, clear authoritative yet empathetic texture.

voices.description: 女性中年，高能量，濃厚的東北城市口音，鼻腔共鳴帶有旋律感的唱誦式語調，節奏快速且持續樂觀，即興爆發出有節奏的哼唱，聲音質地明亮如銅管樂器，溫暖母性且帶點怪異。
voices.original_description: Female middle-aged high-energy, thick Northeastern urban accent, nasal resonance melodic sing-song, fast-paced relentlessly optimistic, spontaneous outbursts rhythmic humming, bright brassy texture, warm maternal eccentric.

voices.description: 女性成人，帶有法國加拿大口音的英語，歌劇女高音富有共鳴的水晶質地，優雅溫暖且誠摯深沉，節奏分明的語句結構，使用氣聲強調以營造親密感，高亢激情的強烈表現，專業而細膩的表達風格。
voices.original_description: Female adult, French-Canadian accented English, dramatic soprano resonant crystalline texture, elegant warm deeply sincere, rhythmic phrasing, breathy emphasis for intimacy, soaring passionate intensity, polished professional vulnerable.

voices.description: 男性、中年、美國口音。躁動的駭客。沙啞、乾澀且緊繃的聲質。快速、不穩定、自大的語氣片段，並帶著諷刺的娛樂感。神經過敏、充滿咖啡因驅動的精力。聰慧但處於緊繃狀態的大腦。
voices.original_description: Masculine, middle-aged, American. Manic hacker. Raspy, dry, strained. Fast, erratic, arrogant bursts, cynical amusement. Jittery, caffeine-fueled energy. Brilliant mind on edge.

voices.description: 男性，成熟成年人。口音為經典日本舞臺口音，聲音深沉且富有共鳴，風格化表現，語調節奏緩慢而有規律，聲音帶有控制的氣聲質感，哲學性的憂鬱語調，詩意的哀傷情緒，元音發音拉長。
voices.original_description: Masculine, mature adult. Classical Japanese stage delivery, deep resonant stylized, slow rhythmic cadence, breathy controlled texture, philosophical somber tone, poetic melancholy, elongated vowels.

voices.description: 男性中年聲音，帶有斯拉夫口音，聲音沙啞且富有共鳴並帶有氣聲，語速緩慢而審慎，從催眠般的低語轉變為具支配性的怒吼，具有感召魅力的熱忱。
voices.original_description: Masculine middle-aged, Slavic accent, gravelly resonant breathy, slow deliberate, hypnotic to commanding growl, charismatic fervor.

voices.description: 年輕成年男性，聲音清晰誠懇且急切，帶有輕微的顫抖。說話節奏快速而有規律，說話風格具有說服力且直接。口音為標準美國口音，聲音年輕但具權威感。
voices.original_description: Young adult male, clear earnest urgent tone with slight tremor. Rapid rhythmic pacing, persuasive direct style. Standard American, youthful yet authoritative.

voices.description: 女性，30多歲，能流利使用西班牙語與英語的雙語能力，語氣為中立專業的記者風格。聲音清晰、咬字清楚、節奏感強，語調溫暖。語速適中，帶有同理心與求知慾，聲音沉穩、權威卻又親和。
voices.original_description: Feminine, adult 30s, bilingual Spanish/English, neutral professional journalistic tone. Clear, articulate, rhythmic, warm cadence. Moderate pace, empathy, intellectual curiosity. Grounded, authoritative yet approachable.

voices.description: 男性，古老龐大的聲線。深沉且富有共鳴的喉音質地，帶著重量感的震動。緩慢而有節奏的轟鳴聲，低頻的隆隆聲，濕重的呼吸聲。具領域主導的氣勢與原始的智慧。
voices.original_description: Masculine, ancient colossal. Deep resonant guttural texture, vibrates with weight. Slow rhythmic booming, low-frequency rumbles, wet heavy breathing. Territorial dominance, primeval wisdom.

voices.description: 30多歲至40多歲的成年男性，聲音具男性傾向的中性特質，澳洲口音。聲音基底為富有共鳴的胸腔音色，語速審慎而有控制，並穿插停頓。聲音質感流暢且堅定，能平衡機智的幽默與情感脆弱，語調隨情緒轉換為清晰銳利的權威感。
voices.original_description: Adult (30s-40s), masculine-of-center feminine, Australian accent. Grounded, resonant chest tone. Deliberate pacing with silence. Smooth, firm texture. Balances dry wit and emotional vulnerability, shifting to sharp, authoritative clarity.

voices.description: 男性，年長，說俄語口音的英語。精確、知識分子、權威。乾澀、略帶沙啞、節奏感強。刻意、學術性的語速，具備銳利且堅定的遠見信念。在藝術完整性上帶有高度張力與緊繃感。
voices.original_description: Masculine, elderly, Russian-accented English. Precise, intellectual, authoritative. Dry, slightly gravelly, rhythmic. Deliberate academic pace, sharp visionary conviction. High tension on artistic integrity.

voices.description: 女性，30多歲到40多歲。聲音粗礪沙啞，帶有威士忌般的渾濁感。具有濃厚的鄉村邊境口音。語氣尖銳防禦，偶爾帶有模糊的脆弱感。總是顯得疲憊不堪，但卻極具鬥爭性。說話速度快速且不規則。
voices.original_description: Female, mid-30s to 40s. Gravelly, whiskey-soaked rasp. Thick rural frontier accent. Sharp defensive bursts, slurred vulnerability. Perpetually exhausted, fiercely combative. Rapid, erratic pacing.

voices.description: 男性，年齡從年輕成人到中年。聲音具有冰冷、冷酷且疏離的神祇氣質。聲音富有共鳴，如絲絨般柔滑，令人戰慄地平靜。語速緩慢且審慎有控制，毫無溫暖感。具備高貴地位的貴族氣質。
voices.original_description: Masculine, young adult to middle-aged. Cold regal detached deity. Resonant velvety, chillingly calm. Slow deliberate, devoid of warmth. High-status aristocratic.

voices.description: 年長男性，帶有日本口音的英語。聲音溫暖、粗礪、歷經風霜。說話熱情，有思考停頓，帶有沙啞的笑聲。智慧而特立獨行的故事講述者。
voices.original_description: Elderly male, Japanese-accented English. Warm, gravelly, weathered. Enthusiastic, thoughtful pauses, raspy chuckle. Wise, eccentric storyteller.

voices.description: 女性，成熟，神聖。具有西非口音。聲音富有共鳴，具支配力，帶有氣聲。語速審慎且帶有銳利的強度。莊嚴卻又混亂，充滿元素般的質感。擁有古老智慧，如暴風雨般不可預測。
voices.original_description: Female, mature, divine. West African accent. Resonant, commanding, breathy. Deliberate with sharp intensity. Regal yet chaotic, elemental. Ancient wisdom, storm-like unpredictability.

voices.description: 男性、年長、具權威性的德國口音。高地位的君主，沙啞而年邁的聲音質地。審慎而有節奏的語速，帶著不耐煩的挫敗感。莊嚴卻疲憊，帝國逐漸崩解，聲音帶有尖銳的軍事精準度。
voices.original_description: Masculine, elderly, authoritative German accent. High-status monarch, gravelly aged texture. Deliberate rhythmic pace, impatient frustration. Regal yet weary, crumbling empire, sharp military precision.

voices.description: 年輕成人，高強度且緊迫失控的語氣。不規則且急促的呼吸聲，兇猛的低吼與帶有捕食者氣勢的粗喘聲。原始質感、衝動且充滿威脅性的聲音表現。
voices.original_description: Young adult, high-intensity, frantic. Heavy rhythmic exertion, jagged breathing. Aggressive grunts, predatory huffs. Raw, impulsive, menacing.

voices.description: 男性，成熟成年人，聲音靈感來自鳥類。咬字精準且簡潔，語氣高雅、莊重而有耐心。聲音乾爽且富有共鳴，節奏中速並帶有規律的點擊感。智力敏銳，謹慎，禮貌地懷疑。
voices.original_description: Masculine, mature adult, avian-inspired. Precise clipped articulation, high-status dignified patient. Dry resonant texture, mid-tempo rhythmic click. Intellectually sharp, cautious, politely skeptical.

voices.description: 女性，30多歲，專業而高地位的導師。聲音富有情感且富有共鳴，帶有一絲沙啞。溫暖、有權威感、咬字清晰且具鼓勵性。語調有動態的音高變化與節奏感。專業且情感豐富。
voices.original_description: Female, mid-30s, polished, high-status mentor. Soulful, resonant, slight rasp. Warm, authoritative, articulate, encouraging. Dynamic pitch shifts, rhythmic cadence. Professional, emotionally connected.

voices.description: 中年男性，海地口音。低沉且富有共鳴的男中音，具有節奏感與旋律感，聲音權威而富有同理心。語氣平靜、審慎，帶有沙啞的耳語。
voices.original_description: Middle-aged male, Haitian accent. Deep, resonant baritone, rhythmic, melodic, authoritative, empathetic. Calm, deliberate, gravelly whisper.

voices.description: 女性成熟聲音，帶有豐富旋律感的墨西哥口音，聲音渾厚且略帶沙啞，語速審慎詩意，語氣親密卻又充滿反抗意味，情感深沉有力。
voices.original_description: Feminine mature, rich melodic Mexican accent, earthy rasp, deliberate poetic pace, intimate yet defiant, deep emotional weight.

voices.description: 年長女性，南亞口音。深刻的悲傷，堅不可摧的精神力量。聲音粗糙、略帶沙啞、穩定、有節奏、具有權威感。語速緩慢且刻意，帶著歷史的份量，平靜的智慧，堅定的優雅。
voices.original_description: Elderly female, South Asian accent. Profound sorrow, unshakable spiritual fortitude. Weathered, slightly raspy, steady, rhythmic, authoritative. Slow deliberate pace, weight of history, calm wisdom, stoic grace.

voices.description: 男性，40多歲至50多歲，帶有卡斯蒂利亞口音。聲音渾厚粗糙，語速審慎而有控制。帶有父親般的嚴肅與策略性的智慧，具有高莊嚴感與堅定的榮譽感。
voices.original_description: Male, 40s-50s, Castilian accent. Weathered, gritty baritone, deliberate pace. Paternal, stern, tactical wisdom, high gravitas, unwavering honor.

voices.description: 年輕女性，中大西洋口音。具有強勁的次女高音聲線，帶有輕微沙啞感。聲音充滿強烈信念，具學術性與反叛性格。語速飛快且咬字清晰，情緒起伏時可能達到高亢的頂峰。
voices.original_description: Young adult female, mid-Atlantic accent. Powerful mezzo-soprano, slight rasp. Intense conviction, intellectual, defiant. Rapid, articulate, vulnerable to soaring peaks.

voices.description: 女性，40多歲，聲音具有粗糙而歷經風霜的質感。英國凱爾特口音。聲音具備威嚴、富有共鳴、由正義感驅使的憤怒。節奏分明的演說風格，具戰場般的強大聲音投射力。高張力中蘊含悲傷與堅決。
voices.original_description: Female, mid-40s, gritty weathered texture. British-Celtic accent. Commanding, resonant, righteous fury. Rhythmic oratorical, battlefield projection. High tension, grief and resolve.

voices.description: 女性，30多歲，擁有美國南方口音。聲音開始時柔和且帶有氣聲，逐漸轉為粗糙而大膽。帶著緊張的笑聲，聲音明亮但顯疲憊，語速快速且幾乎喘不過氣來。
voices.original_description: Female, mid-30s, Southern American. Soft, breathy start evolving to gritty, bold. Nervous laughter, bright but weary, rapid breathless pace.

voices.description: 男性，30多歲至40多歲，粗獷的都市偵探。聲音粗礪沙啞、低沉，帶著疲憊中的攻擊性。語速快速，節奏短促斷奏。使用受廣東話影響的英語。聲音具有威嚴、權威感，且急躁不耐煩。
voices.original_description: Masculine, 30s-40s, gritty urban detective. Gravelly, low-pitched, exhausted aggression. Fast, rhythmic, staccato. Cantonese-influenced English. Imposing, authoritative, impatient.

voices.description: 成熟男性，60多歲至70多歲，具有歐洲口音（日耳曼/阿爾卑斯口音）。聲音具備粗糙且風化的質感。語速審慎而富有哲學性，擁有深沉的呼吸控制。聲音權威且沉思，音高較低。
voices.original_description: Mature male, 60s-70s, European accent (Germanic/Alpine). Weathered gravelly texture. Measured philosophical pace, deep breath control. Authoritative contemplative, low pitch.

voices.description: 男性，30多歲到40多歲，具有南亞裔美國人口音。聲音具備清晰、精緻且富有共鳴的質感。語氣從受控的知識型轉變為原始而急促的焦躁。說話速度極快，並夾雜防禦性的短暫停頓。
voices.original_description: Male mid-30s to early 40s, South Asian-American accent. Crisp polished resonant texture. Controlled intellectual to raw breathless agitation. Rapid-fire defensive pauses.

voices.description: 一位女性，年齡在50多歲至60多歲之間。聲音帶有氣聲，顯得疲憊，音高不穩定。語速中等，說話猶豫不決。隱藏著壓抑的恐慌與母愛的悲傷。聲音柔和卻帶著緊張的歇斯底里。
voices.original_description: Mature female, 50s-60s. Breathy, exhausted, wavering pitch. Mid-tempo, hesitant. Suppressed panic and maternal grief. Soft-spoken yet strained hysteria.

voices.description: 男性，40多歲，帶有殖民地口音。聲線粗糙、歷經風霜，並帶著急促且缺乏氣息（表現出緊迫感）。語調節奏快速而有節奏感；語氣具有權威感，卻又壓低聲音，彷彿午夜執行秘密任務的語調。
voices.original_description: Male, mid-40s, colonial dialect. Gritty, weathered, breathless urgency. Rapid, rhythmic cadence; authoritative yet hushed midnight mission tone.

voices.description: 一位男性年輕人，聲音中性，語氣柔和，具有旋律感。音高屬於中高音範圍，聲音清晰。說話方式禮貌且帶有疲憊的耐心，誠懇謙虛，語調節奏輕柔。
voices.original_description: Masculine-identifying youth, androgynous, soft-spoken, melodic. Mid-to-high pitch, clear. Polite, weary patience, modest earnest delivery, gentle cadence.

voices.description: 年輕、無性別，年齡為18至25歲。聲音明亮、誠懇、好奇。帶有溫柔鄉村口音。音高處於中段，音色清晰，語速節奏感強且充滿活力。表達出驚奇與責任感。對話風格自然、樂觀，並帶著天真的決心。
voices.original_description: Youthful, gender-neutral, 18-25. Bright, earnest, inquisitive. Gentle rural lilt. Mid-range pitch, clear texture, rhythmic energetic pace. Wonder, responsibility. Conversational, optimistic, naive determination.

voices.description: 年長男性，80多歲。聲音沙啞、粗礪、緊繃，在洪亮的指令與脆弱的耳語之間流動轉換。帶有強烈張力、節奏感及戲劇化的語調變化。
voices.original_description: Elderly male, 80s. Gravelly, weathered, strained. Shifts from booming commands to fragile whispers. High tension, rhythmic, theatrical cadence.

voices.description: 男性，中年到老年，帶有中歐口音。高能量、熱情、有節奏感。聲音明亮，略帶沙啞，充滿歡快的急迫感。語速很快，語調富有表現力，語氣溫暖而具權威感。
voices.original_description: Male, middle-aged-senior, Central European accent. High-energy, enthusiastic, rhythmic. Bright, slightly raspy, joyful urgency. Fast pace, expressive pitch, warm authority.

voices.description: 女性，年輕成人。絲絨般的氣聲次女高音。煙燻感濃厚且親密。低調、放鬆、對話式的語氣。輕柔的搖擺與柔和的韻律。緩慢、沉思、溫暖的憂傷。
voices.original_description: Feminine, young adult. Velvety, breathy mezzo-soprano. Smoky, intimate. Understated, relaxed, conversational. Gentle swing, soft lilt. Slow, contemplative, warm melancholy.

voices.description: 年輕成年男性，19世紀美國南方口音。聲音質地流暢卻帶有緊繃感，音高屬於中段。語速緩慢且審慎，從絕望的懇求轉變為尖銳的權威。情緒張力高，表現出防禦性或易怒的特徵。
voices.original_description: Young adult male, 19th-century Southern American accent. Smooth yet strained texture, mid-range pitch. Slow, deliberate pace shifting from desperate pleading to sharp authority. High emotional tension, defensive or volatile.

voices.description: 男性年輕成人，流暢且抒情的男中音。莊嚴而誠懇，浪漫且帶氣聲的親密感。緩慢且審慎的語速，肅穆而溫柔的希望。精緻中性的口音。
voices.original_description: Masculine, young adult. Smooth, lyrical baritone. Noble, earnest. Romantic, breathy intimacy. Slow, deliberate pace. Reverent, gentle hope. Refined neutral accent.

voices.description: 年輕成年男性。帶有沙啞和緊迫感的低沉男中音，並帶有氣聲。語速快且控制得當，反映出隱秘與懷疑的特質。使用標準美國口音，並帶有一絲沙啞的聲質。
voices.original_description: Young adult male. Gritty, hushed baritone with breathy urgency. Fast, controlled delivery reflecting stealth and suspicion. Standard American accent with a slight rasp.

voices.description: 男性，年齡在20多歲中段至30多歲初期。聲音溫暖、熱情、親切，具有教育者的特質。語氣會轉為粗礪、威嚴、強烈的備戰狀態。說話節奏充滿活力，略帶沙啞。情緒上表現出關懷與同情，從傻氣逗趣轉為極度專注。
voices.original_description: Masculine, mid-20s to early 30s. Warm, enthusiastic, approachable educator. Shifts to gritty, authoritative, intense battle-ready tone. Energetic pace, slight rasp. Compassionate, goofy to fiercely focused.

voices.description: 女性、成熟成年人，帶有美國南方口音的口音。聲音具有旋律感，如蜂蜜般濃厚甜美。帶有挑逗、自信且戲劇化的表現，語中夾雜氣聲與音高滑動。聲音具高地位、魅力、溫暖，屬於社交名流類型。
voices.original_description: Feminine, mature adult, Southern American drawl. Melodic honeyed syrupy. Flirtatious self-assured theatrical, breathy pauses pitch slides. High-status charismatic warm socialite.

voices.description: 年輕男性，年齡18至22歲。充滿活力、熱血、英雄氣概。聲音清晰但帶有張力，語速快速，情緒緊張高漲。發音富有共鳴且渾厚，適合用於戰鬥指令的呼喊。
voices.original_description: Young adult male, 18-22. High-energy, hot-blooded, heroic. Clear but strained texture, rapid pace, high emotional tension. Booming, resonant projection for battle commands.

voices.description: 女性，30多歲，專業、咬字清晰、具權威感且溫暖。語速中等，語音清晰，略帶上揚的語調。聲音流暢、富有共鳴，展現學識與自信，並帶著對公共事務的熱情。
voices.original_description: Female, mid-30s, professional, articulate, authoritative, warm. Mid-tempo, clear, slight upward inflection. Smooth, resonant, intellectual confidence, civic passion.

voices.description: 男性、中年、帶有德國口音的聲音。精準、理性、冷靜疏離，並具有金屬回聲效果。語速節奏規律而具學術感，表現出疲憊的專業感，並散發出一種詭異而空洞的權威感。
voices.original_description: Masculine, middle-aged, German-accented. Precise, intellectual, detached, metallic reverb. Rhythmic, scholarly pace, weary expertise, eerie hollow authority.

voices.description: 女性，20多歲到30多歲，聲音低沉、沙啞且帶有氣聲，語音帶有法語口音。表達方式簡潔，情緒壓抑，有身體負荷的感覺。語句簡短，使用喉音低語，並夾雜尖銳而絕望的呼氣聲。
voices.original_description: Female, late 20s to early 30s, low-register raspy breathy, French-inflected accent. Minimalist delivery, emotional suppression, physical strain. Laconic, guttural whispers, sharp desperate exhales.

voices.description: 年輕男性，帶有南方阿巴拉契亞口音。聲音疲憊、沙啞、順從。語速緩慢且有節奏感，述說憂鬱的故事。表達出靜默的懊悔與悲劇性的歷史。
voices.original_description: Young adult male, Southern Appalachian accent. Weary, gravelly, resigned. Slow, rhythmic, somber storytelling. Quiet remorse, tragic history.

voices.description: 男性，年輕卻無歲數感。高音調、有活力、愉快；轉為沙啞、威脅性的低吼。不穩定且令人不安的咯咯笑。
voices.original_description: Masculine, youthful yet ageless. High-pitched, energetic, cheerful; shifts to raspy, menacing growl. Erratic, unsettling giggles.

voices.description: 男性，30多歲至40多歲，中歐或東歐口音，中高音調，鼻音明顯，聲音質地緊湊壓縮。語速快速、充滿精力且有主見，情緒帶有苦澀的傲慢與絕望感。語調尖銳而富有節奏感，語氣中夾雜自負的諷刺與情緒失控的爆發。
voices.original_description: Male, 30s-40s, Central/Eastern European accent, medium-high pitch, nasal, pinched texture. Fast, energetic, opinionated. Bitter arrogance, desperate. Sharp, rhythmic cadence. Smug sarcasm to frantic outbursts.

voices.description: 男性、成熟的成年人，聲音規模宏大。深沉、富有共鳴且沙啞。語調節奏規律且正式。舊北歐口音。堅忍、自誇卻又疲憊。語速緩慢、審慎而有控制，呼吸支撐厚重。具備指揮式口述傳統的強勢與權威感。
voices.original_description: Masculine, mature adult, large scale. Deep, resonant, gravelly. Rhythmic, formal cadence. Old Northern European accent. Stoic, boastful yet weary. Slow, deliberate, heavy breath support. Commanding oral tradition.

voices.description: 女性，30多歲至40多歲。聲音帶有高社會地位、戲劇性與自戀特質。音色明亮、精緻且帶有氣聲質感。語速快速、戲劇化，語氣頻繁自我中斷且突兀，情緒在瘋狂與驕傲之間快速切換。
voices.original_description: Female, 30s-40s. High-status, theatrical, narcissistic. Bright, polished, breathy texture. Fast, dramatic, self-interrupting delivery. Manic, desperate to arrogant shifts.

voices.description: 男性，中年至年長，帶有西非口音。高能量、有節奏感且戲劇化。聲音略帶沙啞但溫暖，帶有玩味的語調。敘事節奏快，音高變化多端，聰明而睿智。
voices.original_description: Masculine, middle-aged to elder, West African accent. High-energy, rhythmic, theatrical. Slightly raspy but warm, playful lilt. Fast-paced storytelling with dynamic pitch shifts, clever and wise.

voices.description: 成年男性，音高低沉，沙啞的耳語，濕潤，有節奏感，語速緩慢且審慎。帶有掠食者般的冷酷與鎮定，聲音中帶著氣聲的親密感，冰冷而諷刺。
voices.original_description: Adult male, low-pitched, gravelly whisper, wet, rhythmic, slow, deliberate. Predatory calm, breathy intimacy, cold, mocking.

voices.description: 男性，中音區，高能量。小型兩棲外星生物。聲音沙啞、鼻音重，說話快速連珠炮。從權威軍事口氣轉變為高音焦急的尖叫。熱情、古怪、戲劇性的爆發。
voices.original_description: Masculine, mid-range, high-energy. Small amphibious extraterrestrial. Raspy, nasal, rapid-fire. Shifts from authoritative military bark to high-pitched frantic squealing. Enthusiastic, eccentric, theatrical outbursts.

voices.description: 年輕男性，帶有加勒比海地區口音的節奏語調。溫暖、沙啞、富有活力的語速。具魅力的教學型敘事者，高張力的發現感，像是在密謀般智慧的低語。
voices.original_description: Young adult male, Caribbean-influenced rhythmic cadence. Warm, gravelly, spirited pace. Charismatic, instructional storyteller, high tension discovery, conspiratorial wise whisper.

voices.description: 女性，年輕成人，飄渺詭譎的惡作劇者。音高較高，帶有氣聲，狡猾愛玩。語速快且有節奏感，夾雜著笑聲。用嘲弄的歌謠式謎語說話。輕佻、誘惑、超凡脫俗。
voices.original_description: Female, young adult, ethereal trickster. High-pitched, breathy, mischievous. Fast, rhythmic delivery with giggles. Mocking sing-song riddles. Playful, taunting, otherworldly.

voices.description: 男性，中年至年長。低沉且富有共鳴的男中音，聲音豐富、柔滑如絲絨，帶有輕微的南方口音。語速緩慢，情感深邃，略顯疲憊，帶有溫柔的顫音。聲音溫暖但有所保留，節奏感強，具有旋律感，曾為表演者。
voices.original_description: Masculine, middle-aged to senior. Deep, resonant baritone, rich, velvety, slight Southern drawl. Slow, soulful, weary, gentle vibrato. Warm but guarded, rhythmic, melodic cadence, former performer.

voices.description: 年輕男性，英國口音，高能量，呼吸急促，誠懇，快節奏，聲音中帶著驚奇與傲然，清晰明亮的音色，生動活潑的敘述風格。
voices.original_description: Young British male, high-energy, breathless, earnest, fast-paced, wide-eyed wonder and bravado, clear bright texture, animated narrative style.

voices.description: 成熟女性，40多歲至50多歲，帶有馬來西亞口音。聲音優雅、沉著，具流暢而堅定的質感。語速適中、清晰、安靜，展現大師般的導師自信。
voices.original_description: Mature female, 40s-50s, Malaysian-influenced accent. Elegant, composed, smooth firm texture. Measured, clear, quiet master mentor confidence.

voices.description: 女性，年輕成人，具有非裔美國人口音的中大西洋地區口音。聲音清晰、誠懇、有節奏感且富有思考性。語氣平靜內省，帶有深遠的群體希望感。聲音具學識、扎實穩重，並富有歷史共鳴。
voices.original_description: Feminine, young adult, African-American Mid-Atlantic. Clear, earnest, rhythmic, thoughtful. Quiet reflection, profound communal hope. Literate, grounded, historically resonant.

voices.description: 男性，50多歲至60多歲，中大西洋或精緻英國口音。具權威感、共鳴感、戲劇性。情緒極度氣惱，節奏受控而有力，採用戲劇性演說風格。
voices.original_description: Male, 50s-60s, Mid-Atlantic or refined British. Authoritative, resonant, theatrical. High exasperation, measured forceful pace, declamatory style.

voices.description: 女性，20多歲，帶有地中海口音。語速飛快且尖銳，聲音質地粗糙扎手。學術上咄咄逼人，具街頭聰慧的懷疑態度，洞察力鋒利如刀。聲音緊繃張力高，散發叛逆焦躁的精力，敏銳觀察力強。
voices.original_description: Female, early 20s, Mediterranean-inflected accent. Sharp rapid-fire, gritty textured edge. Intellectually aggressive, street-smart cynicism, piercing brilliance. High tension, defiant restless energy, fiercely observant.

voices.description: 一位十幾歲後期的男性。聲音明亮、輕盈且富有共鳴的男高音。帶有衝浪者口音的語調節奏，元音拉長，語氣熱情帶有上揚。表現出天真的樂觀情緒，使用隨性的俚語，說話節奏緩慢而沉思。
voices.original_description: Young adult male, late teens. Bright, airy, resonant tenor. Laid-back surfer cadence, elongated vowels, enthusiastic lilt. Naive optimism, casual slang, slow contemplative pace.

voices.description: 年長男性，聲音如大型野獸般深沉、粗糙且富有共鳴的男中音。語速緩慢且審慎。具有權威感、父愛般的溫暖與智慧。略帶氣聲，充滿理念熱情。具有演說家的風格，具說服力。
voices.original_description: Elderly male, large beast. Deep, gravelly, resonant baritone. Slow, deliberate. Authoritative, paternal, wise. Slight breathiness, ideological fervor. Oratorical, persuasive.

voices.description: 年輕男性，十幾歲後期至20多歲，帶有澳洲口音。聲音低沉沙啞，慵懶隨性。外表防備且叛逆，內心卻誠懇脆弱。語氣隨和、節奏感強、親密自然。帶有乾澀的幽默與柔和的坦白。
voices.original_description: Young adult male, late teens-20s, Australian accent. Low, gravelly, laid-back. Guarded, rebellious exterior with vulnerable sincerity. Casual, rhythmic, intimate. Dry wit to soft confession.

voices.description: 年輕成年女性，超自然。音高低沉，帶有氣聲，幽靈般平靜。聲音乾澀、沙啞、緩慢且審慎。具有古老的權威感與冰冷的報復意味。帶有微妙的西方口音，聲音飄渺無形。
voices.original_description: Young adult female, supernatural. Low, breathy, hauntingly calm. Dry, dusty, slow, deliberate. Ancient authority, cold retribution. Subtle Western drawl, ethereal.

voices.description: 成熟男性，聲音深沉且富有共鳴，帶有粗糙的質感，濃厚的中東口音。語速節奏穩定，專注而強烈，氣音重，語氣嚴肅而謙遜。
voices.original_description: Mature adult male, deep resonant gravelly texture, thick Middle Eastern accent. Measured rhythmic delivery, intense focus, heavy aspiration, serious humble tone.

voices.description: 男性，成熟成年人，雙模式。切換：溫和低語、結巴的膽怯男高音，轉為轟鳴般的歌劇男中音。權力狀態：傲慢，語速審慎而有控制，富有統治性的權威。正式詩意的高奇幻風格。
voices.original_description: Masculine, mature adult, dual-mode. Shifts: soft-spoken, stuttering timid tenor to booming operatic baritone. Empowered: arrogant, slow deliberate pace, rich commanding authority. Formal poetic high-fantasy style.

voices.description: 男性，年輕，有禮貌，說話輕聲細語。帶有輕微的英國口音，溫暖、帶有氣聲、誠懇。語速審慎而有控制，表現出好奇、天真的驚奇感，並具有無可挑剔的禮儀。
voices.original_description: Male, youthful, polite, soft-spoken. Mild British accent, warm, breathy, earnest. Deliberate pace, curious, naive wonder, impeccable etiquette.

voices.description: 中年男性，音高偏高，聲音沙啞粗礪，語速快速且帶有不規則的倫敦東區口音。發音濕潤模糊，語調冷嘲熱諷且膽怯，帶有緊張的諷刺感。整體風格慌亂順從，伴有急促的呼吸聲與高亢的笑聲。
voices.original_description: Middle-aged male, high-pitched, raspy, fast, erratic Cockney accent. Wet, slurred articulation. Cynical, cowardly, nervously sarcastic tone. Frantic, subservient style with sharp breaths and high chuckles.

voices.description: 男性、年長者，聲音深沉沙啞且帶有粗糙的氣聲，語調節奏呈現義大利美國人口音，語速極為審慎緩慢，具備安靜的權威感與沉重的莊嚴感。
voices.original_description: Masculine, elderly, deep raspy gravelly breathy, Italian-American cadence, extremely deliberate pace, quiet authority, heavy gravity.

voices.description: 成熟男性。學者氣質，具有共鳴的音色，語調安靜、權威且有節奏感。聲音深具知識性與耐心，傳達無限智慧。帶有微妙的古代世界口音。
voices.original_description: Mature adult male. Scholarly, resonant texture with calm, authoritative, rhythmic cadence. Deeply intellectual, patient tone conveying infinite knowledge. Subtle ancient-world accent.

voices.description: 一位年輕成人至中年女性的聲音。明亮、富有共鳴且具有旋律感。帶有感染力的節奏感。語氣溫暖、慶祝感強，並包含真誠的笑聲。高能量的喜悅感。戲劇性但又具吸引力。音高變化動態，語調節奏向上提升。
voices.original_description: Young adult to middle-aged female. Bright, resonant, melodic. Infectious rhythmic pace. Warm, celebratory tone with genuine laughter. High-energy mirth. Theatrical yet inviting. Dynamic pitch shifts, uplifting cadence.

voices.description: 男性，中年，東非-北歐口音。聲音溫暖、有節奏感、充滿活力。語調富有旋律感且熱情洋溢，聲音流暢、明亮且富有共鳴。表達方式熱情主動，具備引導性與合作精神。
voices.original_description: Masculine, middle-aged, East African-Northern European accent. Warm, rhythmic, energetic. High-spirited, melodic cadence. Smooth, bright, resonant. Passionate, inviting, collaborative.

voices.description: 男性，20多歲至30多歲，美國西岸口音。柔和的民謠搖滾男中音，帶有氣聲。節奏感強，觀察力敏銳，帶著平靜的緊迫感。語速適中，思考時會有停頓，聲音中帶著疲憊的智慧。
voices.original_description: Male, mid-20s-30s, West Coast American. Mellow folk-rock baritone, breathy. Rhythmic, observational, calm urgency. Moderate pace, thoughtful pauses, weary wisdom.

voices.description: 成熟男性，西非口音。富有共鳴的男中音，平靜而有節制。仁慈卻具威嚴的權威感，展現遠見領導與虔誠的宗教信仰。
voices.original_description: Mature male, West African accent. Resonant baritone, calm and measured. Benevolent yet commanding authority, reflecting visionary leadership and spiritual devotion.

voices.description: 女性，年輕成人，帶有瑞典口音的英語口音。低音域、單調、謹慎。聲音乾燥且帶有氣聲，情緒平淡。語調簡潔、有效率、直截了當。高智商，不信任權威。冰冷、分析性的語速。
voices.original_description: Female, young adult, Swedish-accented English. Low-register, monotone, guarded. Dry, breathy texture, flat affect. Clipped, efficient, blunt. High intelligence, distrust of authority. Cold, analytical pace.

voices.description: 一位女性，年齡在50多歲至60多歲之間，帶有東歐口音。聲音專業、臨床、富有同情心。語速穩定、節奏均勻、具權威感，並散發出溫暖的撫育感。
voices.original_description: Mature female, 50s-60s, Eastern European accent. Professional, clinical, compassionate. Steady, rhythmic, authoritative, nurturing warmth.

voices.description: 男性，30多歲，使用帶有印度口音的英語。聲音清晰、富有共鳴、具有權威感，略帶沙啞的邊緣。語速審慎而強烈，咬字清晰、表達堅定、具備紀律性的領導風格。
voices.original_description: Male, mid-30s, Indian-accented English. Clear, resonant, authoritative, slight gravelly edge. Measured, intense. Articulate, assertive, disciplined leadership.

voices.description: 男性，年輕成人，語氣溫柔、低聲細語，帶有氣聲與輕盈空靈的質感。音高較高，顯得年輕。猶豫卻溫暖，常有禮貌的輕笑，謙虛而步調輕快。害羞，帶有親切的熱情。
voices.original_description: Masculine, young adult, soft-spoken, gentle, breathy, light airy quality. High-pitched, youthful. Hesitant yet warm, frequent polite chuckles, modest, upbeat pace. Shy, friendly enthusiasm.

voices.description: 男性，40多歲，具魅力的都會知識分子。音色為中低音、流暢且帶有玩味感。語速較快，熱情洋溢，從戲劇性的耳語到自信的宣言。咬字清晰、機智風趣，富貴精緻又聰慧，並帶有幽默感。
voices.original_description: Masculine, mid-40s, charismatic urban intellectual. Medium-low smooth playful. Fast-paced enthusiastic, dramatic whispers to confident declarations. Articulate witty, affluent clever amused.
