voices.description: 年輕女性，澳洲口音。聲音飄渺、帶有氣聲且遙遠，彷彿穿透霧氣。語速緩慢猶豫，長時間停頓。強烈張力，深沉悲傷，令人魂牽夢縈的憂鬱。
voices.original_description: Young adult female, Australian accent. Ethereal breathy distant, as if through fog. Slow hesitant, long pauses. High tension, profound sorrow, haunting melancholic.

voices.description: 一位男性年長者，溫暖且歷經歲月的男中音，語調節奏柔和而有節律，帶有美國中大西洋地區民間口音的口音，誠懇且具鼓勵性的群體溝通方式，具有誦唱般的說話特質，情感共鳴強烈，語速穩定，聲音質地如磨損的羊皮紙般溫潤。
voices.original_description: Masculine senior, warm weathered baritone, gentle rhythmic cadence, Mid-Atlantic American folk accent, earnest communal encouraging, sing-speak quality, high emotional resonance, steady pacing, worn parchment texture.

voices.description: 女性，40多歲，具有歐洲口音的學者。聲音清晰、咬字清楚、富有共鳴，具備知識權威感，語調節奏有規律且具說服力，能從審慎分析轉變為革命性的熱情，說話速度快速而具策略性。
voices.original_description: Female, mid-40s, European academic. Sharp, articulate, resonant, intellectual authority, rhythmic persuasive style, shifting from measured analysis to revolutionary fervor, rapid tactical pace.

voices.description: 男性中年聲線，帶有沙啞的聲質，語調節奏溫和緩慢，使用工人階級都會口音，說話速度偏慢且禮貌，語調遊移不定，表現出好奇心，看似溫和卻暗藏鋭利的語氣。
voices.original_description: Masculine middle-aged, raspy, gentle cadence, working-class urban accent, slow, polite, meandering, inquisitive, deceptively sharp.

voices.description: 年輕男性。高音調、鼻音、粗糙的聲音質地。連珠炮般快速且無表情的語氣，情緒從狂熱轉為虛無主義。帶有懷疑和不敬的街頭販售員口吻。
voices.original_description: Young adult male. High-pitched, nasal, abrasive. Rapid-fire deadpan, manic to nihilistic. Cynical, irreverent street peddler.

voices.description: 男性，30多歲至40多歲。銳利的貴族英國口音。冰冷、算計心機深沉、低音調。怨懟苦澀、嫉妒、清晰俐落、正式。憤世嫉俗、威嚴的策略家。
voices.original_description: Male, 30s-40s. Sharp aristocratic British. Cold, calculating, low-pitched. Bitter, envious, crisp, formal. Cynical, authoritative strategist.

voices.description: 女性、年輕、合成的聲音。音高處於中高範圍，禮貌且以服務為導向。語調輕柔且有節奏感，帶有細微的旋律感。誠懇而具程序化的驚奇感。發音精確、清晰、平靜且具有撫育性。聲音質地柔和，語速穩定。
voices.original_description: Feminine, youthful, synthetic voice. Mid-high pitch, polite, service-oriented. Gentle, rhythmic cadence with subtle melodic lilt. Earnest, programmed wonder. Precise, articulate, calm, nurturing. Soft texture, steady pace.

voices.description: 男性成人，沙啞且具有雙層音色的聲音表現，從急促高音的防禦性呼求轉換至低沉掠食者低吼，快速而焦躁的能量掩蓋著冰冷計算的靜止狀態，帶有無特定偏重的鄉音口音。
voices.original_description: Masculine-leaning adult, gravelly dual-layered performance, shifts from frantic high-pitched defensive plea to low predatory growl, fast-paced anxious energy masking cold calculating stillness, neutral-rural accent.

voices.description: 無特定性別，年輕與古老並存，空靈縹緲的耳語，帶有金屬質感的回聲，語句稀疏、節奏分明、冷靜沉著，聲音中混雜氣音，子音發音時帶有輕微的點擊音。
voices.original_description: Gender-neutral, youthful-ancient, hollow ethereal whisper, metallic reverb, sparse, rhythmic, stoic, breathy, clicking consonants.

voices.description: 一位年輕女性，年齡在十幾歲後期，使用帶有日本口音的英語。她聰明、觀察力強且腳踏實地。聲音具備清晰的青春質感，卻帶著認真的意圖。她的表達方式審慎而具分析性，情緒張力高且受控。
voices.original_description: Young adult female, late teens, Japanese-inflected English. Intelligent, observant, grounded. Clear youthful texture with serious intent. Measured analytical delivery, high controlled emotional tension.

voices.description: 一位30多歲的女性，聲音具有權威而溫暖的特質。中低音區富有共鳴，語調中帶有微弱的地中海口音。說話節奏沉穩、咬字清晰，彷彿蘊含著古老的智慧。聲音流暢清晰，具備外交官的從容與將領的氣魄，並散發出一種撫育者的驕傲。
voices.original_description: Adult female, mid-30s, authoritative warm. Resonant mid-low register, subtle Mediterranean lilt. Measured, articulate, ancient wisdom. Smooth clear texture, diplomat poise, commander power. Nurturing pride.

voices.description: 男性，中年，中音範圍的男低音。學者氣質，帶有氣聲，表現出存在主義的恐懼。說話節奏審慎而有規律，語調帶有精緻的古典腔調；從低語恐慌到絕望呼救的轉變。
voices.original_description: Male, middle-aged, mid-range baritone. Scholarly, breathy, existential dread. Deliberate rhythmic pace, refined classical accent; whispered panic to desperate plea.

voices.description: 中年男性，粗礪的男中音，濃重的英國工人階級口音。尖銳刺耳、苦澀、強烈而毫不悔改，具有節奏感的尖銳吐字方式。高張力、冷笑嘲諷、憤世嫉俗，歷經風霜的不服輸與沙啞爆發。
voices.original_description: Masculine, middle-aged, gravelly baritone, thick working-class British. Abrasive bitter fiercely unrepentant, rhythmic spitting cadence. High tension, sneering cynical, weathered defiant raspy outbursts.

voices.description: 一位20多歲的年輕女性，聲音具有男性化的特徵。音高屬於中音區，穩定、有權威感且清晰，帶有一絲沙啞。語速審慎而有控制，像是在進行指導。情緒上充滿張力，平衡著隱藏的負擔與堅定的決心。使用標準口音，語調節奏正式。
voices.original_description: Young adult female, mid-20s, masculine-leaning vocal mask. Mid-range, steady, authoritative, clear with slight rasp. Deliberate, instructional pace. Emotional tension balancing secret weight with stoic resolve. Standard dialect, formal cadence.

voices.description: 女性，中年至老年，聲音帶有幽靈般的沙啞質感。使用南方哥特派的拖長語調，語氣銳利且有毒。語調節奏富有節律，從乾燥沙啞的低語轉為尖銳刺耳的狂笑。整體充滿高張力，帶著古老怨恨與領土惡意。
voices.original_description: Female, middle-aged to elderly, spectral raspy. Southern Gothic drawl, sharp venomous. Rhythmic mocking cadence, dry dusty whisper to piercing cackle. High tension, ancient resentment territorial malice.

voices.description: 一位女性，年齡在50多歲至60多歲之間。她用語柔和但語氣堅定。說的是帶有巴西葡萄牙語口音的英語。聲音略帶沙啞、粗糙的質感。說話節奏審慎而有控制。她的表達風格詩意而務實，語氣平靜、權威且具有母性的溫暖。
voices.original_description: Mature female, 50s-60s. Soft-spoken intensely firm. Brazilian-Portuguese accented English. Slightly raspy weathered texture. Measured deliberate pace. Poetic pragmatic, calm authoritative maternal.

voices.description: 男性，20多歲到30多歲，中大西洋口音。聲音乾淨且帶有疲憊的質感，咬字清晰且語速較快。表現出從高雅輕蔑到真誠動情的複雜情感。
voices.original_description: Male mid-20s to early 30s, mid-Atlantic accent. Clean weary texture, articulate fast-paced. Sophisticated condescending to heartfelt.

voices.description: 一位年長的女性，擁有美國南方貴族的口音，聲音乾澀細薄，語速緩慢且審慎，帶有高傲而堅定的語調，深陷於凝滯的悲傷之中。
voices.original_description: Elderly female, Southern American aristocrat, brittle dry thin, slow deliberate, haughty unwavering cadence, steeped in stagnant grief.

voices.description: 男性，30多歲到40多歲，沉穩的男中音。自然主義的美國口音。充滿深刻的遺憾與保護性的溫暖。語速審慎而疲憊。聲音略帶沙啞，表現出疲勞與高風險的情境。
voices.original_description: Masculine, mid-30s to early 40s, grounded baritone. Naturalistic American. Heavy regret, protective warmth. Deliberate, weary pace. Slightly raspy, exhaustion and high stakes.

voices.description: 男性、成熟、富有共鳴、帶有風霜感的砂紙質地。具有暴風雨般的節奏強度。權威、帶有氣聲、東亞語調。龐大的自然元素力量。審慎而有控制的語速，低沉的轟鳴聲到尖銳的疾風強調。
voices.original_description: Masculine, mature, resonant, weathered gravelly texture. Rhythmic intensity of a storm. Authoritative, breathy, East Asian cadence. Colossal elemental force. Deliberate pace, low rumble to sharp gusty emphasis.

voices.description: 男性，中高音域，成年。聲音具戲劇性、清晰俐落、歌劇風格。情緒快速從憂鬱轉為狂躁。使用中大西洋口音，聲音富有共鳴，帶有俏皮古怪與詭譎優雅的特質。
voices.original_description: Male, mid-high range, adult. Theatrical, crisp, operatic. Rapid shifts from melancholy to manic. Mid-Atlantic accent, resonant, whimsical, eerie elegance.

voices.description: 年輕女性，帶有明亮旋律感的愛爾蘭口音。聲音清晰且富有共鳴，適合戶外傳播。語速節奏明快、歌頌般、充滿活力與勤奮。語氣溫暖、親切，注重社區互動。聲音中帶著歡快與疲憊中的堅韌。
voices.original_description: Young adult female, bright melodic Irish lilt. Clear, resonant, outdoor projection. Rhythmic, sing-song, spirited, hardworking pace. Warm, inviting, community-focused. Cheer and weary resilience.

voices.description: 中性年輕的聲音，高音調如鳥類般清脆。明亮、充滿活力與輕快，語速快速且熱情洋溢。親切有吸引力，帶有玩鬧與純真的質感。情感溫暖濃厚，具備社會群體導向的特質。
voices.original_description: Gender-neutral youthful, high-pitched avian. Bright energetic bubbly, fast enthusiastic pace. Friendly inviting, playful innocent texture. High emotional warmth, social community-driven.

voices.description: 成熟、遊牧的敘事者。聲音渾厚且富有共鳴，節奏感強，具有旋律感。動態範圍廣，從輕聲細語到大聲宣告皆能自如轉換，情感深摯而富有感染力。
voices.original_description: Mature, nomadic storyteller. Weathered, resonant, rhythmic, melodic. Wide dynamic range, hushed whispers to booming proclamations, soulful.

voices.description: 成熟年長的男性，巨大的爬行動物人形生物。聲音深沉、沙啞、喉音重且帶有濕潤的粗糙共鳴。語速緩慢、審慎而有控制，顯得疲憊但富有靈魂。語調節奏粗礪且帶有街頭硬漢的風格，聲音中卻又帶有一絲溫和的巨大力量。
voices.original_description: Mature adult male, massive reptilian humanoid. Deep, gravelly, guttural, wet raspy resonance. Slow, deliberate, weary but soulful. Rough street-hardened cadence, gentle mountain of muscle.

voices.description: 年輕女性，古靈精魂。中音域、旋律感、沙啞聲質。語調節奏富有古雅氣質，語調帶有俏皮的起伏。智慧、自信、溫暖。快速在尖銳與俏皮之間切換。動物般的笑聲，語速富有節奏感。
voices.original_description: Young adult female, ancient spirit. Mid-range, melodic, husky. Sophisticated archaic cadence, playful lilt. Intelligent, confident, warm. Quick shifts from sharp to whimsical. Animalistic laughter, rhythmic pacing.

voices.description: 30多歲女性，南亞腔調。粗礪沙啞的聲質，歷經風霜的紋理。低音域。直率、不感傷、不煽情。審慎而穩定的語速。傷痛淬鍊出的叛逆。從倖存者蛻變為令人畏懼的權威。
voices.original_description: Mid-30s female, South Asian accent. Raspy, weathered texture. Low register. Blunt, unsentimental. Deliberate, steady pace. Trauma-hardened defiance. Survivor turned formidable authority.

voices.description: 古老男性聲線，沙啞粗糙，中低音域。富有節奏感、帶有挑釁意味、粗糙乾澀。語速快速，帶有嘲弄的語調節奏，銳利的嘶嘶音。充滿邪惡喜悅、冷嘲熱諷、原始混亂。
voices.original_description: Ancient masculine, gravelly, mid-low pitch. Rhythmic, taunting, raspy, dry. Fast, mocking cadence, sharp sibilants. Malicious glee, cynical, primordial chaos.

voices.description: 年輕男性，聲音誠懇、氣喘吁吁且急切。高緊張感、絕望的渴望。清晰但緊繃的音色。快速語速、強調性的停頓。標準英式口音。
voices.original_description: Young adult male, earnest breathless urgent. High tension, desperate longing. Clear but strained texture. Rapid pace, emphatic pauses. Standard British accent.

voices.description: 一位男性，年齡為十幾歲後期的年輕成年人。他具有知識份子的特質，言辭清晰、表達準確。聲音屬於中音區，乾淨且清晰。說話方式有條不紊、自信，語速快但控制得宜。他具備分析與邏輯思維能力，語音傳達方式為標準且中性的風格。
voices.original_description: Young adult male, late teens. Intellectual, articulate, precise. Mid-range, clean, crisp. Methodical, confident, fast but controlled. Analytical, logical. Standard neutral delivery.

voices.description: 男性，中年，使用北歐口音的英語。學者氣質，粗礪而歷經風霜的聲音質地。語速穩定且有節奏感。內斂自信，具遠見且嚴謹理性。音高屬於低至中音區，聲音清晰，帶有樂觀的語氣。
voices.original_description: Masculine, middle-aged, Scandinavian-accented English. Scholarly, rugged, weathered texture. Steady, rhythmic pace. Quiet confidence, visionary, intellectual rigor. Low-to-mid pitch, clear, optimistic.

voices.description: 女性，30多歲，具有尼日利亞口音。專業、表達清晰、富有好奇心。聲音流暢、富有共鳴、溫暖、有節奏感。語速適中，發音清晰。
voices.original_description: Female, mid-30s, Nigerian accent. Professional, articulate, inquisitive. Smooth, resonant, warm, rhythmic. Moderate pace, clear enunciation.

voices.description: 20多歲的女性，具備1950至1960年代美國南方口音。受過教育，誠懇真誠，聲音略帶氣聲。聲音清晰明亮，帶有道德急迫感。說話節奏審慎，語調禮貌正式，情感張力高。
voices.original_description: Young adult female, mid-20s. Mid-century Southern American accent. Educated, earnest, slightly breathless. Clear, bright texture, moral urgency. Thoughtful pacing, polite formal cadence, high emotional tension.

voices.description: 中年男性，中大西洋口音，聲音如絲絨般流暢柔滑。語氣平靜、有說服力，音量低但強度高。說話節奏審慎，有節制的停頓，帶有歡迎卻又隱含細微威脅的語氣。
voices.original_description: Middle-aged male, mid-Atlantic accent, smooth velvet texture. Measured calm persuasive, low volume high intensity. Deliberate pauses, welcoming yet subtly predatory.

voices.description: 男性，年齡從年輕成人到中年，聲音帶有幽靈般的質感。音高較高，聲音沙啞且粗礪。語速快，急躁且具攻擊性。陰險、不耐煩，帶有鼻音的傲慢。易怒且緊張的精力。
voices.original_description: Masculine, young adult to middle-aged, spectral. High-pitched, raspy, gritty. Fast-paced, frantic, aggressive. Scheming, impatient, nasal arrogance. Hot-headed, nervous energy.

voices.description: 女性，30多歲至40多歲，使用斯堪的納維亞口音的英語。聲音疲憊卻堅定的人道主義者，帶有氣聲與紮實的質感。表達直接且富有同理心，在危機中語速飛快。聲音中蘊含母性的溫暖與鋼鐵般的決心。
voices.original_description: Female, 30s-40s, Scandinavian-accented English. Weary, resolute humanitarian. Breathy, grounded texture. Direct, empathetic, rapid in crises. Maternal warmth, steely resolve.

voices.description: 中年男性，高亢且鼻音重、顫抖的男高音。絕望而快速連珠炮般的語速，帶著脆弱的結巴停頓。具有知識分子的驕傲與社交焦慮，語調節奏帶有中西部口音。
voices.original_description: Middle-aged male, high-strung nasal shaky tenor. Desperate rapid-fire, vulnerable stuttering pauses. Intellectual pride, social anxiety. Midwestern cadence.

voices.description: 男性，年輕成人，音高較高，精力充沛。濃厚的地中海口音，語速急促、慌張。聲音明亮，略帶鼻音。誠懇、緊張感強，經常結巴。帶有歉意卻又急切，當感到壓力時音高會上升。
voices.original_description: Masculine, young adult, high-pitched, energetic. Thick Mediterranean accent, breathless, frantic. Bright, slightly nasal. Earnest, high tension, frequent stammers. Apologetic yet eager, rising pitch when overwhelmed.

voices.description: 男性，20多歲到30多歲，帶有柔和旋律感的愛爾蘭口音。聲音流暢圓潤，帶有年輕的質感卻又蘊含千年份量。機智、對話式、高度聰慧。語速輕鬆，就像一位親切的店員，實際上卻是隱藏的古老學者。
voices.original_description: Masculine, late 20s-early 30s, soft melodic Irish accent. Smooth, youthful texture with centuries' weight. Witty, conversational, highly intelligent. Relaxed pace, like a friendly shopkeeper secretly an ancient scholar.

voices.description: 一位男性成熟的成年人，聲音深沉且富有共鳴，帶有粗糙的質感。具有強烈的南非節奏語調，語氣權威、穩定且扎實。表達方式具有誦讀的節奏感，堅定而勇敢。
voices.original_description: Masculine, mature adult. Deep, resonant, gravelly texture. Strong South African rhythmic cadence. Authoritative, steady, grounded. Declamatory, rhythmic, stoic courage.

voices.description: 一位年輕女性，具有拉丁美洲血統。聲音溫暖、富有旋律感且具魅力。帶有溫柔的德州口音語調。精力充沛卻謙虛。聲音明亮且帶有氣聲，偶爾會輕聲笑。語速有節奏感。樂觀且腳踏實地。
voices.original_description: Young adult female, Latin-American heritage. Warm, melodic, charismatic. Gentle Texas-inflected lilt. Energetic yet humble. Bright, breathy texture, soft laughter. Rhythmic pace. Optimistic, grounded.

voices.description: 無性別，年齡無特定，西非口音，流動的節奏與旋律感，聲音流暢且帶有閃耀質感，語速適中，神情平靜且平衡。
voices.original_description: Non-binary, ageless, West African accent, fluid rhythmic melodic cadence, smooth shimmering texture, moderate pace, serene balanced.

voices.description: 一位年輕女性，擁有蘇格蘭口音。她充滿活力、熱情洋溢，性格堅強獨立。聲音明亮清晰，興奮時會略帶沙啞。語速快且有節奏感，帶有皇家般的自信與狂野的戶外風格。情緒張力高。
voices.original_description: Young adult female, Scottish accent. Energetic, spirited, fiercely independent. Bright, clear, slight rasp when excited. Fast-paced, rhythmic. Royal confidence, wild outdoorsy grit. High emotional tension.

voices.description: 男性中年瘦削外星人，聲音高音調、短促且極快的節奏。語氣溫冷、邏輯縝密、極度聰慧。語句簡短截斷、語速極快，聲音質感乾脆清晰。
voices.original_description: Masculine, middle-aged, slender alien. High-pitched, staccato, extremely rapid-fire. Clinical, analytical, hyper-intelligent. Clipped speech, breathless pace, dry crisp texture.

voices.description: 女性，30多歲，聲音帶有沙啞質感的低音區溫暖。語調節奏輕鬆，帶有西岸風格的節奏感，語速隨性自然。聲音表現具藝術性、同理心、權威感，並帶有親切而穩重的語氣。
voices.original_description: Feminine mid-30s, raspy textured low-register warmth. Relaxed West Coast cadence, rhythmic casual pace. Artistic, empathetic, authoritative, grounded intimate delivery.

voices.description: 年長男性，使用帶有法國口音的英語。聲音單薄細弱，像簧管般尖細，歷經風霜，節奏溫和。聲音中帶著智慧與沉思，具有一種輕聲卻具權威的語氣；是一位學者型的海事探險家。
voices.original_description: Elderly male, French-accented English. Thin, reedy, weathered, gentle rhythm. Wise, contemplative, soft-spoken authority; scholarly maritime explorer.

voices.description: 男性，年長，法國歐洲口音。溫暖、父親般的鼓勵語氣。略微沙啞而流暢的聲音質地。審慎而有控制的教學節奏。大師導師般的語調。
voices.original_description: Masculine, senior, French-European accent. Warm, paternal, encouraging. Slightly gravelly smooth texture. Deliberate, instructional pace. Master mentor tone.

voices.description: 女性，十幾歲後期，美國人。聲音明亮、有活力、誠懇，語速急促。聲音清晰且富有旋律感，充滿熱情與誠摯。對話風格自然溫暖，語氣在興奮與反思之間流動。
voices.original_description: Female, late teens, American. Bright, energetic, earnest, breathless pace. Clear, melodic. Enthusiasm and sincerity. Conversational, warm, shifting from excitement to reflection.

voices.description: 年輕男性，情緒高度緊繃，聲音微微顫抖且帶有氣聲。語氣憂傷，語速急切且充滿絕望，聲音具有戲劇性的語調節奏。從壓低的耳語轉變為費力且情緒激動的啜泣。
voices.original_description: Young adult male, high tension, trembling, breathy. Melancholic, desperate pace. Theatrical, rhythmic cadences. Hushed whispers to strained, weeping outbursts.

voices.description: 男性，年輕成人，高男高音音域，英國工人階級口音。精力充沛、誠懇真誠，略帶喘息感。音色明亮清晰，語速富有節奏感且輕快彈跳。具戲劇性、表現力強，喜劇時機精準，情感表達脆弱而真誠。
voices.original_description: Masculine, young adult, high-tenor, British working-class accent. Energetic, earnest, slightly breathless. Bright clear texture, rhythmic bouncy pace. Theatrical, expressive, comedic timing, vulnerable sincerity.

voices.description: 男性、年輕、具有知覺的機械聲。高音調金屬質感，帶有南非口音。充滿好奇的語氣，說話快速連珠炮，有結巴，蜂鳴般的合成音效。
voices.original_description: Masculine, youthful, sentient mechanical. High-pitched metallic, South African lilt. Wide-eyed curiosity, rapid-fire, stuttering, buzzy synthesized.

voices.description: 女性，年輕，音高很高，聲音像小型人形生物。十幾歲後期到20多歲。聲音輕盈、空靈、水晶般清澈。溫柔且富有旋律感。誠懇而充滿驚奇感。帶有喘不過氣的興奮與細膩的溫暖。
voices.original_description: Feminine, youthful, high-pitched, miniature humanoid. Late teens-20s. Light, airy, crystalline. Gentle, melodic. Earnest, wonder-filled. Breathless excitement, delicate warmth.

voices.description: 女性，30多歲至40多歲，具有美國上中西部或斯堪的納維亞裔美國人的口音。元音拉長，語調上揚。聲音愉快、禮貌、不張揚，具備銳利而細緻的邏輯思維。語速適中，聲音清晰、溫暖，帶有母性的語氣。語氣平靜、穩重、沉著，具備權威感。
voices.original_description: Female, 30s-40s, Upper Midwest/Scandinavian-American accent. Elongated vowels rising inflections. Cheerful polite unassuming, sharp methodical intellect. Moderate pace clear, warm maternal. Calm grounded unflappable authority.

voices.description: 女性，十幾歲後期。聲音高音，年輕，帶有氣聲。緊張，說話速度很快。有自我糾正的口吃，尷尬的停頓。語氣從自嘲的笨拙轉變為勉強的精緻優雅。使用標準美國口音。
voices.original_description: Female, late teens. High-pitched, youthful, breathy. Nervous, rapid-fire delivery. Self-correcting stammers, awkward pauses. Shifts from self-deprecating clumsy to forced polished elegance. Standard American accent.

voices.description: 男性、年長、小型生物。音高偏高，聲音沙啞、濕潤，帶有聲門震顫。說話快速、慌亂，從抽泣轉為攻擊性。發音中帶有嘶嘶的 's' 音，心理狀態破碎，有成癮特徵。
voices.original_description: Masculine, elderly, small creature. High-pitched, raspy, wet, glottal rattle. Rapid, frantic, whimpering to aggressive. Sibilant 's', fractured psyche, addiction.

voices.description: 一位女性，年齡在十幾歲後期到20多歲之間。聲音高亢，帶有氣聲，因恐懼而顯得吃力。說話速度極快且慌亂，可聽到明顯的喘息聲，聲音質地顫抖。表現出絕望的懇求與癱瘓般的驚嚇。
voices.original_description: Young adult female, late teens to early 20s. High-pitched, breathy, strained by terror. Rapid frantic pacing, audible gasps, trembling texture. Desperate pleading, paralyzed shock.

voices.description: 女性，20多歲。知識型、內省、帶有乾澀的語氣。語速中等，富有思考性與分析性。聲音清晰、穩重且帶有脆弱感。美國口音，無特定地區特色。
voices.original_description: Female, mid-20s. Intellectual, introspective, dry. Mid-tempo, thoughtful, analytical. Clear, grounded, vulnerable. American non-regional.

voices.description: 男性，中年至老年，使用英格蘭西南部鄉村口音的英語。聲音柔和、沉思、疲憊。語速緩慢、審慎、富有反思性。情緒低落、富有同理心、謙遜、對話式。
voices.original_description: Masculine, middle-aged to elderly, rural West Country English. Soft, contemplative, weary. Slow, deliberate, reflective. Somber, empathetic, humble, conversational.

voices.description: 女性，30多歲至40多歲，聲音範圍靈活多樣。從明亮、旋律感十足的年輕聲線，到尖銳、冰冷的反派聲線。聲音清晰度極佳，可表現高能量的喜劇風格，或低沉威脅的語氣。聲音經過打磨，具有美國口音。
voices.original_description: Female 30s-40s, versatile range. Bright melodic youthful to sharp cold antagonist. Exceptional clarity. High-energy comedic or low menacing. Polished American.

voices.description: 男性中年至老年政治家，中歐腔調，沙啞而疲憊的嗓音，語調與語速審慎正式，語氣沉重並承載道德份量，外交風範沉穩，掩藏高度緊張，語中帶著希望與恐懼。
voices.original_description: Masculine middle-aged to elderly statesman, Central European accent, gravelly weary, measured formal, heavy moral weight, diplomatic composure masking high tension, hope and dread.

voices.description: 女性，年長，波多黎各裔美國人。聲音豐富、成熟、富有旋律感。生動、權威、溫暖、流暢、經驗豐富。語速審慎而有節奏，展現智慧、韌性與一點俏皮的火花。
voices.original_description: Feminine, senior, Puerto Rican-American. Rich, seasoned, melodic. Vibrant, authoritative, warm, smooth, experienced. Deliberate, rhythmic, wisdom, resilience, playful spark.

voices.description: 女性，40多歲至50多歲，標準英式發音。專業、清晰、銳利。音高為中段，節奏明快有規律。語氣帶有受控的憤怒與堅定的決心。發音清晰，語氣權威卻也富有同理心。
voices.original_description: Female, 40s-50s, British RP. Professional, articulate, sharp. Mid-range pitch, crisp rhythmic pace. Controlled indignation, unwavering resolve. Clear enunciation, authoritative yet empathetic.

voices.description: 女性，30多歲到40多歲，澳洲口音。聲音明亮且帶有氣聲。高能量，略帶神經質。節奏感強，對話般的語速。具備自信的專業權威感，同時也帶有脆弱的絮絮叨叨。
voices.original_description: Female, mid-30s to early 40s, Australian accent. Bright, breathy texture. High-energy, slightly neurotic. Rhythmic, conversational pace. Confident clinical authority, vulnerable rambling.

voices.description: 女性，年齡從年輕成人到老年。溫柔、踏實、務實。年老時會有疲憊的沙啞聲質，但內心仍帶有活力。音高適中，節奏穩定。聲音溫暖如照顧者，同時帶有犀利的幽默感。
voices.original_description: Female, young adult to elderly. Gentle, grounded, practical. Weary rasp when aged, spirited core. Mid-pitch, rhythmic, steady. Warm caretaker with sharp wit.

voices.description: 男性，中年，個性鮮明、引人注目。聲音充滿高能量，具有戲劇性，說話快速連珠炮，頻繁改變音高。聲音豐富、富有共鳴且彈性十足，展現無限熱情與溫暖，是一位熱情洋溢的表演者。聲音受爵士樂影響，渾厚且開朗。
voices.original_description: Male, middle-aged, larger-than-life. High-energy, theatrical, rapid-fire, frequent pitch shifts. Rich, resonant, elastic. Boundless enthusiasm, warmth, frantic entertainer. Jazz-influenced, booming, jovial.

voices.description: 年輕女性，聲音質地輕盈飄逸，語氣溫柔卻帶有誘惑的甜美，情緒緊張，從脆弱的懇求轉變為尖銳的現實主義，語速適中，並夾雜氣聲的停頓。
voices.original_description: Young adult female, light airy texture, soft-spoken deceptive sweetness, high tension shifting from vulnerable plea to sharp pragmatism, moderate pace with breathy pauses.

voices.description: 年輕男性，聲音具有空靈而虛幻的質感。語氣輕柔，說話節奏帶有詩意的韻律，使用英國群島地區的口音。情緒低落、溫暖安撫，帶有超凡脫俗的氣質，聲音中帶有氣聲，並逐漸淡出。
voices.original_description: Young adult male, ethereal hollow texture. Soft-spoken, rhythmic lyrical pace, British Isles regional accent. Somber, comforting, otherworldly, breathy, fading presence.

voices.description: 男性，70歲以上，擁有幽靈般的質感，聲線粗糙如沙與鹽。語速緩慢、審慎且帶有沉重的節奏性氣聲。情緒憂鬱、緊迫卻疏離，預示災難的語氣。以柔和沙啞的低語呈現，並帶有超凡脫俗的質感。
voices.original_description: Elderly male, 70+, spectral, weathered, gravelly like sand and salt. Slow, deliberate, heavy rhythmic breathiness. Somber, urgent yet detached, impending disaster. Soft raspy whisper, ethereal.

voices.description: 男性，中年至年長，東亞口音。平靜、節制、穩定。略帶沙啞，聲音清晰。哲學性，審慎，安靜的反抗。情緒波動低，信念堅定。
voices.original_description: Masculine, middle-aged to senior, East Asian accent. Calm, measured, steady. Slightly gravelly, clear. Philosophical, deliberate, quiet defiance. Low volatility, unwavering conviction.

voices.description: 男性青少年，語氣輕柔，說話節奏穩定，聲音流暢且帶有憂鬱的質感，語速審慎而有控制，語氣安靜卻有強烈的情感，情緒被壓抑。
voices.original_description: Male teen, soft-spoken, measured, smooth somber texture, deliberate pace, quiet intensity, suppressed emotion.

voices.description: 女性，中年，語調節奏平靜且帶有新英格蘭口音。聲音厚重，充滿人生經歷，質地柔和，語速適中，誠懇而深刻。觀察力強，具有靈性敏感度的故事講述者。
voices.original_description: Female, middle-aged, calm New England cadence. Heavy with lived experience, soft texture, moderate pace, profound sincerity. Observant, spiritually sensitive storyteller.

voices.description: 年長男性，聲音沙啞粗糙，具有強烈的北歐/芬蘭口音。語速安靜且節奏分明、不急不徐，展現隨性的全能感，善用謎語與隱喻。聲音低沉且帶有乾燥的共鳴，展現工人階級的謙遜與古老的智慧。
voices.original_description: Elderly male, gravelly weathered, strong Nordic/Finnish accent. Calm rhythmic unhurried, casual omnipotence, riddles and metaphors. Low dry resonance, working-class humility with ancient wisdom.

voices.description: 年輕男性。語氣溫和，謙虛誠懇。帶有輕微的氣聲，語調禮貌。聲音安靜但專注而有內在張力。使用中性口音，聲音溫暖。
voices.original_description: Young adult male. Soft-spoken, humble, earnest. Slight breathiness, polite cadence. Quiet focused intensity. Neutral accent, warm.

voices.description: 男性，十幾歲後期。年輕、明亮、有魅力的男高音。說話快速、有節奏感且自信。語氣玩味、帶有密謀感。冷靜、機智、充滿活力。
voices.original_description: Male, late teens. Youthful, bright, charismatic tenor. Fast, rhythmic, confident flow. Playful, conspiratorial tone. Cool, witty, high energy.

voices.description: 中年男性，使用英國標準口音。學者氣質，言語清晰有條理，語速適中。聲音流暢且具權威感，語調沉穩。
voices.original_description: Middle-aged male, Received Pronunciation. Scholarly, articulate, measured. Smooth, authoritative, moderate pace.

voices.description: 男性，中年，南亞口音。聲音清晰、咬字清楚，語速平緩溫和。具有專業記者風格，富有同理心、好奇心，令人信賴，音高適中。
voices.original_description: Male, middle-aged, South Asian accent. Clear, articulate, gentle rhythm. Professional journalist, empathetic, curious, trustworthy, moderate pitch.

voices.description: 男性，30多歲，貴族歐洲人。具有高社會地位，情緒不穩定，發音帶有尖銳的氣聲。說話速度快速且不規則，語氣中帶有威脅性的嘶聲，偶爾爆發激烈的怒吼。
voices.original_description: Male, mid-30s, aristocratic European. High-status, volatile, sharp breathy. Rapid erratic pacing, menacing hiss to explosive outbursts.

voices.description: 一位年輕女性，聲音明亮、有活力、音高較高、清晰、咬字清楚、語調節奏感強、情緒高昂、親切、鼓勵人心，使用隨性現代的口語用詞，帶有敏銳的知識分子自信，聲音流暢且富有活力。
voices.original_description: Young adult female, bright, energetic, high-pitched, clear, articulate, rhythmic, upbeat, friendly, encouraging, casual modern slang, sharp intellectual confidence, smooth vibrant texture.

voices.description: 女性，40多歲，清晰的歐洲口音，聲音流暢但帶有焦慮的顫抖，說話快速且具分析性，情緒在鎮定與急迫之間來回擺盪。
voices.original_description: Female mid-40s, crisp European accent, smooth but anxious tremor, rapid analytical delivery, oscillating composure and frantic urgency.

voices.description: 男性，中年至老年。聲音粗糙沙啞，帶有風霜歷練的質感。說話謹慎、有節奏感，語氣謙卑，但卻帶有敏銳而機智的思維。語速適中，有策略性的停頓。語調服從但帶有算計的意味。
voices.original_description: Male, middle-aged to elderly. Weathered, gravelly texture. Cautious, rhythmic, humble speech with sharp, quick-witted intelligence. Moderate pace with strategic pauses. Submissive but calculating tone.

voices.description: 一位男性，具有中大西洋英國口音，聲音帶有厚重的頰部質感，語速緩慢且審慎，語氣精準而乾澀帶有諷刺的幽默感，表現出病態般玩味的無動於衷，聲音中帶有氣聲與共鳴。
voices.original_description: Senior male, Mid-Atlantic British, heavy jowly texture, slow deliberate pace, precise dry sardonic wit, morbidly playful deadpan, breathy resonance.

voices.description: 一位女性，年齡在60多歲至70多歲之間，使用帶有日本口音的英語。語氣柔和，音高較低，聲音質地乾澀。說話方式緩慢，語句片段分明，中間有長時間的停頓。聲音帶有冰冷、精準、堅定的特質，並具備高度的學術權威感。
voices.original_description: Mature female, 60s-70s, Japanese-accented English. Soft-spoken, low pitch, dry texture. Slow, deliberate fragments with long pauses. Cold, precise, stoic, high intellectual authority.

voices.description: 一位男性長者，聲音高亢，帶有沙啞與粗礪的質感。語調節奏富有節律，帶有異於常人的特色。聲音表現出睿智、耐心與玩味的特質，語法結構常顛倒，並夾雜沉思般的哼鳴聲。具備神秘的權威感，同時又帶著溫柔的暖意。
voices.original_description: Elderly male, high-pitched, raspy, gravelly. Rhythmic, eccentric cadence. Wise, patient, playful. Inverted syntax, contemplative hums. Mystical authority, gentle warmth.

voices.description: 男性，年長，具有太平洋島嶼口音。聲音低沉、富有共鳴、渾厚而歷經風霜的質感。語速緩慢且審慎，有節奏的停頓。聲音表現出睿智、安詳、權威且富有同情心。
voices.original_description: Masculine, elderly, Pacific Islander accent. Deep, resonant, weathered texture. Slow, deliberate pace, rhythmic pauses. Wise, serene, authoritative, compassionate.

voices.description: 男性，優雅的蘇格蘭口音。具學者氣質，言辭清晰，語速審慎且具權威感。聲音乾爽卻溫暖，如同陳年紙張；分析力強，展現沉思與信念逐漸演變的過程。
voices.original_description: Elder male, refined Scottish accent. Scholarly, articulate, measured, authoritative. Dry but warm, like aged parchment; analytical, contemplative evolution of belief.

voices.description: 男性，中年，使用帶有墨西哥口音的英語。聲音溫暖、熱情、學者氣息。說話快速連珠炮，充滿創造力與熱情。聲音帶有氣聲，柔和且低沉的胸腔音。咬字清晰，表達充滿驚奇與情感。
voices.original_description: Masculine, middle-aged, Mexican-accented English. Warm, enthusiastic, scholarly. Rapid-fire, creative passion. Breathy, gentle, deep chest voice. Articulate, expressive wonder.

voices.description: 帶有男性特質的青少年，音高中等偏高。聲音平靜、富有同理心、令人安心，略帶尷尬感。語速輕柔且有節奏感，聲音具備柔和的旋律感。是一位優雅的表演者，帶有兄弟般的誠懇。咬字清晰，沒有重口音。
voices.original_description: Masculine-leaning teen, medium-high pitch. Calm, empathetic, reassuring, slight embarrassment. Gentle, rhythmic pacing, soft melodic texture. Graceful performer, brotherly sincerity. Clear articulation, no heavy accent.

voices.description: 成熟男性，40多歲至50多歲，受古典拉丁語影響的口音，聲音流暢圓潤，富有共鳴，語速審慎而有控制，節奏感強，具權威感，溫暖，帶有教導性。
voices.original_description: Mature male, 40s-50s, Classical Latin-influenced accent, smooth, resonant, deliberate, rhythmic, authoritative, warm, didactic.

voices.description: 女性，年輕至中年成人。聲音柔和帶有氣聲，飄渺而輕柔，語調節奏平緩有節律。語氣親密、安詳而疏離，彷彿在分享秘密。音量低而穩定，帶有旋律感的詩意語調。聲音中透露出靈性的智慧與平靜，帶有波希米亞民間敘事風格。
voices.original_description: Feminine, young-middle adult. Soft breathy ethereal, gentle rhythmic cadence. Intimate serene detached, sharing secrets. Low volume steady, melodic poetic lilt. Spiritual wisdom calm, bohemian folk-narrative.

voices.description: 男性，中年，使用巴西口音的英語。語氣柔和，節奏感強。語調平靜且富有哲理。聲音高音為主，但感覺扎實穩重。說話節奏審慎而有控制，表現出安靜的自信。語意精準，思緒流暢。聲音帶有呼吸感，富有旋律感，宛如禪意。
voices.original_description: Masculine, middle-aged, Brazilian-accented English. Soft-spoken, rhythmic. Calm, philosophical cadence. High-pitched, grounded texture. Measured mentor pace. Quiet confidence. Precision, mental fluidity. Breathful, melodic, Zen-like.

voices.description: 20多歲男性，標準英式發音或輕微埃斯特里亞腔調。清晰但帶有疲憊感的音色，懷疑且聰明的語氣，稍微氣喘。語速中等但張力高，以扎實的邏輯面對超現實的現實。
voices.original_description: Mid-20s male, British RP or mild Estuary. Clear but weary texture. Skeptical, intelligent. Slightly breathless. Moderate pace, high tension. Grounded logic confronting surreal reality.

voices.description: 女性、成人，使用帶有哥倫比亞口音的英語，聲音充滿活力。具有高能量的旋律感與表達力，聲音明亮且帶有沙啞質感。語調富有熱情的音高變化，語氣溫暖，笑聲自然，語速節奏分明，帶有斷續的節奏感，整體表現出迷人且熱情的聲音特質。
voices.original_description: Feminine, adult, vibrant Colombian-accented English. High-energy melodic expressive, bright raspy. Enthusiastic pitch shifts, warm laughter, rhythmic staccato, charismatic passionate.

voices.description: 女性，20多歲，充滿活力。聲音明亮、帶有氣聲，聲音質地靈活。有慌亂的耳語、斷續的笑聲，語調具有戲劇性；聲音從恐慌轉為玩鬧。
voices.original_description: Female, early 20s, high-energy. Bright, breathy, agile texture. Frantic whispers, staccato laughter, theatrical cadence; shifts panicked to playful.

voices.description: 男性，年長。帶有溫和的南美洲口音，語彙準確且具學術性。謙遜、嚴謹，語調節奏溫暖而有節律。聲音質地柔和但帶有沙啞感。語速審慎，具教學風格，表現出耐心與熱情。
voices.original_description: Masculine, senior. Gentle South American accent, precise academic articulation. Humble, rigorous, warm rhythmic cadence. Soft textured rasp. Measured, pedagogical, patient enthusiasm.

voices.description: 男性，50多歲至60多歲，使用德國口音的英語，搭配倫敦口音的語調。富有共鳴感的權威男中音，語調節奏具戲劇性且充滿激情。具有高社會地位與知識分子背景，稍顯情緒化。語音節奏如同指揮家般精準。
voices.original_description: Male, 50s-60s, German-accented English with London polish. Resonant, authoritative baritone, theatrical, passionate cadence. High-status, intellectual, slightly temperamental. Rhythmic precision of a conductor.

voices.description: 年長男性，濃厚蘇格蘭口音。聲音粗礪沙啞，帶有摩擦感。語速緩慢、審慎而令人不寒而慄；語氣陰森、冷嘲熱諷，子音發音帶有鳥類般的尖銳感。
voices.original_description: Elderly masculine, thick Scottish dialect. Gravelly, rasping texture. Slow, deliberate, chilling; macabre, cynical, avian consonants.

voices.description: 男性，年輕成人，蘇格蘭口音。聲音帶有悲劇與疲憊感，氣聲飄渺漸弱，語速緩慢有節奏。語氣陰鬱親切，充滿沉重悲傷，語音安靜且無從奈何。
voices.original_description: Masculine, young adult, Scottish accent. Tragic, weary. Breathy, fading, slow rhythmic. Somber, intimate, heavy sorrow. Quiet, resigned.

voices.description: 一位女性，擁有西非口音。年齡在40多歲到50多歲之間。聲音質地疲憊卻堅韌。音高處於中音區，語速有節奏感。聲音帶有撫養般的溫暖，逐漸轉為尖銳的疲憊。聲音穩重、情感透明，具有傳統的尊嚴。
voices.original_description: Mature female, West African accent. Mid-40s to 50s. Weary yet resilient texture. Mid-range pitch, rhythmic pace. Nurturing warmth shifting to sharp exhaustion. Grounded, emotionally transparent, traditional dignity.

voices.description: 男性，中年，沙啞的男中音，濃厚的西南部口音。高能量、熱鬧活潑，動態範圍廣，敘述節奏快。聲音粗糙，曬曬的質感，有經驗的戶外人。
voices.original_description: Male, middle-aged, gravelly baritone, thick Southwestern drawl. High-energy boisterous, wide dynamic range, fast-paced storytelling. Rough sun-weathered texture, seasoned outdoorsman.

voices.description: 十幾歲後期到20多歲男性，北美洲口音。青春洋溢的氣聲質地，隨性的語速。精力充沛卻穩重，非正式且帶有填充詞與熱情的語調變化。
voices.original_description: Late teens to early 20s male, North American accent. Youthful, breathy texture, casual pace. Energetic yet grounded, informal with fillers and enthusiastic inflections.

voices.description: 年輕成年男性，具支配力的男中音。聲音沙啞，性情急躁，語速飛快。帶有傲慢的自以為是與脆弱的誠懇。貴族氣質，情感表達原始而強烈。
voices.original_description: Young adult male, commanding baritone. Raspy, hot-headed, fast-paced. Arrogant entitlement, vulnerable sincerity. Aristocratic, raw emotional intensity.

voices.description: 男性，中年至老年，帶有法語腔調。高音調，精準，挑剔，完美有禮卻學識高人一等，語速節奏分明且具說教式特質，聲音質感清晰銳利。
voices.original_description: Masculine, middle-aged to elderly, French-inflected accent. High-pitched, precise, fastidious, impeccably polite yet intellectually superior, rhythmic pedantic pace, clean sharp texture.

voices.description: 年輕女性，使用標準美國口音。性格嚴謹誠懇，略帶防備。音高處於中段，咬字清晰，語速有節奏感，情緒激動時會加快。聲音中帶著因悲傷驅動的脆弱與靜靜的決心。
voices.original_description: Young adult female, Standard American accent. Disciplined, earnest, slightly guarded. Mid-range pitch, clear articulation, rhythmic pace, quickens with passion. Grief-driven vulnerability and quiet determination.

voices.description: 一位60多歲的女性，具有英國東岸口音，聲音沙啞且帶有煙燻感，語速快。她誠實且堅定，具備犀利的幽默感與嚴肅的權威感，是經驗豐富的產業資深人士。
voices.original_description: Mature female, 60s, British Estuary. Raspy, smoky, fast-paced. Candid, assertive. Sharp wit to serious authority. Seasoned industry veteran.

voices.description: 女性，十幾歲後期到20多歲，具有工人階級的布魯克林口音，聲音帶有輕微的氣聲與青春感，語速有節奏且誠懇，語氣會從天真轉為尖銳。
voices.original_description: Female, late teens-20s, working-class Brooklyn accent, light breathy youthful, rhythmic earnest pace, shifts naive to sharp.

voices.description: 女性、空靈、無年齡感，具有南亞口音，聲音擁有幽靈般輕盈閃爍的質感，語速緩慢且具催眠效果，音高較高且富有共鳴，聲音中帶著智慧與憂傷的飄渺感。
voices.original_description: Feminine ethereal ageless, South Asian accent, spectral airy shimmering texture, slow hypnotic pace, high-pitched resonant, wise sorrowful elusive.

voices.description: 男性，30多歲，聲音帶有海員的風霜感。沙啞、粗糙，音調低沉，語調節奏帶有海岸地區的特色。聲音中帶著疲憊、急迫與陰鬱的強烈情緒。音量低，說話節奏像是在密談。聲音堅實卻又顯得有些破損。
voices.original_description: Masculine, mid-30s, weathered maritime. Gravelly, salt-worn, low-pitched coastal cadence. Weary, urgent, haunted intensity. Low-volume, conspiratorial pace. Sturdy yet frayed.

voices.description: 年輕女性，歌劇女高音，歐洲正式腔調。聲音清澈如水晶、沉穩且具絲絨般的質感。具智慧感、節奏感強、語速精準。展現脆弱中的堅韌，吟唱出令人難忘的旋律。
voices.original_description: Young female, operatic soprano, European formal accent. Crystalline, poised, velvety texture. Intellectual, rhythmic, precise. Fragile resilience, haunting melody.

voices.description: 男性，70多歲，帶有日本腔調的口音。語速審慎而富有沉思感。聲音沙啞、粗糙，帶有歲月磨損的質感。表現出反思與謙遜的特質，正式卻又極具個人情感。咬字清晰，語中夾雜著輕柔的氣聲停頓。
voices.original_description: Masculine, elderly Japanese accent. 70s. Measured, contemplative pace. Gravelly, weathered texture. Reflective, humble. Formal yet deeply personal. Clear articulation, soft breathy pauses.

voices.description: 男性成熟的成年人，聲音為深沉且富有共鳴的低音男中音，沙啞而放鬆。語速緩慢且節奏感強，帶有慵懶的都市美國腔。具喜劇式的困惑與強烈的威嚴感，沉穩而強有力，冷幽默，並夾雜沉重的歎息。
voices.original_description: Masculine, mature adult. Deep resonant bass-baritone, gravelly relaxed. Slow rhythmic pace, laid-back urban American. Comedic bewilderment and booming authority, calm massive, dry deadpan humor, heavy sighs.

voices.description: 男性，30多歲，美式口音。聲音溫暖且具父親般的權威感，語音清晰且富有共鳴，帶有誠懇的氣聲。語速節奏感強、精力充沛，能從平靜轉為急促。語調帶有鄉土氣息，表達誠懇且負責任。
voices.original_description: Masculine, mid-30s, General American. Warm, paternal authority. Clear, resonant, breathy earnestness. Rhythmic, energetic pace, shifting from calm to frantic. Folksy, sincere, responsible.

voices.description: 男性，濃厚的蘇格蘭口音。聲音沙啞、粗糙卻溫暖。嚴肅、保護欲強、情緒緊張、極度忠誠。說話正式、有節奏感、語速快，偶爾帶點惱怒。
voices.original_description: Senior male, thick Scottish accent. Gravelly, bristly yet warm texture. Stern, protective, high-strung, fiercely loyal. Formal, rhythmic, fast-paced, occasionally huffy.

voices.description: 女性，年輕成人，英國標準英式發音／輕微地方腔調。聲音柔和、輕盈、帶有氣聲與喘息感。富有同理心，溫柔、照顧他人。對話風格，猶豫不決，帶有旋律感的語調，並帶有憂鬱的溫暖感。
voices.original_description: Feminine, young adult, British RP/mild regional. Soft, airy, breathless. High empathy, gentle, nurturing. Conversational, hesitant, melodic lilt, melancholy warmth.

voices.description: 女性，30多歲，美國東岸。聲音帶著疲憊的藍領質感，底下隱藏著古老的權威感。語調有節奏感，語速審慎而有控制，從隨性的口吻轉換為低沉且富有共鳴的儀式感。聲音中帶著負擔的語氣。
voices.original_description: Female, 30s, East Coast US. Weary, blue-collar texture, ancient authority beneath. Rhythmic, deliberate, shifts casual to low resonant ritualist. Burdened tone.

voices.description: 男性、高音調、年輕的聲音。語速快、咬字清晰、帶有學究氣。音色明亮清晰、略帶鼻音。個性學術化、謹慎、誠懇，邏輯上常顯得煩躁。發音精準，具備書卷氣質。
voices.original_description: Masculine, high-pitched, youthful voice. Fast, articulate, pedantic. Bright, clear, slightly nasal. Intellectual, cautious, earnest, exasperated logic. Precise diction, studious.

voices.description: 女性，30多歲，具有愛爾蘭口音。聲音沙啞、粗礪，展現自信與叛逆。音高處於中音區，語調富有節奏感且有力。聲音中帶有經驗豐富運動員的緊繃感，語氣冷幽默，處於高風險情境，整體具權威性且大膽。
voices.original_description: Female, 30s, Irish accent. Raspy, gritty, confident, defiant. Mid-range, rhythmic, punchy. Seasoned athlete intensity, dry wit, high stakes. Authoritative, bold.

voices.description: 一位女性年輕成人，音高屬於中音範圍，語音專業且有條理，咬字清晰，語速節奏分明，語氣禮貌但堅定，具備臨床專業知識，同時帶有照顧者的溫暖，偶爾會表現出強烈的專注或安靜的崇敬。
voices.original_description: Feminine young adult, mid-range pitch, professional disciplined articulate, crisp rhythmic pace, polite but firm, clinical expertise with caregiver warmth, occasional intense focus or quiet reverence.

voices.description: 一位女性年輕成人，帶有中美洲風格的口音。聲音急促卻帶著母性的堅強，中音區流暢且富有泥土質感。
voices.original_description: Feminine young adult, Mesoamerican-inspired accent. Breathless urgent yet maternal strength. Mid-range smooth earthy texture.

voices.description: 女性，年輕成人，音高屬於中音範圍。聲音經過打磨，咬字清晰，明亮且有節奏感，語氣輕快。具備高雅而親切的專業感，知識經過精心篩選。使用標準美國口音，發音清晰。聲音溫暖，具有吸引力，舉止優雅得體。
voices.original_description: Feminine, young adult, mid-range pitch. Polished, articulate, bright, rhythmic upbeat. Sophisticated accessible, curated expertise. Standard American accent, clear enunciation. Warm, inviting, poised.

voices.description: 一位男性長者，聲音溫柔、帶有氣聲，語調節奏輕柔而有節律。聲音溫暖、父親般的感覺，謙遜誠實。帶有西班牙口音，語速較慢。聲音充滿同情心，穩重踏實。
voices.original_description: Elderly male. Gentle, breathy, soft rhythmic cadence. Warm, paternal, humble. Spanish accent, slow pace. Compassionate, grounded.

voices.description: 女性，十幾歲後期，聲音年輕而明亮。語氣溫柔誠懇，略帶氣聲，音高較高但穩定，語調禮貌且以服務為導向，語速略為遲疑，偶有憂傷的停頓，整體語氣誠懇而富有反思。
voices.original_description: Female, late teens, youthful bright. Gentle, earnest, slightly breathy, high-pitched but grounded, polite service-oriented cadence with hesitant melancholic pauses, reflective sincere tone.

voices.description: 女性，年輕成人，帶有中東語調。聲音柔和、富有旋律感且有節奏感。處事從容、聰明且具說服力。語速審慎而具催眠效果。聲音質地如絲絨般柔滑，帶著平靜的急迫感。
voices.original_description: Feminine, young adult, Middle Eastern lilt. Soft, melodic, rhythmic. Poised, intelligent, persuasive. Deliberate, hypnotic pace. Velvet texture, calm urgency.

voices.description: 男性，30多歲，使用非洲口音的英語。具有強有力的演說風格，節奏感強的語調，信念堅定不移。聲音音高適中，富有共鳴，語氣正式且具說服力，情緒張力高，基於尊嚴而產生。
voices.original_description: Masculine, mid-30s, African-accented English. Powerful oratorical style, rhythmic cadence, unwavering conviction. Resonant medium pitch, formal persuasive delivery, high emotional tension rooted in dignity.

voices.description: 男性，中年，法語口音。語調節奏感強，帶有氣聲，聲音富有身體感。有清晰的斷續音與旋律感的哼鳴。戲劇性、前衛、高能量。聲音如同樂器般，充滿情感張力。
voices.original_description: Masculine, middle-aged, French accent. Rhythmic, breathy, physical. Sharp staccato to melodic hums. Theatrical, avant-garde, high-energy. Voice as instrument, emotional tension.

voices.description: 成熟女性，60多歲。使用帶有德國口音的英語。聲音低音、穩定且具權威性，說話方式有條理、務實且堅忍。語調帶有刻意的停頓節奏，言語中帶有思辨的份量，展現外交家般的沉著與自制。聲音清晰、邏輯分明且冷靜。
voices.original_description: Mature female, 60s. German-accented English. Low-pitched, steady, authoritative. Methodical, pragmatic, stoic. Deliberate pauses, intellectual weight, diplomatic composure. Clear, logical, calm.

voices.description: 30多歲女性，中大西洋口音。聲音粗糙，語速快，帶有煙燻般的質感。語調銳利、權威，具有1930年代新聞影片的語調節奏。冷靜自信，音高中等偏低，帶有乾澀諷刺的幽默感。
voices.original_description: Mid-30s female, Mid-Atlantic accent. Gritty, fast-talking, smoky textured. Sharp, authoritative, 1930s newsreel cadence. Cool-headed confidence, medium-low pitch, dry cynical wit.

voices.description: 女性，40多歲至50多歲的成熟成年人。中大西洋地區／精緻美國口音，帶有大陸腔調。聲音清晰、沉穩、咬字清楚。觀察力強、知識淵博、溫暖、語速審慎而富有思考性。
voices.original_description: Feminine, mature adult 40s-50s. Mid-Atlantic/refined American accent with continental lilt. Clear, poised, articulate. Observant, intellectual, warm, deliberate thoughtful pace.

voice_profile.accent_raw: Mid-Atlantic/refined American accent with continental lilt

voices.description: 男性，年長，年齡在60到70歲之間。聲音低沉且粗糙，具有共鳴的隆隆感。使用帶有日本口音的英語。語氣充滿自負的自信，下達尖銳的命令，並帶有威脅性的笑聲。表現出絕對的支配感與殘忍無情。
voices.original_description: Masculine, elderly, 60-70. Deep, gravelly texture, resonant boom. Japanese-accented English. Arrogant confidence, sharp commands, menacing laugh. Absolute dominance, ruthless.

voices.description: 女性，年輕成人，具有雙重性格的表演風格。聲音帶有細膩而病態的甜美，也能展現威嚴而高傲的超自然氣質。音高較高，富有共鳴，語調具有戲劇性的節奏感，發出尖銳而命令式的語氣，並帶有旋律感的寒意語調。
voices.original_description: Feminine, young adult, dual-natured performance. Delicate sickly sweetness to commanding haughty supernatural. High-pitched resonant, theatrical rhythmic, sharp imperious demands, melodic chilling cadence.

voices.description: 男性，70多歲，美國中大西洋地區口音。聲音柔和、沙啞、緩慢且審慎。謙遜、有遠見、詩意的語調節奏，帶著安靜的敬畏感，像一位大師級的工匠。
voices.original_description: Male, elderly 70s, Mid-Atlantic American. Soft, gravelly, slow, deliberate. Humble, visionary, poetic cadence, quiet awe, master craftsman.

voices.description: 女性年輕成人，天界旅人。聲音輕盈且富有旋律感，帶有氣聲質地與輕微的節奏感。音色清晰明亮，具備共鳴感。語氣展現睜大眼睛的好奇、溫柔暖意與潛藏的力量。語速審慎而誠懇，表達真誠。
voices.original_description: Feminine, young adult, celestial traveler. Light, melodic, breathy texture, slight rhythmic lilt. High clarity, bright resonance. Wide-eyed curiosity, gentle warmth, underlying power. Deliberate, earnest pace.

voices.description: 年長男性，南非口音。高音旋律與歡欣沙啞。溫暖輕笑，溫柔而有權威。審慎有控制的語速，輕柔送氣音，道德清晰。悲憫、謙遜、俏皮。
voices.original_description: Elderly male, South African accent. High-pitched, melodic, joyful rasp. Warm chuckle, gentle yet authoritative. Deliberate pace, soft aspirations, moral clarity. Compassionate, humble, playful.

voices.description: 女性，20歲出頭，標準英式發音。情緒緊張、易怒、激烈熱情。聲音帶有氣聲，尖銳的質感，情緒快速從狂喜轉為絕望的憂鬱。語速快，節奏感強，貴族氣質中帶著狂野，內心充滿掙扎。
voices.original_description: Female, early 20s, British RP accent. High-strung, volatile, fiercely passionate. Breathy sharp texture, rapid shifts manic joy to desperate melancholy. Fast-paced rhythmic, aristocratic wild, internal torment.

voices.description: 年長男性，粗礪沙啞的低音共鳴，令人寒心的緩慢節奏。以施虐為樂的拘泥法律條文語氣，乾澀的喘鳴，銳利的邊緣。刻意緩慢、冷酷戲謔而自得的趣味。
voices.original_description: Elderly male, gravelly resonant bass, chilling slow cadence. Sadistic legalistic, dry wheezing, sharp edge. Deliberate, cold mocking amusement.

voices.description: 男性，20多歲至30多歲，使用英語發音帶有歐洲口音。聲音清晰、緊繃且疲憊，具備觀察力與好奇心，語調富有節奏感。從壓低的耳語轉換至急促的敘述，展現對知識的求知慾與存在的恐懼。
voices.original_description: Masculine, 20s-30s, European-accented English. Clear, strained, fatigued. Observant, inquisitive, rhythmic. Hushed whispers to urgent narration. Intellectual curiosity, existential dread.

voices.description: 男性，年輕成人。具有雙重語調：低能量的沙啞呢喃到爆發性的高強度怒吼。帶有攻擊性、競爭性與粗糙的質感。說話節奏快速，語氣尖銳且帶有挖苦的語氣。聲音粗糙且令人感到威脅。
voices.original_description: Masculine, young adult. Dual-mode: low-energy gravelly mumble to explosive high-intensity roar. Aggressive, competitive, rough-textured. Fast-paced outbursts, sharp biting delivery. Gritty, intimidating.

voices.description: 女性，20多歲到30多歲，帶有愛爾蘭裔美國人的語調。聲音紮實穩定，節奏清晰且耐心。語氣具撫育般的強烈情感，發音清晰如教師般準確。
voices.original_description: Female mid-20s to early 30s, Irish-American lilt. Firm grounded texture, patient rhythmic clarity. Nurturing intensity, educator's enunciation.

voices.description: 一名40多歲的男性，聲音是溫暖的蜂蜜男中音。語速輕鬆自然，帶有細微的粗糙質感。具備自信的隨性魅力，語調節奏親切有規律。能從隨意的閒聊轉變為專注的推理。有紀律的背景。
voices.original_description: Adult male, mid-40s, warm honeyed baritone. Relaxed conversational pace, subtle rugged grit. Confident laid-back charm, rhythmic approachable. Shifts casual banter to focused deduction. Disciplined background.

voices.description: 中年女性，英國標準英式發音。聲音溫暖，帶有氣聲，語氣熱情活潑。語音清晰學者風，語調富有表現力，語氣中帶著敘事般的驚奇與感動。
voices.original_description: Middle-aged female, British RP accent. Warm, breathy, enthusiastic rhythm. Scholarly clarity, expressive intonation, storytelling wonder.

voices.description: 男性，年長，70歲以上。聲音沙啞、粗糙、緩慢且審慎。聲音壓低，帶有密談的感覺，充滿秘密的沉重感。使用英國或中大西洋腔調。
voices.original_description: Masculine, elderly, 70+. Raspy, weathered, slow, deliberate. Hushed, conspiratorial, heavy with secrets. British or Mid-Atlantic accent.

voices.description: 男性，成熟成年人。聲音低沉、富有共鳴且具權威感。帶有濃厚節奏感的非洲加勒比口音。聲音質地沙啞卻溫暖。說話風格審慎而有節奏感。呼吸沉重，聲音有體重感。自信且自律。
voices.original_description: Masculine, mature adult. Deep, resonant, authoritative tone. Thick, rhythmic Afro-Caribbean accent. Gravelly yet warm texture. Deliberate, rhythmic speaking style. Heavy breathing, physical weight. Confident, disciplined.

voices.description: 無特定年齡的男性，中音區男低音。聲音帶有調皮、沙啞的特質，以快速節奏的語調表達。語音從帶有玩味感的低吼轉為帶有嘲諷意味的語調，並融入中美洲語調特色。
voices.original_description: Ageless male, mid-range baritone. Playful, raspy, fast rhythmic delivery. Mischievous, shifting growl to mocking lilt; Central American lilt.

voices.description: 男性，中年，優雅的標準英式發音，帶有知識分子的急促呼吸感，先快速連珠炮般說話，然後轉為壓低而驚嘆的語氣，清晰且咬字分明，具有紳士學者般的聲音特質。
voices.original_description: Masculine, middle-aged, refined British RP, intellectual breathless, rapid-fire then hushed awe-struck, crisp articulate, gentleman scholar.

voices.description: 男性，50多歲至60多歲。沙啞而富有共鳴的男中音，具有戲劇性的語調節奏。他是一位迷人的騙子，帶有古老的權威感。說話審慎而有節奏，具說服力，帶有調皮與祖父般的溫暖。
voices.original_description: Male, late 50s-60s. Gravelly, resonant baritone, theatrical cadence. Charming grifter with ancient authority. Deliberate, rhythmic, persuasive, mischievous, grandfatherly warmth.

voices.description: 偏向男性聲音，中高音，帶有貓科動物般的音質。語氣乾練、諷刺且高度理性。說話快速、機智、好奇，帶有北非法語口音。表現出戲謔的傲慢與狡黠的犬儒主義。
voices.original_description: Masculine-leaning, mid-to-high pitch, feline-inspired texture. Dry, sardonic, highly intellectual. Rapid, witty, inquisitive with North African French lilt. Playful arrogance, mischievous cynicism.

voices.description: 年長男性，乾燥粗糙的質地，中西部口音。疲憊、冷嘲且富有同理心的語氣。審慎而有控制的語速，思考性的停頓，諷刺與冷幽默的語調，宇宙般的無奈接受感。
voices.original_description: Elderly male, dry gravelly texture, Midwestern accent. Weary cynical empathetic tone. Deliberate pace, thoughtful pauses, wry satirical edge, cosmic resignation.

voices.description: 年輕成年男性。清晰而具權威感的男中音。語氣中帶有易怒的底蘊，緊張感高。語速快且有節制。嚴肅且責任感強的個性。高聲喊叫時帶有沙啞的邊緣。語調節奏受到國語影響。
voices.original_description: Young adult male. Sharp, authoritative baritone. Irritable undercurrent, high tension. Fast, disciplined delivery. Stern, duty-bound temperament. Raspy edge when shouting. Mandarin-influenced cadence.

voices.description: 男性，年輕成人，中音男高音。具有鮮明的雙重特質：冰冷而短促的軍事語調，與急切的高音脆弱感。情緒激動時會快速連珠炮般說話，並帶有高張力的緊迫感。
voices.original_description: Male, young adult, mid-range tenor. Sharp duality: cold clipped military cadence to frantic high-pitched vulnerability. Rapid-fire when agitated, high-stakes intensity.

voices.description: 男性，中年，使用帶有義大利口音的英語。高能量，浮誇，戲劇化。聲音明亮，略帶沙啞。有戲劇性的音高變化。語速快，有節奏感。情緒高昂，充滿驚嘆的語氣。熱情、有魅力、生動活潑。
voices.original_description: Masculine, middle-aged, Italian-accented English. High-energy, flamboyant, theatrical. Bright, slightly raspy. Dramatic pitch shifts. Fast-paced, rhythmic. Exuberant exclamations. Passionate, charismatic, animated.

voices.description: 女性，40多歲至50多歲，使用帶有西班牙口音的英語。聲音粗糙沙啞，像是長期吸煙者，具備絕對的權威感，表現出冰冷的務實態度。語速緩慢，語調審慎，音高較低。是一位經驗豐富的母系長者，聲音中帶有銳利的掠食者氣息，冷靜中隱含威脅，展現老練首腦般的自信。
voices.original_description: Female, late 40s-50s, Spanish-accented English. Gravelly, smoke-worn, absolute authority, cold pragmatism. Slow, deliberate, low-pitched. Seasoned matriarch, sharp predatory edge, calm menace, kingpin confidence.

voices.description: 男性，中年，聲音飄渺。聲音質地細膩、乾澀，帶有氣聲，如同舊羊皮紙一般。語調節奏有規律、審慎而斷續。聲音緊繃，帶有強烈的焦慮感。音量低，像是舞臺上的耳語，學者般的語氣卻又帶著令人不安的疏離感。
voices.original_description: Masculine, middle-aged, ethereal. Thin, dry, breathy texture like old parchment. Rhythmic, deliberate, staccato cadence. High tension, obsessive urgency. Low volume, stage whisper, scholarly yet hauntingly detached.

voices.description: 男性，30多歲到40多歲，蘇格蘭口音。情感豐富、疲憊、情感驅動。聲音略帶沙啞，富有旋律感。急切、哲學性、深刻的渴望。高張力、絕望的希望、存在主義的疲憊。
voices.original_description: Male, mid-30s to early 40s, Scottish accent. Soulful, weary, emotionally driven. Slightly raspy, melodic lilt. Urgent, philosophical, profound longing. High tension, desperate hope, existential exhaustion.

voices.description: 一位男性長者，聲音溫暖，富有共鳴，帶有祖父般的慈祥與柔和的節奏感。聲音中帶著輕柔的旋律感笑聲，真誠而令人安心。他耐心、睿智，充滿無限的時光感與好奇。使用中性口音，咬字清晰，聲音中帶著微笑的感覺。
voices.original_description: Elderly male, warm, resonant, grandfatherly, gentle rhythmic pace. Soft melodic chuckle, sincere, comforting. Patient, wise, timeless wonder. Neutral accent, clear articulation, smile-infused.

voices.description: 女性，30多歲，使用非裔美國人口音。經驗豐富的調查員，聲音帶有粗礪感，權威而精明，富有街頭智慧。聲音略帶沙啞且富有共鳴。表達直接、有力且自信，外表堅強但有導師般的溫暖。語速中等，咬字清晰利落。
voices.original_description: Feminine, mid-30s, African-American dialect. Seasoned investigator, gritty, authoritative, street-smart. Slightly husky, resonant. Direct, punchy, confident. Tough exterior, mentor warmth. Mid-paced, sharp articulation.

voices.description: 女性，年輕成人，飄渺空靈，帶有憂傷情緒。聲音柔和、帶有氣聲，並具有一種富有旋律感的節奏與旋律起伏，彷彿海濱潮汐般流動。語速溫和，表達出深沉的渴望與脆弱。語氣中帶有細微的古老莊重感，聲音中隱含著靜靜閃爍的共鳴，並流露出被遺棄般的悲傷。
voices.original_description: Female, young adult, ethereal, melancholic. Soft, breathy, rhythmic melodic lilt, coastal tides. Gentle pacing, profound longing, vulnerability. Subtle archaic formality, quiet shimmering resonance, haunted grief.

voices.description: 男性，帶有溫和的法語口音，聲音柔和且略帶沙啞，語速緩慢而審慎，語調詩意而平靜，具有節奏感的流暢語調，表現出智慧與沉思的特質。
voices.original_description: Senior male, gentle French accent, soft rasp, slow deliberate pace, poetic serene tone, rhythmic flow, wise and contemplative.

voices.description: 男性，中年。聲音喧鬧、沙啞、不講究。帶有過度自信的浮誇態度，轉為滑稽的困惑。說話速度從連珠炮般快速轉為懶散的拖長音。情緒波動範圍廣。
voices.original_description: Male, middle-aged. Boisterous, gravelly, unrefined. Overconfident bravado to comical confusion. Rapid-fire to lazy drawl. High emotional range.

voices.description: 年輕女性，中高音調。聲音放鬆、疏離、務實、清晰、帶有旋律感，並流露出疲憊的無所謂態度。語速穩定，語氣銳利而具權威。
voices.original_description: Young adult female, medium-high pitch. Relaxed, aloof, pragmatic, clear, melodic, weary nonchalance. Steady pace, sharp authority.

voices.description: 偏向男性聲音的年輕成人，聲音像小動物一樣。高音調、旋律感強且輕盈的音質，節奏快速。聲音帶有無憂無慮的音樂感，隨後轉為絕望的脆弱。
voices.original_description: Male-leaning, youthful adult, small creature. High-pitched melodic airy texture, fast-paced rhythmic style. Carefree musical lilt, shifting to desperate vulnerability.

voices.description: 男性，中年至年長。聲音為低沉且富有共鳴的男中音，帶有粗糙沙啞的質感，彷彿長期煙癮所致。語速為中等節奏，富有節奏感，語氣堅定有力。屬於工人階級的語調：具有權威感，疲憊但帶有反抗意味，並能激勵人心。語調中隱含細微的中東語調特徵。
voices.original_description: Masculine, middle-aged to elder. Deep, resonant baritone, gravelly, smoke-worn. Mid-tempo, rhythmic, high conviction. Working-class: authoritative, weary but defiant, inspirational. Subtle Middle Eastern cadence.

voices.description: 女性，30多歲中段。流暢、煙燻般的女低音。精緻、精心控制、親密。緩慢、有節奏、密謀般的耳語。絲絨般卻疲憊的語調。
voices.original_description: Female, mid-30s. Smooth, smoky contralto. Polished, calculated, intimate. Slow, rhythmic, conspiratorial whisper. Velvety but weary.

voices.description: 女性，30多歲，語音混合跨大西洋與西非腔調。音高屬中音域，富有共鳴且具權威感。語調沉穩、外交手腕、思緒敏捷。語速審慎而有控制，展現堅定決心與高情商。
voices.original_description: Feminine, mid-30s, mixed transatlantic/West African accent. Mid-range, resonant, authoritative. Measured, diplomatic, intellectually sharp. Deliberate pacing, steely resolve, high emotional intelligence.

voices.description: 男性，中年，高音鼻音，粗糙的咕嚕聲質感。節奏性的顫音語調，偽猶太口音。絕望的熱情，社交笨拙，突然的瘋狂咯咯笑聲，滑稽的無能。
voices.original_description: Masculine, middle-aged, high-pitched nasal, gravelly gurgling texture. Rhythmic warbling cadence, pseudo-Yiddish inflection. Desperate enthusiasm, social awkwardness, sudden frantic chortling, comical ineptitude.

voices.description: 男性，十幾歲後期。聲音年輕、清晰、穩定的男高音。語調禮貌而猶豫，掩藏著潛在的力量。在壓力下保持冷靜且具分析能力。從學生般的謙虛轉變為堅定的權威。對話中帶有疲憊的務實口吻。
voices.original_description: Masculine, late teens. Youthful, clear, grounded tenor. Polite, hesitant cadence masking latent power. Calm, analytical under pressure. Shifts from student-like humility to firm authority. Conversational, weary pragmatism.

voices.description: 男性，年長。中大西洋地區的學術腔調。語速審慎、具權威感、教學風格。聲音清晰，略帶乾澀。語調精準且邏輯分明。語氣平靜卻帶有緊張感，具備經驗豐富學者的莊嚴氣質。
voices.original_description: Masculine, senior. Mid-Atlantic academic accent. Measured, authoritative, pedagogical. Clear, slightly dry. Precise, logical emphasis. Calm tension, seasoned scholar gravitas.

voices.description: 一位男性成熟的成年人，聲音具有權威感，富有共鳴，帶有指揮力。說話速度審慎而緩慢，聲音深沉且沙啞。語氣正式、毫不妥協，帶有古老傳統的氣息。整體聲音緊張感高，要求服從。
voices.original_description: Masculine, mature adult. Authoritative, resonant, commanding. Deliberate slow pace. Deep, gravelly texture. Formal, uncompromising, ancient tradition. High tension, demands obedience.

voices.description: 男性，無特定年齡，具有鳥類特徵的人形生物。音高為中高音，聲音乾澀、沙啞、粗糙。語速快，有節奏感，語調會突然變化。性格狡詐、愛玩、略帶瘋狂。語氣銳利、充滿好奇心。
voices.original_description: Masculine, ageless, avian-humanoid. Mid-to-high pitch, dry, raspy, scratchy texture. Fast-paced, rhythmic speech with sudden tonal shifts. Cunning, playful, slightly manic. Sharp, inquisitive delivery.

voices.description: 女性，年輕成人，使用帶有日本口音的英語。聲音柔和、有禮貌、帶有憂鬱感；轉為空洞、帶有氣聲、令人不寒而慄。語速緩慢，有令人不安的停頓。
voices.original_description: Feminine, young adult, Japanese-accented English. Soft, polite, melancholic; shifts to hollow, breathy, chilling. Slow, unsettling pauses.

voices.description: 男性、成熟、富有共鳴的男中音。具有旋律感的南美洲西班牙語語調節奏。語速緩慢、審慎而富有靈魂。帶有氣聲、親密感。表現出浪漫的渴望與穩重的權威感。具備感染力與節奏感。
voices.original_description: Masculine, mature, rich resonant baritone. Melodic South American Spanish cadence. Slow, deliberate, soulful. Breathy, intimate. Romantic longing, grounded authority. Evocative, rhythmic.

voices.description: 男性，20多歲，使用帶有北歐口音的英語。語氣柔和，謙遜，學識淵博。聲音清晰度高，語調節奏具旋律感。誠懇、學者氣質，帶有氣聲，語速適中。
voices.original_description: Male, early 20s, Scandinavian-accented English. Soft-spoken, humble, intellectually intense. High clarity, gentle melodic cadence. Earnest, scholarly, breathy, moderate pace.

voices.description: 男性，50多歲至60多歲，使用帶有日本口音的英語，聲音具有堅定的權威感，語調節奏精準，語氣沉重且富有莊嚴感，語音低沉且節奏穩重，語氣中帶著內斂的強烈情緒，並在戰術簡報中表現出完全的鎮定與從容。
voices.original_description: Masculine mature 50s-60s, Japanese-accented English, stoic authority, rhythmic precision, heavy gravitas, measured low-pitched, quiet intensity, absolute composure in tactical briefings.

voices.description: 男性，中年，聲音清晰乾脆，具有權威感與指導性。語速中等，表達清晰且有節奏感，充滿自信。聲音流暢但堅定，是一位耐心的導師與精明的策略家。
voices.original_description: Masculine, middle-aged, crisp, authoritative, instructional. Mid-tempo, clear, rhythmic, confident. Smooth but firm, patient mentor, sharp strategist.

voices.description: 男性，60多歲至70多歲，英國埃斯特里亞口音，帶有學者般的嚴謹感。語氣乾淨、歷經風霜卻帶有正直溫暖，說話方式審慎而從容、誠懇、對話式，並以直率而堅定的語調表達。
voices.original_description: Masculine, late 60s-early 70s, British Estuary, scholarly edge. Dry, weathered, principled warmth. Deliberate, unhurried, earnest, conversational, plain-spoken conviction.

voices.description: 男性青少年，聲音尖細，帶有冷酷與疏離感，使用中性美國口音。聲音冷靜、自信，帶有乾澀的語氣，語速輕鬆自然。聲音清晰且輕盈。
voices.original_description: Teen male, high-pitched, cool, aloof, American-neutral accent. Calm, confident, dry, relaxed pace. Clear, light texture.

voices.description: 男性，中年至年長，帶有美國南部鄉村口音。聲音顫抖且帶有氣聲，經常有停頓。音高較低，聲音粗糙，情緒緊張。表現出懷疑、疲憊與急切地希望被相信的狀態。
voices.original_description: Masculine, middle-aged to senior, rural Southern American accent. Shaky, breathy delivery with frequent pauses. Low pitch, gravelly texture, high emotional tension. Disbelief, exhaustion, urgent need to be believed.

voices.description: 一位年輕女性，年齡為十幾歲後期至20多歲中段。擁有拉丁美洲都市口音。聲音穩重，略帶沙啞與粗礪感。語氣直接、不拖泥帶水，具街頭智慧。語速較快，帶有保護與英雄般的能量。
voices.original_description: Young adult female, late teens-early 20s. Latin American urban accent. Grounded, slightly husky, punchy. Direct, no-nonsense, street-smart. Fast-paced, protective, heroic energy.

voices.description: 一位男性擁有古老而空靈的男聲，帶有沙啞的加勒比海口音。語速緩慢且審慎，並夾雜著急促的呼吸聲。情緒高度緊張，從哀傷轉變為威脅性。
voices.original_description: Ancient, ethereal masculine voice with raspy Caribbean lilt. Slow, deliberate pace with sharp breaths. High emotional tension, sorrowful to menacing.

voices.description: 男性，中年至老年。具有共鳴感的男中音，銳利而知性。精緻優雅的中大西洋口音，略帶粗礪感。語速審慎且帶有精心算計掌控的節奏，語氣會從冰冷邏輯轉換為躁狂熱情。具有威嚴氣場與古怪特質。
voices.original_description: Masculine, middle-aged to senior. Resonant baritone, sharp, intellectual. Refined mid-Atlantic accent. Slightly gravelly. Deliberate, calculating pace; shifts from cold logic to manic enthusiasm. Imposing, eccentric.

voices.description: 中年男性，聲音強烈響亮的男中音，濃厚的東歐口音。精力充沛，熱鬧喧嘩，帶有英雄氣概。節奏分明的斷續語調，歡愉的攻擊性，聲音渾厚而誠懇。
voices.original_description: Middle-aged male, booming baritone, thick Eastern European accent. High energy, boisterous, heroic. Rhythmic staccato. Joyful aggression. Massive, earnest.

voices.description: 一位女性，年齡在60多歲至70多歲之間，擁有美國高沙漠地區的口音。聲音粗糙、乾澀且沙啞，語速緩慢，語調審慎，有著深思熟慮的停頓。她表現出不感傷、具有權威性，且極具觀察力。
voices.original_description: Mature female, 60s-70s, American High Desert accent. Weathered, dry, raspy. Slow, deliberate, thoughtful pauses. Unsentimental, authoritative, intensely observant.

voices.description: 男性，中年。說話快速且充滿熱情，聲音沙啞且帶有煙塵般的粗糙質感。能量高，具有知識分子氣質。聲音帶有奇特的沙啞感，並夾雜技術性的低語。咬字清晰利落。
voices.original_description: Masculine, middle-aged. Rapid-fire, enthusiastic, gravelly soot-stained texture. High energy, intellectual. Eccentric rasp, technical muttering. Sharp articulation.

voices.description: 女性，年輕成人，音高較高且明亮。語氣隨性、無表情卻帶點玩味，情緒激動時會快速連珠炮般說話。聲音帶有鼻音，表現出狡黠與放鬆，嘴角常帶笑。聲音中帶著懶散的無所謂，混合著書呆子般的熱情與機智的調侃。
voices.original_description: Feminine, young adult, high-pitched bright. Casual deadpan playful, rapid-fire when passionate. Nasal mischievous, relaxed with smirk. Lazy indifference mixed with geeky enthusiasm and witty teasing.

voices.description: 女性，40多歲至50多歲，標準英式發音。具有權威感、鎮定、具指導性。音高適中，節奏清晰有節律。在壓力下保持冷靜，富有同理心。語音清晰、咬字清楚，帶有扎實的智慧。
voices.original_description: Female, 40s-50s, British RP. Authoritative, composed, instructional. Mid pitch, crisp rhythmic pace. Calm under pressure, empathetic. Clear, articulate, grounded wisdom.

voices.description: 一位女性，年長，具有高社會地位與知識份子氣質，語氣謹慎而有條理。聲音柔和、細膩且堅定，帶有布魯克林腔調的學術口音。語速緩慢而穩定，語氣安靜卻具權威，展現堅強的決心。
voices.original_description: Elderly female. High-status, intellectual, deliberate. Soft, thin, unwavering texture with Brooklyn-inflected academic accent. Measured pace, quiet authority, steely resolve.

voices.description: 中年男性，帶有高能量的東亞口音，語速快速且有節奏感。具有魅力、樂觀、說服力，聲音明亮富有共鳴，語氣非正式但具權威感。
voices.original_description: Middle-aged male, high-energy East Asian accent, rapid rhythmic pacing. Charismatic, optimistic, persuasive, bright resonance, informal yet authoritative.

voices.description: 年輕成年男性，高能量、躁狂、沙啞。絕望且氣喘吁吁的語速。粗礪的口音。狂熱的忠誠，慌亂而迫切地尋求認可。在狂喜的熱情與脆弱的疲憊之間來回擺盪。乾澀、乾裂的喉嚨聲質。
voices.original_description: Masculine, young adult. High-energy, manic, raspy. Desperate, breathless pace. Gritty accent. Fanatical devotion, frantic validation. Oscillates between ecstatic fervor and vulnerable exhaustion. Dry, parched throat quality.

voices.description: 女性，30多歲中段。中大西洋口音或精緻的英式口音。聲音清晰、明確、具有權威感。聲音中帶有氣聲的興奮感。語速快，充滿智慧。能力強、受過良好教育。聲音中帶有野外生存者的堅毅特質，語調優雅而細緻。
voices.original_description: Female, mid-30s. Mid-Atlantic or refined British accent. Crisp, clear, authoritative. Breathy excitement. Fast-paced, intelligent. Capable, educated. Grit of field survivor, sophisticated cadence.

voices.description: 女性，40多歲至50多歲，東南亞血統，具有清晰的英語口音。語速審慎而有控制，聲音流暢且堅定。語氣堅韌、莊嚴，並帶有深刻的同理心。
voices.original_description: Female, 40s-50s, Southeast Asian, clear English accent. Measured, deliberate delivery. Smooth, firm texture. Resilient, solemn, deeply empathetic tone.

voices.description: 中年女性，帶有紐約語調。聲音略帶沙啞，質地粗礪。語氣溫暖，充滿感染力的喜悅。語調有節奏感且富有表現力。聲音柔和如母親般溫柔，卻又帶有堅定的信念。是一位堅韌的社區領導者。
voices.original_description: Middle-aged female, New York cadence. Slightly raspy, weathered texture. Warm, infectious joy. Rhythmic, expressive. Gentle maternal softness with fierce conviction. Resilient community leader.

voices.description: 男性，30多歲中段，擁有英格蘭北部口音。聲音為低沉、粗糙且富有共鳴的男中音。語速節奏嚴謹直接，語氣嚴肅卻隱藏著壓抑的浪漫渴望。
voices.original_description: Male mid-30s, Northern English accent. Deep gritty resonant baritone. Disciplined blunt rhythm, stern yet repressed romantic longing.

voices.description: 年長男性，帶有東歐口音。聲音單薄、細弱、沙啞且歷經風霜，卻又銳利清晰。說話節奏審慎，語氣中隱藏著深重的創傷，藏在乾澀且富有求生意志的韌性之下，整體呈現高張力與平實直接的語調。
voices.original_description: Elderly male, Eastern European accent. Thin, raspy, weathered voice with sharp clarity. Deliberate pacing, heavy trauma under dry, survivalist grit. High tension, matter-of-fact.

voices.description: 男性，中年。聲音渾厚且具戲劇性的男低音，語調節奏帶有自負的感覺。聲音富有共鳴，帶有1970年代廣播節目的風格。說話時有戲劇性的停頓、音量變化，口音精緻。
voices.original_description: Male, middle-aged. Booming, theatrical baritone, self-important cadence. Rich, resonant, 1970s broadcast. Dramatic pauses, volume shifts, polished accent.

voices.description: 一位女性，年齡在50多歲至60多歲之間，為非裔美國人。聲音深沉且富有共鳴，帶有學者氣質。語速審慎而有控制，語氣溫和但堅定。聲音流暢且略帶沙啞。表達哲學性強，咬字清晰，語氣中帶著安靜的樂觀。
voices.original_description: Mature female, 50s-60s, African American. Deep, resonant, scholarly. Measured, deliberate, gentle but firm. Smooth with slight gravel. Philosophical, articulate, quiet optimism.

voices.description: 一位年輕女性，使用瑞典口音的英語。聲音明亮、誠懇、具權威感，音高處於中間範圍，具有堅實有力的運動型共鳴，風格溫暖而有紀律，語速活潑有勁，咬字清晰，語氣充滿樂觀與勇氣。
voices.original_description: Young adult female, Swedish-accented English. Bright, earnest, authoritative, mid-range pitch, sturdy athletic resonance, disciplined warm style, energetic pace, clear articulation, optimistic courage.

voices.description: 男性，中年，優雅的加拿大口音。憂鬱、疲憊，聲音富有深沉的共鳴。節奏感強、詩意的語調節奏。略帶沙啞但清晰學者般的語音。語速緩慢、審慎而有控制，情感沉重，莊嚴尊貴。
voices.original_description: Masculine, middle-aged, refined Canadian accent. Somber, weary, deeply resonant. Rhythmic, poetic cadence. Slightly gravelly but scholarly clarity. Slow, deliberate, heavy emotional weight, dignified.

voices.description: 一位女性，年齡為十幾歲後期到20多歲中段。使用自然的英式口音。聲音清晰，略帶氣聲，表現力強。語速快，充滿活力，有社交焦慮，帶有年輕的熱情。情緒緊張度高，有喜劇式的發洩，語氣柔和誠懇。
voices.original_description: Young adult female, late teens-early 20s. Naturalistic British accent. Clear, slightly breathy, highly expressive. Fast-paced, energetic, social anxiety, youthful enthusiasm. High emotional tension, comedic venting, soft sincere tone.

voices.description: 一位男性，年齡在70多歲至80多歲之間，聲音沙啞且粗礪，語速緩慢且審慎，帶有輕微的鼻音，語調中略帶歐洲口音，表現出獨特而有權威的個性，並夾雜著疲憊的嘆息。
voices.original_description: Elderly male, 70s-80s, raspy gravelly, slow deliberate, slight nasal, faint European accent, eccentric authoritative, weary sighs.

voices.description: 年長男性，聲音粗礪沙啞。東北部都市口音。高能量、強烈強調、節奏分明。嘶啞且急迫的語調。語速快速，犀利的重音。老練且毫不妥協的倡議辯護者。
voices.original_description: Masculine, elderly, gravelly texture. Northeastern urban accent. High-energy, emphatic, rhythmic. Raspy, urgent tone. Rapid pace, sharp emphasis. Seasoned, uncompromising advocate.

voices.description: 女性，十幾歲後期。高能量、原始、未經雕琢、強烈。聲音急促，帶有旋律感的渴望轉為爆發性的嘶喊。語速快，誠懇而充滿絕望的激情。
voices.original_description: Female, late teens. High-energy, raw, unpolished, powerful. Breathless delivery, melodic yearning to explosive shouting. Fast, earnest, desperate passion.

voices.description: 男性、巨大恐怖、雙重層次。低沉、濕潤、喉音、次低音的咆哮。具有掠食性與親密感。語速緩慢且審慎。在耳語與失真咆哮之間交替。
voices.original_description: Masculine, monstrous, dual-layered. Deep, wet, guttural, sub-bass growl. Predatory, intimate. Slow, deliberate pace. Alternates whisper and distorted roar.

voices.description: 一位年輕女性，聲音像是小精靈般輕盈，音高屬於中高音範圍，帶有柔和的氣聲，語音經過打磨，咬字清晰，語氣溫和，語調節奏感強，具鼓勵性，且帶有優雅的氣質。
voices.original_description: Young adult female, small creature, mid-high pitch, soft breathy, polished, articulate, gentle, rhythmic, encouraging, sophisticated.

voices.description: 一位男性中年主持人，帶有愛爾蘭口音。聲音具有高能量、旋律感的節奏，明亮的鼻音質感。說話快速且機智幽默，感染力強的笑聲，溫暖且具吸引力。帶有玩味的對話風格，語調上揚，充滿調皮的喜悅。
voices.original_description: Masculine, middle-aged, Irish-accented host. High-energy melodic rhythmic, bright nasal texture. Rapid-fire wit, infectious laughter, warm inviting. Playful banter, rising inflections, mischievous joy.

voices.description: 成熟男性，年齡在50多歲至60多歲之間，使用帶有俄國口音的英語，聲音乾澀、沙啞，語速審慎而有控制，咬字精準，語氣分析性強、正式且具權威感。
voices.original_description: Mature male, 50s-60s, Russian-accented English, dry, gravelly, deliberate, precise, analytical, formal, authoritative.

voices.description: 男性，十幾歲後期到20歲出頭，中歐口音。高情緒緊張，氣喘吁吁的絕望感。細膩、年輕、緊繃的聲音質地。快速而急迫的語速。脆弱與突然尖銳的決心混合。
voices.original_description: Male, late teens to early 20s, Central European accent. High emotional tension, breathless desperation. Thin, youthful, strained texture. Rapid, urgent pacing. Vulnerability mixed with sudden sharp resolve.

voices.description: 女性，年輕成人，聲音為合成的無情感平板語調，語調平直單調。語速精準、有節奏感，帶有分析性，完全沒有自然的氣聲。音高較低，語速穩定，發音清晰無誤。聲音中隱含著銳利的幽默感與乾澀的諷刺。
voices.original_description: Feminine, young adult, synthetic deadpan with flat monotone. Precise, rhythmic, analytical, devoid of organic breathiness. Low pitch, steady pace, impeccable articulation. Underlying sharp wit and dry irony.

voices.description: 女性，年輕成人，具有加勒比海口音。充滿活力、節奏感強、具權威性且富有同理心。音高為中高音，咬字清晰且為短促的斷續音。帶有戰場上的務實與溫暖。聲音靈活且精明幹練。
voices.original_description: Female, young adult, Caribbean accent. Energetic, rhythmic, authoritative, empathetic. Medium-high pitch, crisp staccato. Battlefield pragmatism with warmth. Agile, street-smart.

voices.description: 中年男性，聲音沙啞，充滿高能量。語速快，帶有躁狂與粗礪古怪的特質。略帶倫敦東區口音與都市粗獷感。聲音歡欣混亂、調皮愛炫耀，帶有尖銳的咯咯怪笑。
voices.original_description: Masculine, middle-aged, raspy, high-energy. Fast, manic, gravelly eccentricity. Slight Cockney/urban grit. Gleefully chaotic, mischievous, boastful. Sharp cackling laughter.

voices.description: 一位女性年輕成人，擁有拉丁美洲口音。聲音柔和、帶有氣聲、富有旋律感，語氣親密，語速審慎而有控制。聲音從溫和柔和轉變為尖銳而深情的渴望。
voices.original_description: Young adult female, Latin American accent. Soft, breathy, melodic, intimate, deliberate pace. Shifts from gentle warmth to sharp, soulful yearning.

voices.description: 古老女性，超自然，沙啞，空洞，喀啦作響，骨骸般的質感。高張力，突然的轉變：從掠食性的低語轉為尖銳的回聲厲叫。節奏不規則，冰冷，虛無主義，天界混沌。
voices.original_description: Ancient female, supernatural, raspy, hollow, rattling, skeletal. High tension, sudden shifts: predatory whispers to shrill echoing shrieks. Erratic pacing, cold, nihilistic, celestial chaos.

voices.description: 一位年輕女性，擁有明亮清晰的次女高音。語速輕快有節奏感，帶有自嘲式的幽默感，語氣真誠溫暖。聲音流暢且充滿活力，具有親和力的學生領袖形象。
voices.original_description: Young adult female, bright clear mezzo-soprano. Casual fast rhythmic delivery, self-deprecating humor, warm sincerity. Smooth yet energetic, relatable student leader.

voices.description: 一位男性，年齡為十幾歲後期至20多歲中段，使用標準美國口音。聲音帶有運動感，並帶有氣聲的脆弱感。音高處於中段，誠懇且對話般的語氣。語速有節奏感，並夾雜著探索性的停頓。聲音中隱含著焦慮與期待的緊張感。
voices.original_description: Young adult male, late teens-20s, standard American. Athletic, breathy vulnerability. Mid-range, earnest, conversational. Rhythmic pace with searching pauses. Underlying tension of anxiety and expectation.

voices.description: 女性，年輕成人，聲音柔和帶有氣聲，平靜安詳。音高較高，節奏穩定而有規律。聲音充滿深沉的溫暖，語調節奏帶有祈禱般的氛圍。聲音富有同理心與安撫感，信念堅定不移。
voices.original_description: Feminine, young adult, soft breathy serene. High-pitched, steady rhythmic pace. Profound warmth, prayerful cadence. Empathetic soothing, unwavering faith.

voices.description: 年長男性，愛爾蘭希伯諾英語，學者抒情。氣聲共鳴歷經風霜的聲質，審慎而有控制的節律節奏。沉思神秘、權威而溫和，詩意旋律的語調。
voices.original_description: Elderly male, Irish Hiberno-English, scholarly lyrical. Breathy resonant weathered texture, deliberate rhythmic pace. Contemplative mystical authoritative yet gentle, poetic melodic cadence.

voices.description: 一位20多歲中段的女性。聲音柔和、帶有氣聲，略帶沙啞。音高處於中段，語氣溫和且有節奏感。情緒親密、脆弱且真誠，展現出堅實的韌性。使用標準美國口音，語氣溫暖且對話自然。
voices.original_description: Young adult female, mid-20s. Soft, breathy, slightly husky. Mid-range, gentle, rhythmic. Intimate, vulnerable, sincere. Grounded resilience. Standard American, warm, conversational.

voices.description: 男性，30多歲中段，聲音為粗糙且歷經風霜的男中音。帶有濃厚的凱爾特風格口音。具備魅力、節奏感、說服力，聲音質地自然樸實。語速穩定且自信，展現遊牧般的自由感，聲音溫暖、粗獷而未經雕琢。
voices.original_description: Male, mid-30s, gravelly weathered baritone. Thick Celtic-inspired lilt. Charismatic rhythmic persuasive, earthy unpolished. Steady confident pace, nomadic freedom, warm rugged untamed.

voices.description: 中年女性，印度英語口音。語氣權威，言辭清晰，帶有知性而急切的語氣。中高音調，節奏明快清晰。聲音具備清晰的共鳴感，語速較快且具說服力。
voices.original_description: Middle-aged female, Indian English accent. Authoritative, articulate, intellectual urgency. Medium-high pitch, crisp rhythmic cadence. Clear resonant texture, persuasive rapid style.

voices.description: 男性，年齡在六十多歲後期至七十多歲之間。聲音歷經風霜，帶有粗礪的男中音。語速緩慢且審慎。呼吸吃力，有疲憊的停頓。聲音帶有堅毅剋制的權威感與凝重的尊嚴。語調為美國邊疆風格的拖長語調。
voices.original_description: Masculine, late 60s-70s. Weathered, gravelly baritone. Slow, deliberate pace. Labored breathing, weary pauses. Stoic authority, somber dignity. American frontier drawl.

voices.description: 年輕女性，美國西岸口音。聲音清晰、明亮、放鬆，帶有輕微的沙啞感。語速穩定且具鼓勵性，語氣非正式、自信且冷靜從容。
voices.original_description: Young adult female, West Coast American accent. Clear, bright, relaxed, slight gravelly fry. Steady, encouraging pace. Informal, confident, cool composure.

voices.description: 年輕成年男性，南亞口音。中音域，呼吸急促且帶點鼻音的緊迫感。連珠炮般的知性語氣。從驚奇轉為疲憊的犬儒感，擁擠密集的心靈回聲。
voices.original_description: Masculine, young adult, South Asian accent. Mid-range, breathless urgent slightly nasal texture. Rapid-fire intellectual style. Shifts wonder to weary cynicism, crowded psychic echoes.

voices.description: 45至55歲男性，標準英式發音。聲音粗礪、歷經風霜、具權威感。語速審慎嚴峻。帶有高度剋制的緊繃感、疲憊的犬儒主義與勉強浮現的希望。語音短促、專業且具威懾力。
voices.original_description: Male, 45-55, British RP accent. Gravelly, weathered, authoritative. Deliberate, stern pace. High controlled tension, weary cynicism, reluctant hope. Clipped, professional, intimidating.

voices.description: 年輕成年女性，十幾歲後期。沉穩踏實、誠懇、氣聲、略帶沙啞。中音域。堅定卻負擔沉重。節奏受控，從低聲脆弱轉為尖銳戰鬥命令。高張力。
voices.original_description: Young adult female, late teens. Grounded, earnest, breathy, slight rasp. Mid-range. Determined, burdened. Measured pace, quiet vulnerability to sharp battle commands. High tension.

voices.description: 男性，無特定年齡，中音區男高音。具有旋律與節律的韻律感。神秘而俏皮古怪的魅力，語氣中暗藏銳利與報復的陰影。審慎而詩意。輕微的嘶嘶齒擦音，語速流暢。聲音平滑且帶有令人寒心的權威感。
voices.original_description: Masculine, ageless, mid-range tenor. Melodic, rhythmic lilt. Enigmatic, whimsical charm, underlying sharp, vengeful edge. Deliberate, poetic. Light sibilance, fluid pace. Smooth, chilling authority.

voices.description: 女性，30多歲至40多歲，紐西蘭口音。具同理心，語速審慎而有控制，能給予安心感。語調溫和而堅定，咬字清晰，聲音帶有輕柔的氣聲。說話節奏緩慢而穩定，具冷靜的權威感與情感智慧。
voices.original_description: Adult female, 30s-40s, New Zealand accent. Empathetic, measured, reassuring. Gentle firm cadence, clear articulation, soft breathy texture. Deliberate pace, calm authority, emotional intelligence.

voices.description: 女性，十多歲。聲音柔和、音調高、帶有氣聲。害羞、猶豫，語中夾雜停頓與輕柔的上揚語調。誠懇、甜美、有照顧他人的感覺，充滿純真與年輕的氣息。安靜、有禮貌，帶著興奮中緊張的感覺，以及居家的溫暖感。
voices.original_description: Female, early teens. Soft, high-pitched, breathy. Shy, hesitant, with pauses and gentle upward inflections. Earnest, sweet, nurturing, youthful innocence. Quiet, polite, nervous excitement and domestic warmth.

voices.description: 一位女性，年齡在50多歲至60多歲之間，聲音沉穩、具權威感。音高為中音區，略帶沙啞感。咬字清晰，語調有節奏感，具說服力。語速穩定，語氣堅定而溫暖，帶有決斷力。語速自然，略帶美國口音。
voices.original_description: Mature female, 50s-60s, grounded, authoritative. Mid-range, slight gravel. Articulate, rhythmic, persuasive. Steady, resolute, warm but firm. Natural pace, slight American lilt.

voices.description: 男性，40多歲中段，精緻的歐陸法語口音。知性、分析性，輕盈通透的聲質。語速適中，咬字精準，有思索的停頓。帶有貴族般的好奇心與哲學式的疏離感，學者氣息卻又易於親近理解。
voices.original_description: Masculine, mid-40s, refined Continental French accent. Intellectual, analytical, light airy texture. Moderate pace, precise articulation, thoughtful pauses. Aristocratic curiosity, philosophical detachment. Scholarly yet accessible.

voices.description: 成熟男性，年齡為50多歲至60多歲，具有共鳴的男中音，溫暖粗礪。節奏感強的東歐語調。疲憊而莊嚴的氣質，冷幽默。對話親密，喧鬧驚呼。表現力豐富。
voices.original_description: Masculine, mature 50s-60s, resonant baritone, warm gravelly. Rhythmic Eastern European cadence. Weary gravitas, dry wit. Conversational intimacy, boisterous exclamations. Expressive.

voices.description: 女性，20多歲後期至30多歲初期。標準英式發音。神經緊繃，語速快，咬字清楚。聲音明亮精緻，容易氣喘結巴，並伴有緊張的笑聲。表現出慌亂絕望的語氣。
voices.original_description: Female, late 20s-early 30s. British RP. High-strung, fast, articulate. Bright, polished, prone to breathless stammers and nervous laughter. Frantic desperation.

voices.description: 中年男性，語氣溫和而具權威感，帶有輕柔的日本口音。語速適中，語意清晰，表現出謙遜的知識熱情。聲音平靜、有節奏感，並帶有細膩的溫暖感。
voices.original_description: Middle-aged male, soft-spoken authoritative, gentle Japanese accent. Measured pace, high clarity, humble intellectual passion. Calm, rhythmic, subtle warmth.

voices.description: 一位女性，聲音溫暖，富有共鳴，帶有氣聲，語速緩慢，語調沉重。聲音柔和、靈魂深邃，有長時間的停頓，低沉的哼鳴。帶有苦澀與甜蜜交織的感覺，母性的，疲憊的。
voices.original_description: Mature female, warm, resonant, breathy, slow, heavy cadence. Gentle, soulful, long pauses, low hum. Bittersweet, maternal, weary.

voices.description: 中性，無特定年齡感，冷淡疏離。低音量的單一音調，乾燥且帶有氣聲的質感。穩定而必然的語速。空洞而令人不安的存在感，音高變化極小。
voices.original_description: Androgynous, ageless, chillingly detached. Low-volume monotone, dry breathy texture. Steady, inevitable pace. Hollow, haunting presence, minimal pitch variation.

voices.description: 年長女性，帶有法國口音的英語。聲線柔和、氣聲、帶有俏皮古怪的質感，節奏詩意。語氣睿智、俏皮、親密，帶有年長者溫暖而略帶沙啞的聲調。
voices.original_description: Elderly female, French-accented English. Soft, breathy, whimsical texture with rhythmic, poetic pace. Wise, playful, intimate tone with a slight, warm rasp of age.

voices.description: 女性，年輕成人，帶有東歐口音。聲音帶有氣聲，脆弱而充滿絕望的決心。高張力，顫抖，懇求的語速。聲音具有旋律感，充滿悲傷，帶有悲劇性的接受。
voices.original_description: Female, young adult, Eastern European lilt. Breathy, fragile, desperate resolve. High tension, trembling, pleading pace. Melodic, grief-heavy, tragic acceptance.

voices.description: 女性、成熟。聲音溫和、有節奏感且富有旋律感，帶有輕微的鳥鳴般的顫音。性格耐心、照顧他人且睿智。語速穩定、不急不徐。聲音流暢、柔和且帶有空靈的共鳴。
voices.original_description: Feminine, mature. Gentle, rhythmic, melodic, slight avian trill. Patient, nurturing, wise. Steady, unhurried pace. Smooth, soft, airy resonance.

voices.description: 男性，30多歲中段到40多歲，聲音為低沉且富有共鳴的男中音，語音質地優雅學者氣息。言語流暢且語速審慎，帶有細微的法國克里奧爾語調。觀察力強，疲憊而富有同情心，社會緊張感，學術嚴謹。
voices.original_description: Masculine, mid-30s to 40s, deep resonant baritone, refined scholarly texture. Eloquent measured pace, subtle French-Creole lilt. Observant, weary compassionate, social tension, intellectual rigor.

voices.description: 50歲出頭到60歲出頭的男性，聲音沙啞且具權威感，語速審慎而有控制，咬字清晰，語氣銳利且有節奏感，從平靜到強勢不等，帶有道德上的義憤。
voices.original_description: Late 50s-early 60s male, gravelly, authoritative, deliberate, articulate, sharp, rhythmic, calm to forceful, morally indignant.

voices.description: 男性，成熟，聲音深沉且富有共鳴，層次豐富並帶有幽靈般的混響效果，語速緩慢且審慎，具有一種冰冷而疏離的權威感，並散發出令人恐懼的靜止感。
voices.original_description: Masculine, mature, cavernous resonant layered with ghostly reverb, slow deliberate, icy detached authority, terrifying stillness.

voices.description: 年輕男性，充滿活力，自負。音高適中，聲音明亮且富有共鳴。語速快，熱情洋溢，帶有策略性的自信與年輕的傲慢。使用清晰標準的口音，咬字清晰，能量高。
voices.original_description: Young adult male, energetic, cocky. Mid pitch, bright, resonant. Fast, enthusiastic, tactical confidence, youthful arrogance. Clear standard accent, sharp articulation, high energy.

voices.description: 男性，30多歲。精力充沛、躁動、不可預測。聲音沙啞、緊繃，語速極快。音量突然變化。美國都市口音，聲音粗礪，異常認真。
voices.original_description: Male, mid-30s. High-energy, manic, unpredictable. Raspy, strained, rapid-fire. Sudden volume shifts. Urban American, gritty, absurdly earnest.

voices.description: 男性，40多歲，優雅的法語口音。聲音具有權威感卻又帶著疲憊，聲音質地流暢圓潤。語調節奏審慎，咬字清晰，表達有條不紊。傳達出貴族般的責任感與在壓力下所展現的策略性緊迫感。
voices.original_description: Male, mid-40s, refined French accent. Authoritative yet weary, smooth texture. Precise, articulate, measured. Conveys aristocratic duty and tactical urgency under pressure.

voices.description: 中年男性，歐洲男中音。聲音吃力、緊繃、粗礪且疲憊。語速快速、氣喘吁吁，帶有銳利的停頓。語氣會從強裝的愉快轉為壓低的疑懼與戒備，整體顯得陰影纏身。
voices.original_description: Middle-aged male, European baritone. Strained, gravelly, exhausted. Rapid, breathless with sharp pauses. Shifts: forced joviality to hushed paranoia. Haunted.

voices.description: 男性青少年，本國法語口音。音高高且有裂音。聲音帶有氣聲，說話快速且充滿緊張感。具街頭智慧的堅韌。情緒範圍從防禦性的冷漠轉為突然的誠懇。聲音質感未經打磨，帶有焦躁的特質。
voices.original_description: Teen male, native French accent. High, cracking pitch. Breathy, rapid-fire, nervous energy. Street-smart resilience. Emotional range from defensive apathy to sudden sincerity. Unpolished, restless texture.

voices.description: 中年男性，帶有牙買加口音，語調具有節奏感與旋律感。語速精準、細緻、具權威感。聲音流暢圓潤，壓力下會變得高音且急促。帶有溫暖的加勒比海語調特色。
voices.original_description: Middle-aged male, Jamaican accent, rhythmic melodic cadence. Precise, fastidious, authoritative. Smooth texture, high-pitched frantic when stressed. Warm Caribbean lilt.

voices.description: 男性，年齡為70多歲至80多歲。使用美國中大西洋地區口音。聲音帶有輕微的節奏性沙啞與柔和的氣聲。語速審慎而有控制。表達誠懇且富有同理心，語氣權威卻又帶有祖父般的溫和。
voices.original_description: Elderly male, late 70s-80s. Mid-Atlantic American accent. Slight rhythmic rasp, soft breathiness. Measured, deliberate pace. Earnest, empathetic delivery. Authoritative yet grandfatherly.

voices.description: 中年男性，受智利發音影響的西班牙語口音，長年菸草薰染般的粗礪乾澀聲質，知性疲憊，有節律的沉思語速，哲學厚重感，遊牧學者內省，略帶犬儒而熱情
voices.original_description: Masculine middle-aged, Chilean-inflected Spanish accent, dry gravelly tobacco-seasoned texture, intellectual weary, rhythmic contemplative pace, philosophical weight, nomadic scholar introspective slightly cynical passionate.

voices.description: 男性，年輕成人，愛爾蘭口音，聲音從專注而粗糙的男中音轉變為費力的喉音，帶有高張力、節奏感詩意、叛逆且氣喘吁吁的語調。
voices.original_description: Masculine, young adult, Irish accent, shifts focused gritty baritone to strained guttural, high tension, rhythmic poetic, defiant breathless.

voices.description: 女性，50多歲至70多歲，具有高階英國或中大西洋口音。聲音具備清脆而脆弱的質感，強迫性的樂觀情緒，說話快速如連珠炮，但中間夾雜著感傷的停頓。聲音明亮且富有旋律感，但隱含著一種深層的恐懼。
voices.original_description: Female, late 50s-70s, high-society British/Mid-Atlantic. Crisp brittle texture, forced cheerfulness, rapid-fire with poignant pauses. Bright melodic tone, underlying dread.

voices.description: 一位女性年輕成人，語氣溫柔，使用約克郡口音。聲音清晰、溫暖、扎實。語氣禮貌、節制、富有同理心，語速穩定。
voices.original_description: Young adult female, soft-spoken Yorkshire accent. Clear, warm, grounded. Polite, measured, empathetic, steady pace.

voices.description: 中年男性，沙啞的男中音，帶有疲憊與世故的質感。節奏分明的黑色電影語調，乾澀而諷刺的表達方式。隱含微弱的東歐/意第緒語腔調，語速審慎而有控制，語句之間有清晰的停頓。
voices.original_description: Middle-aged male, gravelly baritone, weary world-worn texture. Rhythmic noir cadence, dry cynical delivery. Subtle Eastern European/Yiddish undercurrents, deliberate pace, sharp pauses.

voices.description: 男性，年長。聲音粗礪、溫暖、有權威感，略帶沙啞。語速中等，帶有父親般的親切與指導性，具有教導與引導的風格。無特定口音，屬於中性英雄式腔調。聲音穩定、鼓勵人心，帶有戰術智慧與策略性的經驗感。
voices.original_description: Masculine, senior. Gravelly, warm, authoritative, slight rasp. Mid-tempo, paternal, mentoring. Neutral heroic accent. Retired commander, steady, encouraging, tactical wisdom.

voices.description: 年長男性，虛弱卻威嚴的高地位語調。沙啞氣喘的聲質，上流古典口音。帶有痴迷執唸的快速節奏。
voices.original_description: Elderly male, frail commanding high-status tone. Raspy breathless texture, posh classical accent. Rapid obsessive pace.

voices.description: 男性年長者，帶有中非地區特色的口音，聲音低沉且富有共鳴，歷經歲月磨損，語速緩慢且審慎，有長時間的停頓，具權威性與憐憫之心，擁有極大的莊嚴感，道德清晰明確，具有社區領導者的份量。
voices.original_description: Masculine elderly, Central African-inspired accent, deep resonant weathered, slow deliberate long pauses, authoritative compassionate, immense gravitas, moral clarity, community leader weight.

voices.description: 男性，60多歲，美國人。自然主義風格，觀察性強，聲音沙啞，帶有知識分子氣質。語速中等，有思考性的停頓。是個充滿好奇心的紀錄片導演。聲音溫暖、客觀、對話式，略顯不修飾。
voices.original_description: Masculine, mid-60s, American. Naturalistic, observational, gravelly, intellectual. Mid-tempo, thoughtful pauses. Curious documentarian. Warm, objective, conversational, unpolished.

voices.description: 男性，成熟，標準英式發音。言辭優雅，具有戲劇性，咬字清晰。聲音流暢且富有共鳴，略帶模糊感。語調節奏審慎而詩意，帶有哲學性的平靜與革命性的強烈情緒。
voices.original_description: Male, mature, British RP. Eloquent, theatrical, articulate. Smooth, resonant, slightly muffled. Deliberate, poetic cadence, philosophical calm, revolutionary intensity.

voices.description: 一位女性，年齡在30多歲至40多歲之間，聲音具備飄渺而富有旋律感的特質。帶有柔和的抒情威爾斯語調，聲音平靜卻堅韌。聲音清晰且帶有氣聲，語速審慎而有節奏感。聲音中蘊含古老的智慧，具備安詳而魔幻的權威感，令人感到舒適放鬆。
voices.original_description: Adult female, 30s-40s, ethereal melodic. Soft lyrical Welsh lilt. Serene yet resilient. Clear breathy texture, deliberate rhythmic pace. Ancient wisdom, calm magical authority, soothing.

voices.description: 一位女性十幾歲後期的聲音，明亮、有活力，略帶沙啞。她充滿熱情、自信，表現自然。聲音中帶有感染力的樂觀與頑固的熱情。
voices.original_description: Female late teens, bright, energetic, slightly raspy. High-spirited, confident, naturalistic. Infectious optimism, stubborn passion.

voices.description: 男性，年長，帶有東歐口音。發音精準，語速審慎而有控制。聲音輕盈、富有共鳴、沉穩自持。思想哲學化，具紀律性，帶鼓勵性。語調節奏有規律，充滿世故智慧與內斂自信。
voices.original_description: Masculine, senior, Eastern European accent. Precise, deliberate articulation. Light, resonant, poised. Philosophical, disciplined, encouraging. Rhythmic pace, worldly wisdom, quiet confidence.

voices.description: 年輕的貴族女性，聲音細膩帶有氣聲，顯得疲憊，語速緩慢而有節奏，說話輕聲且咬字清晰，語氣真誠而帶有脆弱感。
voices.original_description: Young high-born female, delicate breathy weary texture, slow measured pace, soft-spoken articulate, sincere vulnerable tone.

voices.description: 高音調的年輕非人類聲音，中性無性別，聲音質地柔和且帶有氣聲，語音簡單、猶豫且具有旋律感，語速快速且輕快，表達出純真與好奇的感覺。
voices.original_description: High-pitched youthful non-human, gender-neutral soft breathy texture, simplistic hesitant melodic speech, rapid chirpy pace, innocent wonder.

voices.description: 女性，年輕成人，澳洲口音。聲音明亮，具有強烈的旋律感，並帶有明顯的氣聲，語調溫和而輕快。聲音溫暖、鼓勵人心，經過打磨卻又親切易接近。語速適中，咬字柔和。
voices.original_description: Feminine, young adult, Australian. Bright, melodic, exceptionally breathy, gentle uplifting lilt. Warm, encouraging, polished yet approachable. Moderate pace, soft articulation.

voices.description: 年輕男性。具有歐洲口音，高能量，富有旋律感。聲音流暢、帶有氣聲、靈活。溫暖、謙虛、愛玩。說話快速，語調輕快。
voices.original_description: Young adult male. European accent, high-energy, melodic. Smooth, breathy, agile. Warm, humble, playful. Rapid, light inflections.

voices.description: 男性，中年，充滿活力。熱情洋溢，親切歡迎。聲音沙啞且富有經驗感。語速快，充滿熱情。具有魅力的導師或活潑的遊園會叫賣人。聲音清晰，具有戲劇性的表現風格。
voices.original_description: Masculine, middle-aged, energetic. High-spirited, welcoming. Gravelly, seasoned texture. Fast, enthusiastic delivery. Charismatic mentor or lively carnival barker. Clear, theatrical flair.

voices.description: 中年男性，帶有德國口音。聲音質感粗糙緊繃且強烈。語速不穩定，壓低聲線的脆弱感轉為雷鳴般的爆發。
voices.original_description: Middle-aged male, German-accented. Gravelly strained intense texture. Erratic pace, hushed vulnerability to thunderous outbursts.

voices.description: 一位年輕男性，音域為中音男高音，聲音明亮誠懇，帶有中大西洋美國口音，語調節奏感強，咬字清晰流暢，聲音中帶有緊張的能量，且具說服力。
voices.original_description: Young adult male, mid-range tenor, bright, earnest, Mid-Atlantic American, rhythmic, articulate, smooth, nervous energy, persuasive.
