voices.description: 男性，年長。20世紀中葉美國地區口音。聲音沙啞、富有共鳴。具備安靜的權威感。語速緩慢，富有沉思節奏，帶有情感份量。表現出反思與謙遜的特質。帶有氣聲的停頓，聲音溫暖，帶有懷舊的質感。
voices.original_description: Masculine, senior. Mid-century American regional accent. Gravelly, weathered, resonant. Quiet authority. Slow, contemplative pace, emotional weight. Reflective, humble. Breathy pauses, warm, nostalgic texture.

voices.description: 一位十幾歲後期的年輕女性，聲音明亮有活力，略帶慌張。音高較高，聲音特質帶有假小子般的運動員風格。表達方式充滿困惑與驚慌，語氣誠懇解釋。語速快而清晰，聲音中帶有年輕的共鳴。
voices.original_description: Young adult female, late teens. Bright energetic, slightly frantic. High-pitched tomboyish athletic delivery. Bewildered panic, earnest explanation. Fast-paced breathless, clear youthful resonance.

voices.description: 女性，年輕成人，音高屬於中間範圍。語調優雅、鎮定、有紀律，專業的節奏。聲音經過打磨，略帶疏離感，鼓勵性的語氣，語速穩定，咬字清晰。屬於高階導師型聲音，帶有策略與傳統的特質。
voices.original_description: Feminine, young adult, mid-range pitch. Elegant composed disciplined professional cadence. Polished slightly aloof encouraging, steady pace crisp articulation. Elite mentor, strategy tradition.

voices.description: 一位40多歲後段的男性，經歷豐富、顯得疲憊。帶有乾澀、諷刺的幽默感。中音區的男中音，聲音沙啞。語氣平靜且節奏穩定。聰明、務實且懷疑一切。
voices.original_description: Biologically late 40s male, seasoned, weary. Dry, sardonic wit. Mid-range baritone, gravelly. Calm, measured. Intelligent, pragmatic, cynical.

voices.description: 男性，十幾歲後期。聲音明亮、精力充沛，充滿無限樂觀。音高屬於中高音，聲音清晰且富有共鳴。語速很快，充滿熱情。使用標準美國口音。誠懇、真誠，帶有英雄氣概。
voices.original_description: Masculine, late teens. Bright, energetic, relentlessly optimistic. Mid-to-high pitch, clear, resonant. Fast, enthusiastic delivery. Standard American. Earnest, sincere, heroic.

voices.description: 一位年輕女性，使用帶有西非口音的英語。聲音明亮、穩定、充滿好奇心，具有中高音且流暢有旋律感。語速自信而謙遜，表現出決心與學生的特質。性格樂觀現實，充滿年輕的抱負，是社區的領導者。
voices.original_description: Young adult female, West African-inflected English. Bright grounded curious, medium-high smooth melodic. Confident humble pace, determined student. Optimistic realistic, youthful ambition community leader.

voices.description: 年輕男性，南亞口音。聲音流暢且富有旋律感，為男高音，語調節奏如全球流行歌星般優雅。語氣平靜、節奏穩定、溫暖。具哲學性但親切易接近。
voices.original_description: Young adult male, South Asian accent. Smooth, melodic tenor, global pop star cadence. Calm, measured, warm. Philosophical yet approachable.

voices.description: 成熟女性，民間說書人。快速的顫音，原始而泥土質感。誠懇、有節奏、親密卻穿透人心，語速穩定。
voices.original_description: Mature female, folk orator. Rapid vibrato, raw, earthy. Earnest, rhythmic, intimate yet piercing, steady pace.

voices.description: 一位50多歲至60多歲的成熟女性，帶有義大利口音。聲音知性、溫暖且具有權威感，具備歷經風霜的共鳴質地，語速審慎且富有思索節奏，展現歐洲的優雅成熟與南美洲的熱情，並帶有節律感。
voices.original_description: Mature female, 50s-60s, Italian-accented. Intellectual, warm, authoritative. Weathered resonant texture. Deliberate, thoughtful pace. European sophistication with South American passion, rhythmic cadence.

voices.description: 年輕女性，英格蘭口音。聲音柔和、旋律優美，有詩意的語調。語氣溫柔卻堅定，語速適中。帶著內斂的決心、浪漫的渴望與高尚的犧牲精神。
voices.original_description: Young adult female, English accent. Soft, melodic, lyrical cadence. Gentle yet firm, moderate pace. Quiet determination, romantic longing, noble sacrifice.

voices.description: 成熟女性，無年齡感，加勒比口音。聲音帶有噼啪作響的聲質，共鳴感強，如壁爐微火低燃般溫暖內斂。語速有意控制且節奏分明。語氣溫暖好奇，情感易變且強烈。
voices.original_description: Mature female, ageless, Caribbean accent. Crackling, resonant, low-burning hearth. Deliberate rhythmic pace. Warm curiosity, volatile intensity.

voices.description: 女性，年輕成人，聲音飄渺卻帶有權威感。高音區，具有旋律感，清晰且有節奏感。帶有細緻的精緻口音。聲音流暢且清晰。語氣直接且具命令感。情緒張力高，表現出堅定的紀律性。
voices.original_description: Female, young adult, ethereal yet authoritative. High-register, melodic, crisp, rhythmic. Subtle refined accent. Smooth, clear texture. Direct, commanding. High emotional tension, stoic discipline.

voices.description: 中年男性，精緻的澳洲口音。務實、權威、清晰。精準、有條理。學術的優雅氣質，工業般的決心。
voices.original_description: Middle-aged male, refined Australian accent. Pragmatic, authoritative, clear. Precise, methodical. Academic poise, industrial resolve.

voices.description: 男性，中音區，沙啞的質感。高能量的瘋狂語速，尖銳的斷續笑聲，陰謀般的低語。瘋狂的喜悅，偏執的專注，誇張的呼吸聲，帶有戲劇化的卡通風格語調節奏。
voices.original_description: Male, mid-range, raspy texture. High-energy frantic pace, sharp staccato chuckles, conspiratorial whispers. Manic glee, obsessive focus, exaggerated breathing, cartoonish cadence.

voices.description: 成熟女性，上流社會英國口音。聲音尖細且帶有氣聲。語速審慎而戲劇化；語氣權威卻荒謬，帶有貴婦般的虛榮。
voices.original_description: Mature female, high-society British accent. Pinched, breathy texture. Deliberate, theatrical pace; authoritative yet absurd, matronly vanity.

voices.description: 女性，年輕成人，英國埃斯特里口音。聲音明亮，咬字清晰，語速快。具有強烈的求知慾，熱情洋溢，觀察力敏銳。語調節奏富有節律感，對話流暢自然，聲音清晰，聲質輕柔。
voices.original_description: Feminine, young adult, British Estuary accent. Bright, articulate, fast-paced. Intellectually curious, enthusiastic, observant. Rhythmic, conversational flow, clear, light texture.

voices.description: 女性，中年，南亞口音。語氣溫和，咬字清晰，富有同理心。語速具沉思節奏，聲音流暢且溫暖。具備知識深度，溫和智慧，語氣謹慎且具吸引力。
voices.original_description: Feminine, middle-aged, South Asian accent. Soft-spoken, articulate, empathetic. Rhythmic contemplative pace, smooth warm texture. Intellectual depth, gentle wisdom, measured inviting style.

voices.description: 男性年長者，帶有德國口音。高音域，知性，節奏精準。聲質單薄細弱，如簧管般尖細。分析性強，表達密集濃厚，有沉思的停頓。具有深厚權威感。
voices.original_description: Masculine, elderly, German accent. High-register, intellectual, precise pace. Thin, reedy texture. Analytical, dense, with contemplative pauses. Profound authority.

voices.description: 男性，中年，帶有疲憊感的男中音。使用中大西洋口音。聲音沉重，充滿靜默的絕望與學識上的疲勞。咬字清晰但猶豫，語速適中，有長時間的停頓。聲音歷經風霜，謙卑中帶著隱忍的怨恨。
voices.original_description: Masculine, middle-aged, weary baritone. Mid-Atlantic accent. Heavy, quiet desperation, intellectual fatigue. Articulate but hesitant, moderate pace, long pauses. Weathered, humble, simmering resentment.

voices.description: 男性，年長。聲音喧鬧、戲劇化，帶有德國口音。能量充沛、節奏感強、言辭華麗。聲音雖然歷經風霜但富有共鳴。說話快速連珠炮，並有戲劇性的停頓。
voices.original_description: Senior male. Boisterous, theatrical, German accent. High-energy, rhythmic, grandiloquent. Weathered but resonant. Rapid-fire, dramatic pauses.

voices.description: 女性，30歲出頭，聲音明亮熱情，具有美國口音。聲音質地輕盈飄逸，語速輕快，語氣中帶著微笑的感覺。在私人對話中，她帶有親切而富有創造力的溫暖。
voices.original_description: Female, 30s, bright enthusiastic American. Light airy texture, upbeat pace, smile-infused. Friendly creative warmth in personal conversation.

voices.description: 女性，20多歲中段至30多歲初段。疲憊沉穩的女中低音，帶有煙燻沙啞的質感。語氣審慎且受控，表達直接專業，情感負荷沉重。語速審慎，語氣壓低而強烈，掩藏內在的緊張與創傷。
voices.original_description: Female, mid-20s to early 30s. Weary, grounded alto, smoky rasp. Cautious, controlled delivery. Direct, professional, heavy emotional weight. Deliberate pace, hushed intense tone. Masks internal tension and trauma.

voices.description: 女性，20歲出頭到30歲出頭。語速中等，語氣沉穩、務實，帶有美國口音。聲音略帶沙啞，質地乾澀。自信、不拖泥帶水的權威感。觀察力強、謹慎、樂於助人。具街頭智慧的幽默感。
voices.original_description: Female, late 20s to early 30s. Mid-tempo, grounded, pragmatic American accent. Slightly husky, dry texture. Confident, no-nonsense authority. Observant, wary, helpful. Street-smart wit.

voices.description: 成熟男性，具有胸腔共鳴的低沉隆隆聲。權威卻又謙卑，聲音從粗糙轉為溫暖，語速慢且審慎。聲音質地如絲絨般粗糙，帶有高尚與疲憊感。
voices.original_description: Mature male, resonant chesty rumble. Authoritative yet humbled, gravelly to warm, slow, deliberate. Velvety coarse texture, noble, weary.

voices.description: 男性，中年，使用英國標準口音。聲音溫暖、有節奏感的男中音，語氣沉穩、富有思考性且咬字清晰。有軍事背景，性格自律，從事醫療工作，帶有疲憊卻好奇的語氣，敘述方式溫和流暢。
voices.original_description: Masculine, middle-aged, British Received Pronunciation. Grounded warm rhythmic baritone. Measured, thoughtful, articulate. Disciplined military background, compassionate medical career. Weary wonder, gentle narrative flow.

voices.description: 男性，年輕成人，聲音充滿活力，明亮且親切。語速快而有節奏感，帶有服務業的友好語調。輕快幽默，樂於助人且積極向上。對話節奏受到日本風格的影響。聲音可靠又帶點玩味，像是同儕般的互動。
voices.original_description: Masculine, young adult, high-energy bright approachable. Fast-paced rhythmic, friendly service lilt. Lighthearted comedic, helpful upbeat. Japanese-inspired conversational cadence. Reliable playful peer.

voices.description: 40多歲的男性，聲音為疲憊但溫和的男中音。語調節奏溫和且沉思。帶有微妙的跨大西洋或柔和的歐洲口音。聲音質地乾燥且帶有塵土質感。表現風格親密、敘事性強，並具哲學深度。
voices.original_description: Mid-40s male, weary but warm baritone. Gentle, contemplative pace. Subtle transatlantic/soft European accent. Dry, dusty texture. Intimate, narrative style with philosophical depth.

voices.description: 年輕成年人，聲音偏男性化或中性。語氣平靜、沉穩、帶有疲憊感。表現出務實且內斂的風格。音域位於低至中音區，節奏穩定而有規律。語氣中隱含高度壓抑的緊張感。聲音簡約，略帶沙啞與粗礪的質感。
voices.original_description: Young adult, masculine-leaning/androgynous. Calm, measured, weary. Pragmatic, internal style. Low-to-mid register, steady rhythmic pace. High suppressed tension. Minimalist, slight rasp.

voices.description: 成熟女性，年齡在40多歲至50多歲之間，聲音深沉且富有共鳴，如絲絨般柔滑。語速帶有節奏感且儀式化。具誘惑性的低音魅力，同時帶有嚴肅的權威感。語氣平靜，有審慎而有意的停頓，聲音親密且古老。
voices.original_description: Mature female 40s-50s, deep resonant velvety. Rhythmic ritualistic pace. Seductive low allure, stern authority. Calm, deliberate pauses, intimate ancient.

voices.description: 男性，年長60多至70多歲，粗礪的男中音。美國中西部口音，節奏感強的語速被爆發的吼聲與尖銳的粗口打斷。乾澀、歷經風霜、犬儒的聲質。
voices.original_description: Masculine, senior 60s-70s, gravelly baritone. Midwestern American accent, rhythmic pacing interrupted by explosive outbursts and sharp profanity. Dry, weathered, cynical texture.

voices.description: 中年至年長的男性聲音，疲憊且心智躁動。音域為中高音，聲音細薄如簧管般尖細。節奏感強，循環且沉思，偶爾突然流露出一種孤注一擲的樂觀。帶有存在層面的疲憊感。
voices.original_description: Masculine, middle-aged to elderly, weary, intellectually restless. Mid-high register, thin, reedy. Rhythmic, circular, contemplative, sudden desperate optimism. Existential fatigue.

voices.description: 年輕女性，音高較高，具有旋律感，聲音帶有氣聲，帶有誘惑的調情口吻。語速活潑有活力，從甜膩的調戲轉換到誠實而實在的語氣。聲音明亮、富有表現力、輕盈、空靈，並帶有細微的誘惑感。
voices.original_description: Young adult female, high-pitched, melodic, breathy, flirtatious. Energetic playful pace. Sugary teasing to grounded sincerity. Bright, expressive, light, airy with subtle alluring weight.

voices.description: 男性，年長，具權威感。聲音粗糙沙啞，充滿歲月感，蘊含無比智慧。語調節奏審慎而刻意，有沉重的停頓。聲音低沉且富有共鳴，平靜而絕對確定。屬於古代東亞血統。
voices.original_description: Masculine, elderly, authoritative. Weathered, gravelly, immense wisdom. Measured, deliberate, heavy pauses. Low, resonant, calm, absolute certainty. Ancient East Asian.

voices.description: 女性，中年，高能量的主持人。聲音清晰、富有共鳴、明亮帶金屬感。咬字完美。語速快、幽默風趣、權威且帶點玩味。舞臺氣場強大，帶有冷幽默的諷刺。
voices.original_description: Female, middle-aged, high-energy emcee. Crisp, resonant, brassy. Impeccable articulation. Fast-paced, witty, authoritative, playful. Commanding stage presence, dry sarcasm.

voices.description: 男性中年聲音，富有共鳴的男中音，帶有豐富如牧師般的語調節奏，情感濃厚的美國南方口音，節奏分明的演說語速，權威而富有同情心，具有旋律感的音高起伏，有意識的停頓，充滿深遠的信念。
voices.original_description: Masculine middle-aged, resonant baritone, rich preacher-like cadence, soulful Southern American accent, rhythmic oratorical pacing, authoritative compassionate, melodic swells, intentional pauses, profound conviction.

voices.description: 一位女性，年齡在50多歲至60多歲之間，聲音具有中大西洋地區學者風格，清晰且富有共鳴，語速節奏明確，帶有教學節奏感，展現學術熱情與沉穩自信。
voices.original_description: Mature female 50s-60s, Mid-Atlantic academic, clear resonant, rhythmic pedagogical pace, intellectual passion, calm confidence.

voices.description: 一位男性長者，帶有蘇格蘭口音，聲音慈祥如祖父。具有高地位，溫暖且異想天開。聲音略帶沙啞，充滿活力與節奏感。是一位具說服力的未來遠見者與表演者。語速明快，帶有感染力的興奮。
voices.original_description: Elderly male, Scottish-accented, grandfatherly. High-status, warm, whimsical. Slightly raspy, energetic, rhythmic. Persuasive visionary showman. Brisk pace, infectious excitement.

voices.description: 男性，無年齡感而古老的聲音。具有掠食者氣質，帶有嘶嘶齒擦音與鳥類般短促斷奏的語調。深沉的胸腔共鳴聲，如雷鳴般的隆隆聲。具有高地位、誘惑且威脅的語氣，節奏感強且審慎。
voices.original_description: Masculine, ageless ancient. Predatory, sibilant, bird-like staccato. Deep resonant chest tones, thunder rumble. High-status, seductive, menacing. Rhythmic, deliberate.

voices.description: 男性傾向的年輕成人，音調高，帶有鼻音。聲音顫抖、脆弱、自嘲。聲音細弱、吃力、帶有啜泣的沙啞聲質，語速快且語句鬆散。
voices.original_description: Masculine-leaning, young adult, high-pitched, nasal. Shaky, vulnerable, self-deprecating. Thin, strained, sobbing rasp, fast rambling.

voices.description: 女性，30多歲中段到40多歲。聲音平靜、令人安心、咬字清晰。語速穩定且有節奏感。聲音溫暖、流暢、扎實、富有同理心且具吸引力。
voices.original_description: Feminine, mid-30s to 40s. Calm, reassuring, articulate. Steady, rhythmic pace. Warm, smooth, grounded, empathetic, inviting.

voices.description: 男性，30多歲，帶有西非口音。聲音疲憊、懷疑，沙啞且音量低。說話時有審慎的停頓，表現出務實、街頭智慧與臨床般的疏離感。
voices.original_description: Male 30s, West African accent. Weary cynical, gravelly low-volume. Pragmatic deliberate pauses, street-smart clinical detachment.

voices.description: 女性，年輕成人，音高屬於中段。聲音經過打磨，輕盈且有節奏感。語調明亮愉快，掩蓋了困惑情緒。咬字精準，具有旋律感，偶爾會有停頓。表達出被設定好的樂觀情緒，但隱藏著輕微的顫抖。
voices.original_description: Feminine, young adult, mid-range. Polished, airy, rhythmic. Bright, pleasant cadence masking confusion. Precise, melodic, occasional pauses. Programmed optimism, underlying tremor.

voices.description: 女性，年輕成人，高音調，帶有青春感的音色。自負、尖銳、有權威感。語速快，輕蔑、不耐煩。聲音清晰、穿透力強，充滿極大的自信。高緊張，傲慢，脾氣暴躁。
voices.original_description: Female, young adult, high-pitched, youthful timbre. Arrogant, sharp, authoritative. Fast-paced, dismissive, impatient. Clear, piercing, immense confidence. High tension, condescending, short temper.

voices.description: 年輕女性，帶有日本口音。具有戲劇性的節奏感與強烈的旋律感投射。具魅力、親切且富有表現力，咬字清晰。聲音帶有控制的氣聲與語調節奏。
voices.original_description: Young adult female, Japanese accent. Theatrical rhythmic delivery, melodic projection-heavy. Charismatic inviting expressive, clear articulation. Breathy controlled cadence.

voices.description: 男性，60多歲，語調節奏與語流風格帶有紐澤西或紐約的特色。聲音乾澀、沙啞、富有節奏感，語流具文學性。情緒表現為反思、疲憊、觀察力強。咬字清晰、語速審慎，語氣在親切關注與諷刺評論之間切換。
voices.original_description: Masculine, 60s, NJ/NY cadence. Dry, gravelly, rhythmic, literary flow. Reflective, weary, observant. Articulate, measured, shifting from intimate concern to cynical commentary.

voices.description: 男性，30多歲中段，英雄式的男中音。聲音富有共鳴，具領導氣質且穩定。帶有歐洲口音。經歷豐富的戰士，說話審慎而有控制，表現出堅定的智慧與潛藏的強烈情緒。
voices.original_description: Masculine, mid-30s, heroic baritone. Resonant, commanding, steady. European-inflected. Seasoned warrior, deliberate, stoic wisdom, underlying intensity.

voices.description: 女性，年齡在50多歲至60多歲之間。使用帶有俄國口音的英語。聲音質地低沉、富有共鳴、莊嚴而尊貴。語速審慎而有節奏感。語調疲憊卻堅定不移。低音區、帶有氣聲的莊嚴感。詩意、親密、具權威性。
voices.original_description: Feminine, mature 50s-60s. Russian-accented English. Somber, resonant, dignified texture. Deliberate, rhythmic pacing. Weary yet unshakable tone. Low-register, breathy gravitas. Poetic, intimate, authoritative.

voices.description: 年輕成年男性，具有英雄般的男高音，聲音富有共鳴且權威卻又謙遜。語速穩定有節奏感，咬字清晰。聲音流暢圓潤，但在表達信念時帶有粗糙的氣聲強度。具有領導者的沉穩感，導師般的溫暖，以及鎮定的決心。
voices.original_description: Young adult male, heroic tenor, resonant and authoritative yet humble. Steady rhythmic pacing, clear articulation. Smooth texture with gritty breathy intensity in conviction. Leader's weight, mentor's warmth, calm resolve.

voices.description: 成年男性，標準英式發音。高音清脆金屬質感。快而繁瑣挑剔的節奏。禮貌焦慮，過度正式，學究氣。氣喘吁吁的語氣。持續處於優雅卻憂慮的狀態。
voices.original_description: Adult male, British RP. High-pitched, crisp, metallic texture. Fast, fussy pace. Polite anxiety, overly formal, pedantic. Breathless delivery. Constant state of worried sophistication.

voices.description: 年輕女性，東亞口音。聲音清晰、堅定、有紀律，帶有若隱若現的脆弱。音高處於中段。語調具策略性的審慎，展現權威卻不失謙遜。說話節奏審慎而有控制。
voices.original_description: Young adult female, East Asian accent. Clear firm disciplined, subtle vulnerability. Mid-range. Measured strategic, authority with humility. Deliberate pace.

voices.description: 男性，30多歲中段，精緻的英式標準發音。具魅力，語速快速且有節奏感。帶有調皮的傲慢，咬字清晰且具戲劇性。語氣從諷刺機智轉為氣喘而真誠。溫暖的男中音。
voices.original_description: Masculine, mid-30s, refined British RP. Charismatic, quick rhythmic delivery. Playful arrogance, articulate theatricality. Shifts from cynical wit to breathless sincerity. Warm baritone.

voices.description: 中年非裔美國男性，語調節奏帶有早期20世紀的正式風格。聲音粗糙、富有共鳴、節奏沉穩、謙遜而具權威感。語速適中，咬字清晰，傳達出堅韌與內斂的驕傲。
voices.original_description: Middle-aged African-American male, formal early 20th-century cadence. Weathered, resonant, measured, humble, authoritative. Moderate pace, clear articulation, conveying grit and quiet pride.

voices.description: 男性，高階年長者，具有優雅的加勒比西班牙口音與跨大西洋腔調。聲音溫暖、具有旋律感、權威而精確，節奏柔和。帶有舊世界魅力。
voices.original_description: Senior male, sophisticated Caribbean-Spanish accent, transatlantic polish. Warm melodic authoritative, precise rhythmic gentle. Old-world charm.

voices.description: 男性，十幾歲後期。聲音雖然有沙啞的質感，但整體溫和、沉穩且富有照顧人的感覺。音高處於中間範圍，聲音清晰、耐心。帶有惱怒卻又充滿愛意的喜劇節奏，語氣輕柔、誠懇。
voices.original_description: Masculine, late teens. Gentle, grounded, nurturing despite gravelly texture. Mid-range, clear, patient. Exasperated but affectionate comedic timing. Soft-spoken, sincere.

voices.description: 女性，年長。聲音帶有沙啞、溫暖、俏皮的質感。語速中等，帶有節奏感的戲劇性停頓。聲音帶有密謀般的、愛玩的、銳利而聰明的邊緣。自信，語調細膩且富有變化。
voices.original_description: Feminine, senior. Raspy, warm, mischievous texture. Mid-tempo with rhythmic dramatic pauses. Conspiratorial, playful, sharp intelligent edge. Confident, subtle vocal inflections.

voices.description: 男性化、成熟、洪亮且聲勢強大的聲音，具有翻湧紊亂的砂紙質感。如同地殼板塊移動般的變化，遠方的怒吼聲。快速且不可預測的節奏，具有風暴般的強度。高情緒張力，帶有哲學好奇心與混沌的權威感。聲音帶有古老元素的質感，並具有共鳴與氣聲的特徵。
voices.original_description: Masculine, mature, booming, gravelly turbulent texture. Shifting tectonic plates, distant roar. Rapid unpredictable pacing, storm intensity. High emotional tension, philosophical curiosity, chaotic authority. Ancient elemental, resonant breathy.

voices.description: 20歲出頭的女性，聲音溫暖穩定，帶有輕柔的旋律感與古樸的氣質，語速柔和且令人安心，音色清晰親切，充滿深刻的同理心。
voices.original_description: Early 20s female, warm grounded casual delivery, light melodic ancient weight, gentle reassuring pace, clear intimate texture, profoundly empathetic.

voices.description: 女性，40多歲至50多歲，帶有拉丁美洲口音。聲音溫暖、具有旋律感，活潑且帶有玩味的底蘊。語速適中，節奏感強。自信而親密，帶有知性的笑聲。
voices.original_description: Feminine, mid-40s-50s, Latin American accent. Warm, melodic, vivacious texture with playful undertone. Moderate pace, rhythmic phrasing. Confident, intimate, with knowing laughter.

voices.description: 成熟男性，洪亮共鳴的低音男中音。質樸醇厚而粗礪精緻的音色，節奏緩慢且有規律。語氣帶有嘲弄而歡快的自信，語氣中隱含著古老的威脅感，使用標準的英式發音（British RP）。
voices.original_description: Male, mature adult, booming resonant bass-baritone. Earthy gravelly refined texture, slow rhythmic cadence. Mocking jovial confidence, underlying ancient threat, British RP.

voices.description: 一位男性，年齡在70多歲至80多歲之間。聲音深沉粗糙，語速溫和有節奏。語氣柔和，帶有權威的智慧。說話溫暖自然，略帶沙啞。表達反思哲學性的內容，如祖父般的導師分享人生教訓。
voices.original_description: Elderly male, late 70s-80s. Deeply weathered gravelly, gentle rhythmic pace. Soft-spoken, authoritative wisdom. Warm conversational, slight rasp. Reflective philosophical, grandfatherly mentor sharing life lessons.

voices.original_description: Female late 20s–early 30s, Irish-accented English. Grounded weary resilient, slight melodic lilt. Mid-range steady pace, calm authority, observant cautious.

voices.description: 一位女性，年齡在50多歲至60多歲之間，使用標準英式口音（British RP）。聲音銳利、簡潔、權威、冰冷、傲慢。具有強烈張力，被冰冷的平靜所掩蓋。以連珠炮般的速度提出問題，卻以緩慢的語氣進行駁回。聲音質地乾淨、清晰且乾燥。
voices.original_description: Mature female, 50s-60s, British RP. Sharp, clipped, authoritative, cold, condescending. High tension masked by icy calm. Rapid-fire questions, slow dismissals. Crisp, dry texture.

voices.description: 女性，40歲出頭至50歲出頭，具有歐洲口音。聲音帶有歷經風霜的權威感，略微沙啞的質地。說話節奏穩定有規律，語氣務實且堅韌。表達直接且不感傷，立足於現實世界。
voices.original_description: Female, mid-40s-50s, European accent. Weathered authoritative, slightly raspy texture. Steady rhythmic pace, pragmatic resilient tone. Direct unsentimental, grounded in physical reality.

voices.description: 年長男性，英國標準英式口音。聲音溫暖，具有學者般的祖父形象，語速溫和且有節奏感。咬字清晰，言辭詳盡，富有同理心、耐心與俏皮古怪的想像力。語氣輕柔但具權威感，帶有專業且客觀的語調。
voices.original_description: Elderly male, British RP accent. Warm scholarly grandfatherly, gentle rhythmic pace. Articulate verbose, empathetic patient whimsical. Soft-spoken authoritative clinical tone.

voices.description: 女性，20歲出頭到30歲出頭，標準英式發音。優雅、言辭清晰、冷靜自信。聲音具有旋律感，清晰、流暢、柔滑。沉著、不動搖、精準，帶有一絲誘惑的諷刺意味。
voices.original_description: Female, mid-20s to early 30s, British RP. Sophisticated, articulate, coolly confident. Melodic, sharp, smooth, velvety. Composed, unflappable, precise, hint of flirtatious irony.

voices.original_description: Elderly male, 70s-80s. Weathered, gravelly, Caribbean lilt. Slow, deliberate, exhausted yet dignified. Low resonance, breathy. Introspective, philosophical, humble reverence.

voices.description: 50多歲至60多歲的男性，濃厚的義大利口音，聲音沙啞且富有共鳴。語速審慎而有節奏感，語氣權威且帶有思考性的停頓。聲音低沉、溫暖、具領導力且充滿熱情。
voices.original_description: Mature male 50s-60s, thick Italian accent, gravelly resonant. Deliberate, rhythmic, authoritative, thoughtful pauses. Low, warm, commanding, passionate.

voices.description: 一位年輕女性，充滿活力且精明幹練。語調帶有明亮的日本風格口音，語氣銳利且具保護性。聲音從清晰到粗礪的權威沙啞不等，語速快節奏，使用隨性的俚語，也能轉為強烈的盤問語氣。

voices.description: 年長男性，精緻的標準英式發音。溫和、氣聲的音質。有節奏感、壓低音量的語調。帶有深刻驚奇與知性權威的語氣。語速審慎，有戲劇性的停頓。語氣溫暖、學者氣息濃厚，並充滿深深的敬意。
voices.original_description: Elderly male, refined British RP. Gentle, breathy texture. Rhythmic, hushed cadence. Profound wonder, intellectual authority. Deliberate pace, dramatic pauses. Warm, scholarly, deeply respectful tone.

voices.description: 一位女性，年齡為青少年晚期到二十歲初期。聲音柔和、富有旋律感，帶有氣聲。語調迷茫、飄忽不定，帶有超現實感。情緒上極度脆弱、易受傷。聲音細膩且充滿好奇心，整體呈現出溫和、夢幻般的質感。發音特徵為中性口音。
voices.original_description: Young adult female, late teens to early 20s. Soft, melodic, breathy. Disoriented, ethereal pace. High emotional vulnerability. Fragile, inquisitive tone. Gentle, dreamlike quality. Neutral accent.

voices.original_description: Masculine, early 30s, British RP accent. Soft, breathy texture. Weary, introspective pace. Somber, rhythmic. Low volume, intimate, deeply melancholic. Poetic resignation, intellectual sensitivity.

voices.description: 男性，30多歲至40多歲。具權威感的男中音，語音為中性口音。聲音平靜、穩定，富有共鳴感。語調節奏穩定，音量低但帶有強烈的張力。聲音流暢、堅定且自信。
voices.original_description: Male, 30s-40s. Authoritative baritone, neutral accent. Calm, steady, resonant. Measured, low-volume intensity. Smooth, firm, confident.

voices.description: 一位男性，年齡在十幾歲後期到二十歲初期之間。自然主義風格，對話式，內省。音高屬於中音區，語速溫和而富有思考性。使用標準美國口音，帶有細微的脆弱感。聲音穩重、誠懇，具有自我反思的情感份量。
voices.original_description: Young adult male, late teens to early twenties. Naturalistic, conversational, introspective. Mid-range pitch, gentle thoughtful pace. Standard American accent, subtle vulnerability. Grounded, sincere. Emotional weight of self-reflection.

voices.description: 女性，40多歲至50多歲，使用德國口音的英語。聲音沙啞、強烈、富有旋律感，帶有高能量的搖滾粗礪感。情感熱烈、溫暖、誠懇，堅強卻謙虛。興奮時語速快速，帶有氣聲，節奏感強。

voices.description: 一位女性，年齡為十幾歲後期到20多歲初期，聲音柔和、內省，略帶氣聲。說話節奏自然，帶有溫和的美國口音。聲音表現出反思、憂鬱與清澈的眼神中的脆弱感，並帶有猶豫的釋然與安靜的堅韌。

voices.description: 男性，中年至高齡，使用帶有法語口音的英語。聲音低沉、沙啞且富有共鳴。語速緩慢而有節奏，並有停頓。表現出耐心、同理心與權威感，聲音中帶有疲憊與敏銳的思維。
voices.original_description: Masculine, middle-aged to senior, French-accented English. Deep, gravelly, resonant. Measured, deliberate pace with pauses. Patient, empathetic, authoritative. Weary, sharp intellect.

voices.description: 女性，年輕成人。音高較高，音色明亮，能量特別充沛。語速明快、清晰，帶有輕快活潑的語調，並具有明顯的旋律感。總是充滿樂觀與熱情，語音清晰且富有表現力。
voices.original_description: Female, young adult. High-pitched, bright, exceptionally energetic. Crisp, fast, bubbly delivery with a melodic lilt. Perpetually optimistic, welcoming, with clear, enthusiastic articulation.

voices.description: 一位女性年輕成人。聲音高亢、精力充沛、明亮，略帶氣聲。說話速度極快，語調突然變化。熱情洋溢、異想天開、心不在焉卻才華橫溢。具備學識上的權威感，同時帶有混亂卻異想天開的魅力。
voices.original_description: Female-presenting young adult. High-pitched, energetic, bright, slightly breathy. Rapid-fire pacing with sudden pitch shifts. Enthusiastic, eccentric, scatterbrained brilliance. Intellectual authority with chaotic whimsical charm.

voices.description: 男性，年齡介於中年至老年。聲音空洞、有回響，節奏緩慢而有規律。令人寒心的平靜，疏離感強。帶有細微的東亞影響，具有催眠與陰森的低頻質感。聲音如幽靈實體般飄渺。

voices.description: 一位女性，年齡為十幾歲後期至20歲出頭。聲音明亮、有活力、有紀律。具有運動員般的呼吸支撐，音色清晰、禮貌且鼓勵人心。語速節奏感強且靈活。聲音從照顧性的溫柔轉為銳利而專注的強度。
voices.original_description: Young adult female, late teens-20s. Bright, energetic, disciplined. High-pitched, athletic breath support. Clear, polite, encouraging tone. Rhythmic, agile pace. Nurturing to sharp, focused intensity.

voices.description: 男性，30多歲中段，沉穩踏實，富有同理心，自然對話，略帶粗礪感，誠懇急迫，標準美國口音，清晰且具有共鳴的音色。

voices.description: 女性，年輕，音高較高。聲音明亮、活潑、充滿能量。具有節奏感與旋律感，帶有興奮的氣聲。語速快，夾雜著笑聲與輕快的語調。宛如一個微小的魔法生物。
voices.original_description: Female, youthful, high-pitched. Bright, bubbly, energetic. Rhythmic, melodic, breathless excitement. Fast, giggles, chirpy. Tiny magical creature.

voices.description: 十幾歲後期到20歲出頭的男性。高男高音，清晰，貴族氣質。語調節奏銳利而有紀律，冰冷但充滿激情。說話快速、咬字清晰，有義正辭嚴的爆發。
voices.original_description: Late teens to early 20s male. High-tenor, crisp, aristocratic. Sharp disciplined cadence, cold but passionate. Fast, articulate, righteous outbursts.

voices.description: 中年到成熟的女性，帶有細微的地中海英語口音。聲音清晰、咬字清楚且富有共鳴，具備學術性的精準。語速審慎而富有思考性，專業卻易於接近。

voices.original_description: Mature female late 60s, warm melodic confident. Mid-Atlantic refined accent. Hospitable, encouraging, rhythmic, slow pace. Smooth breathy, mentor-like.

voices.original_description: Female, late 20s, soft Japanese-inflected delivery. Gentle breathy texture, reflective contemplative pace. Earnest grounded tone, nostalgic melancholy, quiet optimism.

voices.description: 年輕成年女性，標準英式發音（British RP）。聲音明亮且帶有氣聲，誠懇真誠。高能量，表現出睜大眼睛般的驚奇與興奮得氣息急促，帶有戲劇性的低語，語調輕盈旋律，且語氣禮貌。
voices.original_description: Young adult female, British RP. Bright breathy earnest. High-energy, wide-eyed wonder, breathless excitement, dramatic whispers, light melodic polite.

voices.description: 男性，30歲出頭至40歲出頭。具魅力的粗礪男中音，自信且有節奏感的語速。經過打磨的迷人魅力，卻帶有粗糙的邊緣。略帶沙啞，具有權威感，機智犀利，情感強烈。咬字清晰，帶有尖銳的諷刺。
voices.original_description: Masculine, 30s-40s. Charismatic gravelly baritone, confident rhythmic pace. Polished charm with gritty edge. Slight rasp, authoritative, sharp wit, passionate intensity. Articulate with biting sarcasm.

voices.description: 年輕男性，充滿活力，說話節奏快，熱情洋溢。聲音帶有明亮的鼻音共鳴，語調帶有現代美國西岸口音。咬字清晰且富有表現力，經常改變音高，語氣輕快，偶爾使用上揚的氣聲，整體語氣親切自然。
voices.original_description: Young adult male, high-energy, fast-paced, enthusiastic. Bright nasal resonance, modern American West Coast inflection. Crisp, expressive articulation with frequent pitch shifts, upbeat vocal fry, friendly conversational tone.

voices.description: 男性，60多歲後段，聲音乾澀且沙啞。使用中大西洋口音，咬字清晰，語速審慎而有節制。觀察力強，略帶疲憊與內省的特質。語速節奏穩定，有思考性的停頓，聲音安靜而具權威性的文學氣質。
voices.original_description: Masculine, late 60s, dry gravelly texture. Mid-Atlantic accent, articulate, deliberate. Observant, slightly weary, introspective. Measured pacing with thoughtful pauses, quiet authoritative literary presence.

voices.description: 中年至老年男性，聲音溫暖沙啞，語速中等，語氣耐心且鼓勵人心，帶有歷經風霜的學者口音，整體語氣平靜穩定。
voices.original_description: Middle-aged to elderly male, warm gravelly, mid-tempo, patient, encouraging, weathered academic accent, calm, steady.

voices.description: 年長男性，聲音單薄細弱，高音的喘鳴聲帶著脆弱易碎的質感，語速緩慢且有節奏性的停頓，語調從懷舊悲傷轉為可憐哀求，帶著認命的緊繃感，展現出被遺棄的父系家長形象。
voices.original_description: Elderly male, frail thin texture, high-pitched wheezing brittle, slow rhythmic pace with pauses, nostalgic melancholic tone shifting to pathetic pleading, resigned tension, discarded patriarch archetype.

voices.description: 年長男性，使用斯堪的納維亞口音的英語。溫和、學者氣質、沉思。高音歷經風霜的音質。緩慢審慎的語速，善良謙遜誠懇的語氣。
voices.original_description: Elderly male, Scandinavian-accented English. Gentle, scholarly, contemplative. High weathered texture. Slow deliberate pace, kind humble earnestness.

voices.description: 男性，20歲出頭，充滿活力，熱情洋溢。使用清晰的美國英語。聲音親切、英雄氣息、具教育性。表達直接、積極、互動性強。聲音流暢、富有共鳴、音色明亮。
voices.original_description: Masculine, early 20s, high-energy, enthusiastic. Clear American English. Friendly, heroic, educational. Direct, upbeat, interactive. Smooth, resonant, bright.

voices.description: 一位20歲出頭的女性，美國人。聲音明亮、清晰，略帶氣聲，音高屬於中段。誠懇而情緒充沛，語速穩定，但在對峙時會加快。具備大學學生的典型聲音特徵。
voices.original_description: Young adult female, early 20s, American. Bright, clear, slightly breathy, mid-pitch. Earnest, emotionally charged, steady pace quickening in confrontation. Collegiate archetype.

voices.description: 男性長者，具有地中海口音。學者氣質，權威而沉思。語速中慢，聲音歷經風霜但富有共鳴。教學風格，平靜而莊重。
voices.original_description: Elder male, Mediterranean accent. Scholarly, authoritative, contemplative. Mid-slow pace, weathered but resonant. Pedagogical, calm gravity.

voices.description: 年長的南亞男性，聲音具有高音、單薄尖細的簧管般質地。語速平靜且有節奏感，爆破音柔和。聲音充滿深切的悲憫與寧靜，並帶有低調的哲學權威感。
voices.original_description: Elderly South Asian male, high thin reedy texture. Calm rhythmic pace, soft plosives. Deeply compassionate, serene, with quiet philosophical authority.

voices.description: 男性，中年至老年。聲音細瘦、沙啞、乾澀。語速中等，有節奏感，帶有神秘的停頓。聲音帶有狡黠與超凡脫俗的感覺，發音帶有英式英語口音。
voices.original_description: Masculine, middle-aged to elderly. Thin, raspy, dry texture. Mid-tempo, rhythmic, cryptic pauses. Mischievous, otherworldly, English accent.

voices.description: 成熟男性，具備富有共鳴的低沉男中音。語速穩定、節奏從容。帶有哲學性與權威感。語調中帶有細微的南亞語調。表現出包容、好奇與平靜的智慧。
voices.original_description: Mature male, commanding resonant baritone. Steady, measured. Philosophical, authoritative. Subtle South Asian lilt. Inclusive, inquisitive, calm wisdom.

voices.description: 女性，中年，溫暖，母性。標準英式發音（British RP）。聲音清晰度高，有節奏感，令人感到鼓勵。聲音流暢且明亮。具有教學性與遊戲般的語氣，像是老師或圖書館員的聲音。
voices.original_description: Female, middle-aged, warm, maternal. British RP. High clarity, rhythmic, encouraging. Smooth, bright. Instructional, playful, like a teacher or librarian.

voices.description: 女性成熟溫暖的聲音，具有豐富的共鳴與權威感。語音音高適中，節奏穩定而有規律。聲音中帶著大師級工匠的自信，語氣鼓勵且嚴肅，略帶旋律感的語調，展現古老的智慧。
voices.original_description: Feminine mature, warm resonant authoritative. Mid-pitch steady rhythmic pace. Master artisan confidence, encouraging demanding tone, slight melodic lilt, ancient wisdom.

voices.description: 女性，30多歲中段，專業學術人員。語速中等，咬字清晰，語調節奏穩重，帶有柔和的西班牙語語調。聲音沉穩、具權威感，並帶有急切的關懷。發音清晰，呼吸自然，語氣中帶有學術份量。
voices.original_description: Feminine, mid-30s, professional academic. Mid-tempo, articulate, measured, soft Spanish lilt. Grounded, authoritative, urgent concern. Clear diction, naturalistic breathing, intellectual weight.

voices.description: 女性，成人，中音區溫暖的沙啞聲質，帶有旋律感。語調輕柔，具有南美洲口音，語句節奏流暢且富有韻律。聲音表達充滿深刻的同理心與鼓勵感，表現出沉穩而具國際視野的倡議者形象。
voices.original_description: Female, adult, mid-range warm rasp, melodic lilt. Soft South American accent, fluid rhythmic phrasing. Deeply empathetic encouraging, poised global advocate.

voices.description: 年長男性，南美洲口音。輕聲說話，節奏感強，富有哲理。溫和而粗礪的語質，充滿深刻智慧。審慎而緩慢的語速，溫暖、知性、理想主義。具有遠見與創意的信念。
voices.original_description: Elderly male, South American accent. Soft-spoken, rhythmic, philosophical. Gentle, gravelly texture, deep wisdom. Deliberate slow pace, warm, intellectual, idealistic. Visionary, creative conviction.

voices.description: 女性，十幾歲後期，柔和的氣聲略帶疲憊的質感。聰明、表達清楚、帶有冷幽默。中速語速，有思索的停頓。踏實、不感傷、哲學性，帶有少女的犬儒與世故冷嘲。自然的美國口音。
voices.original_description: Female, late teens, soft breathy slightly weary texture. Intelligent, articulate, dryly witty. Mid-tempo with thoughtful pauses. Grounded, unsentimental, philosophical, teenage cynicism. Naturalistic American accent.

voices.description: 年輕男性，年齡在十幾歲後期至20歲出頭。英格蘭北部工人階級口音。高能量、語速快、帶有神經緊張與浮躁不定的語調。聲音明亮但顯得吃力。從平凡到宏大誇張的戲劇性表現。氣息急促、富有想像力且容易分心。
voices.original_description: Young adult male, late teens to early 20s. Northern English working-class. High-energy, rapid-fire, nervous flighty edge. Bright but strained. Mundane to grandiose theatrical. Breathless, imaginative, distracted.

voices.description: 女性，30多歲至40多歲，聲音柔和且帶有氣聲，語調節奏為新英格蘭風格。聲音親密、沉思、安詳，有節奏的停頓，聲音質地輕盈。表現出平靜的接受感與學者般的精準。
voices.original_description: Feminine, 30s-40s, soft breathy New England cadence. Intimate, contemplative, serene. Rhythmic pauses, airy texture. Calm acceptance, scholarly precision.

voices.description: 男性，年輕成人，聲音具有共鳴的空洞聲質。語速平靜且有節奏，語調智慧且預言般，帶有細微的中美洲影響。聲音具備好奇的古老權威，擁有高情感智商。
voices.original_description: Male, young adult, resonant hollow texture. Calm measured pace, wise prophetic tone, subtle Central American influence. Curious ancient authority, high emotional intelligence.

voices.description: 年輕男性，聲音平靜、低調且漫不經心。言語簡潔、事實性強。略帶氣聲，語速屬於日常對話節奏。
voices.original_description: Young adult male, calm understated nonchalant. Minimalist matter-of-fact speech. Slight breathy texture, conversational pace.

voices.description: 女性，年輕成人，使用蘇格蘭英語的語調。聲音柔和且帶有氣聲，呈現憂傷的感覺。語速緩慢且審慎，表達沉重的悲傷與遲來的覺悟。聲音親密如告解般，帶有脆弱的緊張感與安靜的悲劇性妥協。
voices.original_description: Female, young adult, Scottish-English lilt. Soft breathy melancholic. Slow deliberate, heavy grief, late-blooming realization. Intimate confessional, fragile tension, quiet tragic resignation.

voices.description: 女性，30歲出頭到40歲出頭。專業、清晰、具權威性的廣播語調，語彙表達準確。使用中性北美口音。聲音清晰、打磨過、富有共鳴。語速穩定且有節奏感。自信且具學術好奇心。
voices.original_description: Feminine, mid-30s to early 40s. Professional, articulate, authoritative broadcast delivery. Neutral North American accent. Clear, polished, resonant. Steady, rhythmic pace. Confident, intellectually curious.

voices.description: 女性，十幾歲後期，澳洲口音。聲音清晰、帶有氣聲，誠懇真誠。對話風格，充滿熱情。語速穩定，語氣安靜而自信。聲音溫暖、鼓勵人心，是一個腳踏實地的冒險者。
voices.original_description: Female, late teens, Australian accent. Clear, breathy, earnest. Conversational, passionate. Steady pace, quiet confidence. Warm, encouraging, grounded adventurer.

voices.description: 成熟男性成人聲音。深沉、共鳴、粗礪的音質。帶有淡淡的蘇格蘭口音。聲音表現出疲憊、憂鬱、高尚與尊嚴，並具有節奏感。語速緩慢，呼吸吃力。帶有古老而默默承受痛苦的感覺。
voices.original_description: Masculine, mature adult. Deep, resonant, gravelly texture. Subtle Scottish lilt. Weary, melancholic, noble, rhythmic cadence. Slow-paced, labored breathing. Ancient, quiet suffering.

voices.description: 年輕男性，明亮誠懇的男高音。說話快速且富有知識性；語氣溫和有禮。情緒表達清晰，聲音真誠自然。
voices.original_description: Young adult male, bright earnest tenor. Rapid, intellectual pace; gentle, polite texture. High emotional clarity, wholesome sincerity.

voices.description: 男性，年齡為年輕成人至中年，具有卡斯提爾西班牙語口音。聲音為沉穩、接地氣的男中音，帶有粗糙與風霜的質感。語調節奏感強，表達誠懇真摯。聲音在親密的低語與富有共鳴、鼓舞人心的力量之間切換。
voices.original_description: Masculine, young adult to middle-aged, Castilian Spanish accent. Grounded, earthy baritone, gritty and weathered. Rhythmic, earnest delivery. Shifts between intimate whispers and resonant, rallying strength.

voices.description: 成熟女性，40多歲至50多歲，東岸／中大西洋口音。聲音銳利、有節奏感、不煽情。略帶乾澀、歷練豐富的權威沙啞聲質。語速快、有力、急迫、懷疑、直接。
voices.original_description: Mature female, 40s-50s, East Coast/Mid-Atlantic accent. Sharp, rhythmic, unsentimental. Slightly dry, seasoned authoritative rasp. Fast-paced, punchy, urgent, skeptical, direct.

voices.description: 男性，年齡在50多歲後期至60多歲。聲音低沉沙啞，帶有風霜歷練的男中音。語氣中帶有犬儒與不服輸的邊緣。說話方式審慎且疲憊，語速緩慢且帶有氣聲的吃力感。聲音低沉、沙啞且粗糙。語速犀利且具權威感。
voices.original_description: Masculine, late 50s-60s. Gravelly, weather-beaten baritone. Cynical, defiant edge. Deliberate, weary speech with breathy strain. Low-pitched, raspy texture. Sharp, authoritative pace.

voices.description: 男性，中年至年長，使用印度英語口音。聲音溫暖、學者氣息濃厚、樂觀積極。語氣溫和卻具權威感，敘述節奏有規律，聲音質地柔和。充滿感染力的熱情，有深思的停頓，表現出發現新事物時的驚奇與好奇。
voices.original_description: Masculine, middle-aged to senior, Indian-English accent. Warm, scholarly, optimistic. Gentle yet authoritative, rhythmic storytelling pace, soft texture. Infectious enthusiasm, thoughtful pauses, wonder of discovery.

voices.description: 這是一個偏男性化的聲音，具有多樣化的音域，屬於成熟成年人的聲音。語調節奏帶有風格化的古典舞臺特色，能從富有共鳴的喉音權威感轉換到細膩的旋律感頭腔音。咬字精準，有戲劇性的停頓與豐富的顫音。聲音表現具有跨性別的特質。
voices.original_description: Masculine-leaning, versatile range, mature adult. Stylized classical stage cadence. Shifts from resonant guttural authority to delicate melodic head tones. Precise articulation, dramatic pauses, rich vibrato. Gender-fluid expression.

voices.description: 女性，30多歲，使用印度口音的英語。聲音精準、流暢、清晰且具權威感。語調節奏感強，語速審慎而有控制，整體平靜且富有學識。情緒表達較少，專注於邏輯性。
voices.original_description: Feminine, 30s, Indian-accented English. Precise, smooth, crisp, authoritative. Rhythmic, deliberate, calm, intellectual. Minimal emotion, focuses on logic.

voices.description: 年輕男性。情緒高度緊張，語速急促且有節奏感。聲音沙啞且緊繃。從壓低的親密耳語轉變為爆發性的絕望喊叫。使用郊外地區的口音，語氣隨意但強烈。精神狀態逐漸惡化。
voices.original_description: Young adult male. High emotional tension, frantic rhythmic pace. Raspy, strained texture. Shifts from hushed intimate whispers to explosive desperate outbursts. Suburban dialect, casual but intense. Deteriorating mental state.

voices.description: 一位女性，年齡在50多歲至60多歲之間，擁有卡斯提爾西班牙語口音。聲音柔和、帶有氣聲，並具權威感。語速審慎而富有沉思感。聲音溫暖、母性、極其平靜安詳。語句詩意、比喻豐富，並帶有溫柔而強烈的表達方式。
voices.original_description: Mature female, 50s-60s, Castilian Spanish accent. Soft, breathy, authoritative texture. Deliberate, contemplative pacing. Warm, maternal, profoundly serene. Poetic, metaphorical, gentle intensity.

voices.description: 年輕女性，美國口音。聲音清晰、輕盈，帶有氣聲的熱情。語氣隨性、有節奏感且富有表現力；充滿活力卻又深思熟慮，帶有幻想與踏實的特質。
voices.original_description: Young adult female, American accent. Clear, light, breathy enthusiasm. Casual, rhythmic, expressive; energetic yet thoughtful, whimsical and grounded.

voices.description: 30多歲的女性聲音，具備流暢且威嚴的女低音，語氣平靜務實，帶有微妙的空靈共鳴，語速穩定審慎，表現出冷靜疏離卻樂於助人的態度。
voices.original_description: Mid-30s feminine smooth authoritative alto, calm pragmatic delivery, subtle ethereal resonance, measured pace, cool detached helpfulness.

voices.description: 年輕成年女性，使用標準英式發音（British RP）。聲音清晰，但帶有潛藏的粗礪與緊張感。情緒急迫而脆弱，從剋制從容轉變為毫無修飾的強烈情緒。音域處於中音區，語速犀利且果斷。
voices.original_description: Young adult female, British RP accent. Clear with underlying grit and tension. Urgent vulnerable, controlled poise to raw intensity. Mid-range, sharp decisive pace.

voices.description: 年輕成年偏女性化的男性。高音、氣聲、情緒不穩定。快速的美國南方語調，帶有尖銳的聲門塞音。原始未修飾的聲音，具有防禦感，從慌亂轉為疲憊。
voices.original_description: Young adult, feminine-leaning male. High-pitched, breathy, emotionally volatile. Rapid Southern lilt, sharp glottal stops. Raw, defensive, frantic to weary.

voices.description: 年輕女性青少年，聲音帶有明亮的鼻音，說話速度很快，使用美國郊區口音。充滿活力，誠懇、笨拙、脆弱、堅強且樂觀。
voices.original_description: Young female teen, bright nasal tone, fast suburban American speech. High energy, earnest, awkward, vulnerable, resilient, and optimistic.

voices.description: 男性，十幾歲後期。聲音柔和、猶豫、內省。音高處於中段，帶有氣聲，質地脆弱。說話節奏自然，對話式，有反思性的停頓。聲音中帶著輕微的焦慮，但逐漸浮現希望。是一位敏感的學生。
voices.original_description: Male, late teens. Soft, hesitant, introspective. Mid-range pitch, breathy, vulnerable texture. Naturalistic, conversational pace with reflective pauses. Quiet anxiety, emerging hope. Sensitive student.

voices.description: 男性，中年，聲音沙啞的男中音，帶有濃厚的歐洲口音。語調強烈且具權威感，語句富有節奏感且有力，聲音帶有氣聲與緊繃的質感。語速審慎而有控制，從耳語到爆發式的命令。
voices.original_description: Masculine, middle-aged, gravelly baritone, thick European accent. High-intensity, authoritative. Rhythmic punchy phrasing, breathy strained texture. Deliberate pace, hushed whispers to explosive commands.

voices.description: 中年男性，精緻的日本口音。聲音流暢，帶有古怪的特質，有急促銳利的吸氣聲。語調有節奏感且審慎。從輕聲的敬畏轉為犀利的權威。
voices.original_description: Middle-aged male, refined Japanese accent. Smooth, eccentric, sharp intakes of breath. Rhythmic, deliberate. Hushed reverence to sharp authority.

voices.description: 中年男性，沙啞的男中音，帶有風霜歲月的泥土質感。使用英格蘭北部／約克郡口音。語速緩慢且審慎，帶有沉重而堅定的權威感，表現出毫不動搖的真誠與誠懇。
voices.original_description: Middle-aged male, gravelly baritone, weathered earthy. Northern English/Yorkshire accent. Slow deliberate, somber stoic authority, unwavering sincerity.

voices.description: 年長的男性聲音，深沉且富有共鳴的男中音，沙啞粗糙。說話節奏緩慢且審慎，帶有正式的貴族口音。聲音令人感到威嚴卻又親切，散發出古老機構權力的氣息。
voices.original_description: Elderly masculine, deep resonant baritone, weathered gravelly. Slow deliberate rhythmic pace, formal aristocratic accent. Intimidating yet welcoming, ancient institutional power.

voices.description: 男性，50多歲至60多歲，使用德國口音的英語。語音精準、具權威性且富有遠見。講述風格節奏分明，聲音清晰並帶有輕微的沙啞感，展現出大師級學者的堅定信念。
voices.original_description: Masculine, 50s-60s, German-accented English. Precise, authoritative, visionary. Rhythmic lecture style, clear with slight rasp. Conviction of a master scholar.

voices.description: 中年至高齡男性，澳洲口音。聲音平靜、節制、富有學識。咬字清晰、具有教學風格、溫和而堅定的信念。聲音流暢、學者氣息、富有同理心。
voices.original_description: Middle-aged to senior male, Australian accent. Calm, measured, intellectual. Articulate, pedagogical, gentle firm conviction. Smooth, scholarly, empathetic.

voices.description: 男性，成人，中東口音。謙虛、腳踏實地、粗礪、誠懇。語速中等，謹慎但誠摯。聲音溫暖，具有共鳴的胸腔音，語氣壓低，帶有密談般的緊急感。
voices.original_description: Masculine, adult, Middle Eastern accent. Humble, grounded, gritty, sincere. Mid-tempo, cautious but earnest. Warm, resonant chest tones, hushed conspiratorial urgency.

voices.description: 中年男性，聲音偏陽剛。專業、中性且具權威感。聲音流暢且富有共鳴。語速中等，節奏分明，咬字清晰。表現為冷靜的引導者，情緒穩定。
voices.original_description: Middle-aged human, masculine-leaning. Professional, neutral, authoritative. Smooth, resonant texture. Mid-tempo, rhythmic, clear articulation. Detached facilitator, high composure.

voices.description: 男性，紐約外區口音。聲音帶有沙啞與氣聲的權威鼻音質感。自信，常有停頓，語氣強調明顯。說話節奏慢條斯理，帶有對話的節奏感。
voices.original_description: Senior male, New York outer-borough accent. Raspy breathy authoritative nasal texture. Confident, frequent pauses, emphatic stress. Deliberate conversational pace.

voices.description: 女性，30多歲，使用非裔美國人語彙。聲音充滿活力，節奏感強，機智犀利。略帶沙啞，自信堅定，不拖泥帶水。語速快，音高變化動態。聲音踏實，具有強烈的保護欲，並帶有靈魂深處的溫暖。
voices.original_description: Feminine, mid-30s, African-American vernacular. High-energy, rhythmic, sharp-witted. Slight rasp, confident, no-nonsense. Fast-paced, dynamic pitch shifts. Grounded, fiercely protective, soulful warmth.

voices.description: 男性，低沉如絲絨般的男中音，聲音冰冷，帶有氣聲，堅忍無動於衷，極簡。語速緩慢，審慎而有控制，帶有古老而深沉的疲憊感，致命而略帶淡淡的憂傷。
voices.original_description: Adult male, deep velvety baritone, cold, breathy, stoic, minimalist. Slow, deliberate, ancient weariness, lethal, faint melancholy.

voices.description: 男性，中年。聲音高亢、緊繃且帶有鼻音。說話時會口吃，音量時而突然提高，語句中夾雜不自然的停頓。語速表現出誠懇卻笨拙的節奏，語氣認真卻顯得困惑。帶有不恰當的自信與社交焦慮。
voices.original_description: Masculine, middle-aged. High-pitched, strained, nasal. Stammers, volume spikes, awkward pauses. Earnest, confused, clumsy pace. Misplaced confidence, social anxiety.

voices.description: 中年男性，帶有友好的澳洲口音。聲音溫暖且富有共鳴，屬於自然的對話語調。講述故事時充滿熱情，語速活潑，聲音清晰健康，並帶有鼓舞性的高能量表達。
voices.original_description: Middle-aged male, friendly Australian accent. Warm resonant conversational tone. Enthusiastic storytelling pace, clear healthy texture, motivational high-energy delivery.

voices.description: 男性中年聲音，乾澀粗糙且顯疲憊，音高較低，語氣冷淡帶有諷刺，語速中等，表現出無聊卻自信的語調，具有犀利的幽默節奏。
voices.original_description: Masculine middle-aged, dry gravelly weary, low pitch, deadpan sardonic, mid-tempo, bored confidence, sharp comedic timing.

voices.description: 年輕女性，南亞口音，音高適中。聲音帶有氣聲與粗糙質感，語速快速。表達中帶著銳利的懷疑，情感張力混合了生存主義的堅韌與脆弱的創傷。
voices.original_description: Young adult female, South Asian accent, mid pitch. Breathful, gritty, rapid delivery. Sharp skepticism, emotional tension merging survivalist grit with vulnerable trauma.

voices.description: 年輕男性，帶有牙買加口音。聲音流暢、富有共鳴，充滿活力、魅力、自信且放鬆。語速適中，帶有感染力的溫暖與權威感。
voices.original_description: Young adult male, Jamaican accent. Smooth, resonant, energetic, charismatic, confident, relaxed. Moderate pace, infectious warmth, authority.

voices.description: 男性十幾歲後期，聲音年輕且明亮中音區。聲音質地乾淨真誠，風格現代、對話式且富有同理心。語速充滿活力且思慮周全，語音清晰具都市感。
voices.original_description: Masculine late teens, youthful bright mid-range. Clean sincere texture, modern conversational empathetic style. Energetic thoughtful pacing with urban clarity.

voices.description: 一位男性中年日本語發音者。語氣平靜、低調、謙虛，帶有冷靜的節奏感。說話輕柔但具權威感，語句簡潔，思考時會有停頓。聲音穩重專業，充滿熱情與工藝感，表現出放鬆而自信的語氣。
voices.original_description: Masculine, middle-aged Japanese speaker. Calm understated humble, cool rhythmic. Soft-spoken authoritative, minimalist thoughtful pauses. Grounded professional, passionate craftsmanship, relaxed confidence.

voices.description: 一位女性，年齡在40多歲至50多歲之間，擁有標準英式發音。聲音具備知識分子的特質，清晰、有條理且具權威感。語速審慎而有節奏，語氣帶有好奇心，略帶批判性，並具學者般的莊嚴氣質。
voices.original_description: Mature female, 40s-50s, British RP. Intellectual, articulate, crisp, authoritative. Deliberate, rhythmic pace. Inquisitive, slightly critical, scholarly gravitas.

voices.description: 成熟女性，聲音具有神秘而超凡的質感，帶有氣聲且斷續的吸氣聲。語調節奏緩慢而哀傷，發出啜泣般的嚎叫。表現出深刻的悲傷與絕望。
voices.original_description: Mature female, haunting ethereal texture, breathy ragged inhalations. Slow mournful pacing, sobbing wails. Profound grief, supernatural despair.

voices.description: 中年男性，英國-黎凡特口音。溫暖優雅的知識分子。節奏感強且熱情的表達方式，咬字清晰。聲音溫和且具吸引力，語調節奏如教師般細膩且富有思考性。
voices.original_description: Middle-aged male, British-Levantine accent. Warm sophisticated intellectual. Rhythmic enthusiastic delivery, clear articulation. Gentle inviting texture, thoughtful teacher cadence.

voices.description: 成熟男性，使用英式英語。聲音質地柔和且歷經風霜。語氣低語、親密、帶著疲憊的智慧。語速緩慢且富有沉思節奏。情緒憂鬱卻溫和，展現來之不易的平靜。
voices.original_description: Mature male, British English. Soft, weathered texture. Hushed, intimate, weary wisdom. Slow, contemplative pace. Melancholic yet gentle, hard-won peace.

voices.description: 一位女性，成熟的大人，使用西非口音的英語。聲音溫暖，富有共鳴，讓人感到安定。語速審慎而有節奏感。具備深沉的母性權威與平靜，聲音中帶著豐富的撫育溫暖與柔和的旋律感，並蘊含古老的智慧。
voices.original_description: Feminine, mature adult, West African-accented English. Warm, resonant, grounding. Deliberate, rhythmic pace. Deep maternal authority, serenity. Rich nurturing warmth, gentle melodic lilt, ancient wisdom.

voices.description: 女性，年輕成人，標準英式發音（British RP）。聲音清晰，咬字清楚，語速極快。聲音質地乾脆明亮，帶有知識分子的權威感。自信、學術嚴謹、急躁。語調節奏精準，重點音節強調。
voices.original_description: Female, young adult, British RP. High-clarity, articulate, rapid-fire. Crisp bright texture, intellectual authoritative edge. Confident, academic rigor, impatient. Rhythmic precision, key syllable emphasis.

voices.description: 女性，十幾歲後期到20歲出頭。聲音高亢、帶有氣聲、語氣輕柔，有緊張的口吃。隨後轉為高能量、有節奏的自信語調。聲音帶有年輕感，略帶鼻音質感，語速快且充滿急躁的精力。
voices.original_description: Female, late teens to early 20s. High-pitched, breathy, soft-spoken, nervous stutter. Shifts to high-energy, rhythmic confidence. Youthful, slightly nasal texture. Fast-paced, frantic energy.

voices.description: 男性，年長，帶有愛爾蘭口音。聲音粗糙沙啞，語速中等至緩慢，節奏感強，富有詩意。表現出沉思、堅韌、憂鬱與冷幽默的特質。情緒智商高，語氣溫暖。
voices.original_description: Masculine, elderly, Irish-accented. Weathered, gravelly. Mid-to-slow pace, rhythmic, lyrical. Reflective, resilient, melancholy, dry wit. High emotional intelligence, warmth.

voices.description: 一位男性，年齡為十幾歲後期到二十歲初期。嚴肅、自律、堅毅。音高屬於中段，語速穩定且審慎。發音帶有氣聲，表現專注與內在平靜，英語中帶有細微的日本口音。
voices.original_description: Young adult male, late teens to early twenties. Serious, disciplined, stoic. Mid-range pitch, steady deliberate pace. Focused breathy delivery, inner calm, subtle Japanese-inflected English.

voices.description: 男性，十幾歲後期。冷靜、分析性，高音域年輕清晰。語速審慎節律，帶有憂鬱與疲憊，並以知性的精準使語氣更銳利。情緒表達極為簡約。
voices.original_description: Masculine, late teens. Calm, analytical, high-register youthful clarity. Measured, rhythmic pace, melancholic and weary, sharpening with intellectual precision. Minimalist emotion.

voices.description: 一位年輕女性，聲音柔和、帶有氣聲，並帶有憂鬱的情感。語氣溫柔、內斂，語速審慎而有節制。聲音中透露出脆弱，但同時也展現出逐漸成長的力量。咬字精準，語調中帶著細微的驚奇與感動。
voices.original_description: Young adult female, soft, breathy, melancholic. Gentle, reserved, measured pace. Fragility with emerging strength. Precise articulation, subtle wonder.

voices.description: 男性，30多歲中期，優雅的標準英式發音。絲絨般流暢的男中音，沉穩從容卻隱藏著掠食者氣息。語速審慎，帶有諷刺的幽默感，服從卻又隱含細微的主導性。擁有古老智慧，表現出毫不費力的專業能力。
voices.original_description: Male, mid-30s, refined British RP. Velvet-smooth baritone, poised and calm with a predatory undercurrent. Measured pace, sardonic wit, subservient yet subtly dominant. Ancient intelligence, effortless competence.

voices.description: 一位女性，40多歲中段，美國人，音高為中音區，聲音穩定、扎實且鼓舞人心，溫暖但有紀律，語速審慎而有控制，如同一位經驗豐富的導師。
voices.original_description: Female mid-40s, American, mid-range, steady, grounded and inspiring, warm but disciplined, measured pace of a seasoned mentor.

voices.description: 年長男性，帶有日本口音，語氣平靜、節制、有紀律，聲音乾澀且沙啞，語速緩慢且有條不紊，語氣謙遜而具權威感，整體呈現極簡而莊嚴的氣質。
voices.original_description: Elderly male Japanese accent, calm measured disciplined, dry raspy texture, slow deliberate pace, humble authoritative, minimalist gravitas.

voices.description: 女性，30多歲中段，使用非裔美國人口音。聲音溫暖、穩定且富有靈魂感。語氣柔和而堅韌，帶有節奏感的南方語調。
voices.original_description: Feminine mid-30s, African-American dialect. Warm grounded soulful texture. Gentle resilient delivery, rhythmic Southern cadence.

voices.description: 一位年長女性，帶有法語口音，聲音沙啞且有歲月痕跡，具備親密的質感，語速審慎而富有沉思感，語氣深具哲學性，同時展現母性與威嚴的語調。
voices.original_description: Elderly female French-accented, raspy weathered intimate texture, deliberate contemplative pace, deeply philosophical maternal yet formidable tone.

voices.description: 男性，30多歲至40多歲。聲音溫暖，富有共鳴的男中音，帶有民謠歌手的語調。思緒深沉、懷舊、疲憊。節奏感強的敘事風格。使用中大西洋口音，聲音帶有柔和的氣聲質感。誠懇而詩意的表現風格。
voices.original_description: Masculine, mid-30s-40s. Warm, resonant baritone, folk-singer lilt. Thoughtful, nostalgic, weary. Rhythmic storytelling. Mid-Atlantic accent, soft breathy texture. Earnest, poetic.

voices.description: 男性，年齡為70多歲至80多歲。語氣正式、穩重且富有同情心。聲音柔和、語氣溫和且有節奏感。具有高聲譽的東亞口音。語速審慎而有控制，表現出謙遜、權威與深思熟慮的特質。
voices.original_description: Elderly male, 70s-80s. Formal, measured, compassionate. Soft-spoken, gentle, rhythmic. High-prestige East Asian accent. Humble, authoritative, deliberate.

voices.description: 女性，年輕成人，美國口音。聲音扎實、謙虛、帶有氣聲，音高處於中段。聲音清晰、有節奏感，帶著安靜的自信。專注、專業、謙虛。
voices.original_description: Female, young adult, American. Grounded, humble, breathy, mid-range. Clear, rhythmic, quiet confidence. Focused, professional, modest.

voices.description: 年長女性，80多歲至90多歲，紐約口音。聲音粗礪乾澀，節奏明快，語氣犀利、機智、直接。聲音明快活潑，帶有調皮的沙啞權威感。
voices.original_description: Elderly female, 80s–90s, New York accent. Gravelly, dry, rhythmic, sharp, witty, direct. Brisk, vibrant, playful raspy authority.

voices.description: 一位男性，聲音規模龐大。低沉且富有共鳴的低音，沙啞而地底般的質感。語速緩慢且審慎，帶有貴族氣質。令人恐懼的強大力量，嘶嘶作響，具捕食者般的智慧。
voices.original_description: Ancient male, massive scale. Deep, resonant bass, gravelly, subterranean. Slow, deliberate, aristocratic. Terrifying power, sibilant, predatory intelligence.

voices.description: 成熟女性，歷經風霜的次女高音。聲音沙啞且帶有氣聲質地。說話速度緩慢而脆弱，情緒有明顯的高峰；口音逐漸淡去，呈現精緻的語調特徵，整體帶有悲劇性的憂鬱感。
voices.original_description: Mature female, weathered mezzo-soprano. Raspy, breathy texture. Slow, fragile delivery with emotional peaks; refined fading accent, tragic melancholy.

voices.description: 一位女性，年齡在50多歲至60多歲之間。具有歐洲口音，聲音富有旋律感。聲音成熟、優雅，具備教養與撫育他人的特質。音高位於中音區，聲音流暢、圓潤且經過打磨。語速審慎而有控制，具說服力且富有遠見。
voices.original_description: Mature female, 50s-60s. European accent, melodic. Sophisticated, nurturing. Mid-range, smooth, polished. Deliberate, persuasive, visionary.

voices.description: 女性，30多歲中段，具有精緻的標準英式發音。語氣柔和、帶有氣聲，優雅而脆弱。語速審慎、從容、溫和，具有旋律感的語調節奏。聲音流暢清晰，帶著安靜的尊嚴。
voices.original_description: Feminine, mid-30s, refined British RP. Soft-spoken, breathy, elegant, vulnerable. Measured, poised, gentle, melodic cadence. Smooth, clear texture, quiet dignity.

voices.description: 男性，成熟成年人。聲音富有共鳴，胸腔音渾厚有力。語氣具有權威性與儀式感。語速節奏分明，審慎而有控制，聲音質地粗糙沙啞。情緒強烈，充滿神聖自信。口音古老且扎實穩重。
voices.original_description: Masculine, mature adult. Resonant, booming chest tone. Authoritative, ritualistic delivery. Rhythmic, deliberate pace with crackling, gravelly texture. High emotional intensity, divine confidence. Ancient, grounded accent.

voices.description: 男性，中年，優雅的英式標準發音。聲音富有共鳴，具權威感與哀傷的溫暖。語速審慎而有節奏感。聲音流暢且帶有乾爽的成熟質感。學者般的莊嚴與情感深度。
voices.original_description: Masculine, middle-aged, refined British RP. Resonant, authoritative, mournful warmth. Deliberate, rhythmic pace. Smooth, dryly-aged texture. Scholarly gravity, emotional depth.

voices.description: 年輕女性，聲音明亮、樂觀。音高屬於中高音，聲音清晰、陽光明媚。充滿活力，節奏感強。聲音溫暖、親切，帶有冒險的堅韌感。語氣具教學性，隨和、友好。
voices.original_description: Young adult female, bright, optimistic. Mid-to-high pitch, clear, sun-drenched. Energetic, rhythmic. Warm, welcoming, adventurous grit. Instructional, informal, friendly.

voices.description: 女性，十幾歲後期。充滿活力、運動感、有魅力。聲音清晰、明亮、帶有氣聲，有溫暖共鳴。語速輕快且自信。語氣親暱、真誠、鼓勵。具有自然的魅力與樂觀的抑揚感。
voices.original_description: Female, late teens. Energetic, athletic, charismatic. Clear, bright, breathy, warm resonance. Brisk, confident pace. Affectionate, sincere, encouraging. Natural charm, optimistic lilt.

voices.description: 中年男性，具權威感的男中音，帶有濃厚的地中海口音與腔調特徵。語調節奏斷續，動態強烈且富有爆發力，表演風格戲劇化且誇張。
voices.original_description: Middle-aged male, authoritative baritone, thick Mediterranean accent. Staccato delivery, explosive dynamics, theatrical bombastic performance.

voices.description: 男性中年聲音，帶有東歐口音，聲音低沉粗糙且帶鼻音，從戲劇性的威脅低吼到柔和笨拙的溫暖，動態範圍高，語速快且有節奏感，元音發音誇張。
voices.original_description: Masculine middle-aged, Eastern European accent, deep gravelly nasal, theatrical menacing growl to soft clumsy warmth, high dynamic range, fast rhythmic with exaggerated vowels.

voices.description: 一位20多歲中段的男性，聲音具備明亮的旋律感與節奏感。帶有中西部都市口音的輕柔韻律，聲質略帶沙啞的高男高音質地。語速輕快有活力，帶有溫暖親切的個人魅力。
voices.original_description: Young adult male, mid-20s, bright melodic rhythmic style. Midwestern urban lilt, raspy high-tenor texture. Joyful energetic pace, warm approachable charisma.

voices.description: 中年男性，聲音渾厚的男中音，使用精緻的標準英式發音。語氣具有權威感、自誇且自大，但又可靠。聲音具有豐富的胸腔共鳴，語調節奏正式且有規律。
voices.original_description: Middle-aged male, booming baritone, posh British RP. Authoritative, boastful, pompous yet dependable. Resonant chesty texture, formal rhythmic delivery.

voices.description: 高音、偏女性化、年輕的聲音。充滿活力、有節奏感、明亮、活潑。短促的旋律感鳴叫，語速快、樂觀、愛玩。
voices.original_description: High-pitched, feminine-leaning, youthful creature. Energetic, rhythmic, bright, bubbly. Short melodic chirps, fast-paced, optimistic, playful.

voices.description: 女性，成熟。溫暖、穩重、富有共鳴。語調節奏中速、有節奏感、詩意。充滿同情心卻堅定，帶有古老智慧。聲音溫和、具有旋律感，語調輕柔起伏，發音特徵受地中海地區影響。
voices.original_description: Feminine, mature. Warm, grounded, resonant. Mid-tempo, rhythmic, poetic cadence. Compassionate yet firm, ancient wisdom. Gentle, melodic lilt, Mediterranean-inspired accent.

voices.description: 年輕女性，年齡在十幾歲後期至20歲出頭。聲音高音、氣聲、脆弱。語氣遲疑，有急促的吸氣聲和結巴。具有高焦慮與創傷。語速柔和而快速，帶有恐慌。社交退縮，處於緊繃狀態。
voices.original_description: Young adult female, late teens to early 20s. High-pitched, breathy, fragile. Hesitant, sharp intakes, stammers. High anxiety and trauma. Soft, rapid, panicked pace. Socially withdrawn, on edge.

voices.description: 男性，中年至高齡。聲音溫和、謙遜，帶有對話般的自然語氣，並具有一種輕柔空靈的聲質。語調節奏規律且富有思考性，語速審慎而有控制。聲音帶有日本口音，發音柔和，語氣親切且充滿熱情。
voices.original_description: Masculine, middle-aged to senior. Warm, humble, conversational, gentle Japanese accent. Modest, reflective, light airy texture. Rhythmic, thoughtful pace. Approachable, passionate.

voices.description: 一位年輕女性，聲音明亮有活力。音高屬於中高音，具有清晰的旋律感。語音自然對話式，帶有上揚的語調，親切易接近，風格現代隨性，屬於北美口音。
voices.original_description: Young adult female, bright energetic. Mid-to-high pitch, clear melodic. Natural conversational, upward inflections, friendly approachable, modern casual North American.

voices.description: 男性，30多歲中段，標準英式發音。聲音疲憊卻堅定，流暢中帶有砂啞的邊緣。分析性強，壓低的語氣，急切，音高為低中音。安靜的宇宙般權威。
voices.original_description: Male, mid-30s, British RP. Weary yet resolute, smooth with gravelly edge. Analytical, hushed, urgent, low-mid pitch. Quiet cosmic authority.

voices.description: 女性，中年，英式英國口音。聲音具備嚴謹的學術氣質，精準且音高處於中等範圍。聲音穩定，語速審慎而有控制，表現出溫柔且具權威性的特質，並帶有臨床般的嚴肅。
voices.original_description: Female, middle-aged, RP British accent. Intellectually rigorous, precise, mid-range. Steady, methodical pace, authoritative compassion, clinical gravity.

voices.description: 成熟女性，中大西洋口音。聲音清晰且具觀察力。語速審慎而有節奏感；聲音溫暖、具說服力，展現社區導向的權威感。
voices.original_description: Mature female, Mid-Atlantic accent. Sharp, observational texture. Deliberate, rhythmic pace; warm, persuasive, community-focused authority.

voices.description: 中年男性，天神。富有共鳴的男中音，平靜，有節奏感。安詳、莊嚴、具有絕對的權威。咬字精準，語氣平衡，帶有疏離感。
voices.original_description: Middle-aged male, celestial deity. Resonant baritone, calm, rhythmic. Serene, immense, absolute authority. Precise articulation, balanced, detached.

voices.description: 一位十幾歲後期的女性，聲音高亢、明亮且富有旋律感。她使用經過打磨的美國西岸口音，語速節奏感強、充滿活力，帶有谷地腔的語調。她總是充滿樂觀、說服力強，聲音中帶有年輕的氣聲與熱情。
voices.original_description: Young adult female, late teens. High-pitched, bright, melodic. Polished West Coast American. Rhythmic, upbeat pace, valley inflection. Perpetually optimistic, persuasive, breathy youthful enthusiasm.

voices.description: 年長女性，標準英式發音。溫和、學者氣息、富有同情心。語速中慢，有思索的停頓。聲音歷經風霜但清晰。善於觀察、具教學風格、溫暖的敘事方式。
voices.original_description: Elderly female, British RP. Gentle, scholarly, compassionate. Mid-slow pace, thoughtful pauses. Weathered but clear. Observational, pedagogical, warm storytelling.

voices.description: 一位30多歲的女性，擁有強烈且富有共鳴的權威語調。語音中帶有細微的南亞口音。聲音清晰有力，語調節奏明確且富有力度。
voices.original_description: Adult female mid-30s, strong resonant authoritative tone. Subtle South Asian lilt. Clear powerful texture, rhythmic punchy delivery.

voices.description: 男性成熟成年人，溫暖且具有旋律感的巴西葡萄牙語口音，哲學性且溫和深具共鳴的聲音，語速審慎而有節奏感，並帶有反思性的停頓，聲音流暢且接地，具有靈性平靜、同理心與安靜的鼓勵。
voices.original_description: Masculine mature adult, warm melodic Brazilian-Portuguese accent, philosophical gentle deeply resonant, deliberate rhythmic pace with reflective pauses, smooth grounded texture, spiritual peace empathy quiet encouragement.

voices.description: 一位女性，年齡在50多歲至60多歲之間，擁有歐洲學術口音。聲音溫暖、帶有氣聲，富有同理心。語速審慎而有節奏感，語氣平靜且具專業權威感，同時帶有溫和的莊嚴感。
voices.original_description: Mature female, 50s-60s, European academic accent. Warm, breathy, empathetic. Deliberate rhythmic pace, calm clinical authority with gentle gravity.

voices.description: 年輕成年女性，十幾歲後期。聲音柔和、溫和、誠懇。語調明亮、禮貌。音高較高但真誠。樂於助人、略帶遲疑、溫暖。具照顧他人的精神氣質，圓融善於協調，語速有節律。
voices.original_description: Young adult female, late teens. Soft, gentle, earnest texture. Bright, polite cadence. High-pitched but sincere. Helpful, slightly hesitant, warm. Nurturing, diplomatic energy, rhythmic pace.

voices.description: 男性，40多歲至50多歲，使用帶有細微斯堪的納維亞口音的英語。聲音平靜、節制，思維銳利。語調穩重、疲憊卻堅持，音高屬於低中音，語速穩定且有節奏。
voices.original_description: Male, 40s-50s, subtle Scandinavian-inflected English. Calm, measured, intellectually sharp. Grounded weary persistent tone, low-mid pitch, steady rhythmic pace.

voices.description: 女性，50多歲至60多歲，聲音溫暖、疲憊且清晰。語速中等，說話方式謹慎有條理，帶有輕微的沿海地區口音。語氣安靜自信，具母性般的善良，同時帶有銳利的專業感。
voices.original_description: Female 50s-60s, warm weary articulate. Mid-tempo methodical with slight coastal accent. Quiet confidence, maternal kindness, sharp professional edge.

voices.description: 一位男性，年齡在60多歲至70多歲之間。語氣溫和，語調有節奏感，帶有沉思的氛圍。使用拉丁美洲西班牙語口音，聲音歷經風霜但柔和。語速緩慢且審慎，有詩意的停頓與氣聲的質感。具備哲學詩人般的權威感。
voices.original_description: Mature male, late 60s-70s. Soft-spoken, rhythmic, contemplative. Latin American Spanish accent. Weathered but gentle. Slow, deliberate pace. Poetic pauses, breathy texture. Philosopher-poet authority.

voices.description: 男性，英國標準口音。學者氣質，語速穩重，聲音乾淨但溫暖。表達精準且具解釋性，語調柔和而堅定，帶有莊嚴的氣質。
voices.original_description: Senior male, RP British accent. Scholarly, measured, dry but warm. Precise, explanatory style with gentle, firm cadence and gravitas.

voices.description: 中年至年長的男性，使用精緻的法語口音英語。聲音富有共鳴，具有權威感且精準。語速審慎而有控制。聲音帶有成熟的智慧與沙啞感，表現出高雅、鼓勵的語氣。
voices.original_description: Middle-aged to senior male, refined French-accented English. Resonant, authoritative, precise. Deliberate pace. Sophisticated, encouraging, gravelly wisdom.

voices.description: 成熟女性，年齡層為50多歲至70多歲，使用中大西洋口音。聲音具領導力、知識淵博、節奏感強。聲音乾爽、富有共鳴，語速審慎而有控制。聲音風格嚴謹卻充滿熱情，具藝術家的權威感。
voices.original_description: Mature female, 50s-70s, Mid-Atlantic accent. Commanding, intellectual, rhythmic. Dry, resonant, deliberate pace. Disciplined yet passionate, artistic authority.

voices.description: 男性，中年至年長的澳洲人。聲音溫暖、熱情，帶有節奏感，音色明亮且沙啞，帶有玩味的旋律感。能量高，具鼓勵性、教學性與表達力。
voices.original_description: Male, middle-aged to senior Australian. Warm enthusiastic rhythmic delivery, bright gravelly texture, playful melodic lilt. High energy, encouraging, instructional, expressive.

voices.description: 中年男性，具有拉丁美洲西班牙語口音。聲音沙啞、粗糙且歷經風霜。語速審慎，富有詩意與哲理性。音高較低，親密卻具支配力。情緒緊張度高且受控。
voices.original_description: Middle-aged male, Latin American Spanish accent. Gravelly, weathered texture. Measured, poetic, philosophical delivery. Low-pitched, intimate yet commanding. High controlled emotional tension.

voices.description: 男性，年長，使用埃及口音的英語。充滿活力、具權威性、熱情。聲音沙啞、富有共鳴、有節奏感、強調語氣。帶有高學術熱情。具有演說家的風格，是具領導力的領域學者。
voices.original_description: Masculine, senior, Egyptian-accented English. Energetic, authoritative, passionate. Gravelly, resonant, rhythmic, emphatic. High academic excitement. Oratorical, commanding field scholar.

voices.description: 一位女性，20歲出頭，擁有輕柔抒情的女高音，聲音清澈如歌劇般晶瑩。聲音帶有氣聲，誠懇真摯，眼神中流露出驚訝與憂傷。語音流暢且有節奏感，具備嚴謹的音樂背景。
voices.original_description: Female early 20s, light lyrical soprano, crystalline operatic. Breathy earnest, wide-eyed wonder, melancholy. Fluid rhythmic, disciplined musical background.

voices.description: 成熟女性，40多歲中段到50多歲，具備精緻的標準英式發音。專業、有權威感、鼓勵人心。聲音清晰且富有共鳴，語速穩定而有節奏。語氣正式但溫暖，堅韌且具有高道德目標。
voices.original_description: Mature female, mid-40s to 50s, refined British RP. Professional, authoritative, encouraging. Clear resonant texture, steady measured pace. Formal but warm, resilient, high moral purpose.

voices.description: 一位女性，年齡在40多歲至50多歲之間，擁有北美口音。聲音歷經風霜、粗礪且具權威感，語調節奏刻意、學術化卻富有熱情，音高較低。聲音中帶著疲憊卻堅決，展現強烈的保護本能，語速穩定。
voices.original_description: Mature female, 40s-50s, North American accent. Weathered, gritty, authoritative texture. Deliberate, academic yet passionate, low-pitched. Weary but resolute, fierce protection, steady pace.

voices.description: 一位女性，年齡在50多歲至60多歲之間。聲音溫暖、富有共鳴、具權威感、豐富且富有靈魂。語調具有節奏感與旋律感，充滿深刻的同理心。說話方式既對話式又具指揮力，從低語到激勵性的高潮層層遞進。使用標準美國口音。
voices.original_description: Mature female, 50s-60s. Warm, resonant, authoritative, rich, soulful. Rhythmic, melodic cadence, deep empathy. Conversational yet commanding, hushed to inspirational crescendos. Standard American.

voices.description: 一位成熟女性的聲音，古老、深沉、富有共鳴，如同洞穴般幽遠，語速緩慢且審慎，帶有令人毛骨悚然的冷冽感，情緒疏離，語氣權威，語調具有節奏感，並帶有儀式般的莊嚴氣息。
voices.original_description: Mature female, ancient, deep, resonant, cavernous, slow, deliberate, chilling, detached, authoritative, rhythmic, ritualistic.

voices.description: 女性十幾歲後期，聲音年輕明亮略帶高音，音質溫和輕盈，誠懇熱情，節奏輕快，禮貌而興奮，語氣會從柔和沉思轉變為活潑有活力，自然對話中帶著溫暖。
voices.original_description: Female late teens, youthful bright slightly high-pitched, gentle airy texture, earnest enthusiastic, rhythmic upbeat pace, polite excitable, shifts from soft contemplative to bubbly energetic, natural conversational warm.

voices.description: 男性，50多歲後期，標準英式發音。聲音歷經風霜，帶有粗礪的質感。語氣審慎、權威，背負著秘密。語調乾澀，表現出剋制堅毅而精準的特質。音高低沉，語速緩慢，控制力極高。
voices.original_description: Masculine, late 50s, British RP. Weathered, gravelly texture. Measured, authoritative, heavy with secrets. Dry, stoic precision. Low pitch, slow pace, high control.

voices.description: 中年男性，具有優雅的英國口音。發音清晰且咬字分明，音高為中低音。語速較快但語意清晰，帶有學者般的精準與嚴謹。
voices.original_description: Middle-aged male, refined British accent. Crisp articulate delivery, medium-low pitch. Scholarly precision, fast-paced yet clear.

voices.description: 年長女性，聲音具備學識與思維活躍的特質。發音清晰，帶有中大西洋口音，語氣威嚴而溫暖，語速快速且充滿熱情。咬字清楚，講課節奏有規律，是一位經驗豐富的教授。
voices.original_description: Feminine, senior. Articulate, academic, intellectually vibrant. Mid-Atlantic accent. Authoritative yet warm, rapid enthusiastic pace. Clear enunciation, rhythmic lecture cadence. Seasoned professor.

voices.description: 一位女性，20多歲中段。聲音柔和、帶有氣聲，充滿沉思感。語調節奏帶有溫和的日本語調。聲音親密、有節奏感，並展現安靜的堅韌。語速適中至較慢，有思考性的停頓。聲音接地、誠懇。
voices.original_description: Young adult female, mid-20s. Soft, breathy, contemplative. Gentle Japanese-inflected cadence. Intimate, rhythmic, quiet resilience. Moderate to slow pace, thoughtful pauses. Grounded, sincere.
